dkar chagashis brjod/ 09sngonagleng / 13dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 15kun la gtan gros gdams ngag tu brjod pa'i phreng ba snying gi bdud rtsi/1 dam bca' bdun ma/ 192 chos bzhi ne sdu'i padme/ 263 gros 'debs thugs bskul smon tshig 314 rang tshul dpags pa'i gdams ngag 365 bla ma'i gdams ngag tshig gcig ma/ 436 gdamasangag gros 'debs gcig dril ma/ 467 lam khyer spangs bsgyur shes gsum/ 568 zhal gdams don brgyad ma/ 679 sems ngo skyong thabs kyi man ngag 7710 dam pa'i gsung lan 'brel tshad don ldan/ 8011 thugs dam gsal 'debs zab don snying dril ma/ 8412 dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi gsung lan/ 8913 theg chen gyi snying po'i lag len gnad lnga ldan pa/ 91

4 dkar chag14 chos mthun rnam thar skyong tshul/ 9515 ku swā li'i sems khrid/ 9616 snyigs dus kyi bla slob 'brel tshul la skyo ba'i smre sngags/ 9717 snyigs dus kyi skye bo mi srun pa'i 'gyur spyod la skyo ba'i smre sngags/ 9918 rang gzhan snyigs dus kyi spyod tshul sgong por smra ba drang srong bden tshig 10219 mi rtag pa'i gtam nges 'byung pho nya/ 10420 med thabs med pa'i byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams ngag 10721 sems don skyong ba'i man ngag 10822 sgom rim thugs dam gsal 'debs/ 10923 skad cig rang grol/ 11224 lta sgom spyod 'bras gnyug ma rang shar/ 11225 gsol 'debs thugs rjes gzigs zhu/ 11626 dwags brgyud lta sgom nges pa'i glu gnyug ma rang shar/ 11727 nā ro chos drug gi zab donargyan gyi me tog 12428 ni gu chos drug gi rdo rje'i gnas nges pa'i mgrin glu/ 12929 rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi dbyangs tshigarig ldan dgyes glu/ 13430 'chi medatshe'i ke'u tshang la spro ba'i thol glu/ 14031 mgrin pa'i pi waṃ dad nyams kyis brdungs pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 14132 rig 'dzin dgyes skyed kyi dga' glu thol byung / 14433skal mtshungs dgyes skyed kyi mgrin glu shugs byung / 14634sngon dran da mthong giskyo glu ring mo/ 148

dkar chag 535 rje btsun la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i gdung dbyangs/ 15236 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar rjes dran gyi gsol 'debs/ 15437 snang ba brda'i bla mar rtogs pa'i rdo rje'i mguradabyangs/ 15738 bka' drin can rnam gnyis la thugs rje bskul ba daphyid kyi dbyangs snyan/ 15939 thugs rje mngonapar bskul ba'i glu dbyangs/ 16340 mos gus kyi gdungadabyangs rnoba'i bcud len 16641 nyams len gyi rmang rdo tshugs par smon pa/ 17242 skyabs sems kyi nyams masdo/ra/ 17343 karma bde legs bzangapo'i gsung lan byung rgyal ma/ 17744 chos tshul yin min gyi shan 'byed tshangs thig 'dun ma'i yangartse/ 17945 stong nyid snying rje'i blo sbyong kun tu dgos pa'i nyams dbyangs rangagar/ 18146 las go gcig chod kyi ngang tshul rang gi sems gsos su smra ba/ 18347 tshe 'di snang gis bslus par zhe khre la ba'i mgur dbyangs shar ma/ 18548 'phral snang gdong 'ded kyi gsal 'debs/ 18749 lta sgom spyod pa'i 'phrang grol gyi gsol 'debs/ 18950 rig 'dzin bkra shis kyi gsung lan 'brel tshad don ldan/ 19051 nyams len gyi dogs sel grub thob rgya mtsho'i gshegs shul/ 19452 phyag chen lnga ldan du nyams nda/len tshul/ 19653 lta sgom spyod gsusladran shes gcig bsdus kyi man ngag 19854 lta sgom spyod pa'i gces gnad 'brel thogs smin byed mgur chungadang po/ 19955 lta spyod don gnyis lhun grub mgur chungaganyis pa/ 199

6 dkar chag56 sems ngo lta ba'i man ngag mgur chung gsum pa/ 20057 bka' brgyud rgyal sa 'dzin thabs 'dra chos bcu gcig mgur chungabazhi pa/ 20158 lha dbang bkra shis la gnang ba'i zhal gdams/ 20259 dam pa'i rnam thar tha mal dbang pos spyod pa la ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/ 20560 rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' lan lta sgomaspyod 'bras/ 20961 rtogs pa'idabang phyug tu 'gyur ba'i myur lam phyag chen/ 21262 sems khrid chos nyid bden mthong / 21463 las dang po pas sems ngo bskyang tshul/ 21564 sems nyid lhan cig skyesapa'i gshis lugs ngo sprod/ 21565 sku gsum sgrub tshul gyi man ngag gces gnad lnga pa/ 21666 mos ldan gyi gsal 'debs 'chi khar gtad thub kyi gdams ngag 21767 phyag chen sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ 21868 phyag chen lta sgom spyod 'bras mthar 'khyol gyi man ngag 21979 sems ngo skyong ba'i gces gnad thog mtha' bar gsum/ 22070 sems nyid mdo rgyud chos kun gyi rtsabar ngo sprod pa/ 22161 rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi bgrod pa mthar dbyung ba'i man ngag 22372 shan 'byed dge sbyor skyong gnad bar do 'phrang grol/ 22573 spang blang mnyam nyid du spyod tshul tshogs drug rang grol/ 22674 zab lam phyag rgya chen po'i sgom rim gnad bsdus/ 22875 thar pa'i rgyal sar 'jug pa'i nyams len gnad bsdus/ 22976 thos grol nyams snang dga' glu/ 231

dkar chag 777 phyag rdzogs tshe gcig thar lam/ 23278 gdams ngag nyams len gnad bsdus/ 23379 rang mtshang phud pa'i do ha gzhi thog rtsal rdzogs/ 23380 kun 'dus gzhi med klong grol/ 23781 rtse mo byung rgyal gyi lta ba/ 24082 gter chos dang 'brel ba'i dri lan/ 24183 bslab bya legs par baljangad pa skabs bzhi pa/ 242par byang smon tshig 259

da (/ po sta(no sdoṣṭṛtre waram̐—wa —sna〉 — — dzi ‘ pasnyosha lku ༄༅༅// susti/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbus na pad dkar ltar/ /bsngags pa'i gzi 'od stong 'bar rab 'phro zhing / /snyigs dus 'gro la lhag par brtseb yis/ /rtag tu skyong mdzad shākya'i rgyal por 'dud/ /khyod bstan yongs rdzogs pur rgyal gangs ljongs su / / dus kyi rim pas snga 'gyur gsar ma zhes/ /grags pa'i bye brag sgrub brgyud kam tshang pa'i/ /don ldan snyan pa bzang po dang ba'i yul/ /deng 'dir bstan rgyun yun du skyong ba'i slad/ /gdams pa'i mdzod rnams gcig las du ma ru/ /bkye ba'i ma smad lhag bsam cas mtsho yis/ /las kyi 'a〈snar le'i rba rlabs 'phyur 'dir bsngags//rgyu rjedar 'brel kun bde bar rab 'aṣṭharwa ning / /rgyu bzang rten 'brel thabs shes lam zhugs mthus/ /rgyu yi 'bras bu mthar thug rnam mkhyen sar/ /rgyu cesags rgya masnur dang bcas son par smon// /ces pa 'di ni 'jam mgon bla brang nas bod kyi chos brgyud spyi dang bye brag sgrub brgyud kam tshang gi phyag dawa dkon rigs khag lhu rwa1sa mtha' yas pa'i mdzod ces pa'i deb phreng du rim pas 'don spel bya 'char la/ 'di nas sgron tshig cig dgos par rten bcas bskul ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge spyong tu la'i bla mas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me phag zla 1༷ tshes 19 dang / phyi lo 2༷༷7 zla 11 tshes 28 nyin sbyar ba'o// // (tsho7

// ci co byerdo da// twaṭwāṃrngu~X ༵ba1'iṣṭa8 ༄gyi// 'jam mgon bla brang nas gsung rab spyi dang bye brag skyabasarje 'jamamagon kong sprul rin bo che dang / gang gi ring lugasasgrub brgyud kai tshang pa'i dbe rgyun nye bar mkho yang rnyed / son dka' ba'i rigasablo grosamatha' yasapa'i mdzod cesapa'i deb phreng gi rnam par don / gnyer can rnams kyi dbal du gsar bzhengasazhu ba'i lasarim la rjesasu yi rang dang / kun tu spyod pa 'disarlabasachen rgyal ba'i bstan par bya ba byed pa'i mig dper 'gyur zhing /'jam mgon bla ma'i phrin lasargyasapa'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba'i re smon bcas/ rme— rkarma pa o rgyan phrin lasardo rjes/ nang lo 2551 phyi lo 2007 zla 8 pa'i tshes 27ril—/— — ciri ———dzi

)7560so50so31sakya2jis sa ga6༄7/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad nyid bdag sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes su chags pas bsam bzhin mi'i gar du gang gdul gyi rnam par rol pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mdzad bzang gis mdzes pa'i skyes rabs phreng bar bstar ba las/ bdag cag rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 7skyabs rje 'jam mgon rin po che sku phreng gsum pa mchog gi bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed dgongs bla med du mar mchis la/ gus 'bangs gang gi zhabs 'bring du 'khod pa rnams kyis 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi mdzad 'phrin dgung du 'degs pa'i srid zhur rlom nas/ sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig 'dril gyi 'bad pas dgongs 'char 'khod pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig rags rim nas bsgrubs zin pa'i khul yin zhing / mdzad don lhag mar lus pa rnams las gtso bo zhig ni spyir ris med kyi gsung rab dang lhag par rang re bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab med du mi rung ba rnams dus 'gyur gyi pho nyas lkog tu sbas pas dpe rgyun dkon zhing phal cher nub la nye ba rnams 'tshol sgrub kyis srung skyob bstan pa nam gnas su byed pa'i dpe mdzod tshad du 'byol ba zhig dang / de'i yan lag tu gsung rab de dag don gnyer can yongs la 'grems spel khyab brdal du bya ba'i gsung rab dpe skrun sde tshan zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po yod pa ma tshad 7skyabs rje nyid la bod nas phyag dpe mi nyung ba tsam phyag son byung zin pa sogs mdzad 'char de dus nas dbu 'dzugs mdzad pa lags/

de ltar 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi bzhed don gtso bor gnas pa bzhin gus 'bangs rnams nas kyang de nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bor bzung nas 'bad rtsol nus 'tshams zhig bsten kyang dpal 'byor dang zhu sgrig pa sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'i rkyen gyis bsam sbyor don thog tu ma 'khel bar da bar rim lus su gyur/ da cha mgon po gang gi thugs bskyed dus su sad pas gnas mi longs spyod sogs gang 'thad nas mthun rkyen legs tshogs kyis gom bgrod mdun bskyod thub tsam byung ba las brtas pa'i dga' spro ni bdag cag rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i snying por 95cimarnga5/des na da lan sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan 7rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje mchog la gsol ba btab don bzhin spar skrun gyi mtshan byang du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi deb phreng zhes pa dang / deb phreng 'di yi sngon brjod thugs smon zab rgyas kyis brjed pa bka' drin bskyangs pas dbu btsugs te gsung rab deb phreng du spel ba'i las 'char 'di bzhin spel ba lags/ rnam dkar gyi bgyi ba 'di nyid kyi 'bras bur bstan 'gror sman pa rlabs chen rgya che rgyun mi chad du 'byung bas mgon po gang gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub mchod dam par gyur te/ bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar thugs rje'i ra gur las mi 'dor bar tshe rabs kun tu zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang rgyun ldan las thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i smon 'dun rtse gcig bcas deb phreng 'grems spel gyi ngo sprod du/ 'jam mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rdo rje nas spyi lo 2008zla 1 tshes 7 nyin/

dpe skrun gsal ngagond/༄tsho/ /rigs kun khyab bdag 'bor lo'i mgon po rnam par snang mdzad nyid 'gro la rjes su chags pas bsam bzhin mi'i gar du rnam par rol pa sgrub pa'i lo paṇa brgyud mar byon pa'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba mngon par mdzes shing / de dag kun gyi rnam thar phrin las gcig tu bsdoms pa lta bur sgrub bstan ris med 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad phrin rlabs chen rang re'i gsos su bskyangs pa'i dpal mgon dam pa rje 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde mchog gis skal ldan gdul bya rnams kyis ji ltar gsol ba'i ngor khams dbang mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i 66zhaldogadamasasnying gibadud rdzi’’zhes bya ba go sla zhing lag len bde ba dang /mdo rgyud kun gyi gnad don bsdus la man ngag gi chings dang ldan pa sogs khyad chos du mas khyad du 'phags pa'i tshan pa du ma rgya chen bka' mdzod du bzhugs yod cing / snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus skye 'gro kun tshe yun je thung dang / blo je rtul/'du 'dzi'i brel 'tshub je 'phel gyi skabs 'dir rgya che'i gsung rab la zhugs shing rtogs pa'i go skabs ha cang chung bas/ ji skad du/ jo bo rje lha cig gis/tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar gyis/ /

16 dpe skrun gsal bshad/zhes gsungs pa bzhin chos tshan 'di dag rang re sgrub brgyud gyi gral mthar 'khod pa rnams kyi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i chos su nges pas/ 'di nyid grub pa'i go 'phang mchog gi 'jug ngogs dam pa kho nar go zhing tshul gzhan gyis bkri bar mi nus pa'i blos 'jug dgos par gor ma chag 'on kyang glegs bam mthong bas dngangs pa'am de nyid ljags lung zhu ba'i yul tsam du 'dzin pa'i log shes gang rung gis sgo bkag nas gdams pa 'di nyid la thos bsam sgom pas go skabs don ldan mdzad pa cher nyung / ngang tshul 'di nyid la gzhig ste gdams ngag 'di dag rgya chen bka' mdzod kyi khrod na lkog tu ma lus pa'i ched zur bkod kyis par 'grems zhus na/ dwangs mkha'i nyin byed kyis pad tshal bzhad pa bzhin skal ldan yongs kyi thugs rgyud smin grol gyi cha rkyen dam par 'gyur nges pa'i re 'dun drag po mngon du phyung ste khyab spel bgyis pa lags na/ kun gyis gong gsal dge mtshan rnams la dgongs te dga' gus spro gsum thun min gyis tsha bas gdungs pa'i glang chen mtsho la 'jug pa'i tshul du thos bsam sgom rim gyis zhugs shing nan tan thugs nyams su bzhes te sgrub brgyud gong ma'i gshegs shul bsnyeg pa'i re ba don ldan yong ba'i smon 'dun rtse gcig zhu/zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi 'di la ma dpe khag gnyis byung zhing de dag la nang phan tshun mi mthun pa dang ma gsal ba mang bas/ gtso bor sde dge'i spar ma gzhir bzhag ste dpe ma bu gnyis zhib bsdur gyis lan mang 'bru 'ded kyis bklags pa sogs sgo gang 'thad nas zhu sgrig bgyis shing / gzhan yang zhal gdams 'ga' zhig las yongs rdzogs la mtshan byang mi snang bas/ deng dus kyi dpe deb dang mthun par skabs bab kyi chos tshan btsal sla ba'i ched zhu sgrig pas

dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 17dkar chag bsgrigs par mtshan byang med mi rung du mchis la/ des na gzu lum dang rang bcos su ma song bar zhal gdams so so'i sde tshan gyi nang dngos bstan brjod bya'i tshig zur gzhir bzhag ste mtshon don du mtshan byang bkod sgrig zhus yod/ de bzhin sgo gang 'thad nas rang nus shes tshod kyis g.yo med sla chos su ma song bar gang legs nan sbyor zhus yod kyang / las don 'di dag bgyis pa'i 'khos ka dang shes tshad nyams myong sogs zhan pa'i rkyen gyis 'gal 'khrul rigs 'byung srid pas/ mkhyen pa yongs su dag pa rnams kyi spyan sngar nongs bshags snying nas zhu rgyu dang chabs cig legs spel nyes 'gog gi bka' slob lam ston lhug por bka' drin bstsal gnang yod pa thugs 'jags 'tshal/dpe deb 'di nyid dngos por grub pa'i cha rkyen du mtho rim bzhi pa'i slob phrug dge slong bsam gtan mthar phyin dang chos dbyings 'gyur med rnam gnyis nas bshad grwa'i las rim dza drag che yang nyin rer chu tshod gcig gi ring bar gseng rnams su lhag bsam rnam dag gis ma dpe zhib bsdur gyis chad lhag nor bcos sogs kyi ram 'degs gnang bar rjes su yi rang zhu/ mtha' don du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis dus gsum gyi rnam par dkar ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i mthu la brten nas klog pa/ po rnams kyi thugs rgyud la sems kyi gnas lugs tha mal gyi shes pa 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po mngon du gyur te glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag nyi ma'i mdun na mun pa mi gnas pa bzhin du rang yal du song nas sa lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag gegs med myur du bgrod nas chos sku sgom med rgyal sa mngon du gyur ba'i mthus/ mi mthun pa'i rgud tshogs mtha' dag nye bar zhi zhing bde skyid phun tshogs rdzogs ldan gyi dus ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i smon 'dun shugs drag dang
da du rispru2008

༄byubya/ /rang gzhan la gtan 1stos gdams ngag gi tshul du brjod pa'i phreng ba snying gi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bsdokyigs rbedu/ /dam bca' bdun ma/'bor lo'i mgon po bka' drin mtshungs med rdo rje 'chang chos kyi rje/ chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen padma nyid byed dbang pos thugs rjes gzigs shi ga kyai ma/ bdag mi'i lus ni thob/ bstan pa'i sgor ni zhugs/ lam phyin ci ma log pa ni rnyed/mtshan ldan gyi bla ma ni mjal/ rnyed dka' ba dag/ rnyed cing rang dbang rang la yod pa'i dus 'dir/ zin dus med cing snying pos dben pa'i tshe 'di'i bya ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yud tsam pas blo mi 'brid par/ shul thag ring po tshe phyi ma phan chad la phan pa'i bsam sbyor chos mthun sna re yin kyang ci nas bya/ ga re da res rang mgo rang gis ma bton na/ 'don rogs byed mkhan su yong / 'khor ba mtha' med nas thar dus nam yod/ chos ldan gyi rten bzang po nam thob/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ang dkon la/ rab tu byung ba'ang dkon na/ smin grol gyi chos tshul zab mo dang 'phrad pa'i skal pa 'di lta bu ni rnyed mi srid pa'i tshod du gda'/ des na deng nas bzung ste rje btsun padma nyin byed dbang po'i sku gsung thugs dang ro gcig ma gyur gyi bar du dam pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa'i blo ngan/ spyod ngan tha na rmi lam du'ang mi 'byung

20 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bar bya/ 'gro 'dug za nyal ci byas kyang rung ste rang rgyud rang gis brtag rang skyon rang gis bsal/ ma ṇi rdog gcig bton pa la sems kyi 'phen pa bzang ngan lan gcig blta/ zas kham gcig za ba la blo'i skor rdzogs lan gcig byed/gnod pa dang mi dge ba'i bsam sbyor rnam pa kun tu dor nas lus ngag yid gsum byang chub kyi sems rin po che la hril dril ba ni dam du bca' ba dang po ste/rnam kun byang chub sems kyi 'phen pa gtang / /bde na byin rlabs sdug na las su shes/ /bde sdug kun la gtong len dmigs pa bsgom/ /rang sems dkar zhing dkon mchog mi khrel bya/ /bdag lta bu'i skal dman la zhal dngos su ston cing smin grol gyi byin rlabs stsol ba/ sangs rgyas kun las bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rin po cher lus dang srog la mi blta bar mnyes pa kho na bsgrub cing mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang mi bya/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang du thag bcad/ bka' drin 'khor mtha' med par gdung shugs bskyed/ bsam na rnam thar bsam/ smra na gsol 'debs byed/ mnyam bzhag tu thugs yid bsre/ rjes thob tu dag snang sbyangs/ rnam pa kun tu mos gus bsgoms nas ci mdzad ye shes kyi rol pa/ ci byung byin rlabs dang dngos grub tu shes pas snang srid bla ma chos sku'i 'khor lor blta ba dang / med bzhin du yod par 'du shes nas 'khor ba rnams su sdug bsngal mi bzad pa sna tshogs nyams su myong ba'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa yul 'don/ ma rig pa ther la 'don/ rang che 'dod dang skyid 'dod kyi 'gong po rtsad nas dbyung / thog med nas da lta'i bar du phung phung

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 21brlag brlag gi byur 'dre chos brgyad kyi rtog ngan rmi lam du skyes kyang tshar chod/ mi 'dod pa thams cad ngar 'dzin gyi steng du spungs/ mdor na ci byas chos su 'gro bar bya zhing / chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig bya ba'i dam bca' gnyis pa ste/sgrub na dpal ldan bla mar mnyes pa bsgrub/ /'dul na phung rtsa bdag 'dzin kho na gdul/ /spong na chos brgyad blo ngan 'di ka spang / /ci byas chos su 'gro ba'i las shig bya/ /srog dbugs kyis bsdus pa'i sems can la pha ma drin can sha stag tu ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med/ de yang yang nas yang du drin gyis bskyangs pa yin kyang da lta mas bu ngo ma shes/ bus ma ngo ma shes par la la ni dgra/ la la ni gnyen/ la la ni btang snyoms par gyur/ ma rgan rnams thar med 'khor ba'i btson dong na sdug bsngal du mas gtses pa 'di ltar la bdag kho na lus sems bde bas ga la chogadrin can khong rnams bde ba dang ldan na bdag 'khos dman nyam chung dbul phongs su gyur kyang shin tu dga' ste khong rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur yin/ khong rnams ma rig pa'i dbang gis bdag la dgrar lta ba dang / 'khon du 'dzin pa dang / skur ba 'debs pa dang / 'bar sha sdigs ra byed pa dang / bub kha gtong ba dang / bsnun brdeg byed pa sogs la khag ci ste yod/ slar yang bdag la brten nas ma rgan rnams kyis sdig gsog pa'i rgyu de 'dra snying re rje ang / des na bdag gis sems can rnams la 'dod chags sam/ zhe sdang ngam/ gti mug gis kun

22 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/nas bslangs pa'i mi dge ba'i sems skad cig mas bskal pa du ma'i dge 'bras 'joms pa de lta bu dang / che 'dod kyi kha thabs/ za 'dod kyi mgo bskor/ bslu 'dod kyi g.yo sgyu skad cig kyang bskyed par mi bya zhing / lus ngag yid gsum sems can gyi don du byang chub sgrub pa dang / chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rang 'khos gang yod zol zog mi bya ba sogs phar phyin drug la 'bad 'bung ci nus su 'don pa ni dam du bca' ba gsum pa ste/khro ba'i lan du slar yang mi khro zhing / / gshe dang mtshang bru brdeg la lan mi ster/ /shi yang log pa'i 'tsho bar mi spyod cing / /'gro phan g.yo sgyu med par bsgrub par bya/ /'khor mtha' med pa'i drin ldan ma rgan rnams byang chub ma thob na phan phyogs re btags kyang mi phyin pas bdag gi don ma 'grub kyang ci lto/ bdag la pha ma sems can las gnad che ba sa steng du gar yod/ khong rnams kyis tshe rabs mang por phan btags lugs ma shes pa ma gtogs bdag gi don du 'di ma byas pa med pa/ de'i phyir khong rnams 'khor ba na mtha' med du 'khor ba yin pas/bdag gis da res lus srog 'dor yang drin lan gsab nus min pas sems can gyi ched du sangs rgyas kho na don du gnyer ba las bdag la bya rgyu gzhan ci mchis/ de yang thar pa sgrub pa'i thabs su sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gsungs pa yin phyin 'di mi zab bya ba ye med cing / bzang ngan 'dems ka byar med pas/rang gi dbang po dang mthun pa zhig la nyams len mthar 'don pa yin kyang /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 23gtad so gcig kyang med pa'i gsar 'grogs re byas na/ the tshom gyis dngos grub 'gyangs/ chos spang gi las ngan bsags pa de nam yang mi bya bar/ spang la be'u phur btab pa ltar blo brtan zhing 'gyur ldog med pas byas pa lam du 'gro/ byas pa mthar phyin pa zhig bya/ rang gis nyams su ma myong bar thos long med par bshad 'dod dang / 'jig rten rnam rtog lu gu rgyud bcad nas zhag gcig bsgoms ma myong bar grub rtags 'dod pa dang / nyams rmis la mchog 'dzin gyi zhen pa sogs nam yang mi bya ba ni dam bzhi par bcas pa ste/bsgrub byar yin kyang lam la re dogs spang / /phan 'dogs yin kyang lan la re ba spang / /rnam pa kun tu chos la the tshom spang / /tshab tshub blo sna mi mang brtan par bya/ /bdag ser gos 'di gyon phyin chad shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug yin pas khong gis ci gsungs bya ba las gzhan gyi khur thang ma mchis/ khyad par sems kyis snang ba dbang du ma 'dus pas chos la khag bzhag nas/ 'jig rten chags sdang gi bsam sbyor dang / rang gi kha rgyab la brten pa'i sdig pa grangs med pa 'di mi bsag sangs rgyas la dgra gnyen ma mchis na bdag de'i rjes su 'jug pa la dgra gnyen gyi 'dzin stangs dang / de'i gleng bslang tsam yang byed don ci yod/ bu dang chung ma sogs mi gso ka med ni med pas/ dam pa'i chos gsha' ma sgrub pa de mu ges 'chi zer ba'ang ma thos na/ so nam dang tshong khe sogs la yid 'khring nas ci zhig bya/ des na bdag lus rab byung du 'dug nas sems la khyim pa'i bya gzhag

24 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dang rnam rtog bkod pa 'di mi 'thad pas deng nas mi chos rgyab tu bskyur/ lha chos dang du len/ grub thob gong ma rnams kyi mdzad spyod la mig ltos yar ldan byed pa ni dam bca' lnga pa ste/rab byung yin pas 'jig rten khur thang med/ /pha chus sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhung shing gzung / /so nam dad sogs 'phags pa'i nor bdun bsag /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong rang gi sems la bya/ /khyad par kha nyes pa kun gyi sgo yin par ma zad/ long gtam ldab ldib dge sbyor gyi sad du gsungs pas chos ldan gyi gtam las smra ba mang po mi bya/ dus kyi dbang gis ngan 'gro'i las can kho na lhan cig tu tshogs dngos bstan 'di ltar la/ bdag bla ma sangs rgyas kyis rjes su bzung ba'i pho rgod bla ma'i rnam thar skyong ba las/ khong rnams kyi mig ltos ngan pas bslab bya bag yangs su 'dor nas rang rgyud rang gis bsreg don ci ste yod/ phyogs ris kyi kha 'dzin/ chos kyi chags sdang / rnam pa kun tu rang rtsis che bas rang la nga rgyal dang rlom sems kyis rang phung zhing / gzhan la phrag dog dang zur zas gzhan rgyud dkrugs te/ mthar gnyis ka ngan song du 'phen pa'i bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi bsam sbyor tshig tu smra bar yang mi bya/ zhal gzigs/ mngon shes/ mo rmis/ mtshan rtags/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan med par yod par brdzus nas mi chos bla ma'i rdzun zhar dang zhor du 'chad de sdom pa rtsad nas brlag pa 'di nam yang mi bya ba'i dam drug par bcas pa ste/

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 25sgo gsum tha mal bag yangs mi gtong bar/ /rang nyid yid ches gzhan la dang ba 'dren/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod nga rgyal phrag dog dang / /tshul ltar 'chos pas gzhan dag bslu mi bya/ /mdor na bdag skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar byung yang blo bla ma dkon mchog la bkal/ shi ma shi med par chos bya/ spyod lam dal brel med par chos bya/ res bya res 'jog med par chos bya/ nyams len gyi mthil mos gus byang sems sgom/dge sbyor gyi mthil rang sems srung / 'gro don gyi mthil bsngo ba dang smon lam 'debs/ skad cig ma'i nyams len la 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi gnad go chod par byed de/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi ngang nas mi tshe 'gyod med cig bsgrub par dam bca' bdun pa ste/pha ma'i ngor yang sdig pa'i las mi byed/ /srog gi phyir yang dkon mchog gsum mi spang / /gshed mas brdung yang dran pa'i mdangs mi bskyur/ /'di phyi bar gsum chig dril nyams len bya/ /zhes dam bca' bya bdun ma 'di kha mang bas ma yin/ col chung bas ma yin/ mkhas khyad 'don par ma yin/ ma nus jo brdzu ma yin/ bag yangs snang shas kyis gang dran bklag cor ma yin par/ rang rgyud sra rengs chos kyi 'jur mig nas drangs phyir yin lags na/ rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po sangs

26 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas /rgyas padma nyin byed dbang po thugs rje dang mthu chen por ldan pa khyed kyis bsam don mtha' dag bar chad med par stan thog 'di nyid du nyams su lon par byin gyis rlobs shig re sa gzhan na med do/ /ci mdzad khyed rang mkhyen/ skyob pa ni khyed kho na lags la/ snying rje'i yul ni bdag yin na 'khor ba dang ngan song gsum du e gtang khyed rang mkhyen no// //chos bzhi ne sdu'i padme/7/da ni thugs rjes zungs shig lags/ /slar yang byang chub lam gyi rtsa ba dang / /yan lag mang yang nyams su len pa la/ /med thabs med pa'i gnad 'gag mdor bsdus 'ga'/ /rnam kun rang dran gso phyir brjod par bya/ /dang po bdag gi bya cha 'di bzhir bsdu/ /thos pa'i go bas spros pa phyi nas bcad/ /bsam pa'i nyams myong mthil phyin rgyud la bkal/ /sgom pa'i rtogs pas gnyis snang zad sar bskyal/ /gnas skabs kun tu tha mal ma rberter bya/ /de yang rgyud la phan nges bya tshul bzhi/ /thos pa'i dus su phyogs ris med par bya/ /bsam pa'i dus su the tshom chod par bya/ /sgom pa'i dus su rtogs pa thob par bya/ /bya ba ci byas 'gyod pa med par bya/ /de la gal gnad che ba rnam bzhi ni/ /thos dus blo sna rtse gcig bsdu ba gnad/ /sems dus blo gros rgya yangs bskyed pa gnad/ /sgom dus blo rtog thad kar gcod pa gnad/ /dus kun blo thag yang yang bstung ba gnad/ /mdo don dril ba'i bstun pa rnam bzhi ni/ /phyi tshul so sor thar pa'i khrims dang bstun/ /nyams len theg rtse phyag rdzogs gnyis dang bstun/ /bsam sbyor thams cad byang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 27chub sems dang bstun/ /sgo gsum ci byas dam pa'i chos dang bstun/ /dgos don 'grub pa'i gtad pa rnam bzhi ni/ /blo sna 'gyur ldog mi mang gcig la dril/ /nyams len the tshom mi bya gcig mthar 'don/ /skyo ngal btang snyoms mi bya 'bad pas brtson/ /re dogs tshab tshub mi bya de gar klod/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dga' ba rnam bzhi ni/ /gzhan phan gyur na bdag nyid sdug pas dga'/ /chos phyir dka' ba ji ltar che yang dga'/ /dkon mchog khrel las rang nyid shi ba dga'/ /chos dang ma mthun mi rtsis chung na dga'/ /dgos pa rnam bzhi mkhas pa'i pha zog ni/ /bla ma bsten tshe gdams ngag phyug pa dgos/ /rang rkya bzung tshe blo thag chod pa dgos/ /yon tan skye tshe zhen pa med pa dgos/ /rkyen ngan byung tshe gnad du 'gro ba dgos/ /chos lugs kun la mkho ba'i mchog bzhi ni/ /mi mang khrod du smra brjod nyung ba mchog /gcig pur 'dug dus btsun tshugs bzung ba mchog /khur thang med pa'i blo rgya bskyung ba mchog /bya ba ci yang brtags shing byed pa mchog /bgrod par mi bya'i 'gro sa rnam bzhi ni/ /lta ba kha khyer dred po chos rdugs 'gro/ /ma smin chos bshad rang phung byur du 'gro/ /mi mkhas byed mang dka' ba don med 'gro/ /dus min 'gro don gnyis med seng ger 'gro/ /don chung 'dra yang 'phral phugs bde bzhi ni/ /rtog ge pa dang mi smra chags sdang bslang / /blun po rnams dang mi smra yi mug skye/ /legs bshad byis pa'i kha na 'dug kyang 'dri/ /chos min bshad na gong ma'i gsung yang bor/ /shes nas bor bar bya ba rnam bzhi ni/ /don med dpe nyog bltas na dran mang langs/ /byed rgyu ha cang mang na mdo rtsa shor/ /mig ltos ngan pas rang rgyud bag yangs 'gro/ /lab gleng mang na nyon mongs dug ro bslang / /'phral phugs gnyis kar 'cheng ba'i chos bzhi ni/ /sne gcig bsrung yang ngo lkog

28 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/med na 'tsheng / /mang mi shes kyang nges pa rnyed na 'tsheng / /phan ma thogs kyang gnod sems med na 'tsheng / /phyogs ris med kyang rang rkang bzung na 'tsheng / /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba rnam bzhi ni/ /blo thag chod na ji ltar byas kyang bde/ /rang sems dkar na shi'am gson kyang bde/ /chags sdang med na su dang 'grogs kyang bde/ /nyam thag byung yang re ba med na bde/ /chog pa rnam bzhir blo phugs bkal ba ni/ /gzhan ma mgu yang g.yo sgyu med pas chog /grub rtags med kyang chos dang mthun pas chog /rtogs pa dman yang nyon mongs gnon pas chog /brtson 'grus zhan yang res 'jog med pas chog /gal gnad che ba'i thag chod rnam bzhi ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su kho thag bcad/ /rang sems ma bcos chos skur kho thag bcad/ /'dir snang zhen 'dzin mi bya kho thag bcad/ /blo phugs chos la gtad par kho thag bcad/ /rgyun du dgos pa'i spyod lam rnam bzhi ni/ /rang gis bltas na rang yid ches par bya/ /gzhan gyis bltas na gzhan dag mgu bar bya/ /dkon mchog bla mas gzigs na mi khrel bya/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ka mi bslu bya/ /med pa rnam bzhir mgo gtad bya ba ni/ /byin rlabs spyan ras gzigs las che ba med/ /rig sngags yi ge drug las zab pa med/ /dag snang khyer so gsum las dga' ba med/ /'gro don sems bskyed bzang las lhag pa med/ /dang du len pa'i drin chen rnam bzhi ni/ /rang la ngo sprod bla ma bka' drin che/ /bod la o rgyan chen po bka' drin che/ /thar pa bsgrub la dmyal ba bka' drin che/ /dngos grub thob la rkyen ngan bka' drin che/ /'dug tshul 'di bzhi sems la skor rdzogs bya/ /phyogs ris che ba chos pa'i mtshang du 'dug /rnam rtog mang ba bdud kyi g.yab mor 'dug /nga rgyal rloms sems 'bor ba'i gting rdor 'dug /phyogs re ra zhen

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 29pa thos chung skyon du 'dug /ma nus jo bzang 'dra ba rnam bzhi ni/ /sems rgyud thul na 'dug sa gar yang 'dra/ /skyong lugs shes na sgrim glod gang byas 'dra/ /lam khyer shes na skyid sdug gang byung 'dra/ /nyams len nus na dam chos gang bsgrub 'dra/ /bsgom par bya ba'i mdo 'gag rnam bzhi ni/ /dge sbyor snying po bla ma'i mos gus bsgom/ /nyams len snying po byams dang snying rje bsgom/ /spros bcas snying po gtong len rdor bzlas bsgom/ /spros med snying po phyag rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom/ /gcig tu gal che zab pa'i chos bzhi ni/ /bya thabs sla yang rdo rus gtugs pa zab/ /dang por nyams len gang byas mthar 'don zab/ /rtag tu dran shes rang tshugs ma shor zab/ /gang byung dgos kyang dang po bcos pa zab/ /dus rgyun dgos pa'i mi lto rnam bzhi ni/ /sa chod chung yang mi lto ngo bo skyong / /chos spyod ma nus mi lto rang rgyud 'dul/ /yod kyang mi lto zhen chags 'dzin 'khri bcad/ /med kyang mi lto nam 'chi cha med bsam/ /ma byas thabs med bgrod gcig bzhi pa ni/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres kyang mos gus bya/ /thams cad stong par go yang las 'bras 'dzems/ /bdag gzhan dbyer med rtogs kyang snying rje bskyed/ /chos lugs mang yang dwags po'i rjes su zhugs/ /las dang po yi skyong lugs gces pa bzhi/ /the tshom byung yang mi bskyur skyong ba gces/ /gnas 'gyu mi gdam thad kar skyong ba gces/ /nyams kyi sna kha mi bskyil skyong ba gces/ /yul rkyen 'phrod tshe bsgrims nas skyong ba gces/ /'byed par dka' ba'i spang blang rnam bzhi ni/ /zab kyang yid yul 'dug pa'i go ba bsal/ /bzang yang myang byar yod pa'i nyams dang phral/ /yid dpyod rang zhig song ba'i rtogs pa 'tshol/ /rang rtsis ma che gzhan las zhun thar gcad/ /yin pa bzhi yis nyams len skyong ba ni/ /rtsir zin byas na

30 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rang nyid 'ching ba yin/ /gar 'gror btang na 'dir 'gro med pa yin/ /lhod kyis klod na sa ler 'char ba yin/ /dran tsam ma gtogs cham gyis bskyur ba yin/ /bzhag thabs rnam bzhi bye ba ring bsrel ni/ /gang shar so ma blo yis ma reg bzhag /'jur bus mi bcings dran tsam ngang du bzhag /gang byung des chog tha mal lhug par bzhag /rang gsal klong du rang grol yan par bzhag /btang tshul rnam bzhi chos kyi snying po ni/ /snang ba dgag sgrub med par bun long btang / /gang shar bcos bsgyur med par phya le btang / /bde sdug spang len med par shigs ser btang / /bzang ngan gdam pa med par khro ler btang / /gal mdo nges pa'i 'dus so rnam bzhi ni/ /nyams len mos gus snying rjer 'dus par bya/ /lta sgom dran tsam chog la 'dus par bya/ /spyod lam chos nyid ngang du 'dus par bya/ /rang rgyud 'dul la chos rnams 'dus par bya/ /sgom byung brdol ba'i do ha ma lags kyang / /mdo rgyud zab mo mthong zhing nang du yang / /cung zad brtags nas nyams la gang shar du/ /bzhi tshan sum cur dril ba'i glu chung len/ /yon tan 'di dag bdag la ma mchis pas/ /gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i re med kyang / /ma shi'i bar du rang dran gso snyam pas/ /mi chos bla ma'i nyes pa med snyam bgyid/ /de phyir 'di smras 'di la 'brel thogs bcas/ /gegs dang gol sas nam yang mi bslu bar/ /khyab bdag padma nyin byed dbang po dang / /thugs yid gcig 'dres byang chub ro gcig shog /ces gang dran thol byung brjod pa'i ne tso'i padme 'di ni rang lo nyer bzhi par dpal spungs sgrub khang du sdod skabs bris par gda'o// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 31gros 'debs thugs bskul smon tshig7/ bka' brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang rje btsun sgrol ma dgongs/ /'chi ba ma dran tshe 'di sgrub pa yi/ /dal 'byor stong zad nga la thugs rjes zungs/ /rmi lam 'dra ba'i mi tshe yad yud 'di/ /skyid kyang rung la sdug kyang rung bas na/ /skyid sdug gnas la yid smon mi byed par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /rlung gseb mar me 'dra ba'i mi tshe 'di/ /thung yang rung la ring yang rung bas na/ /bdag 'dzin dam por kha bsnon mi 'debs par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /slu byed sgyu ma 'dra ba'i rnam dpyod 'di/ /'grigs kyang rung la ma 'grigs kyang rung bas/ /chos brgyad khyer zhwa rtswa ltar dor nas su/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /shing kha'i bya tshogs 'dra ba'i grwa 'khor 'di/ /'dus kyang rung la 'bral yang rung bas na/ /sna thag rang gi mgo la dkri ba yis/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /lo brgya'i khang rul 'dra ba'i sgyu lus 'di/ /'tsho yang rung la 'gyel yang rung bas na/ /zas gos sman gyi rtsol bas mi 'ching bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra ba'i chos tshugs 'di/ /zin yang rung la shor yang rung bas na/ /zar zir mang pos rang mgo mi bskor bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /me long gzugs brnyan 'dra ba'i lha 'dre 'di/ /phan yang rung la gnod kyang rung bas na/ /rang snang 'khrul pa dgra ru mi blta bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /rjes med brag ca 'dra ba'i 'khrul gtam 'di/ /snyan yang rung la ma

32 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/snyan yang rung bas/ /dkon mchog gsum dang rang sems dpang bzhag nas/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /sha ba'i rwa 'dra dgos dus mi phan pa/ /shes kyang rung la ma shes kyang rung bas/ /rig gnas tsam la blo gtad mi 'cha' bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /btsan dug ha la 'dra ba'i dkor rdzas 'di/ /byung yang rung la ma byung yang rung bas/ /log 'tsho'i sdig la mi tshe mi bskyal bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /khyi lud dar bstums 'dra ba'i bla gzugs 'di/ /thob kyang rung la ma thob kyang rung bas/ /rang mgo rul ba sna yis tshor nas su/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra ba'i gnyen 'brel 'di/ /mdza' yang rung la 'khon yang rung bas na/ /zhen pa'i gdos thag snying nas bcad pa yis/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /rmi lam nor rnyed 'dra ba'i zang zing 'di/ /yod kyang rung la med kyang rung bas na/ /mthun 'jug ngo dgas gzhan mgo mi bskor bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /byi'u chung shing rtser bab 'dra'i go sa 'di/ /mtho yang rung la dma' yang rung bas na/ /rang sdug gnas la yid smon mi byed par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /mtshon cha 'dra ba'i dbang sdud ngan sngags 'di/ /'grub kyang rung la ma 'grub kyang rung bas/ /rang srog gcod pa'i spu gri mi nyo bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /nee tso'i yig drug 'dra ba'i don brjod 'di/ /byas kyang rung la ma byas kyang rung bas/ /byas byas mang po'i rnam grangs mi bgrang bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /ri bo'i 'bab chu 'dra ba'i bshad pa'i chos/ /mkhas kyang rung la ma mkhas kyang rung bas/ /kha bshad mkhas la chos su mi bsgoms par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 33byed par shog /phag pa'i sna 'dra dpyad pa myur ba'i blo/ /rno yang rung la rtul yang rung bas na/ /don med chags sdang zegs ma mi bslang bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /dbyar gyi rka chu 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor nyams/ /'phel yang rung la 'brid kyang rung bas na/ /byis pa 'ja' tshon rjes su mi 'ded par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /ri mgo'i char ba 'dra ba'i dag snang 'di/ /shar yang rung la ma shar yang rung bas/ /'khrul pa'i nyams la bden par mi bzung bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par rbesgog /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i dal 'byor 'di/ /ma thob dam chos sgrub thabs mi 'dug pas/ /rang lag yod dus chud zos mi byed par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /thar lam sgron me dpal ldan bla ma 'di/ /ma mjal gnas lugs rtogs thabs mi 'dug pas/ /gar 'gro shes dus g.yang la mi mchong bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /nad sel sman dang 'dra ba'i dam chos 'di/ /ma thos spang blang shes thabs mi 'dug pas/ /phan gnod shes dus btsan dug mi 'gom par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /dbyar dgun res 'dra'i skyid sdug 'gyur ldog 'di/ /ma mthong nges par 'byung thabs mi gda' bas/ /sdug res rang la 'khor bar thag chod nas/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /chu rdo chu gting bying 'dra'i 'khor ba'i nang / /dko/na mchog thugs rje'i dpyangs thag btang ba la/ /da res ma zin phyis nas mi zin pas/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /nor bu'i gling 'dra thar pa'i yon tan rnams/ /ma shes brtson 'grus rtsom thabs mi 'dug pas/ /gtan du rgyal ba'i khe gzang mthong nas su/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /bdud rtsi'i bcud 'dra dam pa'i rnam par

34 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/thar/ /ma mjal yid ches skye thabs mi 'dug pas/ /pham rgya la shes dus rang sdug mi nyo bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /zhing sa gshin po 'dra ba'i byang chub sems/ /ma skyes sangs rgyas thob thabs mi 'dug pas/ /don chen sgrub la btang snyoms mi 'jog par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /col chung spre'u 'dra ba'i rang sems 'di/ /ma bsrung nyon mongs spang thabs mi 'dug pas/ /smyon pa'i lad mo ci bder mi byed par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /lhan skyes grib ma 'dra ba'i bdag 'dzin 'di/ /ma spangs bde sar phyin thabs mi 'dug pas/ /dgra bo zin dus bshes su mi bsten par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /thal gseb me 'dra dug lnga'i rtog pa 'di/ /ma chom sems nyid rnal du mi gnas pas/ /dug sbrul phru gu rum du mi gso bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /snum kog 'dra ba'i rang rgyud dred po 'di/ /ma dul chos dang rang rgyud mi 'dre bas/ /rang skyes phru gu skyag langs mi gtang bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /chu klung 'bab 'dra bag chags ngan goms 'di/ /ma bcad chos min spyod dang mi 'bral bas/ /mtshon cha dgra bo'i lag tu mi 'tshong bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /zin med chu gnyer lta bu'i rnam g.yeng 'di/ /ma spangs brtan pa thob thabs mi gda' bas/ /ci byas chog dus 'khor ba mi bsgrub par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /sbos rgya'i ri mo 'dra ba'i dgos dgos 'di/ /ma bskyur dam chos gsha' ma mi 'grub pas/ /long bas glang mjug zin dus mi gtang bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /sa chu dros 'dra bla ma'i byin rlabs 'di/ /ma zhugs rang ngo 'phrod thabs mi gda' bas/ /nye lam sleb dus sa rgya mi bskor bar/ /dam pa'i

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 35chos la nan tan byed par shog /dbyar gyi sman ljongs 'dra ba'i dben sa 'di/ /ma bsten yon tan skye thabs mi gda' bas/ /ri la gnas dus grong nag mi 'grim par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /bse rag phugs su zhugs 'dra'i skyid 'dod 'di/ /ma phral sdug bsngal rtsol sgrub mi chad pas/ /ltogs 'gong phug gi lha ru mi mchod par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /mkhar gyi sgo lcags 'dra ba'i dran shes 'di/ /ma bsten 'khrul pa'i rgyu 'grul mi chad pas/ /rkun ma yod dus sgo cha mi klod par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /'gyur med nam mkha' lta bu'i gnas lugs zhal/ /ma mjal gnyen po'i byed rtsol mi zhig pas/ /rang gis rang nyid lcags su mi bcug par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /dri med shel gong 'dra ba'i rig pa'i gshis/ /ma rtogs rtsa bral gzhi rtsa mi chod pas/ /'bral med 'grogs dus gzhan la mi 'tshol bar/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /sngar 'dris grogs 'dra tha mal shes pa'i ngo / /ma 'phrod byas tshad bslu ba'i chos yin pas/ /mig bu btsums nas sbar tshod mi byed par/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan byed par shog /ston pa'i gdams ngag a ti shas bstan cing / /bka' brgyud rnams kyis thugs nyams bzhes pa yi/ /byang chub sems gnyis rgyud la skyes gnas su/ /byas tshad dam pa'i chos su 'gro bar shog /chos bzhin gdams na bla mar log lta dang / /las ngan lhongs tshe lha la yi chad dang / /'gal rkyen byung na sgrub pa bshol ba sogs/ /dngos grub thob kar bar chad ma gyur cig /byas tshad thams cad don med sa stong bskor/ /'bad tshad thams cad rang rgyud rengs pa'i rgyu/ /dran tshad thams cad zhabrul pa'i kha snon btab/ /so skyes chos su rlom kun rang bcing rgyu/ /bya rgyu mang la grub

36 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'bras gcig kyang med/ /dran rgyu mang la gtad so ci yang med/ /dgos dgos mang la 'dzoms dus med pa yi/ /bya ba btang nas gdams ngag sgoms shig gu/ /bya'o bsam na rgyal gsung dpang por tshugs/ /byed do bsam na rang rgyud chosatshodang bsres/ /sgrub bo bsam na bka' brgyud rnam thar ltos/ /langs 3(ra khyod la bya ba gzhan gyis ci/ /dma' sa zin cing chog shes nor gyis phyug /chos brgyad 'ching grol sgrub la snying rus sra/ /bla ma'i byin zhugs rtogs pa mkha' dang mnyam/ /bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i rgyal rabs zin par rbestog /ces rang la gros 'debs dang /lhag pa'i lha'i thugs rje bskul ba'i smon tshig gi tshul du spong ba par mos pa yon tan rgya mtshos dben pa'i rir smon pa dge/ //rang tshul dpags pa'i gdams ngagalje/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma padma nyin mor byed pa'i zhabs kyi padmor spyi bos phyag byas nas gdams pa'i tshul cung zad gsol na/ rang re rnams mi'i lus rmi lam gyi rgyal srid lta bu zhig thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal ba ni dbul pos nor bu rnyed pa las kyang sdug cing phangs/ de las kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa dwa phrug pha ma dang 'phrad pa las kyang 'tshengs che ba 'di 'dra'i phun sum tshogs pa rnyed dus/ dam pa'i chos snying khung rus pa'i gting nas mi bsgrub par rnam g.yeng rlung khyer gyi 'khor lo bskor nas tshe thung dgun kha'i nyi ma dang 'dra ba 'di yud tsam la stong par zad de/ mtho ris dang thar pa la phyir phyogs shing gtan gyi bde ba'i 'jug ngogs rang nyid kyis phral ba ni mig yod kyang long

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 37ba/ rna bas nyan kyang 'on pa/ smra she/sa kyang lkugs pa/ dran pa rnal du gnas kyang smyon pa zang mar song 'dug pa'i rang tshul rang gis shes pa gnyid log pa'i zhabrul snang glo bur du sangs pa ltar/ rang yid rang la ches shing rang mtshang rang gis brus te/ dus da lta/ stan thog 'di nyid nas bzung sgo gsum dge ba'i srang la gzhal te sdig pa mi dge ba'i bsam sbyor lta ci smos/ btang snyoms lung ma bstan du'ang skad cig ma shor bar bya snyam pa 'di chos rgyud la skyes ma skyes thams cad la rnam pa kun tu gces nor gyi dbyig dam bca'i go cha ste/ 'di med na blo sha ba brgyad pa'i rwa bzhin 'jig rten 'dir ltos kyi gal che gcig song gcig mthud chu gnyer lta bu'i bya ba zin med kyi sbubs nas thar pa'i dus mi 'ong bar 'dug pas/chos nyams su len na thog mar blo thag rang gis gcod pa kho na gal che/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dang / tha na zas kham gang dang / gos lus gang la'ang 'khri ba ma chod par zhen pa dungs dungs/ chags pa kam kem byas/ bslab gnyer/ dbang lung / go rtogs/ 'chad spel/ dad gus/ snying rje/ dag snang / nyams myong sogs chos kyi yon tan la nyung ngus chog shes pa'i dge bshes mang pos rang gzhan grub mtha' kun la khyab pa'i spyan ltos log pa de ma bslab par shes shing lag tu thebs/ yang dag pa'i spyod pa ston ka'i sprin ltar dengs pa la blo chod pa skad byed pa mang yang / de ni bstan pa yun ring du mi gnas par byed pa'i dge sbyong ltar bcos pa deng sang 'byung bar lung gis bstan pas na/ de'i lad mo mi bya bar rang rgyud dge ba'i phyogs mtha' dag la bslab/ gdams ngag be'u bum chang chung la gces spras che drags/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang rgyab 'gal du song ba de blun drags pa'i skyon yin/ rnam pa kun tu yid rton pher ba ni rgyal ba'i bka' yin/ dpang po

38 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rang gi sems kho na bzang bas gzhan dag gis bstod par re/ smad par dogs/gzhan gyis ma bkur dogs/ gzhan dang ma mthun dogs pa'i chos pa de/ ji ltar byas kyang zla ba dkar yang mun pa'i shan zhig yod pas rang 'dod kyi sems khral rtsa ba nas spangs te/ mdo sngags grub mtha' rang nyid gang la dad pa de la the tshom med par 'jug cing lta spyod bka' dang mthun na sems rgyud chos dang 'dres bya ba lags/ grub pa ci ltar byas na thob ma shes par grub thob dang rtogs ldan sogs ming snyan po zhig la re ba bcas nas thos bsam khyi lud ltar dor ba dang / mkhas pa'i grags pas khyad thon du re bas mi tsher dpe hrul klog pa'i g.yeng bas nyams len yid smon du lus pa gnyis ka'ang tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pas sgom pa gtsor bton cing thos bsam phyogs rer ma song bas chos kyi spyan yangs par bya/ston pa la gus pa rnyed na bstan pa la gces spras 'byung ba yin/ de'i rgyu sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs tsam re ma thos thabs med/ rgyal ba'i yon tan la snying thag pa nas yid ches skyes na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob 'dod dang / tshogs mtha' yas pa bsag 'dod dang / mkha' khyab sems can rnams kyi don du bskal pa mang por 'khor bar 'khyams kyang skyo ngal med pa'i theg pa chen po'i sems rnal ma de rgyud la skye ba yin/ lar mi rtag pa gsha' ma zhig skyes nas tshe phyi ma yod par yid nges par ches na/ tshe 'di'i 'phral snang gi lto gos la'ang mi ltos par chos gsha' ma snying nas bsgrub nus pa zhig 'ong bar gda' bas bshad pa mang po'i kha na med/ nam 'chi cha med dang 'jig rten pha rol tu las rgyu 'bras rang thog tu smin nges pa'i dran 'dun du re ba dang ma 'bral bar mdzod/ chos rgyud la sbyor bar byed pa la rang sems rang gis 'dul nus dgos kyang / chos spyod bsnyen sgrub tu

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 39btags pa sogs 'di mi byed bya ba med pa'i spros spros mang pos rang sems gnya' rengs su btang nas lam rtags kyi yon tan lta zhog ngag nus tsam mam/sems gnas gsha' ma zhig kyang skyes ma 'dod par chos brgyad kyi rnal 'byor mchog cig grub nas/ chos dang gang zag kun la dag snang gi mig 'grib ste rang che nga rgyal gyi khong 'tshang can zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ rnam pa kun tu rang gi sems la zon bcug nas lto rgyab ma phyid dogs pa'i sems khral tsam yang spangs te/ 'jig rten su dang yang ngo mi bstun par nyon mongs dang bdag 'dzin ci thul la 'bad pa zhig byung tshe thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi bcad khrigs sogs ma byung yang bzod/ 'on kyang thun dang thun mtshams khrigs kha tshad la phebs pas rang rgyud chos kyi srang du ma gcun na/ thog med ngan goms kyi bag chags dang 'dris drags pa'i blo 'di/ byis pa langs shor ltar tshe 'di'i bslu kha kho nar 'chor bas sgom byed pa la dmigs rkang mang nyung dang bshad rgya che chung sogs la rag ma las par thun gcig gi khong nas rdo rus 'phrod pa zhig ma byung thabs med/ grub mtha' so sos bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang zhing thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i lam du 'du yang / dpe bltas dang go ba skam po'i nyams rtogs de rtswa kha'i zil pa dang mtshungs par re zhig bden bden ltar snang yang grul mi thub par myur du yal ba yin pas/dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i lugs kyis chos dang sems su bsre ba la bla ma chos sku'i mos gus lam du byed de/ kha nang du log nas rang sems rang gis bsrung ba ma gtogs bya rgyu gzhan med pa yin/ 'dod pa la blo ma log na chos rgyud la 'byor ba'i dus mi 'ong bas 'khri ba btsan thabs su bcad pa 'di phyag rgya chen po'i sgrub thabs ches zab pa yin pas/ rnam par rtog pa re re bzhin yang 'od gsal ba'i

40 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ dbyings su bya lam rjes med du gcod nus na rim gnyis kyi grub 'bras thams cad de'i nang du don gyis 'du ba lags/lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis tshad mar grub cing nyams rtogs rgyun ma chad pa'i lta sgom phyin ci ma log pa zhig rgyud la yod na/ snang tshul ji ltar rung lhag pa'i bslab pa las 'da' bar mi 'gyur bas skyon brgya yon tan gcig gis zil gyis gnon pa dang / lung dang mi mthun cing stong nyid la mngon par zhen pa'i lta ba rtogs pa dang ma 'bral la/ nyams myong gi drod dang bral bar gyur na spyod pa ji lta legs kyang khams gsum pa'i rgyu 'bras can yin pas yon tan brgya skyon gcig gi 'og tu chud pa ste/ des na so skye'i blo'i 'khrul 'khor ji tsam bskor yang phye ma leb kyis nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol ba bzhin du chos kyi dbyings de kho na nyid gtan la dbab par mi nus pas/ byin rlabs kyi rim pa las 'ong zhing dbang gi ye shes bde ba chen po dang rjes su 'brel ba'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i thabs bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa la/ le lo dang the tshom skad cig kyang ma shor bar gnad du bsnun na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas lugs tshegs chung ngus mngon sum du gtan la dbab par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i tshul yang bod yul 'dir yongs su grags pa'i mi zab pa dang zab pa'i rdzogs rim ji snyed cig mchis pa las rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa ni de'i gong na ga zhan ma mchis pa'i chos te/ bstan pa 'di'i chos tshul thams cad las khyad du 'phags shing snying po'i bcud du gyur pa rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bu/ rgyud kyi lung khungs/ sa bcu pa'i 'grel ba/ man ngag gi zab khyad/ byin rlabs kyi tshan kha bcas rnam pa

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 41bzhis khyad par du byas pas bsgom bya'i gdams ngag 'di las lhag pa stong gsum du btsal yang rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ so so'i skye bo'i rnam rtog gis gsar du bcos pa'i dmigs rkang sa bcad mdzes mdzes su bsgrigs kyang sems can bslu ba'i nag po'i chos dang / bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi rtsa lhung chabs cig par dang du blang ba tsam las dgos pa gang yang ma mchis pas tha na'ang dben gsum dang sor sdud tsam re 'byang bar mdzad tshe mi lus thob pa don dang ldan zhing rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'bras bu can du byas pa lags/mdo sngags rgya gang che la 'jug pa'i khul byed kyang mdo sngags kyi zab don rang de g.yas chung du bzhag nas 'jig rten pa dang thun mong du gsungs pa'i tshogs gsog gi sgor 'bad pa ni/ spyir dge ba mi dran pa la ltos na ngo mtshar che mod kyi rnal 'dresar pa la 'gangs che rgyu med/ dben sa bsten/ phyi mtshams bsdams/thun bzhir bcad kyang lus sems dben tu ma btub par/ dgos dgos kyi g.yeng bas khyer ba de mi smon jo bzang tsam las dge sbyor rnal ma rgyud la skye ba'i dus mi 'ong bar 'dug sems 'brul rtog gis dben na dben pa'i mchog yin/ gzung 'dzin la a 'thas brgyud mar skye ba 'di dran shes kyis nam zin na rang grol du 'gro bas/ rang byung gnyug ma'i gshis la dgag sgrub re dogs kyi mdud pas mi bcing bar rig pa 'gyur med kyi ngang du rang sems bzo med du bskyur nas gang shar gtad med du btang na ci snang chos nyid du grol bas/goms 'dris kyi shugs chung ba'i lan gyis yengs 'khrul du song ba'i skabs ma gtogs mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin pas sems phyogs pa rnams kyis khrid thams cad kyi don dran shes kho na la bsdu ba yin/

42 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/des na dwags snying pa'i ring lugs 'khrul med rnams kyis nyams len lag tu blang bya dngos de/ mi rtag pa snying la gzer/ nges 'byung gsha' ma skyes/ las rgyu 'bras srog ltar btsa'/ dag snang gi mig yangs/ mos gus la snying phur btsugs pa gzhir bzhag nas/ thun mang nyung ring thung gang ltar byas kyang dmigs rkang mang nyung / lung rigs kyi dpyad pa/ 'don bzlas kyi grangs ka sogs la gtso bor mi byed par/ las dang po pas lus gnad lta stangs sems 'dzin gyi rtsol ba tsam ma gtogs pa chams kyis bzhag lhod klod la/ don nyung / bya ba nyung / 'khrul pas mi g.yeng / bzo med kyi rig pa la 'pho 'gyur med/ 'od gsal gyi 'char sgo gong du 'phel/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams len rjes thob tu khyer nus shing / de gnyid dang bar do la sleb thub pa zhig la gtsor bton par gda' bas mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ chos 'di'i lugs kyi nyams len de rang la rag las pa yin/ gzhan gyi mthun rkyen 'dzom ma 'dzom sogs la ltos mi dgos/'on kyang nyams len la brtan pa zhig ma thob bar du sgo gsum spros pa sna tshogs kyis g.yeng ba 'di chos rgyud la mi 'byor ba'i gegs che shos yin pas/rig pa dwangs shing dge sbyor 'phel ba'i gnas gcig tu mos gus dang / yengs med khor yug la sa rde'u btsugs na rlan drod 'dzom pa'i myu gu bzhin du zhag skyed zla skyed thon pa la the tshom mi bdog 'chi ba ma dran pa'i mi dang blo bstun na 'jig rten gyi g.yeng bas dbang med du g.yengs shing chos min gyi bsam sbyor ma tshor bar 'byung bas/ gzhan gyi kha la mi rgyug par rang gi bya ba rang nyid kyis thag bcad nas rang blo rang gis bkol btub pa zhig dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung mi bden zer mkhan nang pa la med kyang rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gdams ngag la

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 43yid ches ma skyes pa'i thog lta spyod zab mo phal cher la the tshom gyis bar du bcad nas nyams su len pa'i skal pa chad cing / blang ba'i khul bgyis pa la'ang 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus mi 'ong ba zhig snang ba 'di chos kyis go ma chod pa'i skyon min/gang zag gi skyon yin pas chos dang gdams ngag la the tshom med pa'i yid ches kyis nyams len zhig nus phyin chad/ tog ce ba tog tsi'i sems 'dzin gyis de kho na nyid mngon du gyur pa bzhin rgyud grol ba la tshig mang nyung khyad par med pas zab mo'i lam la nges shes thag chod pa zhig gal che ba lags/ zhes rang tshul la dpags te gdams ngag gi rnam pa cung zad brjod pa 'di'ang lung rtogs yon tan gyis phyug pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos gsung bskul ma ldog tsam du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal sbungs gdan sar bris pa gzhan rgyud chos dang mthun pa'i rkyen du gyur cig/ //bla ma'i gdams ngag tshig gcig ma/7/ mchog gsum kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang padma nyin byed dbang po la skyabs su mchi'o/ /blo kha chos la phyogs pa rnams ci byas chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs shig yang skal ldan chos la mos pa rnams bsam mno re thongs mdzod dang /dal 'byor gyi mi lus ni thob dka'/ 'chi bdag gi bdud po ni zhe gnag mi rtag pa nam 'ong ni cha med/ rang byas kyi 'bras bu ni chud mi za bas da res rdog sna 'dred na phyi nas dkon mchog gsum dang bde 'gro'i sgra rna bar yang mi thos pas da lta nyid nas lus ngag yid gsum dam pa'i chos la 'bung dgos/ chos byed zer

44 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ba mang yang chos dang mthun pa ni mi srid pa tsam du gda'/ chos mthun gyi blo gsha' ma zhig skyes na 'jig rten 'di'i snang ba thams cad gcan gzan gyi mdun du rtswa spungs pa bzhin gang red red du chug snyam pa zhig 'byung / de tsa na ci byas chos su 'gro ba yin mod/ bzang bzang legs legs mdzes mjes kyi sgrigs dang cho ga kha ton bzlas brjod/ yar mchod mar sbyin/ lha bri rten bzhengs sogs 'di mi bya ba med pa zhig byas nas/ rang nyid chos pa'i yang rtse yin snya/ma pa'i nga rgyal brtan po re byas kyang sangs rgyas thob pa la nye ba'i rgyu tsam yang ma song / de rnams cis lan zhe na/ rang gi sems rgyud ma thul bas lan /mdor bsdu na/ bka' bstan bcos/ lung man ngag gi sgo nas bsgom rgyu byed rgyu mang du gsungs kyang / rtsa ba rang gi sems 'di kho na 'dul thabs ma gtogs gzhan ci yang med pas bla ma'i gdams ngag tshig gcig ces pa'i don yin/ rang sems lug gi bal ltar mnyen shigs se song na blo chos su song zer ba las/rang sems rang gi bkol du mi btub pa g.yag rgod kyi rke mjing ltar byas nas thugs dam zab zab dang lta ba mtho mtho byas kyang 'chi ba thog tu bab pa'i nyin tha mal pa las kyang lod pa zhig 'ong / des na dmu rgod kyi sems la 'di mi dran bya ba med pas ngan rtog re re skyes tsa na 'bur 'joms su btang nas/ nyi ma re re'itshobar yang rang sems la yar skyed bton nas nyon mongs pa dang chos brgyad kyi rtog pa je nyung / dge ba'i sems la je 'dris su 'gro ba zhig byas na gzod phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis rtogs par 'gyur/de yang chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed yin pas thog ma nas rgyud la 'dre nges bya/ khyad par snying rje chen pos drangs pa'i bdag bas

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 45gzhan gces kyi bsam pas rtag tu gtong len gyi dmigs pa la brtson/ dus kun tu nam 'chi cha med kyi blo sna yang yang bstung / gnas grogs longs spyod 'du 'dzi kun la ha cang sred pa mi che bar chog shes par bya/ grub mtha' su la'ang phyogs ris chags sdang mi bya bar dag snang sbyang / rtsa ba'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas dus rtag tu gsol ba snying nas btab pas ji zhig na tshig dang yid dpyod kyi lam du ma lus par/ rang gi sems kyi de nyid nang nas rang brdol du 'char ba ni sgrub brgyud rin po che 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin pas thugs la chongs mdzod/khyad par mnyam med dwags po rin po che dang / rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje gnyis la gsol ba snying na sa thob dang byin rlabs gzhan las che ba zha la bzhes yod/dngos su sems rang bzhin ci mi bsam pa gnas pa/ rnam rtog thol thol 'phro ba 'gyu ba/ de gnyis gang red ha go ba rig pa'am gnas 'gyu ngo shes pa yin/ de steng sems 'di dang po gang nas byung / da lta gang du gnas/ tha mar gar 'gro rtsad bcad pas/ ma skyes mi 'gag gzhi med rtsa bral rang gsal lhun grub chen por ngo 'phrod pa 'ong / de nas gnas 'gyu gang byung yang ched du dga' sdug mi bya bar byed mkhan kho rang gi ngo bo la ma bcos par hrig ger bltas pas/ chu dang rlabs ltar rang byung rang grol du 'gro ba ni las dang po pa'i bsgom bya'i ngo ti lags pas re zhig thugs la chongs/ mdor na mang po'i kha na med/ rang gi brtson 'grus dang bla ma'i byin rlabs la rag las pas res 'jog mi bya bar dus rgyun du rang gi sems bsrung zhing gsol ba btab pas nam zhig rang yid rang la tshes pa zhig 'ong /rjes kun tu bsngo smon rnam dag spyi dang bzang spyod/ khyad par bde smon la snying thag

46 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pa nas 'bad 'tshal/ zhes pa'ang dge slong karma phan bde'i bzhed ngor btsun pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis smras pa dge/ //gdams ngag gros 'debs gcig dril ma/༈ dran mchog mgon po bde ba chen po dang / /dbyer med bla ma pad ma nyin mor byed/ /bdag sogs snying dbus dad pa'i pad mtsho sa /byin rlabs 'od stong 'du bral med par stsol/ /kho bos chos cung zad thos kyang rang rgyud chos dang ma 'dres pas chos mthun gyi gdams ngag brjod par dka' yang / khyed dge ba'i thugs mnga' nas yang yang gsungs pa'i lan mi gcog tsam zhu na/ de yang / ji skad du/tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar byos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten pa'i tshe dgun kha'i nyi ma ltar ci byas med pa'i ngang la yud tsam du zad/ sgos snyigs dus kyi mi tshe la bar chad kyi rkyen mang bas bar snang gi glog ltar skad cig mar nam 'chi mi shes/ mdo don bsdu na/ zan kham gang dang gos lus gang gi ched kho na ma gtogs dgos don gyi gtad so drag zhan su la'ang med pa la/ gcig yod tsa na gcig ma 'dzom/ gcig byas tsa na gcig ma lo/dgos ngo shes pa dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba gal chung g.yas chung du btang / byed du mi 'os la ma byas kyang chog pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba chu yi gnyer ma ltar gcig song gcig sleb zad du med pa la yengs nas mi tshe gar zad ma tshor bar 'chi ba la gtugs thug ste/ sems stong phyad phyod/ snying tsha khum khum/ tshe gang byas pa'i las

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 47rnams mdang gi rmi lam sad pa ltar rang la phan pa spu tsam med par 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i dus la bab ste/ gnam sa kha zhabs log pa lta bu'i ci drag gang drag la thug pa'i dus de/ rang re la de ring sang tsam la'ang mi 'ong nges pa med pas/ byed byed kyi shom ra mang po'i long skabs med cing / byas byas mang po rang mgo rang g.yogs kyi rgyu yin pas 'chi dus phan nges pa'i chos shig bya dgos la/de byed pa'i dbang da lta rang lag tu yod pa yin/ dbang mi lag tu shor nas snying nas chos byed mi khom pa 'dra mo 'di/ gcig tu sngon las ngan pa'i 'phro dang /gnyis su rang sems rang gis bkug ma thub pa yin/ sems nang du bkug thub na lus rang gi ci byed chog pas rang dbang gzhan lag tu shor don med/ nam zhig bem rig bral nas rnam shes dge sdig gi rjes su 'brang tshe de dus rang dbang rang la med de la kha'i bya sgro rlung khyer dang 'dra bar dgongs 'tshal/chos byed pa la gnyis yin/ rten bzhengs mar me phyag bskor kha bton sogs 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa gtso bor bton pa de 'jig rten pa dang thun mong gi chos yin/ ngo mtshar dang phan yon dpag tu med kyang dam pa'i chos zer ba de la zer ba min/ thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson cing sdom gsum ngo lkog med par bsrung ba sogs 'dus ma byas kyi dge rtsa la 'bad pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos yin/ rang re rnams kyis de gtso bor 'don dgos/ de thams cad bsam pa byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa zhig gis zin na/ byang chub kyi rgyu dang chos lam du 'gro ba bya ba yin/ bsam pa byang chub sems kyis ma zin pa'i dge ba zag bcas zag med ci byas kyang khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu las ma 'das pas sems bskyed bzang po 'di dus thams cad du gal che/

48 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/byang chub kyi sems zol med pa zhig yod na dge ba lta ci/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba phal pa rnams kyang byang chub kyi lam du 'gyur nges pa yin/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye ba la/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i gzhung khrid tsam zhig ci nas thob dgos/de ston byed kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis mgo ma 'khor ba zhig rnyed dgos/ der ma zad dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin na ni blo chos su mi 'gro/ chos byed blo cung zad skyes kyang chos lam du 'gro mi srid pas/ sangs rgyas chos kun dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po ni thar 'dod rnams la dmus long gi sna khrid dang 'dra ba lags/ 'o na rang 'dod la ci yang 'char bas de thams cad chos su mi 'gro ba'i phyir/ dang du len rgyu dngos de gang yin zhe na/ rang re tsho khyim pa'i rjes 'jug min/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug yin pas tshe 'di dang du mi len par phyi ma dang du len dgos/ phyi ma la phan pa chos yin kyang rgyud dang ma 'dres pa'i chos de phyi nas byugs pa dang 'dra/ khe grags 'gran sems ngas byas mi bya ka med can gyi chos des chos brgyad kyi g.yeng ba spel/ de nyon mongs kyi grogs su song nas/ skabs shig tsa na rgyud ngan lang du shor nas chos pa chos dang 'gal ba'i rang rtags rang gis ma tshor ba mi kun gyis 'phya zhing dgod pa zhig 'byung / rang rgyud chos dang bsre ba la mi rtag pa snying la gzer kem kem pa tha na nyin rer lan gsum gsum dran dgos/ mi rtag pa snying la dran tsa na/ tshe 'di la long med kyi blo sna thung / de tsa na 'di phyi bar do gsum kar mdung tshugs su khyer chog pa'i gdams ngag gcig dril ma zhig las spros bcas mang po'i long skabs med cing dgos pa chung bar go de lta bu'i gdams ngag de

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 49rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams nas tshang la ma nor ba 'byung yang zab cing rgya che drags pas gang gtso zhe na/ rang re rnams kyis theg pa chung ngu las theg chen gyi lta spyod gtso bor byed dgos/ theg chen mdo sde las kyang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde'i tshul la mos pa lam du byed dgos/ rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas kyang rnal 'byor bla na med pa la 'jug pa dang 'jug pa'i smon lam 'debs dgos/ bla med la'ang bskyed rim dang spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang spros med kyi rdzogs rim rnams yod pa las snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma ches zab pas spros med rdzogs rim zhig la hril dril dgos/ de yang bla med gang rung zhig gi dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig la gnas pas bskyed rim gsal snang thebs tsam dang grangs bsnyen tsam song nas dran dran mang po'i kha na med pas blo gcig thog tu bzhag nas spros med kyi nyams len la mi tshe dril nus na mi lus thob cing chos dang mjal ba don ldan du byas/de'i nang nas rdo rje theg pa nyin mo'i skar ma lta bu dkon pa'i mchog dang phrad pa chud zos su ma shor/ skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma da res grub pas pho rgod mgo stong du ma song ba yin no/ /rdzogs rim gyi rnam grangs mang yang bla med kyi rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gcig tu 'dril ba'i spros bcas kyi lag len zab cing bde shos sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ nā ro ni gu chos drug sogs yin cing / spros med ni phyag rdzogs su 'du'o/ /de la phyag chen bsgom par 'dod na thog mar thun mong dang / thun min gyi sngon 'gros rgyud sbyang / de rjes brgyud pa'i byin rlabs ma chad pa'i bla ma dam pa las mnyam bzhag ngo sprod kyi gnad legs par zhus te/ dngos gzhi dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yab sras kyi bka' 11la phyag chen lnga ldan gyi gdams pa lta bu zhig la dril na

50 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ring por mi thogs par rang rig chos sku'i rang zhal mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gang la'ang dad pa'i gzhi lta bu brtan dgos/ gdams ngag sa bon lta bu thebs dgos/ brtson 'grus so nam lta bu rem dgos/ sems bskyed drod gsher lta bu legs dgos/ bar chad sad ser lta bu bsrung dgos/ de ltar na mchog gi dngos grub 'bras bu lta bu dang / thun mong gi 'bras bu phub sog lta bu zhor la 'byung ba chos nyid yin no/ /de'ang 'dod pa'i dad pa ma skyes na sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs dang mdo sde la blta/ dang ba'i dad pa mi skye na 'phags bod mkhas grub kyi rnam thar la blta/ yid ches pa'i dad pa ma skyes na mdo sde las brgya pa dang byang chub lam rim sogs las rgyu 'bras ston pa'i gzhung rnams ltos la dad pa bskyed/ gdams ngag med na mi tshe chos dang sgrub pa la bskyal yang sems thog tu yid ches 'byung ba'i dus med pas gdams ngag btsal/ gdams ngag yod kyang nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa med na skurdzon tan nang nas mi 'char bas brgyud pa 17la med la gshugs/ gdams ngag thob kyang brtson 'grus med na rgya mtsho'i 'gram na skom grir 'chi ba dang 'dra bas res 'jog dang rgyun chad med par nyams su len/ sems bskyed med na lta sgom spyod pa byas tshad stong las su song bas ci byed gzhan don du dmigs/ chos kyi bar chad zab cing rnam grangs mang bas byung dang ma byung rang gis kyang rtogs dka' bas bdud brtags pa'i le'u sogs mdo sde dang / lce sgom pa'i ri chos rin spungs sogs la blta zhing brtags nas blang dor bya'o/ /de la theg chen spong ba pa zhig gis nyams su len bya mdor bsdus na/ byang chub thob 'dod kyi dad pa/ bla ma la chos sku'i mos gus/ sems can ris med la

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 51snying rje/ yengs med gcig tshugs kyi dran shes/ phyogs med khyab brdal gyi dag snang lnga la dge sbyor gyi dngos gzhi bya zhing / thun mtshams su phyin drug gtso bor gyur pa'i dge ba'i bya ba chung ngu yin kyang ras su mi bor zhing / chen po la'ang sems mi zhum pa'i sgo nas gang 'grub nan tan bya/ gal te 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa 'grub pa'i nus pa med pa'am/ yod kyang mnyam bzhag la g.yeng bas gnod na re zhig g.yeng ba thams cad spangs te mnyam bzhag la nan tan byed pa kho na chod che'o/ /rang re rnams bstan sgor zhugs nas rgas rgas su 'chi ba la nye yang / mi tshe phyed lhag kha yengs mig yengs la zad/ phyed tsam grwa sa'i rnam g.yeng la 'byams/sems chos brgyad kyi dbang du btang / log 'tsho dang dkor rdzas rgya mtsho tsam zhig la spyod/ nyes lhung gi khur po ri bo tsam zhig khur nas ring por mi thogs par ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong du cha ba la bsams nas ri dwags mtha' la gcur ba lta bu'i 'jigs skrag gnong 'gyod dang bcas pas/ gsung yi ge drug ma/ rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas/ thar pa chen po'i mdo dang dri med bshags rgyud/ byang chub lhung bshags sogs la nyin mtshan dal med du brtson zhing / khyad par rang rig rang ngo sprod pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can la mos gus drag po'i snang ba dang mi 'bral bar/ da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa bsgoms kyang bzang du ma song / ma bsgoms pas ngan du ma song / 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs su 'char yang gang gis kyang ma gos shing / ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ brjod du med la/ myong du yod pa 'di la thag gcig thog tu bcad nas/ 'di yin no/ /'di min no/ /shes so/ /mi shes so snyam pa la sogs pa'i re dogs thams cad spangs te/ rang sems kyi ngo bo sa le hrig ger rig pa'i ngang du rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba byung tshad rang yal bzo

52 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/med du bzhag nas/ 'og 'gyu dang lung ma bstan gyi dbang du ma shor bar dran pa la rtse nas so pa bud pa lta bus yengs med du bskyangs pas/ ji zhig na chos thams cad sems/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i stong nyid rig pa'i snying po can/ de las logs su sku gsum grub pa med par thag chod nas blo bde thog tu phebs pas don gnyis 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs par 'gyur ro/ /kye ho/ yang gcig gson dang skal ldan gyi grogs po/ /'o skol ser gos gyon nas chos gzugs 'di byas phyin/ /chos sgo kun dang mthun pa'i skal ba 'dra med kyang / /sne gcig chos dang mi mthun shi ba rang dga'o/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus dam chos la 'bung na/ /skye ba gtan du bde ba'i khe skyed cig gda' ste/ /nor bu rang lag yod dus chud zos la btang nas/ /skye ba gtan sdug myong ba'i bsam med rang mang ngo / /nam 'chi cha med dran pa'i blo sna zhig bstung na/ /dam chos sgo skyel byed pa'i grogs bzang zhig gda' ste/ /'dir snang 'ja' mtshon 'dra ba'i mgo bskor gyis bslus nas/ /mi tshe stong zad byed pa'i rlung khyer rang mang ngo / /mthun rkyen thams cad tshang dus nyams len zhig brtson na/ /'chi khar sems 'gyod med pa'i blo bde zhig 'byung ste/ /mi khom mi 'dzom ngang la lo zla ni zad nas/ /gser phye chu la 'pho ba'i mdo shor rang mang ngo / /bla mar sangs rgyas shes pa'i mos gus shig yod na/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam byin rlabs rang babs su 'byung ste/ /mnyam 'grogs brnyas thabs rtogs ngan snying nang du zhen nas/ /ma tshor dam tshig nyams pa'i bsam brlag rang mang ngo / /rang 'dod gting nas spangs pa'i snying rje zhig bskyed na/ /ci byas sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshogs chen du 'gyur yang / /bdag 'dzin skyid 'dod 'gong po zhe phug tu bcug nas/ /tsandan

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 53sol bar bsgyur pa'i blo chung rang mang ngo / /bzo med rig pa'i rang ngo yengs med du skyong na/ /gnyug ma chos sku'i btsan sa tshe gcig la zin te/ /thag chod nges shes med pa'i the tshom gyi gegs des/ /spros bcas rnam g.yeng ngang du mgo 'khor ni mang ngo / /gang shar chos sku'i rol par thag chod cig skyes na/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs pa tshegs med du 'char te/ /gzung 'dzin spang gnyen blo yis rang zhal la bsgribs nas/ /ma bcos gnas lugs don la rgyab 'gal rang mang ngo / /rang sems dpang du btsugs pa'i dam tshig zhig bsrung na/ /gzhan dag su ma mgu yang rang blo 'dra bde yang / /g.yo zol ngo lkog ngang la 'phyor chas tsho gzab nas/ /dkor nag chu ltar 'gom pa'i g.yo can 'dra mang ngo / /dpal ldan e waṃ chos ldan mkhas grub kyi gdan sar/ /mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pas zab chos kyi bdud rtsis/ /khyod thugs smin grol mdzad na ku swā li'i tshig 'khyal/ /smra la dgos pa med mod bzhed bskang phyir thal lo/ /a ho/ tshe 'di'i snang ba glog gi gar mkhan 'dra/ /srid pa'i bde 'byor rtswa rtse'i chu thigs bzhin/ /dgos dgos zad med spos rgya'i ri mor mtshungs/ /thams cad 'dzom nas sgrub la brtson snyam yang / /'dzom pa'i dus med mi tshe mtha' la thug /chog shes skyes na thams cad 'dzom dang 'dra/ /gzhan kun lta ci lto rgyab gnyis po yang / /ci byung thub na chos kyi phyed ka 'grub/ /byang sems yod na ci byas dam chos yin/ /rang ngo shes na cir snang rang grol yin/ /mos gus yod na shar tshad chos sku yin/ /zhen pa thongs na snang tshad sgyu ma yin/ /ma bcos bzhag na thams cad gnyug ma yin/ /bcas bcos byas tshad don las phyin ci log /rang sems tha mal rtog pas ma dben na/ /lus ngag 'du 'dzis dben kyang 'phyi ba bzhin/ /

54 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/spyod lam thams cad tshogs su ma khyer na/ /ched du 'bad pas a thang chad pa'i rgyu/ /shar tshad chos sku'i yo lang ma shes par/ /lta sgom thams cad rnam rtog skor log nyid/ /da lta nyid du chos la ma 'bad na/ /sang bya gnangs bya le lo'i mgo skor yin/ /byed lugs shes na ci byas chos yin pas/ /gcig pur sdod pa'i long khom bsgug mi dgos/ /chos min chos log zer ba gud na med/ /rang nyid grags 'dod gzhan la brnyas bcos dang / /nga rgyal the tshom le lo chos pa'i bdud/ /spangs nas dman sa 'dzin pa gnad du zab/ /dman sa zin che yon tan gyen du 'phel/ /che 'dod byung tshe sgom chen thur skya phab/ /gol sa yin te rang mtshang shes pa dkon/ /yon tan til tsam skyes la nga rgyal che/ /nyams len med pa'i chos snas khog pa sbos/ /zhen log med par rnyed tshad nor du gsog /rang rgyud tha mal lus la sgom gyis ci/ /thun dang thun mtshams rnam pa thams cad du/ /mi rtag nges 'byung gnyis pos rang sems gcun/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis pos thun mgo bzung / /mos gus dran shes gnyis po mthil du gtad/ /dag snang snying rje gnyis po lam du khyer/ /bsngo ba smon lam gnyis pos mjug kun sdud/ /chos kyi gnad 'gag thams cad 'di ru 'dus/ /rtag chad mtha' dang bral ba'i lta ba la/ /zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i sgom pas brgyan/ /bsdu dngos bzhi dang phar phyin drug la spyod/ /yan lag bdun gtsos lus ngag dge la 'bung / /khyad par bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang sems bsgom/ /mdo lugs phar phyin nyams len de la 'dus/ /bskyed rim bsgom pas snod bcud lha ru bsgyur/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas grags stong gsung du khyer/ /bde stong rdzogs rim chos sku lam du khyer / /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i gnad gsang de la 'dus/ /rang sems las gzhan sangs

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 55rgyas gud na med/ /gtad med skyong las gdams ngag gzhan na med/ /med kyang gzhan du 'tshol bas thams cad bslus/ /sems thag nang du gcod na mi legs sam/ /rang sems rang gi chos la ma bskul na/ /gzhan gyis gcun pa khyi rkun lam ded 'dra/ /chos dang rang rgyud zhu dag ma byas na/ /grwa sa'i chos spyod bro pa'i zlos gar 'dra/ /sgrub la dka' spyad snying rus mi nus pa'i/ /nyams rtogs skye 'dod zhing ngan lo tog 'dra/ /rang gi sems la brdar sha mi gcod pa/ /tshig la zhen pa ma thongs gtam rgyud 'dra/ /zab zab snyan snyan mang po ci smras kyang / /thag chod nges shes nang nas ma shar bar/ /don gyi thog tu nam yang mi 'bab pas/ /rang sems ngo bo skyong la nan tan mdzod/ /nges 'byung chos brgyad rlung gis ma khyer 'tshal/ /snying rje gnod sems sad kyis ma bcom 'tshal/ /mos gus rtog dpyod dgra la ma shor 'tshal/ /dge sbyor phyi bgol ngang du ma gtong 'tshal/ /dran shes brjed ngas dbang du ma 'byams 'tshal/ /nam zhig gnas lugs lhongs su ma gyur bar/ /bsgom mi dgos pa nam yang mi srid pas/ /brtson 'grus grim lhod ran pos phyi klod la/ /nang gi sems nyid tha mal mi gtong sgrims/ /kha cig stong ltas las 'bras khyad du gsod/ /gzhan dag spros bcas lhur len sgom pa smod/ /gnyis ka byang chub lam dang thag ring bas/ /lta ba mtho yang spyod pa zhib pa gces/ /yang thog song na g.yang sa che ba bzhin/ /rgyud tshod mtho bzhin bar chad che bas na/ /yon tan skye dus kun la ma zhen dgos/ /khyad par rtsa ba'i bla mar brnyas thabs kyis/ /mos gus 'grib na gegs chen 'byung nges pas/ /rang nyid rigs gsum mgon tsam gyur na yang / /bla ma chos sku rjen par lta bar gces/ /mdor na sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun pa'i/ /blos btags chos kyis rang

56 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gzhan mgo bskor bas/ /gdams ngag bka' dang mthun par nyams len te/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la 'jug par mdzod/ /ces 'di blo gros mtha' yas bhu su kus/ /dge bshes bstan 'dzin bzang po'i bzhed bskang phyir/ /bka' brgyud grub pa'i tshogs kyis byin brlabs gnas/ /swā la'i nags khrod 'du 'dzis dben par mā /gtad med ngang du lhug par nyal ba'i tshe/ /gang byung chal chol gros su gdams pa'o// //lam khyer spang bsgyur shes gsum/7/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru padma snying dbus mi shigs dwangs ma'i thig ler mchod do/ /bdag cag chos pa'i gzugs brnyan can rnams nyon mongs pa'i g.yang sa 'jigs shing ya nga bar tsham tshom med par mchongs pa las bzlog tu gsol lo/ /de la rang re rnams kyi sems 'di long ba thang dkyil du 'khyams pa dang 'dra ste gar 'gro 'dir 'gro'i brtol med/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga ni pha bsad kyi sha len snyeg mkhan dang 'dra ste bzung bar dka' ba'i rnam rtog gi 'phrang nas sgug chos dang gdams ngag zab mo ni mig 'byed pa'i sman pa mkhas pa dang 'dra ste 'thab pa dang 'bros pa'i tshod shes pa'i spang blang gi mig sbyin par byed pa'o/ /dper na 'jig rten na rang nyid gsod nges pa'i dgra zhig kyang yod la/ de ngo shes nas 'thab nus na 'thab/ 'thab ma nus na bros/ thabs mkhas na 'khesan pa bsdums nas gnyen du 'gug de gsum gang yang ma byas par dgra'i g.yul ngor phyin pas the tshom med par gsod du 'ong / 'thab pa'i dpung dang go mtshon yang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 57tshang / 'bros pa'i mig dang rkang pa yang yod/ dgra grogs su bsgyur pa'i blo stobs kyang yod bzhin du de gsum gang yang mi byed par dgra'i lag tu rang srog bskyal na blun po'i mthar thug pas phyugs las kyang lod do/ /dpe de bzhin du rang re rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi gnas su sngar lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par bsad/ ma 'ongs par gsod par 'gyur/ da lta gsod bzhin pa'i dgra nyon mongs dug lnga 'di ngo shes nas las dang po ba 'bros/gnas lugs rtogs nas 'thab/ brtan pa thob nas grogs su byed pas lam du khyer/ de gsum gyi lam srol gang yang ma ldan par nyon mongs pa 'jol nyog tu spyod na the tshom med par ngan song du 'phen du 'ong / 'bros pa lta bu nyon mongs pa spong ba'i lam/ 'thab pa lta bu bsgyur ba'i lam/ gnyen du 'gug pa lta bu rang bzhin shes pa'i lam ste/ de dag shes bzhin du nyams len mi brtson par sems nyon mongs pa'i dbang du btang na/ dgra'i lag tu rang srog bskyal ba las kyang ches blun pa ste chos byas pa'i dgos pa stor ba'o/ /gzhan yang dpe 'di lta ste/ 'chi bar byed nges pa'i dug de dang po ngos zin dgos/ shes nas myur bar thag ring por spong dgos/ rigs sngags mkhan gyis dug de bcud len du bsgyur nas bza'/ rma byas ni de gnyis gang yang mi dgos par zos pa kho nas mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod nges pa'i nyon mongs pa rgyud la skyes pa tsam nas ngos zin dgos/ ngos zin pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog ste blo stobs chung na mdo 'dul ltar spang dgos/ blo stobs che na sngags phyi pa ltar bsgyur dgos/ blo stobs shin tu che ba'i rnal 'byor pa rab rnams kyis ni sngags nang pa ltar ma spang lam du khyer ba ste/ las dang po

58 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pas stag mchongs sar wa mchongs na rang nyid nyams nyes par 'gyur bas/'dod yon lam khyer ni smon pa tsam ste/ rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i mos bsgom bya ba nyid gnad du che'o/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'bor ba'i rtsa ba byed/ /ci dgar bzhag na phung lngar nyi nga mtshams sbyar/ /zhe sdang la sogs nyes kun sna 'dren byed/ /spangs na 'gro ba brgyud lnga'i nyer len gcod/ /lam khyer shes na bde stong chos sku 'grub/ /'dod chags phung po ri bo tsam sla yi/ /zhe sdang skad cig ma ni de lta min/ /khong khro skad cig skyes pas bskal mang du/ /bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun kyang 'joms par byed/ /rang bzhin shes na gsal stong longs sku dngos/ /ma shes 'bur 'joms spang la nan tan mdzod/ /nyon mongs kun gyi 'byung gnas gti mug ste/ /rgya mtsho med na chu phran ga las bab/ /mun pa med na lam log ci phyir khur/ /ma rig gti mug mun pa'i gting che yang / /rig pa'i nyi ma shar na dka' tshegs med/ /rang rig ngang du mnyam bzhag goms par 'tshal/ /yon tan yod na nga rgyal dgos pa min/ /mkhas pa'i blo de nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /bzang ngan che chung kun shongs gu dog med/ /yon tan med la nga rgyal che ba na/ /myur ba nyid du rang dma' rang gis 'bebs/ /yon tan cung zad skyes tshe nga rgyal na/ /bdud kyi gegs te sngar yod yon tan 'grib/ /phyin chad yon tan skye dka' 'gro don 'gag /sangs rgyas byang sems yon tan bsam tsa na/ /nyi zla'i 'od dang srin bu me khyer 'dra/ /chos pa nga rgyal ma zhugs gal re che/ /gzhan gyi bsod nams mnga' thang 'gro don la/ /phrag dog lan gcig skyes pas rang nyid kyi/ /bsod nams mnga' thang 'gro don phyags mas 'ded/ /rang las lhag na phrag dog byas ci phan/ /rang nyid tshogs

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 59ma bsags pas 'bras bu yin/ /rang dang mnyam na phrag dog byed ci dgos/ /rang rang las 'bras so sor spyod pa yin/ /chos pa phrag dog che bas phung ba mang / /de bas bdag 'dzin 'dul la brtson par 'tshal/ /nyon mongs kha yan btang na tha mal pa/ /nyon mongs mgo bo gnon na dge sbyong ste/ /nyon mongs ye shes 'char na rnal 'byor pa/ /spang bsgyur shes gsum rang blo'i tshod dang dpag /nyon mongs rang dgar nam yang gtong mi bya/ /deng sang sgom chen kha bshad mkhan mang yang / /dus kyi dbang gis nyon mongs chom pa dkon/ /rtogs ldan nyon mongs can dang 'grogs pa na/ /'o ma bzang po skyur dang 'grogs pa ltar/ /rang rgyud dag kyang ma rung byed pas na/ /dran shes bag yod kho nar snying nor mdzod/ /chos sgor zhugs kyang lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad mi shes pa dang / shes kyang nyams su mi lon pa'i gang zag las dang po pa rnams kyis mdo dang 'dul ba'i dgongs pa bzhin nyon mongs pa spang bar bya ste/ 'dod chags skyes pa'i tshe chags yul de phyi pags pa'i g.yogs srab mos bsgribs pa las/ nang na sha kham pa/khrag dmar po/ chu ser gyi ljan ljin/ snabs lud gcin rtug sogs mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu so gnyis kyis skyugs ldog pa/ dri nga ba/ khyi phag gi khog pa kha phyes pa dang khyad par med par bsam/ des ma zhi na chags yul de shi ba'i ro bam pa/rul ba/ sngo ba/ ham pa/ 'bus myags pa/ rul dri can bsams nas mi sdug pa'i 'du shes bsgom pas kyang ma zhi na/ de'i lus keng rus skya khro le/ mig dmar ha re ba la yun ring sems gtad/ mthar keng rus de 'dras snang yul gang bar bsam pas nges par zhi'o/ /nor rdzas sogs la rmi lam gyi nor rdzas ltar sems zhabrul pa'i rang gzugs las bden par ma grub pa/ chu'i lha ba ltar snying po med pa/
