60 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'byor rgud gnyis ka mi rtag pa bsam pa sogs bya'o/ /zhe sdang skye na nyes dmigs dran/ zhe sdang skye yul de dgra gnyen su yin kyang rang gi rtsa ba'i ma dang sring mo lta bu bsgom la tshad med pa'i byams pa dang snying rje bskyed/ sems can du gyur tshad rang gi pha ma min pa gcig kyang med pa la/ bdag gis pha ma la phan ma thogs pa'i steng / bdag la brten nas pha ma zhe sdang skye bas chud zos su btang ba a tsa ma/ pha ma bdag la khros kyang bdag pha ma la khro thabs gar yod snyam du bsam/gti mug ma rig pa dang mi shes pa thams cad yin pas/ de'i gnyen po thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa yin kyang / bye brag gnyid 'thibs tshe ma rig pa las 'du byed 'byung / de nas rim bzhin rnam par shes pa/ ming dang gzugs/skye mched drug reg pa/ tshor ba/ sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi'i bar du byung nas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo chen po 'di grub/ ma rig pa 'gags na 'du byed 'gags pa nas/ rga shi'i bar du 'gags te/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor ldog par 'gyur ba'i tshul bsam/ gzhan yang thub pa'i skyes rabs/ sangs rgyas byang sems mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar shes na de rnams bsam/ ma shes na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang skyes chen rnams dang / mched grogs sogs kyi yon tan mdzad phrin ngo mtshar rnams yid la dran cing dad gus bsgom ste mdor na dge ba'i rnam rtog spro bar bya/ gnyid khar rang gi spyi bor mar me shin tu gsal ba zhig bsgom pa la rig pa gtad pa'ang gnyid srab pa'i gdams ngag yin no/ /nga rgyal phrag dog sogs skyes na gong du tshigs bcad du brjod pa ltar nyes pa che ba dang / nga rgyal bya rin mi chog cing / phrag dog byed don med par bsgoms nas spang bar bya ste/ nyon mongs pa de dag byung ma thag tu pang du sbrul byung ba ltar 'jigs pa

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 61chen por bltas nas rtsad med rmang med du spong ba yin no/ /dbang bskur thob cing bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i gsang sngags mos pa lam byed rnams kyis nyon mongs pa bsgyur bar bya ste/ 'dod chags skyes pa'i tshe rang dang 'dod chags kyi rtog pa dbyer med pa 'od dpag med du krong nger bsgom/snod thams cad bde ba can/ bcud thams cad 'od dpag med/ chags yul thams cad kyang 'od dpag med du bsgom/ lha la 'dod chags byed du mi rung ba dang / 'dod chags rang gar shor na sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang /'dod chags nyid rgyal ba 'od dpag med du gnas gyur pas nyon mongs pa ye shes kyi grogs su song ba la dga' ba bskyed de/ rnam rtog rang yan du ma shor bar snying rus bskyed de bsgom/ zhe sdang la snod mngon par dga' ba/ bcud mi bskyod pa/ gti mug la zhing stug po bkod pa/ bcud rnam par snang mdzad/ nga rgyal zhing dpal dang ldan pa/ bcud rin chen 'byung ldan/ phrag dog la zhing las rab rdzogs pa/ bcud don yod grub pa/ sgom tshul gzhan 'dod chags bsgyur skabs kyis rigs 'gre'o/ /phyag rdzogs sogs rlung sems la sbyang pa gtso bor byed pa rnams kyis nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin shes pas lam du khyer dgos pa yin/ de yang rtog pa rang ga ma de skyong bas lam du 'gro ba min/ rtog pa de nyams su myong mkhan zhig yod pa la/ der 'dzin gyi shes pa med pa'i gzhi med rang grol gyi rig stong rjen pa bskyangs pas lam du 'gro ba yin/ de yang rang bzhin yongs shes zer ba de dper na sog ma gcig bcad nas bltas pas nang stong par mthong bas sog ma gzhan du yod kyang de dang 'dra bar nang stong par shes pa bzhin du/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam

62 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rtog gcig skye dus skye yul gyi rjes su phar mi mngags par skye mkhan gyi shes pa la kha nang log tu bltas pas rnam rtog de dngos med rang grol la song nas stong par mthong / de ltar yang yang nyams su myong bas rnam rtog thams cad kyi spros pa chod nas stong pa yin min la the tshom mi dgos/ stong pa yin tsa na stong pas phan btags gnod skyel gang ci'ang mi nusapas/ nyon mongs pa skyes ma skyes la blang dor dga' sdug re dogs gang yang mi dgos par skyes pa dang ngos zin pa dang grol ba gsum po dus mnyam du 'gyur ba yin no/ /lar rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa gang la'ang las dang po pas khab mig tu skud pa sprad pa ltar bsgrims nas de'i rjes su mi 'brang / rgyun mi mthud/ de grol ma grol gyi zhen 'dzin kyang ma zhugs par skye mkhan gyi ngo bo de skyong shes par byed dgos/ rang grol yin par rlom nas kha yengs mig yengs la btang na rgyud je lod du 'gro/ brtan pa thob tsa na rang res rang grol bzo mi dgos/ kho rang rang grol du 'gro ba yin/ rang re rnams sgo lnga'i rnam shes ma ldog pa dang / nyon mongs pa can gyi yid ma spangs pa'i gnad kyis yul dang 'phrad na nyon mongs mi skye ba mi 'ong yang / nyon mongs pa'i rjes su mi 'brang / de lag tu mi 'debs pa skad cig dang po la nyon mongs skyes kyang skad cig gnyis pa la dran pas sleb thub par byas nas/ skad cig gsum pa la spang bsgyur shes gsum gang rung gis lam du gtong dgos pa yin/ rnam rtog gi 'char sgo mi khegs/ bkag dgos skye mi rung snyam pa de blo yin/ blo'i yid byed thams cad bcos ma yin/ ma bcos pa zer tsa na yid byed thams cad dang bral dgos pa yin/ rnam rtog ji tsam shar yang rgya mtsho la char babs pa ltar 'gyu stong skye med du grol bas dgag blo med pa/ ma shar yang sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' ltar rig

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 63stong dang so na gnas pas bsgrub blo med pa/ mdor na dus rtag tu rig pa'i rang ngo kho na bskyang ba las tsab tsub mang po mi dgos/ nad brgya sman gcig yin/ de bskyang ba la mos gus dran shes gnyis dang ma bral ba kho na gal che/ de gnyis yod na byin rlabs/ nyams rtogs/ snying rje/ dag snang thams cad zhor la 'byung bas dus rtag tu mos gus dang / dran shes kyis ma yengs par bskyang ba la 'bad par zhu/khyad par bla med rgyud sde las/ /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu nyid kyis ni 'gugs pa dang / /mes 'tshigs rma la mes gdung ltar/ /nyon mongs nyid kyis nyon mongs pa/ /sbyong byed bzlog pa bsgom par gsungs/ /skyes bu 'dod chags can dag gis/ /rang lus thabs ldan gdams pa dang / /gzhan lus pho nya'i zab lam sbyangs/ /zhe sdang can rnams drag sngags kyis/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra bsgral/ /gnyid ni spang bar mi bya zhing / /srab mthug 'od gsal sbubs su bstim/ /tha mal zhen rtog spangs nas su/ /sgo gsum lha yi nga rgyal bzung / /sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam thar kun/ /rang nyid gcig pus bsgrub smon te/ /phrag dog lam du khyer bar bya/ /kun la rang bzhin yongs shes dang / /sems bskyed rnam dag med thabs med/ /phal cher rnal 'byor mchog gi lam/ /tha mal 'jug pa'i yul min kyang / /thos dang mos pa tsam gyis kyang / /zab mo'i snod du rung ba yi/ /bsod nams chen po gsog 'gyur bas/ /thabs shes gnad kyis nyon mongs pa/ /mi spangs lam du khyer nus pa'i/ /smon lam kha tsam min par bya/ /snod dang 'tshams na gdams zab kyi/ /rim pa bla ma'i zhal las longs/ /da ni khyad par du spangs bsgyur shes gsum gyi lam de dag phyag rgya chen po lnga

64 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ldan gyi khrid rim dang bstun te stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yab sras kyi bka' srol rgyal ba yang dgon pas rtsal du bton pa ni/thog mar 'dod chags kyi rtog pa skyes na/ de ma thag tu 'bur 'joms mi bya bar dran pas zin bzhin pa'i ngang / 'dod chags de rtsal rdzogs su bcug de nas bdag gis deng nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'dod chags kyi rtog pa rang rgyud pa skad cig kyang byed re shi snyam pa'i spong sems brtan po bya/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/'bras bu 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal ji snyed yod pa rnams dang / khyad par rang gis thog med nas bsags pa'i 'dod chags kyi las 'bras/ lam zhugs dge ba'i grogs po rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bar du gcod pa'i 'dod chags gang yod/ 'dod chags des bar du bcad nas srung sdom nyams pa sogs kyis ngan song du skye ba'i las 'bras ji snyed gang yod thams cad rang gi rtog pa 'di la 'ub kyis bsdus pas/ 'gro ba thams cad 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par mos/ da res bdag rgyud la skyes pa'i 'dod chags kyi rtog pa 'di la brten nas 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god par bya'o/ /de'i phyir rim pa gnyis kyi lam bsgom par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/skad cig rang nyid yi dam gyi lha yab yum zhal sbyor gsar ma yin na bde dgyes dang / rnying ma yin na bka' dgongs lta bu gang rung bsgom/ bskyed rim shin tu gsal ba dang / gdan dang rgyan sogs rdzogs par bsgom pa gnad che/ gsal thebs nas yab la rig pa hril gyis gtad/ yum la ha cang sems gtad par mi bya/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng 'od phung gi dbus su rang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 65gi rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas/ bag dro 'ur re bzhugs par bsams la/ mos gus snying thag pa nas bskyed de/ bla ma rin po che bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi rtog pa thams cad so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyin chad 'dod chags kyi rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod de sems can gcig gi rgyud la'ang 'dod chags kyi rtog pa rang ga ma mi skye bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par bdag rgyud la skyes pa'i 'dod chags lam du lhongs nas bde stong phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol 'debs dar drag la snang ba 'gyur nges bya/de nas bla ma dang lha dang nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa shes mkhan gyi rang ngo la ce re bltas pas stong khyams kyis song ba snyam byed na/ stong 'dzin de la rtsis su mi byed par stong ngo snyam mkhan gyi shes pa gsal rig gi rig pa de'i rang ngo la blta/ rang ngo la blta zer yang blta bya lta byed gnyis su yod pa min/ dper na rang gi gdong pa rang gis mi mthong ba dang mtshungs/ blta bya lta byed gnyis su mi phyed la/ gnyis su med do snyam pa'i shes pa'ang med par blo dang bral ba'i rig stong rjen pa 'char ba de bskyang / rtog pa 'og rgyu byung na de'i dbang du mi gtang bar/ mos gus dang dran shes sbrel te bsgrims nas bskyang / yun ring thung thog mar nyon mongs skyes nas lam du khyer ba'i mgo tshugs pa'i bar tsam las thung thabs med/ ring na legs kyang bar rnams su rnam rtog sna tshogs skyes na phyis kyi rten 'brel mang po la gnod pas nya le nyob le mi bya bar rig pa bsgrims nas dar drag la yun ring thung blo tshod dang dpag par bya'o/ /

66 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/mthar/ dge ba 'di dang bdag gzhan gyi/ /dus gsum dge rtsa ci bsags mthus/ /'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs zhi/ /sku lnga ye shes mngon gyur shog /khyad par 'dod chags ma spang dag /sor rtog ye shes nyid gyur cig /bdag 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing khams su/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal sgra mi grags/ /ye shes bde ba'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun nyer 'tshor shog /bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg kun/ /nyon mongs sangs shing ye shes rgyas/ /bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /brdzus skyes don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /'dis skyon mang po dag yon tan mang po 'phel/ rten 'brel mang po 'grigs pa'i gnad mchog tu zab pa'o/ /des zhe sdang sogs dug lnga kar 'gre ste/ zhe sdang la lha spyan ras gzigs dang mi bskyod pa lta bu zhi ba kho na bsgom/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa me long ye shes gsal stong phyag rgya chen po sogs bsgyur shes par bya/ gti mug la 'jam dbyangs dang rnam par snang mdzad lta bu bsgom/ chos dbyings ye shes/ rig stong phyag rgya sogs bsgyur/ nga rgyal la rdo rje gzhon nu dang rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu bsgom/ mnyam nyid ye shes/ dran stong phyag rgya sogs bsgyur/ phrag dog la gshin rje'i gshed dang don yod grub pa lta bu bsgom/ bya grub ye shes dang tshor stong phyag rgya chen po sogs bsgyur/ de'ang nyon mongs pa rang bzhin gyis skyes na skyes pa de rtsal rdzogs nas lam du khyer ba yin/ nyon mongs pa ha cang mi rags kyang rtog pa phra mo rgyun chad med pas ting 'dzin la gegs byed na bag nyal ba yin pas/ rtog pa ched du bskyed nas nyon mongs mngon gyur du ldang tshe lam du khyer bas rtsad chod par 'gyur/ khyad par bskyed rdzogs la blo phyogs nas rig pa dwangs shing gsal ba'i tshe bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang skyes pa de nyid nus pa shin tu che ba yin

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 67pas/ btang snyoms su mi bzhag par so so'i ngo bo la blta ba sogs kyis 'phral mar lam du khyer ba gal che'o/ /chos rnams nyon mongs 'dul thabs kho nar gsungs/ /deng sang nyon mongs 'dul ba'i chos pa dkon/ /kha cig mi spang lam du khyer ro lo/ /phyi snyan nang stong rnga kog dag dang mtshungs/ /chos bzhin byas na khyi bzhin nyam chung yang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge sbyong yin/ /chos gzugs sbyor ldan nyon mongs nang rdzong can/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i tho chen de min su/ /bdag rgyud nyon mongs mes bsregs kyang / /snying nas gzhan la phan pa'i blos/ /chos dang mthun par bris pa'i dges/ /'brel tshad 'gro kun rang grol shog /ces pa'ang chos mdzad mos ldan 'ga'i dge sbyor gsal 'debs su yon tan rgya mtshos dben pa'i ri ngogs su 'phyi sgom gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i skabs su bris pas 'gro ba mang por phan thogs par shog cig /dge legs 'phel// //zhal gdams ngesan brgyad ma/dza/ ye shes klong nas byin rlabs 'bebs pa/ /rdo rje'i bla ma padma ka ra/ /dbyer med sangs rgyas padma nyin byed/ /snying dbus dwangs ma'i thig ler mchod do/ /dad pa dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor/ /zab mo'i lam la brtson 'grus mdzad pa/ /skal bzang khyed la gdams pa'i mdo 'gag /gang shar lhug par smra 'dir gson cig /kye lags/ mi'i lus 'di shin tu rnyed par dka' ste dbul pos yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnyed pa lta bu'o/ /mi lus rin po che 'di la ma brten par thar pa sgrub

68 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pa'i thabs ma mchis so/ /dal 'byor chud ma gzon cig gzhan dag la yang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams dang po'o/ /lto rgyab tsam gyi ched du sdig pa la tsham tshom med par 'jug pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /mi dge ba sha stag la dus rtag tu spyod pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs bsgrub pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /phyi ma skad cig kyang ma dran pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /chos sgor zhugs kyang chos bzhin mi byed pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /sdom pa dam tshig ras su bor ba ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /chos brgyad la nang rdzong byed pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /snyan grags dang stobs 'byor bsgrub pa ni dal 'byor chud gzan pa'o/ /yul khams 'di dang dus tshod 'di lta bu la dal 'byor chud gsan pa ni ches mang ngo / /dal 'byor don yod byed pa ni nyung ngo / /mdor na dam pa'i chos mi sgrub na bsam sbyor thams cad dal 'byor chud gsan pa'i rgyu las ma 'das/ dam pa'i chos ma bsgrub na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho bzod dka' ba las thar pa'i thabs ma mchis so/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'phral yun thams cad du bde legs ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas te lo tog legs pa dang 'dra'o/ /dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la nan tan du mdzod cig gzhan dag la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams gnyis pa'o/ /rang nyid che 'dod kyis dge sbyor byed pa ni dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /gzhan la 'gran 'dod kyis tshogs gsog byed pa ni dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /sems can la gnod pa'i rten bzhengs dang gnas bskor la sogs pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /ngas byas can gyi mchod sbyin byed pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 69rlom sems can gyi tshul khrims srung ba'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /nga rgyal can gyi thos bsam byed pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /mchog 'dzin can gyi stong nyid bsgom pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /phyogs ris can gyi snying rje byed pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /blun zhen u tshugs snying la zhen pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /rang rgyud ma smin gzhan don byed pa'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /bsgoms bsgoms bsgrubs bsgrubs byas byas mang po'ang dam pa'i chos ma yin no/ /mdor na chos par khas 'che ba grog ma'i tshang ltar brdol yang chos dang rang rgyud 'dres pa nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du dkon pa la ltos/ rang rgyud chos dang 'dres na chos lam du song ba bya ba thar lam gyi rmang / sangs rgyas kyi lam/ grub pa rnams kyi gshegs shul yin no/ /rang rgyud chos dang 'dres par mdzod cig gzhan dag la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams gsum pa'o/ /lto gos rnyed bkur snyan grags la ltos pa med na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba gtad med ling gis 'bor nus na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /tshul 'chos dang mdzes khrigs kyi rtsis gdab med na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /rang che nga rgyal spangs nas dman pa'i sa zin na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /las rgyu 'bras mig gi 'bras bu ltar mthong na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /grub mtha' la phyogs ris mi 'byung na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /dag snang ris med du 'byongs na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /chos la tshod yod mi byed na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /gang zag gi rgyud tshod mi bzung na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /chen po la mtho sdang mi byed na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /nyam chung khyad

70 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/du mi gsod na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /gzhan skyon mi rtog rang skyon rtog na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /bdud kyi phye gtor mi 'gam na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /rang phyogs kyi mgo 'don mi byed na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /gzhan phyogs kyis brnyas dogs mi 'byung na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /zab mo'i don la the tshom bral na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /lam rtags la rlom sems mi byed na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /'bras bu la re ba mi byed na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /lam las phyir ldog mi byed na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /blo sna ri ltar du brtan na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa yin no/ /mang du smos pas ci bya/ chos pa'i gzugs brnyan dang seng ge'i gsob gnyis la dgos dus su 'bras bus stong pa yin kyang /deng sang seṅge'i gsob gyon pa mang bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan pa nyi ma nub kha'i zer thag lta bu 'di'ang mi snang ba'i thabs kho na la brtson par snang gi gsob ma gyon zhig de las tha mal pa rang dga' 'o/ /tha mal pas dkon mchog la brten pa'i sdig pa cher bsags pa ma yin no/ /chos lam du mi 'gro ba'i rgyu de tshe 'di blos ma thongs ba las byung / tshe blos mi thongs ba de rgyu bdag 'dzin bag chags ngan pa dang / rkyen 'chi ba ma dran pa las byung bas mi rtag pa'i 'du shes kyis snying la gzer thob cig gzhan dag la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams bzhi pa'o/ /chos la brtson 'grus rtsom pa yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /tshe 'di'i che thabs mi bsgrub pa'ang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /rgyu 'bras 'jol nyog tu mi spyod pa'ang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /chos las phyir ldog mi 'byung ba yang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 71'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /'khor ba'i btson ra las thar ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /chos brgyad kyi khong mtshang bud pa yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /chags sdang gi sgrog las grol ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /bdud kyi spyod pa spang ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /grogs ngan gyi spyod pa mi 'go ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /mig ltos ngan pa'i rjes su mi 'brang ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /byas pa don med du mi 'gyur ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /rang mgo rang gis mi bskor ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /rang skyon rang gis mthong ba yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /smyon pas rang ngo zin pa yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub pa yang 'chi ba dran pa las 'byung ngo / /'chi ba dran pa'i rjes su chos la rdo rus gtugs shig gzhan du yi mug gi sems khral tsam du 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sa bon/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs dam ni/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi byang chub sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis yin la/ don dam yang kun rdzob la brten nas skye bas byams pa dang snying rje'i sems dang rtag tu mi 'bral bar mdzod cig gzhan la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams lnga pa'o/ /ci byed rang don gyi 'khri ba med na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /dgra dang gnyen bshes ngo mnyam na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /mtho ris kyi bde ba la mi chags na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal la mi 'cher na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /'khor ba dang du len nus na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /myang 'das ched du mi gnyer na byang chub kyi sems

72 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'byongs pa'o/ /mi 'dod pa spang bya med na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /rang 'dod kyi don 'bras bsgrub bya med na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /rang gi bde ba gzhan la sbyin nus na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang gis len nus na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /thang lhod dang phyogs ris med na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /'gro kun pha mar shes na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /ngas byas kyi khong yus dang bral na byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'o/ /'di dang gtan gyi bde skyid ji snyed mchis pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems rin po che kho na las byung bas/ byang chub sems kyi yon tan ni tshad med dpag tu ma mchis/ 'tshang rgya ba'i lam mi 'acesal na der zad/ btsal nas sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu 'dod phyin chad lo tog 'dod pa la sa bon dang chu lud lta bu ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di yin pas 'di dang ma bral bar 'chi khar dbugs la slebs par gyis shig rgyud thog tu mi khel ba'i zab zab mang pos bslu'o/ /zhon rta brling ba gcig gis chu rabs chod pa yin no/ /nyams len gu yangs pa gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi sar skyel ba yin no/ /bdag 'dzin rtsa ba ma chod pa'i snying rje kho na yang phyogs gcig pa'i gol sa yin gyi/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud la skye bar mdzad 'tshal/ de la dpyad sgom pa'i lugs de kha 'byongs pas/ byin rlabs kyi rig pa dang 'jog sgom gyi zhabs su ldan pas srid pa'i rtsa ba bde blag tu gcad 'tshal/ dpyad pas kyang bden 'dzin cung zad 'jig mod/ ye shes snying la ma phab bar du gnyug ma'i rang zhal mjal bar mi 'gyur bas rnam rtog gi stong skor la yang dag pa'i sgom par ma rloms shig ye shes ni byin rlabs las rang byung du 'char bar 'gyur zhing / byin rlabs mos gus

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 73las 'byung bas/ mos gus ni/ bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i gshegs shul/gsang sngags lam gyi yang snying / dad ldan ku swā li rnams kyi bsgrub bya/ khyad par nā ro bka' brgyud kyi gces nor yin pas bla ma'i mos gus la sgrub pa'i gces nor mdzod cig gzhan la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams drug pa'o/ /mos gus kyis rtogs pa rang byung du shar ro/ /mos gus kyis rig pa snying dbus su sad do/ /mos gus kyis rang rig chos sku ru mthong ngo / /mos gus kyis snang srid bla ma ru mthong ngo / /mos gus kyis 'khrul snang btsan thabs su 'gag go /mos gus kyis rlung sems dbu ma ru 'jug go /mos gus kyis snang sems ro gcig tu 'dre'o/ /mos gus kyis sdig lhung rang bzhin du 'dag go /mos gus kyis snang grags lha sngags su shes so/ /mos gus kyis chos min rtog pa kun zhi'o/ /mos gus kyis gegs dang gol sa kun grol lo/ /mos gus kyis sa lam bde myur du bgrod do/ /mos gus kyis gcig shes kun grol du 'gyur ro/ /bzlog tu med pa dus mtha'i me lta bu'i mos gus de gang la bya na bla ma la bya/ bla ma rtogs pa'i chu rgyun ma chad/ nyams rtogs kyi srol ka ma nub/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan ma bsnyal/ dam sel gyi rnyog pas ma bslad/ bar chad kyi byur 'dre ma zhugs/ rnam g.yeng gi rlung gis ma khyer/ chos dang rang rgyud ma 'dzol ba zhig la bya/ so skye'i rten la skyon du mngon pa re cis kyang 'ong bas bla ma'i skyon la mi rtog pa khag che/ bla ma dang sngags la the tshom zhugs na dngos grub kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung gi steng du ngan song gi tshogs chen po sgrub pa yin/ de ltar mos gus kyi shugs las rang byung gi ye shes shar ba de nyid dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis thang lhod med par skyong ba

74 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gdams pa thams cad kyi snying po ste/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi rnal 'byor la rtag tu brtson par mdzod/ gzhan la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams bdun pa'o/ /dran shes can la mi dge ba'i spyod pa mi 'byung ngo / /dran shes can la nyes pa dang lhung ba mi 'byung ngo / /dran shes can la ma brtags pa'i spyod pa mi 'byung ngo / /dran shes can la pha rol gyi g.yo sgyus mi brdzi'o/ /dran shes can la bdud ris kyis bar du mi chod do/ /dran shes can la 'byung po yi glags ltas mi khel lo/ /dran shes can la yengs 'khrul gyi bar gseng mi zhugs so/ /dran shes can la nyams myong gi sgron me 'bar ro/ /dran shes can la zhi gnas kyi rgya mtsho 'khyil lo/ /dran shes can la rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'char ro/ /dran shes can la yon tan gyi yar zla rgyas so/ /dran shes de lta bus gang bskyang na rang sems kyi ngo bo bskyang ba yin no/ /sems las sangs rgyas 'byung / chos sku nang nas 'char/ nor bu lag mthil nas rnyed/ des na chos byed pa la rang gi sems la rang dbang ci thob ma gtogs phyi rol du spu tsam yang rag ma las pa zhig dgos/ gdams ngag thams cad kyi yang snying / chos thams cad kyi mdo/ zab lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas rang sems kyi ngo bo bskyang ba la rtag tu brtson par mdzod/ gzhan dag la'ang de ltar du gdams shig ces pa zhal gdams brgyad pa'o/ /de'ang las dang po bas skad cig kyang yengs su mi gzhug rta rgod btul ba ltar bskyang / de la yun thung grangs mang ba dgos/ gnas pa'i sne zin nas grim lhod ran pos bram zes skud pa 'khel ba ltar bskyang / de la 'du 'dzis dben pa dgos/ 'gyu ba rang thog tu song nas bsgom du rdul tsam med la yengs su skad

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 75cig kyang med par rang bab to por bskyang / de la dran shes kyi so pa dgos/ ngo bo rjen par mthong nas bzo bcos blos byas dang bral bar gshis lugs chams 'jog tu bskyang / de la brtson 'grus kyi lcag dgos/ gnas lugs kyi mtshang rig nas snang stong la nye ring med par thams cad gnyug ma'i yo lang rin chen gser gling du phyin pa lta bur bskyang / de thams cad du mos gus kyi gzer dgos/ mdor na rang sems wa ler hrig ge ba 'di nyid lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin pas bzo bcos ma byas par hrig ge ba de ngo shes pas chog rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'char ba 'di ye shes kyi rang mdangs yin pas gang shar la cher cher bltas pas rang zhi rang grol du song ba de nyams len gyi mthil yin/ nyams bzang po la 'thas nas gnas pa shas che ba ni nyams bzang po lta bu'i ngan pa yin pas de la ma 'thas pa dgos/ nyams yal nas rig pa dwangs sangs/ sngon las rnam rtog sbun pa de lhag mthong skye 'dod pa yin pas nyams ngan pa 'dra ba'i bzang po yin/ de'i dus su rtog pa rang grol du bskyang dgos/ mdor na grub chen sa ra has/ so ma/ lhug pa/rang dwangs la zhog ces gnad gsum gsungs pa 'di phyag rgya chen po pa rnams kyi bsgom bya yin te/ so ma zhes pa rang sems la bzo bcos ma byas pa/ lhug pa zhes pa 'bad rtsol med pa/ rang dwangs ni rnam rtog la gnyen pos ma spangs pa ste nyams len gyi gnad thams cad ni de gsum la 'du'o/ /lta ba thams cad rang sems kyi gnas lugs yin no/ /sgom pa thams cad rang sems kyi rang mdangs yin no/ /spyod pa thams cad rang sems kyi rtsal sbyong yin no/ /'bras bu thams cad rang sems rang gis rtogs pa la 'du'o/ /chos thams cad rang gi sems 'dul thabs su gsungs so/ /lha 'dre thams cad rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul du zad rdo// /

76 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'khor 'das thams cad rang sems rtogs dang ma rtogs kyi khyad do/ /skyon thams cad rang sems kyi 'khrul snang yin no/ /yon tan thams cad rang sems kyi rang bab la yod do/ /mdor na rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rtogs pa las sangs rgyas gud na med pas/ gnas lugs gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma padma nyin byed kyi bar du byon pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la brnyes pa gang yin pa de/ skal ldan khyod kyi snying la 'phos nas mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa sgrol ba'i ded dpon dam par gyur cig /a ho/ blo gros mtha' yas ming can 'du shes ni gsum pa/ /'jig rten chos dang ma mthun byung rgyal du spyod kyang / /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur bzhengs padma yi nyin byed/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu bcu phrag ni gsum gyi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs bsten smin grol gyi mdzod thob/ /mig btsum mchi ma 'don pa'i stong yus 'dra med kyang / /mos gus rdo yi ri mo 'gyur ba ni mi 'dug /dngos grub nor bu'i pha phogs thob pa zhig los yong / /bla ma ma nor rgyud ldan byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod/ /lta ba ma nor nges don dbu ma ni chen po/ /sgom pa ma nor phyag rdzogs theg pa yi yang rtse/ /spyod pa ma nor mdo sngags rang gzhung bzhin zhugs pas/ /'bras bu ma nor rtsol med lhun grub tu los thob/ /spangs rtogs yon tan gzhal na ri bong gi rwa mtshungs/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang bzhin mo gsham gyi bu bzhin/ /bdag 'dras gzhan la phan pa'i re ba ni med kyang / /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i smon lam 'dra btab pas/ /cal col tshig gi tha snyad don dam du 'gyur srid/ /'ur sgra 'brug ltar ldir ba'i 'gro don ni med kyang / /bsam sbyor thams cad gzhan don kho na ru bsngos yod/ /byang chub lam dang sne 'dzol ma gyur

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 77tsam byung na/ /don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa'i rten 'brel 'dra los 'grig /mngon shes grub rtags la sogs snyan grags kyi 'phyor chas/ /tha mal skye bo mgu ba'i rnam dpyod de med kyang / /rang byung rig/ pa'i khye'u grogs su ni 'thams pas/ /lhan skyes rang zhal lta la the tshom 'dra mi 'dug /bka' brgyud grub pa'i gshegs shul ring po na med dam/ /de phyir nye lam zab mo snying po ru byed na/ /blo bral tha mal shes pa chos sku yi rang bzhin/ /rang lugs rig pa rkyang ded 'phrang lam la bcur nas/ /the tshom res 'jog med par gcig tshugs su bskyangs te/ /gnas lugs lhums su tshud pa'i rtogs ldan zhig mdzod dang / /yu bu 'bral med gdod ma'i grub mtha' de bsnyegs nas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel 'dra zhu'o/ /zhes pa'ang sgrub pa la snying por mdzad pa'i bla ma 'od 'phros yang yang bskul ngor yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs dben khrod du smras pa gzhan la phan par gyur cig/ //sems ngo skyong thabs kyi man ngagalje/ bka' brgyud gdung 'tshob rje btsun padma'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so thar pa'i lam sna drongs/ /'chi rgyu yin par kun gyis shes na yang / /nam 'chi cha med gnad du ma phog pas/ /ci byas 'khor ba ngan song rgyu ru song / /mgo la skra dkar zug kyang 'dug tshis sgrub/ /kha nas so gral zhig kyang blo sna ring / /sdom pa dam tshig bsrung mtshams ngo mi shes/ /thar pa'i srog gcod dkor la chog shes med/ /byur ngan chags sdang 'di dang 'dris drags pas/ /don med 'khrul rtog ngang du mi tshe zad/ /rgas rgas sdod long su yang mi 'dug pas/ /mi tshe stong zad tshis la mi

78 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'bad par/ /nam 'chi cha med snying nas dran par mdzod/ /'di bgyis 'di byas mang po'i kha na med/ /'chi ba dran na chos phyed tshar ba lags/ /bka' gter chos la zad pa'i mtha' med cing / /nyams su blang na phan yon che mnyam yang / /kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems ngo bo skyongs/ /bya sla don che chos kyi mthar thug lags/ /gnas 'gyu'i ngo lta tsam ni sngar nas shes/ /rig thog rdo rus 'phrod pa'i nyams rtogs med/ /bogs dang yon tan gong du ma 'phel bas/ /chos go chod min the tshom za mi dgos/ /phyi ru ma yengs yengs mkhan ngo bo ltos/ /nang du ma sgoms sgom mkhan rtsad brdar chod/ /sgom snyam shes pa phyi mas lhan ma gdab/ /yid ches rtog pa'i rkun bu nang ma gzhug /mdor na gang yang yid la mi byed par/ /tha mal shes pa rang ngo shes tsam ngang / /dgag sgrub bzo bcos med par skyong shes na/ /chos sku'i rang zhal rim gyis mjal bar 'gyur/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i mngon rtogs ma lus pa/ /bla ma'i mos gus kho nas bgrod gsungs phyir/ /gcig chog rgyal po rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir mos gus 'bral med bya/ /dbang lung gdams phran re tsam kun nas thob/ /ltar snang dad zhen rang phyogs kun la yod/ /gcer mthong rang ngo sus kyang sprod ma myong / /rtsa ba'i bla ma su yin mi 'tshal na/ /rgyal bas phyag chen bdag por lung bstan cing / /ma 'ongs brgyud 'dzin gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /rtogs pa skye bar nyid kyis zhal bzhes la/ /mnyam med dwags po rtsa ba'i bla mar zungs/ /'brel thogs bla ma rnams dang dbyer med sgoms/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir mi brjed dran brtan gyis/ /mos gus gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas thob/ /thugs yid bsres la rang ngo bcos med skyongs/ /gdul bya gang la gang 'dul ma gtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chos skur

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 79dbye ba med/ /de phyir lha gcig bsgrubs pas thams cad 'grub/ /gcig las gcig legs gnyis 'dzin spang blang blos/ /thams cad bsgrubs pas gcig kyang mi 'grub rgyu/ /de phyir yi dam lha gcig phur tshugs sgoms/ /dbang lung rnam grangs shin tu mang po thob/ /grangs bsnyen 'brel pa thogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mang / /'di yang legs snyam spro bsdu sna tshogs 'don/ /yi dam gang yin nges tig med pa na/ /bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /chos skal gsang sngags yi ge drug ma ste/ /lha sngags 'di las phan yon che ba'i chos/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis ma gsungs shing / /rang re bod kyis bsgrub na 'grub thag nye/ /blo sna mang yang a thang chad pa'i rgyu/ /lha gcig sngags gcig 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /bde ba gtang zhing sdug bsngal len pa dang / /skye med rdor bzlas de yi grogs su khyer/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed chos kyi sngon 'gro yin/ /mos gus snying rje chos kyi snying po yin/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug chos rnams kun gyi srog /bsngo ba smon lam chos kyi rjes bsdu yin/ /sems can blo yi rnam rtog ma zad par/ /de srid chos kyi pha ma tha' zad pa med/ /de kun lag tu lon pa'i thabs med pas/ /rang sems gcig rtogs de kun mtshan nyid shes/ /de bas gcig shes kun grol 'bad par 'tshal/ /'di yang gu ru dzhai ṣa dzu nyid kyi/ /bzhed pa skong slad dpal spungs yang khrod du/ /'khos med bya bas tshur la btang ba'i mi/ /yon tan rgya mtshos rang la dpags nas bris/ /dge bas grub pa'i rgyal sa zin par the(ga /dge'o// //

80 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dam pa'i gsung lan 'brel tshad don ldan/7/ skyabs dus gsum kun mkhyen padma dang / /dbyings gcig gyur padma nyid byed dbang / /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin rlabs stsol/ /gson dang rig 'dzin bgres po lags/ /chos ma shes nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa min/ /lag tu ma blangs pas rang re bslus/ /mtho mtho zab zab cig 'dod 'dod nas/ /thos tshad la che gnyer med pa de/ /rgyud tha mal du lus pa'i snga ltas su gda'/ /bka' mdo rgyud rnams su ma 'thus pa'i/ /gdams ngag tu rlom pa'i tshigs bcad sogs/ /chos gsar pa'i khong na ci yang med/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang grub thob gsung / /byin rlabs can gyi tshig gcig des/ /the tshom mdud pa mang bkrol bas/ /so skyes mdzes mdzes bsgrigs pa yi/ /pusti mang pos do zla min/ /bka' dang mthun na chos pa yin/ /lung dang mthun na nyams myong yin/ /the tshom chod na rtogs ldan yin/ /rlom sems spangs na btsun po yin/ /rgyun chad med na rnal 'byor yin/ /chos kha bshad shes pa mang lags kyang / /sems chos dang 'dres pa'i nyin mo'i skar/ /blo rgyud gnya' rengs su btang bas lan/ /de 'chi ba rgyud la ma dran pas lan/ /nam 'chi cha med 'di ma go ba'i/ /ming chos par btags nas chos brgyad dang / /skad cig kyang 'bral bar mi phod pa'i/ /bdag lta bu'i ser gzugs grog tshang ltar/ /brdol nas bstan la rma 'byin par/ /yi lan brgyar chad kyang las kyi mthus/ /rang dbang rang gis ma 'dus par/ /nyin mtshan chos min gyi 'khor lo bskor/ /las rgyu 'bras kyi rang gzugs bslu med de/ /rang thog tu myong 'gyur

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 81dran tsa na/ /snying tshal bar mi 'gro 'di ci zhig /dpal 'byor rtsa rtser chags pa yi/ /zil pa phra rab tsam zhig la/ /blo 'bral bar ma bzod dal 'byor lus/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa/ /chos min gyi bsam sbyor shes tshad kyis/ /chud zos su btang ba bdag 'dra bas/ /deng sang rgyal khams kun gang ba/ /'di mthong tshe mtho ris thar pa'i lam/ /ming tsam du gyur snyam rab tu skyo/ /khyed rnal 'byor dbang po ji ltar dgongs/ /'on kyang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /thabs mkhas 'gro phan mdzad pa la/ /tshul ston du sna tshogs gzugs 'chang dang / /nang gi rnal 'byor la gnas pa sogs/ /khong ye shes spyan ldan ma gtogs pa/ /so skye'i brtags dpyad ci tsam du/ /legs kyang rgyud tshod mi zin pas/ /dag snang 'di chos kyi snying po yin/ /grub mtha'i rang tshugs shor dogs pas/ /so so'i sa na che bshad kyis/ /gzhan gyi skyon 'don mang lags kyang / /rang re la tshugs ka'i gnyer med pas/ /shes bzhin du thar lam mi sgrib par/ /dag snang gi blo rgya bskyed par 'tshal/ /dag snang phyogs med mkhan go ba'i slad/ /chos thos tshad nyan la lag len med/ /dbang bskur tshad zhu yang nyams len med/ /bla ma mthong tshad bsten la dam tshig med/ /snyigs dus mi blo bdud kyis bsgyur/ /bstan bshig zog po 'grim sgo che/ /gser ra gan nor nyen 'dug pas na/ /dag snang phal cher phung ba'i rgyu/ /de 'dra 'chal pa yin pas spang / /kun rdzob zhabrul sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos/ /rmi lam rmis pa'i myong tshor ltar/ /don dam gyi gshis su ma grub kyang / /ji srid 'khrul snang ma dag pa/ /de srid las 'bras phra mo yang / /bslu ba med la nges rnyed na/ /ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs mtho ris kyi/ /sgo chen phyed 'gyur 'jig rten pa'i/ /yang dag lta ba de tsam zhig /mi ldan stong pa'i rbad khams can/ /

82 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'brel tshad log pa'i 'dren ston yin/ /snang tsam 'di bkag kyang mi khegs kyi/ /'dzin zhen gyi lhad kyis ma bslad na/ /snang shes gnyis stong pa nyid du mnyam/ /gnas lugs spros dang bral bas na/ /bcos ma'i dgag sgrub rang bcing rgyu/ /mtshan 'dzin rtog pas stong pa de/ /rgyal bas stong par mthong zhes gsungs/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab yin/ /blo yis byas pa'i spros bral de/ /yul du byas pa'i stong nyams te/ /med dgag gi zhen la 'then 'then nas/ /lta bar nyes na phung khrol che/ /rnam rtog gi bun long stong par mthong mthong ba po gtad med kyi ngang du grol/ /'dzin med kyi rig pa zang thal de/ /yid dpyod kyi mun pas ma bsgribs na/ /'od gsal gyi nyi ma khor yug shar/ /rtsol med kyi rang sa ma zin na/ /rtsol bcas kyi bsam gtan 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /bya ba snying nas ma thongs na/ /btang bas rtsol ba tshur la 'bor/ /rtogs ma rtogs kyi re dogs sangs pa na/ /rtogs pa kun gyi mchog tu gyur/ /deng sang lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo/ /chos bshad skye bo pho mo mkhas/ /sgom kha la babs pas sa steng gang / /rgyud nyon mongs dul ba ri bong rwa/ /mi tshe zab zob kyi ngang du zad/ /'gro ba 'dren par rlom na yang / /lam sna phyogs tsam ma zin pa/ /skal dman rnams de 'dra la ngo mtshar byed/ /dam pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa'i/ /ser gzugs de gnyis phung gi tho ba yin/ /de la ngo mtshar ci zhig yod/ /chos dang sne gcig mthun gyur na/ /rtogs pa dman yang ngo mtshar che/ /chos min gyis rang rgyud bsregs bsregs nas/ /mi rjes ma sleb pa'i sdug gtam lags/ /khyed bden pa gzigs la zhu ba min/ /bstan par khag bsnyad kyi zhabrug rtsod dang / /kha mchu bun skyed tshong khe sogs/ /gzhan gnod kyis phug tu 'tshang bzhin du/ /'dul 'dzin du rlom pa spyon pa

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 83dngos/ /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spangs pa de/ /khyim na gnas kyang tshangs spyod kyi mchog/ /log 'tsho sdud thabs kyi 'phyor gos de med kyang bzod/ /byang chub don du gnyer ba'i blo/ /'bral ba med de sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos kun 'dus pa rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos thams cad 'dun pa'i tsa bar gnas/ /'dun pa ma zhum pa zhig 'tshal/ /skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad/ /mi 'bral gzhan phan gzhir bcas spyad/ /theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba ste/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub la med ka med/ /rang 'dod can gyi snying rje dang / /bdag gces 'dzin can gyi 'gro phan de/ /byang chub kyi spyod dang 'gal na yang / /chos pa bzang brdzus bslus pa mang / /gsang sngags kyi sgo ru zhugs phyin chad/ /dam tshig med na khang stong yin/ /dmatshotshig gi snying po mos gus yin/ /bcos min gyi mos gus skyes pa la/ /mchog gi ye shes 'bab cing 'khor/ /bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba la/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs 'jug /zang zing gi gnang sbyin ngo bstod sogs/ /mthun 'jug 'dod thog tu byung tsa na/ /sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug pa skad/ /chos brgyad dang g.yo sgyu mi ldan na/ /mi chos ma mkhas pas phung ba skad/ /rang 'dod kyis bla ma bzang ngan bcos/ /ci mdzad legs par ma mthong ba'i/ /bcos ma'i mos gus de yi chad rgyu/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro ba bsod nams chung / /zog po rnams ni sangs rgyas su mthong / /dam pa rnams ni khyi ltar lod/ /dge sdig kyang de bzhin go ldog spyod/ /rgyu des bskyed mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung / /so skye'i rang 'dod la gtad so ci/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la dpang po 'tshal/ /deng sang dus kyi dbang gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas byon nas chos gsungs kyang / /mgo ril ril byed pa ma gtogs pa/ /yid ches thob pa 'byung dka' bas/ /grong tshig gi phreng bas ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang dam pa'i gsung gi

84 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/lan/ /mdor bsdus byung rgyal du smras te phul/ /'brel thogs rgyud la phan par shog /ces rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor maṅga la'i mtshan can gyi bzhed ngor yon tan rgya mtshos smras pa dge/ //thugs dam gsal 'debs zab don snying dril ma/lje/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med phrin las kyi/ /lha mchog de yi byin rlabs rkyen nyid dang / /bslab gsum rgyu tshogs 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel las/ /gang nyid chos la brtson pa'i 'a bras bu'i sne/ /rnyed par gda' bas chud zos ma gtong mdzod/ /grwa sar zhugs tshe yon tan che ba yis/ /mchog dman kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas thob kyang / /rang rgyud tha mal ngang du mi tshe zad/ /mdo sngags 'di dang rang rgyud mthun no zhes/ /blo bde tshags su tshud pa mi 'byung bas/ /tshe gcig spros bcas rnam g.yeng 'byams pa las/ /nges 'byung skyo shas skad cig skyes pa dga'/ /mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran pa ni/ /'du shes kun gyi nang nas mchog go zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa de yis nan tan gdams/ /sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyang gdams ngag 'dis/ /myur du sa lam yon tan rdzogs pa lags/ /deng sang chos pas 'chi ba ma dran pas/ /lo zla song bzhin rtag 'dzin phyi phyir che/ /dgos dgos ngang la mi tshe yud kyis gda'/ /chos su rlom pa'i bsam sbyor byas tshad kun/ /nyon mongs gros/sa su song nas rang rgyud gyong / /dam chos tshul bzhin ma grub 'jig rten gyi/ /bya gzhag rnams kyang 'dod thog ma 'khyol ba'i/ /gnyis med seng ges dal 'byor yid bzhin nor/ /chud zos btang ba des kyang ma chog par/ /dkon

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 85mchog la brten sdig pa tshabs che bas/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su gtan yul byas la gzigs/ /de lta bas na nges 'byung skyo shas kyis/ /rtag tu rang rgyud 'khul bar mdzad pa na/ /chos pa kun gyi yang rtser son par 'gyur/ /nges 'byung yod na dam chos shugs kyis 'grub/ /skyo shas can la mos gus ngang gis 'byung / /zhen log can la mthun rkyen rang bzhin 'byor/ /ji tsam 'dod zhen che ba de tsam du/ / 'dod thog mi 'gro mi 'dod thog tu bab/ /ji tsam re ba che ba de tsam du/ /bsam rgu mi 'grub dgos don phyin ci log /mi che gcig ni mdang sum rmi lam 'dra/ /bzang ngan gnyis ka rjes shul bsdad pa med/ /da lo'i skyid sdug sang phod yal nas 'gro/ /bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khrul snang la/ /re dogs ling gis bor na bde ba che/ /gzhan las ma btsal rang gi sems las rnyed/ /rang 'dod can gyis smon lam btab na yang / /bde ba can gyi zhing du phyin par dka'/ /bsam pas bde ba 'dod kyang sbyor ba ni/ /sdug bsngal bsgrub pa 'bor ba spyi yi lugs/ /sems bskyed bzang ngan byas tshad chos yin kyang / /rang 'dod 'khri ba zad nas gzhan don las/ /bya rgyu med pa'i sems bskyed shin tu dka'/ /dang po'i sems kyi 'phen pa tsam zhig las/ /phal cher snang shas rjes su 'gro ba mang / /de 'dra byang chub sems dpa'i spyod min pas/ /bya byed mang yang lam du 'gro ba min/ /kha yis sems bskyed zhe la rang don sgrub/ /chos tshugs bzang yang nyan rang 'thob pa'i rgyu/ /byang chub sems kyi bsngags pa rjod byed kyang / /byang chub sems gnyis rang la mi ldan na/ /dbul pos nor bu'i bsngags pa brjod dang mtshungs/ /snying rje zol med sems la skye ba na/ /rnam gzhag bshad mi shes kyang rgyal ba'i sras/ /rang sems ngo bo zhabrul med rtogs pa na/ /grub rtags ston ma nus kyang brgyud pa

86 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/zin/ /des na ltar snang dge ba 'bum phrag las/ /mos gus snying rje gting nas skye ba dang / /rang sems ngo bo skad cig mthong ba mchog /nyams kyi 'char sgo lho sprin na bun 'dra/ /rang sems stong pa'i klong nas ci yang shar/ /gang shar sems las gzhan du ma grub pas/ /don la phan gnod med cing de nyid la/ /bden 'dzin byas na sgom chen sgom gyis bslu/ /re dogs byas na gegs dang bar chad 'jug /dgag sgrub byas na mtshan ma'i gol sas 'ching / /'on kyang ma bsgom pa la nyams mi skye/ /skyes pa skad kyang gnad la bcar na rdzun/ /khams 'dus la sogs bzang ngan ci byung yang / /sgom pa gnad du song ba'i rtags yin phyir/ /gang shar rang gi sems su thag chod pas/ /re dogs dgag sgrub med par dbyings su bskyur/ /shar mkhan ngang du bzhag pas 'char sgo yang / /bya lam rjes med rtogs pa'i bogs thon cing / /rtogs pa'i rang rtsal 'khor 'das snang cha kun/ /ma sgrib 'char bas nyams kyi bogs kyang 'byin/ /deng sang rtogs ldan grub thob mtshan can dang / /grub mtha' skyong rgyu med kyang sde ris kyi/ /phyogs 'dzin dam pa'i che rgu phal mo che/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'jig rten phyi ma la/ /yid mi ches pas rang dang rang nyid la/ /'brel pa zab tshad ngan 'gro'i phyogs su 'phul/ /khyim pa rnams la bstan pa'i gnyer med kyang / /bsod nams zad pas phyogs ris kha 'dzin byed/ /rim gyis tshabs che sde zhabrugs phung la sbyor/ /de 'dra'i phyogs der phyi ma lta ci smos/ /mthong chos la yang bkra mi shis kun 'byung / /des na rang 'dra'i nyam chung gang zag rnams/ /chos nas bshad tshod nyams len thebs dka' yang / /chos spangs las ma bsags pa tsam byung na/ /snyigs ma'i skye bo rnams la do gal che/ /gnyid dang chang la bag med spyod pa dang / /le lo snyom las ltar snang chos

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 87spyod kyi/ /rnam par g.yeng bas mi tshe thabs kyis rku/ /sdig pa'i grogs pos ma tshor ngan 'gror khrid/ /thos chung nga rgyal che bas bdud las grub/ /lha mthong 'dre mthong sdom pa zhor la 'jig /log 'tsho'i rnyed pas rtsa ba'i lhung ba 'grub/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod bsod nams rmang nas sgyel/ /phyogs ris chags sdang 'brel tshad log ltar btsud/ /chos pa chos ltar bcos pa'i mtshang ngan de/ /gzhan la mi ngoms rang ngo shes srid na/ /deng sang grub thob kun gyi rgyal po lags/ /go ba lhan po 'dra bas rkyen mi theg /nyams myong 'ja' tshon 'dra bas grul mi thub/ /rtogs pa'i rang zhal nang nas mjal ba de/ /nam yang mi 'gyur dgos dus khrig ger sleb/ /lan re sems rgyud chos dang 'dres 'dra yang / /yul snang 'phrad tshe rkyen gyi dbang du 'chor/ /de rjes 'brang nas bsam sbyor sngar bas lod/ /skabs rer rang sems ngo bo mthong 'dra yang / /dran pas ma zin tha mal ngang du 'byams/ / rtse gcig mngon rtogs tsam yang rgyud la med/ /'chi ba snying zug mi tshe sgrub pa la/ /skyel ba'i snying rus can zhig ma gtogs pa/ /shes snyam yin snyam ngang la lus pa mang / /bdag 'dra'i 'chi ba ma dran chos gzugs rnams/ /'gyod pa rtas mi sleb kyang phyis pa tsam/ /skal ldan grogs dag snying rus 'don par 'tshal ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i don/ /bzo med tha mal shes pa 'di yin te / /yin min bshad pa mang po'i kha na med/ /mos gus byin rlabs lam du lhong ba las/ /gding nas nges shes rnyed na de kas chog /rang ngo shes pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ /yengs med dran pas rtag tu skyong nus dgos/ /ma bskyangs rgyal bu dmangs su 'khyams dang mtshungs/ /shes rig rang tshugs mi thub 'khrul pas g.yengs/ /de 'dra tha mal pa dang khyad ci yod/ /'on kyang yengs dogs brjed dogs shugs chen

88 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pos/ /ha cang btsir na de nyid 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /lhod kyis klod la hrig gis rig pa'i ngang / /ma brjed dran pa'i bya ras rgyang so btsugs/ /de tshe thol skye rnam rtog 'phral du rig /rig mkhan stong par yal tshe las dang po/ /rig mkhan rnam rtog gnyis ka dbyer med du/ /shar nas rang bzhin stong pa 'bring gi sa/ /tha mal ngang du 'phro gnas tha snyad bral/ /shar dang ma shar spyod pa'i dran pa yal/ /rig bya rig byed gnyug ma zang thal du/ /shar na sgom pa bdag po'i lag tu 'khyol/ /de 'dra tshad du 'byol na snying po yi/ /bstan la zhugs pa'i dgos don ma stong tsam/ /sgom chen dran pa brten pa mang mod kyang / /dran tsam nyid las skyong rgyu med pa dang / /rnam rtog ngo shes kho nas chog go zhes/ /rig stong rjen pa'i rang zhal ma mthong ba'i/ /mchog 'dzin lam gyis sgom chen bslus pa mang / /dran tsam chog pa'ang 'dzin zhen phra mos bslad/ /rnam rtog mthar 'ded nying 'khrul lu gu rgyud/ /phyogs tsam yin kyang gnad du ma 'khyol ba'i/ /sgom pas rang gzhan bslus na tshabs che bas/ /dran 'khrul mnyam rjes la sogs bcos ma'i blos/ /dgag sgrub ma byas chos nyid rnal ma la/ /'dzin stangs bzhigs pa'i rtog med rang gsal ngang / /rang bab 'jog pa lam gyi snying po lags/ /thos pa med pa'i sgom chen mun par 'khyams/ /man ngag med pa'i rnyesnam chen ce( brgyal che/ /dran mang 〉stom chen mtha' gzhug rlung gis khyer/ /mos gus med pa'i sgom chen rtogs pas dben/ /snying rus med na gnas nas 'phags dus med/ /rang sems kho na bltas pas chog zer yang / /de don rtogs la de rnams med thabs med/ /zab don snying por dril ba'i tshig bcad 'di/ /bslab pa gsum ldan rdor slob ratna la/ /dge sbyor skyes pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs su/ /sangs rgyas dngos byon padma'i mtshan can

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 89sogs/ /dam pas rjes su bzung yang sprang 'khyal du/ /mi tshe rgas pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis/ /kun bzang bde chen gling gi dben khrod du/ /gang dran smras pa khyed thugs la smin nas/ /skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan pa 'byung bar 3(ga /dge'o/ / //dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi gsung lan/7/ rje btsun gyi rgyal po thugs rje can/ /padma nyin byed dbang por 'dud/ /spyir gsang sngags la zhugs pa skal pa bzang / /sgos rje'ogs rim nyams len lam thag nye/ /yang sgos sgrub brgyud kyi gdams ngag byin rlabs che/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar/ /grub thob kyi phreng ba bar ma chad/ /kha bshad dang tshig skam tsam min par/ /blo gtad thub nges kyi zab chos dang / /byin rlabs yod nges kyi brgyud pa lags/ /dus deng sang snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug /las skal ba bzang ldan nyin skar 'dra/ /chos zab chos las kyang kha chos brin/ /rje mtshan ldan las kyang zog pos dga'/ /bka' mdo rgyud rnams las zog chos gdam/ /lha yi dam rnams las gdug 'dre dad/ /chos sne gcig tshul bzhin mi spyod par/ /kha lto rgyab phyi ra du 'di phyi brje/ /mi skal ldan chos mthun re re yang / /bdud 'byung po'i bar chad 'tshe ba mang / /blo lang shor ma gyur re re tsam/ /tshe chos min ngang la hril gyis zad/ /phug gtan 'dun 'grub pa re re tsam/ /lar de 'dra'i gral du 'khyogs pa na/ /chos rnal ma 'grub par mi srid pas/ /che nam 'chi cha med blo sna stungs/ /gnas 'khor ba 'di la skyo ba bskyed/ /las rgyu 'bras don la yid ches

90 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/sgoms/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo snying gtod/ /ma 'gro drug kun la snying rje bskyed/ /thabs rtsa rlung thig le'i lam bzang de/ /gnad gzhan las 'phags shing lam myur yang / /gegs che la de bzhin khe yang che/ /gegs sel ba'i thabs ni mang bshad kyang / /kun go gcig chod la mos gus dang / /the tshom med pa gnad du zab/ /rlung bzung ba'i yul dang dus gnad sogs/ /gzhung zhal gdams tshad ldan dag dang bstun/ /gtum mo sdug bsngal gyi dus su brtson 'grus gnad/ /bar 'dod chags dus su zhe bcad zab/ /mthar bde ba'i dus su mthar 'don zab/ /thams cad kyang mthar phyin gnad du che/ /cis kyang mi phan gegs che na/ /sngon las ngan gyi 'bras bu smin pa'am/ /gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la sel yod pas/ /phyag bskor dge sbyor gang 'grub dang / /yid gnong 'gyod drag po'i gdung shugs kyis/ /dpal rdor sems sgom bzlas gnad du bsnun/ /chos zab mo 'di yi sgor zhugs nas/ /gnad ma nor rtse gcig nyams blangs na/ /tshe gcig gis grol bar smos ci dgos/ /zhag bdun tsam thos nas nyams blangs na/ /phyir mi ldog grol bar 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /gzhan chos drug spyi yi gnad zhal gdams/ /zab rgyas kyi man ngag mang mchis kyang / /rje bla ma bsten dang bka' brgyud pa/ /gong ma yi gsung las sgro 'dogs bcad/ /mdo gnad du che ba nyams len yin/ /de yi rtsa ba dran shes te/ /bag yod kyi rtsi dang ma bral 'tshal/ /tshig de skad skal bzang chos spyod pa/ /dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi gsung bskul ngor/ /gnas tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi mgul/ /dpal kun bzang bde gling nags khrod du/ /mi snyom las chos ltar bcos pa'i gzugs/ /ming yon tan rgya mtshor grags des smras// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 91theg chen gyi snying po'i lag len gnad lnga ldan pa/pho/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin rlabs stsol/ /rang gis snying nas dam chos ma dran na/ /gzhan gyis chos bshad tshong 'dus gtam snyan 'dra/ /de legs de dgos snyam pa'i ngang du lus/ /nyams myong rtogs pa nang nas ma skyes na/ /ngo sprod mang pos rgyab rten bshad pa 'dra/ /phyogs re tsam las don thog khel ba med/ /ma go ma shes kho nas bslus pa min/ / thos pa'i don la yid ches ma skyes shing / /blo thag ma chod pa yis rang re bslus/ /yid ches yod na dam chos tshig gcig gis/ /rang rgyud sangs rgyas sa ru skyel ba lags/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ma'i lung / /skye mchog gong ma'i rnam mthar gsung sgros ni/ /tshig re yin kyang rang gi rgyud la sbyar/ /brtan thob bar du de nyid mthar phyin 'tshal/ /byas byas mang pos dgos dus bslu bar gda'/ /thog mar cis kyang dgos med nges 'byung dang / /bar du las 'bras yid ches spang blang dang / /tha mar gang shar rang grol lta sgom dang / /rnam kun phyogs zhen med pa'i snying rje dang / /gcig chog rtsa ba'i bla mar mos gus te/ /lnga po 'di la dam chos theg chen gyi/ /snying po'i lag len ma tshang med pa lags/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra/ /yad yud tsam las yun ring rtag mi thub/ /mtho dman phyug dbul la sogs phan tshun 'gyur/ /mdza' ba'i gnyen grogs phangs pa'i nor rdzas dang / /gces pa'i srog kyang myur du 'bral dgos na/ /chags zhen byed pa blo chung 'brul pa'i mtshang / /sgyu ma'i ltad mor mgo bo 'khor ba ste/ /da lta nyid nas zhen chags

92 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/spang na legs/ /chags zhen med na bral yang sdug bsngal med/ /zhen chags che na nam yang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /khyad par 'chi khar chags na ngan 'gror 'phen/ /tshangs dang brgya byin 'bor los sgyur rgyal dang / /dbul mo gos hrul zas lhag sdud pa gnyis/ /skye ba phyi ma'i gdeng la khyad par med/ /mtho ris ngan song gnas ris mtho dman kun/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin me yi 'obs lta bur/ /mkhyen nas mi rtag nges 'byung bskyed par mdzod/ /las 'bras rtsa ba rang gi sems la thug /zhe gnag spyod tshul legs kyang sdig pa 'phel/ /lhag bsam bzang la sangs rgyas chos kun 'dus/ /dge rtsa chen po min kyang ci lcogs bsgrub/ /sdig pa chung ngu yin kyang dug bzhin spang / /dge sdig 'bras bu mi 'chol so sor smin/ /rang gis byas pa'i las 'bras chud mi za/ /las ma bsags pa'i 'bras bu smin mi srid/ /bstan dang bla ma'i don la khag bsnyad dang / /pha ma bu tsha gnyen 'dun nor gyi phyir/ /mi bya med pa'i las ngan byas pa'i 'bras/ /gzhan la mi smin byed pa po la smin/ /don chung tshe 'di'i ched du lta ci smos/ /chos kyi phyir yang chos 'gal byed mi rung / /gzhan la gtan du phan tshad dge ba yin/ /'di phyir gzhan gnod 'gyur tshad sdig pa yin/ /rang don 'phral snang tsam la nges pa med/ /dge rtsa gong 'phel song na sems rgyud grol/ /sems rgyud grol la rtogs pa shugs kyis 'char/ /rgyu 'bras mi shes rang rgyud ma dul ba'i/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i grags pas rang gzhan bslu/ /bslu med rgyu 'bras spang blang legs spyad na/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta ba yin/ /'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi rang gzugs te/ /'brul snang tsam las don du grub pa med/ /ma grub bzhin du bde sdug sna tshogs myong / /'di dag dngos po mtshan mar bzung bas len/ /dngos 'dzin rtsa ba bcad na stong par

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 93rtogs/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i shes rab skye ba lags/ /chos kun gnas lugs 'od gsal de bzhin nyid/ /bdag gzhan 'khor 'das kun la mtshungs par khyab/ /rang gi sems nyid gdod nas chos kyi sku/ /rang ngo shes na 'bras bu logs su med/ /nyams blangs nges shes skye na lta ba lags/ /tha snyad bshad pa'i lta ba tshig tsam zad/ /lta ba phyi ru ma 'tshol nang du ltos/ /thog mar 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rang ngor blta/ /'dzin byed mkhan po dbyings su yal ba'i tshe/ /phyi yi gzung yul shugs la dag par 'gyur/ /'gyu ba phyi ma ma skyes snga ma 'gags/ /rib tsam wa le 'gyug ge de nyid kyi/ /rang ngo rig nas bzo bcos mi bya bar/ /gsal rig 'gag pa med par rtag tu bskyang / /nyon mongs la sogs rtog pa gang skyes kyang / /rnam rtog yin snyam blo bzo mi bya bar/ /ngo shes mkhan po'i rang zhal blta bar gces/ /snang tsam nyid nas 'di yin 'di min gyi/ /ngos bzung med pa rang nyid rang gsal du/ /rtogs na snang ba rang sar grol ba zer/ /bsgom rgyu'i dmigs gtad yod na bcos ma yin/ /bcos ma'i sgom pas gnas lugs don mi rtogs/ /bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med pas rang sar zhog /yengs su skad cig ma gzhug dran shes brten/ /ma bcos tha mal gnyug ma'i shes pa la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'dus pa lags/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa tshul bzhin thob pa'i tshe/ /rtsal mdangs snying rjer shar nas gzhan gyi don/ /'bad med lhun grub 'byung ba chos nyid kyang / /deng sang phal cher tshig gi lta bar 'byams/ /kha cig blun sgom nga rgyal lam du gol/ /byang sems bsngags pa 'ba' zhig brjod rnams kyang / /gzhan phan chung ngu lag tu len pa med/ /sems bskyed zer zhing rang don gces par bzung / /byang sems gzugs brnyan theg chen spyod dang 'gal/ /snying rje med na nyan rang lam du

94 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gol/ /gzhan don lta ci rang don mthar mi phyin/ /mkhas btsun rtogs ldan sgom chen grub thob sogs/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal snying rje'i 'gal zla yin/ /nga rgyal spangs nas rang gi skyon la brtag /drang po'i sems kyis bden pa'i tshig smra zhing / /gzhan la phan pa'i lhag bsam rtag tu bskyed/ /dngos su phan na gang phan lag tu len/ /dge rtsa byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /sangs rgyas chos kun tshogs bsags sgrib rjeXng gi /thabs su gsungs kyang gsang sngags nye lam la/ /gcig chog rgyal po bla ma'i mos gus zab/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bor thag chod nas/ /mdzad spyod bzang ngan ji ltar mthong na yang / /log lta khu 'phrig spu tsam med pa yi/ /thag chod mos gus drag po gal re che/ /gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa mtho dman kyang / /mos gus che chung rjes su 'gro ba yin/ /de don rgyud dang grub pa'i rnam thar dang / /so so'i nyams su myong ba'i rtags kyi gsal/ /bla ma'i mdzad par skyon du mthong ba de/ /rang nyid 'brul snang log ltas bsgribs pa'i rtags/ /de dbang shor na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /spyir na gzhan skyon mthong tshad rang gi skyon/ /bzhin ras ngan pa me long nang du 'char/ /me long skyon min rang gi gdong pa'i skyon/ /de ltar shes nas phyogs ris med pa la/ /dag snang 'byongs tshe mngon dga' bde ldan sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing mchog phyi ru 'tshol mi dgos/ /sku dang zhing khams rang gi sems las rnyed/ /rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par 'gyur/ /dzee thang rje dpon dam chos bzhed skong slad/ /gang shar tshigs su bcad pa'i gdams ngag 'di/ /nges don snying po'i tshul la rab gus shing / /don sgom spong ba pa yi gzugs brnyan can/ /blo gros mthas yas zhes bya'i ku swā lis/ /kun bzang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 95bde chen 'od gsal gling du smras/ /dge bas nyams rtogs yar zla ltar rgyas re ga /dge legs 'phel// //chos mthun rnam thar skyong tshul/༈ rje dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bdag snying nas gdung bas gsol 'debs na/ /tshig don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang rgyud la spang rtogs mi ldan pas/ /gzhan la gdams pa brjod dka' yang / /khyed snying nas gus pa'i dam tshig can/ /gsung mi gcog phyir du tshig gi 'gag /tshe ma tshor ngang du zad la thug /'di gtan 'dun nyes pa'i ltas su 'dug /dus rtag tu longs med dran pa yis/ /tshe 'dir ltos bya gzhag ma sgrubs mdzod/ /tshe 'dir snang thams cad rmi lam ltar/ /ci byung gang byung du bor la thongs/ /des chos kyi phyed ka tshar ba lags/ /blo gtod sa ma nor dkon mchog gsum/ /rang de rjes zhugs pa dran mdzod la/ /chos 'gal kun rmi lam du yang spongs/ /chos bya rgyu ma nor theg pa che/ /rang don gyi yid byed med pa yis/ /tshogs gnyis la ci 'grub gsag par 'tshal/ /lam bgrod sa ma nor rdzogs pa che/ /yid dpyod kyi lta sgom bral ba yis/ /don rang rig mngon sum bskyang bar zhu/ /phyi snang ba bzhi yi snang nyams dang / /nang rig stong rtogs pa zung 'brel ba/ /the tshom dang le lo spangs pa yis /mngon sum gyi gnad la gcun nus na/ /tshe 'di la 'a tshang rgya'i skal med kyang / /bar do ru grol bar the tshom med/ /lta ba mtho la spyod pa zhib/ /sgom lugs yangs la bshad lugs dog /nga rgyal chung la snying rje che/ /rang tshugs brling la dag snang

96 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'byongs/ /chos dang mthun pa'i rnam thar yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid ston par 'dzin phyin chad/ /rnam thar de 'dra bskyang bar zhu/ /deng sang gi lugs srol phal mo che/ /chos dang 'gal ba'i log spyod yin/ /de ma 'grub pa la ci zhig 'gyod/ /don mdo rtsa yin no skal pa can/ /tshig brjod pa mang pos ci zhig bya/ /gnas tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi mgul/ /kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gyi/ /gling rtag gnas spong ba pa yi gzugs/ /blo gros mtha' yas de skad smra/ /khyed sku tshe rdo rje ltar brtan cing / /nyams rtogs pa yar zla'i ngo bzhin rgyas/ /bsam don kun yongs su 'grub pa yi/ /smon lam dang 'dun pa'i rten 'brel zhu/ /zhes pa'ang gdan sa chen po rta rna dgon dmar sprul pa'i sku'i thugs bzhed skong slad du smras pa maṅga lo// //ku swā li'i sems khrid/7/ na mo gu sa lta sgom bshad tshul mang lags kyang / /rang sems ngo bo skyong la 'dus/ /sems zhes gzhan du yod pa min/ /da lta'i rnam rtog 'di ka yin/ /de rjes phyi ru mi 'brang bar/ /kho rang rang ngo bltas pa'i tshe/ /blta bya lta byed gnyis su med/ /stong pa yin pas dngos po med/ /gsal ba yin pas rang gis rig /tha dad ma yin zung du 'jug /ci yang med las ci yang 'char/ /de nyid rang ngo shes tsam gyi/ /mi brjed dran pas bskyang ba las/ /bsgom bya gzhan du mi 'tshol zhing / /yin min bzo bcos re dogs kyis/ /ma bslad rang sar bzhag pa yin/ /tha mal shes pa bzo med 'di/ /chos sku 'od gsal mthar thug yin/ /phyag rdzogs chos skad grangs mang yang / /nyams len rtsa ba 'di ru 'dus/ /de yis mi chog sangs

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 97rgyas zhes/ /bzang po gzhan du 'tshol ba de/ /re dogs 'ching ba yin phyir spongs/ /de 'dra ji bzhin rtogs pa'i thabs/ /mos gus tshogs bsags gal che bas/ /rtag tu bla ma o rgyan rjer/ /mos gus gnad du bsnun pa dang / /sgo gsum dge la 'bad par 'tshal/ /sga stod khri 'du'i rig sngags 'chang / /rang slob padma chos 'phel ngor/ /blo gros mtha' yas ku swā lis/ /bde chen 'od gsal gling nas bris/ /dge legs 'phel// //snyigs dus kyi bla slob 'brel tshul la skyo ba'i smre sngags/༈ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /rje padma'i mtshan can dbyings nas gzigs/ /bdag skal dman snyigs dus su skyes pa'i bu/ /bzang ngan gyi 'brel ba thogs tshad kun/ /khyed ma gtogs re sa gzhan med pas/ /'khor ba dang ngan song du ma btang bar/ /thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'dren du gsol/ /kye ma/ mi lus thob kha ru khyi lus dang / /dmyal bar 'gro kha ru dpon lus bzhin/ /bla 'dod tsam don du ma gnyer yang / /rang shugs kyis bla ma'i ming snyan thob/ /bdag 'dra ba'i bla ma'i gzugs brnyan la/ /sngon las kyi g.yer grags ma gtogs pa/ /don rang rgyud la yon tan til tsam med/ /de med pas mi yi nang nas bud/ /gnas sa stong lkog nyal byas nas su/ /dug lnga po kha yan sbyong na yang / /de yon tan yin par mthong nas su/ /mi klad med rang 'dra kha cig gis/ /sbyin bdag byas nas bsnyen bkur bstabs/ /slob ma ru byas nas dbang chos zhus/ /tha na'ang zhal mjal phyag dbang zer/ /mi mdo med klad pa chung ba'i don/ /ngo ma chog ci zer kha la nyan/ /

98 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dgos zer tshad mtha' ru phyin pa na/ /phan ma btags gnod pa byas pa 'dra/ /kha cig gis ngo srung mi 'dug zer/ /kha cig gis sna len ma byas zer/ /kha cig gis spyod pa 'chol 'dug zer/ /kha cig gis bzang med ngan med zer/ /lar dus ngan gyi skabs 'dir rang gzhan kun/ /'dod khams kyi bdag pos byin gyis brlabs/ /ngo ma shes gong nas bla mar bsten/ /yid ma ches gong nas slob mar bzung / /tshig thos long med par sgrub la zhugs/ /don rtogs long med par bshad snying 'dod/ /sems gtad so med par gzhan don spyod/ /bdag bla ma'i yon tan mi ldan cing / /dbang khrid sogs long skabs med byas kyang / /tshogs ma bsags pa yi mi 'ga' zhig /tshig thos pa tsam gyis grol 'dra ba'i/ /nan chen pos don du gnyer ba'i mthar/ /sngags bla med kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur/ /don snying po'i gdams pa zab mo nyan/ /'da' dka' ba'i dam tshig gnyan pos sbrel/ /de tshar nas phan tshun thag chod pa/ /pho khram pa zas la tshogs pa bzhin/ /chos gdams ngag thos kyang rgyud ma dul/ /don bden pa bshad kyang yid mi ches/ /las ci drag byas kyang mgu dus med/ /thag ring tshad kun gyi rna snyan lab/ /'dris che tshad kun gyi skyon mtshang brjod/ /kha dad dad 'dra yang gting la med/ /'phralabazang bzang 'dra yang phugs su rtsub/ /nor 'bul ba blangs na 'phrogapa 'dra/ /las bya ba bcol na thabs kyis byol/ /tshig drang por smras na ngo 'dzum gnag /rdzun bstod ra btang na so rtsa dkar/ /rgyu zang zing mthong tshe khyi bzhin gus/ /gzhan bstod mkhan mthong tshe tshig pa za/ /mi smad grogs 'dzom na sems rtsa skyid/ /lar bstod pa'i zhor la smad pa btang / /mthar sgro skur mang pos mi snyan brjod/ /skyon gang yod ngoms shing yon tan sbed/ /gzhi bzang po phal cher skyon du bcos/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 99skyon chen po 'ga' zhig yon tan mthong / /bla ma la tshur bsnyegs mi dran par/ /dbang med du khral la phab pa bzhin/ /bshes gnyen la dgra ru mthong ba mang / /bka' mdo rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa yi/ /bla slob kyi mtshan nyid bsten tshul sogs/ /go ldog gi lag len dar dus 'dir/ /spyir rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa nyams/ /sgos gsang sngags gnyan po tshul min spyod/ /ma mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs/ /rgyal khams la mi dge sna tshogs 'byung / /tshe phyi mar rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /rgyu de 'dra lag tu len bzhin du/ /nyams pa rnams pho tshod nyam pa mtho/ /chos dam tshig chu nang 'phen bzhin du/ /shi dmyal bar 'gro snyam yid la med/ /nyes bshags sdom tshul bzhin byed pa dkon/ /pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /dus snyigs ma'i bla slob rnams la gzigs/ /khyed dmigs med snying rje'i klong yangs nas/ /don ye shes dri ma med pa'i bcud/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i khrus chu stsol/ /bdag bzang 'brel ngan 'brel gyur tshad rnams/ /rgyud nyes lhung rnam dag tshangs par mdzod/ /mchog mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum po'i ngang thabs shes rab zung 'jug sdom pa yis/ /e waṃ gyi phyag rgya che 'grub shog /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i dus ngan bla slob 'brel tshul la snying nas skyo ba skyes te bden par smras pa'i glu'o// //snyigs dus kyi skye bo mi srun pa'i 'gyur spyod la skyo ba'i smre sngags/lje/ dus deng sang snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug /mi thams cad las dang bsod nams dman/ /sems rmu rgod nyon mongs me ltar 'bar/ /bden phugs bzhag byed

100 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/mkhan nyin skar 'dra/ /tshe 'di phyi las 'bras khyad du gsod/ /khrel ngo tsha bsam pa yid la med/ /nor til 'bru tsam la 'di phyi brje/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la log par lta/ /drin che ba'i pha ma khyad du bsad/ /gtan tshe rogs yin kyang rgas nas bskyur/ /phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel/ /drin che tshad rnams kyi yi thag bcad/ /rang rgyal kha thob pas mi chog par/ /pha rol po gtan nas med par 'dod/ /phu nyes med ri dwags rtsad nas skams/ /des dkar phyogs dbu 'phang dma' ba'i rtags/ /las dge ba spyod rnams don mi 'grub/ /bar g.yo khram rdzun gyi 'khor lo bskor/ /des lha srin sde brgyad zhabrugs pa'i rtags/ /rims sa g.yo btsa' sad ser bas bcom/ /mda' mna' za khrel 'gom rku 'phrog byed/ /bdud nag phyogs 'byung po kha rgyal nas/ /las mi dge spyod tshad bsam don 'grub/ /tshe med pas skyes lus yud kyis rdzogs/ /lo ma lon gong nas bsam mno lon/ /lo lon dus bsam mno phyin ci log /nang bsod nams med pa'i phyi rtags su/ /mgo skra yi gseb nas thal rdul khol/ /gdong snum bcud bkrag med skya la hol/ /gos bkrag med me tog sad khyer 'dra/ /blo bzang po mi dran ngan pa dran/ /don bden pa bshad na the tshom skye/ /sdig mi dge'i phyogs su nam yang langs las bzang po bslabs kyang lob dus med/ /bslab ma dgos spyod ngan sna tshogs shes// /mi gsar pa 'phrad na lha ru lta/ /chas gsar pa rnams la rtsis su byed/ /lo re la bzang ngan 'gyur ldog mang / /brdung thub na pha mgo yin kyang brdung / /'phrog thub na bla ma'i dkor yang bcom/ /g.yo dgos na ma rgan mgo bo bskor/ /khram dgos na tshe rogs zas skal bcad/ /rdzun phyi rkub bud kyang ngo tsha med/ /gtam de ring smras pa sang nyin brjed/ /las da lta brtsams pa da lta bskyur/ /dus

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 101da lta bshad pa do dgong med/ /mi 'phrad ma thag tu ngo shes bsgrigs/ /ngo shes ma thag tu snying gtam bshad/ /rgyus ma 'o1na gong nas nang mi byed/ /rgyus 'o1na nas mna' bzhag shag po bslu/ /blo gtod pa'i 'dris yod thabs kyis bskyur/ /drin che ba'i gnyen bshes rgyang du bor/ /don chung chung la yang 'di phyi brje/ /zas ngan ngon tsam la ngo tsha bor/ /mna' nag po zhim zas bzhin du za/ /sdig mi dge pha zog bzhin du bsags/ /bden ya rabs spyod pa than du lta/ /chos dkar po dge ba dug bzhin spang / /lar gnas skabs yud tsam ma gtogs pa/ /lo rjes mar ci 'gyur mi dran na/ /tshe phyi mar lta yang ci zhig smos/ /lo re re las re res ngan du song / /mi snga ma las phyi ma zhan du song / /sdig mi dge spyod pa je mang song blo bsam shes ldan pa je dkon song / /rje rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub rir phyogs/ /tshad ldan gyi rjes 'jug nyin mo'i skar/ /da dung yang je las je zhan 'gro/ /dus ngan pa'i mthar thug 'di 'dra bar/ /lus blangs pa'i sems can bsod nams dman/ /lar gang nas bsam yang yi mug skye/ /khyod khong par don snying yod pa rnams/ /dus bzang po shar sgug re ba yis/ /tshe 'di la rtag 'dzin ma che bar mthong tshad la skyo shas drag po dang / /thos tshad la nges 'byung bskyed nas su/ /mi rang mgo thon pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /chos lag tu lon tshad rgyal ba lags/ /bdag rang yang dus ngan snyigs ma'i mi/ /skyes bo yi gral mtha' ma gtogs pa/ /mi gzhan skyon rtogs pa'i yon tan can/ /ya rabs kyi tshugs kha mi 'dug kyang / /mi gsar skyes phal la dpag pa na/ /skye snga ma'i yon tan cung zad 'dug /lo lon pas mgo la skra dkar skyes/ /skyid mthong bas lus la gya rgud med/ /blo drang bas kun gyis bden par 'dzin/ /g.yo med pas kun dang snang ba mthun/ /chos byas pas bla ma'i ming

102 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/yang thogs/ /sbong klog gi lag rjes cung zad bdog /de gcig tu sngon bsags las 'phro dang / /rje bla ma dkon mchog la blo gtad pa'i/ /thugs rje dang byin rlabs bslu med lags/ /skyabs 'di la bslu ba mi 'dug pas/ /bsam blo yi ngal ba brgya phrag gis/ /thabs rtsol ba mang po phar bzhag nas/ /blo bla ma dkon mchog la gtod nus na/ /tshe 'di phyi'i bsam don kun 'grub cing / /gtan bde ba'i 'dun ma 'byung nges pas/ /khyed da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon/ /tshig 'di yang thugs la gcag par zhu/ /snyigs ma mthar thug pa'i dus dang skye bo mi srun pa rnams kyi 'gyur bas skyo shas kha tsam min par skyes te thal byung gi smre sngags blo gros mtha' yas kyi mgrin pa'i lam nas thon pa'o// //rang gzhan snyigs dus kyi spyod tshul srong por smra ba drang srong bden tshig7/ khyod mdo med mi de dran rgyu mang / /kha bden bden 'dra yang don la med/ /kha bltas na rgyal khams nyi ma shar/ /don lag tu len dus mun pa rub/ khyod col chung mi de zer rgyu mang / /sems dran tshad thams cad kha ru 'don/ /khas smras tshad lag len gcig kyang med/ /lag blang na ma rabs bya ba byed/ /khyod blo mang mi de byed rgyu mang / /las gcig 'go mi thon gnyis la 'jug /yar mtho sa bzhag la phyir la bsnyegs/ /dma' rang mal mi zug mtho bsnyab byed/ /khyod sems chung mi de dga' sdug mang / /tshig mtho dman tsam gyi gnad mi khyog /ngo dkar nag tsam gyis rang mtshang phog /zas bzang ngan tsam gyis mgu 'khang skyen/ /khyod spro thung mi de 'gyur ldog mang / /sems skyid dus byang chub sems dpa' 'dra/ /sems sdug

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 103dus sbrul la gtses pa 'dra/ /dus rtag tu rgyus pa mes tshig 'dra/ /khyod tha chad mi de 'dris rogs mang / /'dris rnying tshad rnams dang rim par bye/ /mi rgyus med rnams dang gsar 'dris 'tshol/ /nyams bcar na blo gtad gcig kyang med/ /khyod ma rabs mi de za rogs mang / /lto 'bol dus ngo dga' mkhas tshad bsdu/ /lto ltogs dus khrel dang ngo tsha bor/ /las rang byas la phyi mig lta mi shes/ /khyod 'dod can mi de chags pa che/ /gdong skya skya mthong na 'dzum chung shor/ /nor bzang bzang mthong na sems rtsa 'gul/ /mi dbul pos bslangs kyang ser sna dam/ /khyod shes med mi de rang 'dod che/ /mis drang por lab kyang bden mi 'dzin/ /sems g.yo sgyu che yang ngo tsha med/ /mi gzhan mgo g.yogs kyang sha tsha med/ /tshe thog med nas las ngan khur po khur/ /nyon mongs pa'i grogs dang yun ring 'dris/ /dus deng sang mi lus rin chen thob/ /chos sangs rgyas bstan pa mjal ba'i dus/ /las ci byed rang gi lag tu gda'/ /lcags sra mo btul na bzo chas thon/ /rdo mkhregs pa bzhus na rin chen 'byung / /zhing tha rengs rmos na lo tog skye/ /phyugs mi srun btul yang zhon khal pher/ /tshig go shes yod pa mi yi bu/ /snying khong pa'i gting nas ma rul na/ /lam thar par bgrod la dka' tshegs med/ /las rang lag yod kyang gzhan dbang shor/ /chos byed bsam ngang du mi tshe zad/ /kha lto rgyab rjes su rgyug rgyug nas/ /chos thos bsam sgom gsum dbyings su yal/ /drin che ba'i skyon la brtags brtags nas/ /sdom dam tshig chu yi nang du bor/ /ngag don med gtam gleng mang mang nas/ /'don bzlas brjod sa rgyab lkog langs byas/ /yid 'bras med bsam blo btang btang nas/ /bskyed rdzogs pa mi mngon dbyings su thim/ /las ci byas 'di byas med pa dang / /don ci thon 'di thon gcig kyang

104 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/med/ /lar da lta'i dus na bdag 'dra ba'i/ /lus ser gos gyon pa'i bande dang / /lag bgrang phreng thogs pa'i mtshams pa dang / /sems rnal du mi gnas rtogs ldan dang / /dkor grong chog sdud pa'i bla gzugs rnams/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum po'i bka' drin gyis/ /lto pho ba rgyags kyang khog nad che/ /gos mig sngar mdzes kyang zhe la gzan/ /nor ci 'dod 'byor yang zhen pa log /tshe 'di gang skyid kyang phyi mar sdug /'phral lam phugs gnyis kar phan pa'i chos/ /don bshad mkhan yod kyang nyan mkhan med/ /tshig nyan mkhan yod kyang go mkhan med/ /phyogs go yang lag tu len pa dkon/ /lag blangs kyang mtha' ru phyin pa dkon/ /bshad shes kyang rang nyams len pa dkon/ /gang byas kyang las 'phro dman pa'i mi/ /gar bltas kyang dus ngan snyigs ma'i rtags/ /da 'di 'dra'i dus su chos mthun gyi/ /bsam sbyor ba sne gcig mthar phyin na/ /de mi rjes sleb pa'i pha yi bu/ /phyir mi ldog gtan 'dun 'grub pa lags/ /rang gzhan snyigs dus kyi spyod tshul ya nga la skyugs bro ba/ ngu bro la nyams mtshar bas na bun gyi phreng ba bzhin du g.yeng bar mthong nas dben pa'i ri ngogs su blo gros mtha' yas kyis shugs 'byung du smra ba zang thal du song ba lags so// //mi rtag pa'i gtam nges 'byung pho nya/༈ pha rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe pha rol bde bar 'dod pa rnams/ /tshe 'di la rtag par ma 'dzin cig /mtho nam mkha'i sprin dkar lang ma ling / /dus gtan du sdod sdod 'dra na yang / /glo bur du

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 105skyi ser rlung gis gtor/ /dgung sngon stong pa mthong tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /chab ko mog mtsho chung nyal ma nyil/ /dus gtan du 'khyil 'khyil 'dra na yang / /glo bur du than pas khad kyis skam/ /'dam pa kog po mthong tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /shing ljon pa'i skyed tshal lo 'dab sngo/ /dus rtag tu rgyas rgyas 'dra natshoyang / /ston bser bus rnying zhing thang la lhags/ /sdong po skya zing mthong tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /thang spang ljongs me tog tshom bus mdzes/ /dus gtan du skyid skyid 'dra lags kyang / /ston ba mos zhag gcig nyid la skam/ /thang chen skya bo mthong tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /dbyar me tog phreng ba lta na sdug /dus rtag tu mdzes mdzes 'dra lags kyang / /sad ser bas skad cig nyid la yal/ /yu ba gog po mthong tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /gzhon pho mo dkar dmar bkrag mdangs can/ /dus rtag tu gces gces 'dra lags kyang / /rgas lang tsho rnying nas mi sdug gzugs/ /'tsho ba'i tha mar gyur tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /mi gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs/ /dus rtag tu sdod sdod 'dra lags kyang / /glo bur du 'chi ba'i nad kyis thebs/ /mal sa stong pa mthong tshe skyo ba'i rgyu/ /tshe ring po zhig tu 'tsho snyam yang / /shi mi rtag pa la dus btab med/ /'phral chos la brtson 'grus ma brtsams na/ /'di bya snyam ngang du mi tshe 'da'/ /rgas rgas su sdod pa srid mtha' tsam tshe nges pa med pa glo bur 'chi/ /bya byed kyi shom ra 'ding ba kun/ /bsam thog tu khel ba re re tsam/ /las byed 'phro phal cher shul du lus/ /yul bod du skyes pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /tshe phyi mar chos kyis phan no zhes/ /phyugs gnag rdzi yan chad smra ba gcig /lag lon pa chos pa la yang dka'/ /kha chos byed zer ba mang yod kyang / /chos snying nas sgrub pa nyin skar 'dra/ /gzugs brnyan gyi chos pas sa steng gang / /chos rgyud thog 'byor ba shin tu dkon/ /lus ser gos gyon pa'i rab byung gzugs/ /

106 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/sems nyon mongs 'brugs pa'i mi nag pa/ /kha lto rgyab tsam gyi grub don la/ /gtan 'dun ma phung ba'i blo nyes po/ /mthong tshad kun 'chi ba'i skul 'debs dang / /thos tshad kun mi rtag rang bzhin de/ /dus ring por mi thogs rang nyid la/ /'byung nges pa'i blo thag gcod dus babs/ /babs ma zad re zhig phyis pa'i skyon/ /mgo skra dkar lha yi pho nya dang / /gdong gnyer ma gshin rje'i khong 'dzum dang / /bar dbang po rgud pa'i phrin pa rnams/ /dus gcig tu 'dzom tshe sems rtsa skyo/ /'chi mi rtag dran pas blo snying 'dar/ /lo zla ba lta ci sang nyin tsam/ /sdod nges pa'i blo gdeng med pa'i dus/ /chos dran kyang a thang chad pa'i rgyu/ /chos byed na rang dbang yod dus gyis/ /rten dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi/ /las bzang pos rgyal bstan mjal ba rnams/ /rmi lam na dbul pos nor rnyed bzhin/ /mi srid pa'i mnog chen thob pa'i dus/ /sems nges 'byung drag pos blo thag stungs/ /blo phyi barbertel ma byed chos la gshegs/ /chos byang chub sems gnyis rgyud la sbyor/ /rgyud chos dang 'dres tshe skyid thog sleb/ /skyid zhe blo bde na chos don 'grub/ /tshig 'di tsam smras pa'ang don yod cing / /yong skal ldan rnams la phan par shog /ces pa'ang 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpon slob rin po che'i rigs dpon 'phags nor bdun gyis rgyud phyug pa gang de'i bzhed skong du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes spang ljongs skyed mos tshal gyi grib bsil du nges par 'byung ba'i blo dang bcas te smras pa'o// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 107med thabs med pa'i byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams ngag7/ rje 'gran zla kun bral rdo rje 'chang / /dpal padma nyin byed zhabs la 'dud/ /tshe 'di snang bden med rmi lam 'dra/ /mi rtag pa nam 'ong cha ma mchis/ /byung dus su bzlog thabs cang med pas/ /skabs de dus phan par nges pa ni/ /dam pa yi chos mchog kho na yin/ /chos kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /sems 'dul na chos sgo thams cad 'dus/ /chos byas byas mang pos tshe zad kyang / /sems ma thul thar pa'i 'bras mi thob/ /sems 'dul thabs mdo rgyud thams cad nas/ /thabs dpag tu med pa gsung na yang / /mdor bsdu na kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems gnyis po sbyong thabs lags/ /de ji bzhin rgyud la 'byor ba ni/ /tshe blos btang chos pa ma gtogs pa/ /mi phal pas nyams su lon par dka'/ /'on kyang rang dbang yod dus su/ /dad pa dang brtson 'grus ma chung na/ /spyod lam kun byang chub lam bsgyur ba/ /theg chen dang gsang sngags khyad chos yin/ /de bas na 'di bzhin nyams len mdzod/ /sems can kun pha ma yin shes pas/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas brtse ba yi/ /byams snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed nas/ /de dag kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir/ /lus ngag yid dge la bkol ba yi/ /blo bcos ma min pas gzhi bzung nas/ /snod bcud dang rang gzhan dgra gnyen kun/ /sgyu ma dang rmi lam snang ba bzhin/ /bden med kyi 'dun pa rtag tu sbyang / /tshur rang gi sems la bltas tsam na/ /gzugs dngos por ma grub stong pa nyid/ /cang med pa ma yin gsal zhing rig /stong gsal nyid gnas lugs gnyug ma'i gshis/ /de

108 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bzo bcos mi byed rang bab bzhag /brjed med kyi dran pas rtag tu bskyang / /sgrim drags na rtog pa 'phro rkyen byed/ /glod drags na ma tshor yul la yengs de bas na sgrim glod ran po yis/ /yun thung la grangs mang mnyam par bzhag /las dang po la gces pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /sems zer ba da lta'i rnam rtog ni/ /sna tshogs su 'phro mkhan 'di nyid yin/ /de 'phro sa'i yul la mi dpyad par/ /'phro mkhan dang gnas mkhan gyi rang ngo la/ /kha nang du log nas bltas pa yis/ /brjod mi shes kyang myong rgyu yod pa yi/ /gsal stong gi shes pa lhag ger 'char/ /sems ngo bo lta ba de la zer/ /yun ring du goms na nyams rtogs skye/ /lar nyams len snying nas byed pa la/ /dgos med kyi blo sna thung ba dang / /bla ma la mos gus 'bral med dang / /dran shes kyi yang yang gsal 'debs rnams/ /med thabs med pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /don de dag thugs la gcag pa nas/ /chos bzhin gyi bsam pa mthar phyin cing / /byang chub kyi lam sna zin pa zhig /snying thag pa nas smon lam zhu ba lags/ /zhes dal 'byor gyi sdong po la chos ldan gyi yal ga rgyas pa nā tha lasgyis bzhed ngor gu ṇas smras pa dge/ //sems don skyong ba'i man ngag7/ na mo gu ru be/ thog mar nam 'chi cha med blo sna stungs/ /bar du las kyi rnam smin bslu med soms/ /rtag tu bla ma'i mos gus mi 'bral bar/ /da lta'i tha mal shes pa skad cig mar/ /rang ngo rig thog bzo bcos dgag sgrub dang / /re dogs bcos bsgyur gang yang mi byed par/ /dran pa rgyun chad med pas rtag tu
