zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 109bskyang / /rang sems ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku/ /gsal ba longs sku rig rtsal sprul pa'i sku/ /dbyer med rang ngo shes shing bskyang nus na/ /'bad rtsol mi dgos sangs rgyas sems las rnyed/ /snang srid chos sku gnyug ma'i yo lang nyid/ /gdod nas su yang 'khrul ma myong bas na/ /thams cad rang grol ye sangs rgyas pa'i don/ /rig pa snying dbus sad nas gdod ma'i gzhir/ /mngon par byang chub dge legs dpal 'bar 31ga /ces pa'ang ban chen dgon gyi tshe mtshams dge 'dun ngor gu ṇas smras pa dge/ //sgom rim thugs dam gsal 'debs/7/ rgyal ba kun 'dus padma dbang / /rang gzhan rgyud grol byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang sems la/ /'dus pas rang sems rtag tu skyongs/ /mkhar la rtsig rmang med thabs med/ /chos la sngon 'gro med thabs med/ /rmang gzhi legs na khang mkhar brtan/ /sngon 'gro 'byongs na nyams rtogs skye/ /de bas dus rgyun mi rtag pa'i/ /'du shes snying la gzer ba dang / /khams gsum 'khor bar zhen log nas/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro brtson/ /gzhan don byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /yig brgyas sgrib pa nyams chag sbyong / /maṇḍal gyis ni tshogs chen/ bsag /khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor brtson/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs par/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes mi 'char zhing / /cung zad 'char yang 'grib par 'gyur/ /de bas rtogs pa skye 'dod na/ /lo tog skyed la brlan drod ltar/ /mos gus kho na gal re che/ /'chi ba snying nas dran pa dang / /mos gus dag snang che ba dang / /las

110 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'bras mig ltar srung ba na/ /rang byung rtogs pa shugs la 'char/ /'di phyir bde ba'i mgo bo tshugs/ /zob chos brgya yis do zla min/ /de kun spyi yi bslab bya lags/ /dngos gzhi zhi gnas nas bzung ste/ /sgom med chen por sleb kyi bar/ /thad kar skyong tshul skye tshul dang / /ngo sprod gdab tshul re re yod/ /gcig dpe kun la mtshungs pa min/ /dang por bsam mkhan bsam yul gnyis/ /'phrad pa'i skad cig dang po dang / /chod na snang tshad sems su chod/ /ma chod skad cig gnyis pa nas/ /snang ba rig pa phar tshur lus/ /'khrul pa rang ga ma ru 'byams/ /des na gang shar ngo bo la/ /dpyod pa dang po'i skyong tshul min/ /bcad mkhan skad cig ma de yang / /mi spang mi 'ded rang thog na/ /rtsol med klod pa bzhag pa de/ /goms na gang shar skad cig ma/ /yul med rang rig rang gsal rtogs/ /sgom chen gsar bu'i blo rten yin/ /rang gi sems la bzo mi 'chos/ /legs su re dang ma legs dogs/ /yin min the tshom khu 'phrig spang / /rig pa rten med gcer bur bzhag /sgo lnga rang yan ngang du thongs/ /'gyu ba rang grol chu rlabs bzhin/ /mdor na bsam mno kun spangs nas/ /ma bcos rang bab bzhag pa ni/ /da lta'i sgom chen pha mkhar yin/ /bzhag shes mang yang bshig shes dkon/ /ma bshig nyams kyi rtsi la 'byar/ /sgom mo snyam pa'i dran thag bcad/ /sgom mkhan rang gi ngo bor ltos/ /ched du mi bsgom dran thag mthud/ /mdor na dran pa kho na las/ /bsgom du ci yang med pa ni/ /bsgom med yengs med gnad ka yin/ /phyi nang 'char tshul thad kar chod/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi ci byas kyang / /rig pa rtsol med lhug pa las/ /mi 'da' rang byung rang gsal ngang / /bya rgod gnam 'phang gcod pa ltar/ /yid ches dpa' ba'i gdeng thob nas/ /rtogs ldan ming du 'bod pa yin/ /'phro

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 111rgod tshab tshub skyong mi bde/ /rig pa klod ma shes pas lan/ /shes shes 'dra la mi shes pa/ /nye bzhag rgyang nas bskor bas lan/ /nyi ma sprin sgrib chu rnyog 'dra/ /rig pa dwangs snyigs ma phyed lan/ /de la 'jam rlung bag tsam bzung / /lta stangs sprin med mkha' la gtad/ /shes pa mig tu bcug nas ni/ /rig pa ngar skyed mkha' dang bsre/ /yul sems gang la'ang mi dpyod par/ /rtsa bral hrig ge rjen ner bzhag /bogs 'don gdams pa zab mo yin/ /mdor na lus gnad lta stangs bcas/ /dang po rig pa ma bcos par/ /sgom med ngang du yengs med 'jog /bar du sgom mkhan rang ngor blta/ /bsgom med ngang du shig ger bshig /tha ma dran thag ma chad par/ /rig pa rten med ngang du bskyang / /goms nas 'jog bshig mi dgos par/ /dran rig lhongs su bud pa na/ /thun bsgom mtha' ru phyin pa yin/ /ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje 'gag med sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum rang sems gcig la tshang / /ngo 'phrod the tshom chod pa na/ /sangs rgyas sems las rnyed pa'i phyir/ /zab chos sku gsum ngo sprod gsung / /dbyings rig rang rtsal gsum gyi don/ /bon rnams ma bu rtsal gsum zer/ /chos skad tsam las don du gcig /don 'di yun ring goms dgos te / /lan re dran kyang brtan thob min/ /bsgom yun shi dang mnyam zhes gsungs/ /zhi gnas tsam la yid rton na/ /mgron po lam du gnyid log 'dra/ /zhi gnas med pa lhag mthong btsal// /chu snod med pa'i zla gzugs 'dra/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel rgyal ba'i lam/ /go na 'khor ba dong nas sprugs/ /myong bas thar pa'i lam sna zin/ /rtogs pa brtan na grub thob 'gyur/ /gshen btsun drung mu'i ming can gyi/ /thugs dam gsal 'debs bzhed don dang / /mthun par blo gros mtha' yas

112 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/kyis/ /nyin lhung dben pa'i ri ngogs su/ /shar mar gdams 'dis 'gro phan shog/ //skad cig rang grol/lje/ na mo gu sa zhi gnas rtse gcig sems 'dzin ni/ /las dang po la gces pa yin/ /goms nas rang ngo shes pa yi/ /lhag mthong med na go mi chod/ /cis kyang sgom chen rgan po yis/ /gnas dang mi gnas 'gyu mi 'gyu'i/ /dgag sgrub re dogs byed don med/ /gang shar rang bab ngang du zhog /bzo bcos med pa'i rang ngo skyong / /rnam rtog chos skur shes par mdzod/ /skad cig rang sar grol ba yin/ /maṅga le// //lta sgom spyod 'bras gnyug ma rang shar/tsho/ rdo rje 'chang dngos padma nyin byed zhabs/ /bdag snying chu skyes dbus nas brtser dgongs la/ /skal ldan rgyud la ye shes dbang bskur stsol/ /skyes mchog dam pa sgrub la brtson pa khyed/ /sgo gsum tha mal lus pa bdag lta bu'i/ /tshig gis chos la bskul ba mi 'tshal yang / /gzhan phan phyir du bka' yis bskul ba'i lan/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gnas tshul cung zad gsol/ /yang dag lta ba rtogs na gnas lugs yin/ /gnas lugs zhes pa gangesad ma'i bzhugs tshul lags/ /de las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas gud na med/ /stong gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 113'di/ /sus kyang ma byas rang byung rang shar la/ /blo yi yul las 'das pas spros dang bral/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku dang / /tha mar 'gro ba kun gyi gshis lugs la/ /bzang ngan che chung med de kun la khyab/ /rgyal ba'i chos sku gnyis med ye shes kyis/ /'khor 'das lam gsum rtag tu khyab pas na/ /rang sems 'od gsal 'di yang de yi cha/ /dbyings kyi ngo bo 'pho 'gyur med pas rtag /glo bur dri ma dag na ye shes de/ /mngon gyur rgyal ba'i dbyings dang ro gcig gyur/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin pa'i/ /gtan tshigs de yin rang byung rgyal ba dang / /kun mkhyen yab sras bzhed dgongs 'khrul med lags/ /sgom pas nyams su len skabs phyogs re ba'i/ /bcos ma'i sgom pas ma bcos don mi mthong / /mos gus stobs kyis gnyug ma'i shes pa de/ /snying la sad na rang byung ye shes yin/ /dang po'i las can 'du byed dran pa bsten/ /dran pa nyams na dge ba'i chos kun 'jig /ji srid dran dang bshes bzhin ma nyams pa/ /de srid srid pa'i sa bon rang sar 'gag /klong du gyur na dran pa'i brtod phur bud/ /'dzin dran dag tshe sems kyi lhad med pas/ /'khor 'das kun kyang rig pa'i mdangs su shar/ /ci snang chos sku'i yo lang ngo mtshar che/ /stong gsal 'gag pa med pa rig pa'i 'gros/ /rang bab gnyug ma'i lam las mi 'khyog na/ /de tshe rnal 'byor rtsal chen rdzogs pa yin/ /tshig gi lo ma mang pos ci zhig bya/ /de yis ma tshims bcos ma sgom pa ni/ /rgya mtsho bor nas smig sgyu 'ded dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba 'di rnams de ltar ma rtogs pas/ /sdug bsngal 'khor mo yug tu spyod pa la/ /stong pa'i rang mdangs snying rje shar ba de/ /nam mkha' ji srid gzhan don lhun grub rgyu/ /so skye'i 'gro don rang gzhan mgo bskor yin/ /'bor ba'i gnas su thog ma

114 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/med pa nas/ /sngar bsags sgrib pa'i khur po ljid drags na/ /sdom gsum chags nyams dad rdzas gshin dkor sogs/ /slar yang sgrib pa'i kha snon len phod dam/ /sgrib pa can la log par lta ba 'phel/ /lta las nyams na spyod pa ci bzang yang / /khams gsum 'khesar ba'i gnas las 'phags mi nus/ /sgrib pa dag na rtogs pa ngang gis 'char/ /tshogs chen rdzogs na yon tan shugs la 'phel/ /bcos ma'i spyod pa mtha' ru 'khyol ba dka'/ /mi 'grub dam bca' mang po rang phung rgyu/ /ma bcos spyod pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam/ /de yang bab bcol spyod la zer ba min/ /mi dge'i las dang rang 'dod 'khris med par/ /mos gus snying rje stong nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /ched du ma spang ched du ma blang bar/ /dran dang shes bzhin spyod lam rnam pa bzhir/ /byang chub lam du sgyur de spyod pa'i mchog /tshul 'chos brtul zhugs mang pos do zla min/ /'on kyang rang re ston pa'i rjes 'jug gi /rnam pa yin phyir tshul khrims mig ltar bsrung / /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sdom pa sne gcig tsam/ /kha zhe ngo lkog med par bsrung nus na/ /ltar snang dge ba 'bum phrag las kyang 'phags/ /dgos nges sdom pa dam tshig rgyab tu bor/ /chos brgyad 'khor lo nyin dang mtshan du bskor/ /g.yo 'phrul du mas 'dre yang dbang du sdud/ /snyigs dus bsod zad rnams kyi skyabs gyur pa'i/ /zog pos rgyal khams gang nas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yud tsam thal bar byed pa 'di mthong tshe/ /rang blo rnal du gnas pa'i skabs med na'ang / /ngan 'gro'i las can rjes su 'jug phod dam/ /da ni bstan pa'ang rtags tsam 'dzin par gyur/ /spyi ru rgyal bstan yun du mi gnas la/ /sgos su snying po'i bstan pa mun rum na/ /glog 'gyu tsam yin khyad par snyigs ma'i tshe/ /rlung nang mar me bzhin du mi brtan cing / /tshe phyed mjug 'di nub kha'i

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 115nyi ma 'dra/ /gnyen 'dun longs spyod ji tsam 'dzom gyur kyang / /rmi lam dpal 'byor tsam yin snying po med/ /snying po med la blo gtad byas la bslu/ /rang gis rang nyid g.yang sar ma bskyur na/ /gzhan dag ji ltar ngan yang 'phen mi nus/ /blo sna rbad kyis bstungs nas skad cig kyang / /sgo gsum tha mal lam du ma lus par/ /rang gis rang gcun rdo rus ma gtug na/ /yin yin yong yong go bab tsam gyi ngang / /rang mgo rul ba sna yis ma tshor bar/ /don med ngang du klad pa zad nyan gda'/ /mdor na rang sems thog tu thag chod tshe/ /re dogs rtsol sgrub mdud pa grol bas na/ /gtad med ngang du 'khor 'das snang cha kun/ /dgag sgrub spang blang med par bsgyur chog na/ /sems dang chos su 'dres pa'i nyams len yin/ /kha yis chos bshad sems la chos med pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa'i g.yo can lags/ /rang sems ngo bo mthong na lta ba'i rab/ /dran pa rgyun chad med pa sgom pa'i rtse/ /res 'jog spang blang med pa spyod pa'i phul/ /sangs rgyas sems la rnyed pa 'bras bu'i mchog /rmi lam lta bu'i 'jig rten bya gzhag dang / /spros bcas chos spyod zang zing mang po yis/ /mi g.yengs 'khrul pa'i sems kyi khungs rdib ste/ /'od gsal chos sku mngon du byed par sho/ga /ces pa'ang sgrub chen don dam gyi rnal 'byor rje dpon bla ma rin po che chos grags rgya mtsho'i bka' bskul ma gcog tsam du yon tan rgya mtshos g.yu thog rnam rgyal dgon nas phul ba dge legs 'phel// //

116 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gatre(la 'debs thugs rjes gzigs zhu/7/ na mo gu sa rtsa ba'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ /'brel tshad don ldan thar lam gyi sa mkhan/ /skal ldan slob ma'i snying dkyil du shar ba'i/ /bzod thabs med pa'i mos gus ni drag pos/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis gzigs shig /sras bcas rgyal ba'i gnyis med kyi ye shes/ /'gro kun gzhi rgyud bde gshegs kyi snying po/ /mtshon bya rtogs pa don brgyud kyi bla ma/ /rje btsun bla ma'i dgongs pa dang ro gcig /'gyur med rig stong zang thal gyi ngang du/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis gzigs shig /dkon mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi bkod pa/ /rtsa gsum zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ /mtshon byed dpe dang gzugs sku yi bla ma/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes kyi cho 'phrul/ /dag snang rab 'byams rgya yan gyi ngang nas/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis gzigs shig /rten 'byung rang rtsal shes bya ru srid tshad/ /rang ngo sprod pa'i slob dpon gyi mchog gyur/ /snang ba brda dang tha snyad kyi bla ma/ /drin chen bla ma'i thugs rje yi rang mdangs/ /ci shar chos nyid 'khor lo yi ngang nas/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis gzigs shig /gdod nas rang byung gshis lugs kyi rig stong / /mkha' ltar kun khyab 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba/ /rang sems don dam chos nyid kyi bla ma/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rgyud dang dbyer med/ /mi yengs mi sgom rang babs kyi ngang nas/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis gzigs shig /bdag dang mkha' khyab ma gyur gyi 'gro drug /las nyon bag chags gzhan dbang du gyur pas/ /don med rgya

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 117'byams rmi lam ltar 'khrul te/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ni drag po/ /zlog par dka' ba bar med kyis gtses pas/ /skyabs med nyam thag gyur pa la gzigs shig /re sa bla ma dam pa las med do/ /ci mdzad thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed mkhyen no/ /'khrul snang spyo 'tshab gtad med du sangs shing / /las shugs drag po byin rlabs kyis bzlog mdzod/ /rdo rje'i ye shes snying dbus su phab ste/ /tha mal shes pa rang shar du sad nas/ /dgag sgrub spang blang bcos bsgyur dang bral ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma yi 'od gsal/ /'du 'bral rtsol med khor yug tu 'char ba/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug bla ma khyed mkhyen no/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa'i bar chad kun zhi zhing / /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsang ba mchog gsum dang / /bdag gi sgo gsum dbyer med du shog cig /ces pa 'di'ang sgrub brtson bla ma kame 'chi med kyi bzhed ngor yon tan rgya mtshos cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lngar g.yu thog rnam rgyal dgon du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi lta sgom la nges pa cha tsam rnyed pa'i glu gnyug ma rang shar zhes bya ba/7/ rdo rje 'chang zhes g.yer po che/ /yon tan brgyad ldan du skad pa de/ /bdag tha mal snang ngor mi yi gzugs/ /mgon padma'i mtshan can byin rlabs can/ /snying padma 'dab brgyad gur khang du/ /dus skad cig ma bral gsol ba btab/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam kyi skal med kyang / /rang ngo shes tsam gyi byin rlabs thob/ /chos brgyad gnyer kha chung du song / /'od gsal chos sku sgra bo che/ /thugs yid bsres

118 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pas lhag ger mthong / /rnam rtog steng du mi rtog rnyed/ /blo bral ngang nas ye shes shar/ /sangs rgyas dwags po'i bu brgyud dang spro bas/ /rjes shes kyi mgrin pa btegs snying 'dod/ /nub o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas/ /grub thob tai lo chen po yis/ /nor bu rnam gsum gter kha phyes/ /byang me tog mdangs 'phrog dgon pa na/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ /rlung sems gnyis med kyi grub rtags ston/ /lho gro bo lung gi sman ljongs su/ /dgyes mdzad sprul pa'i lo tsā yis/ /grub thob yongs kyi chu 'go btsugs/ /nub la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na/ /skyes mchog bzhad pa rdo rje yis/ /tshe gcig la zung 'jug go 'phang bsgrubs/ /shar dwags la sgam po'i zhing khams na/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa 'tsho byed zhabs/ /sa bcu pa'i ting 'dzin mngon du gyur/ /gnas sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor na/ /che bzhi chung brgyad grub pa'i khyu/ /phyag rgya chen po'i srog mthu grub/ /sangs la mi rgya ka med byung / /byang chub sems kyi dbang sdud mkhas/ /'gro don mi 'byung ka med byung / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nor sgrub zab/ /longs spyod mi rdzogs ka med byung / /gcig shes kun grol mkhyen pa rgyas/ /lung chen mi thob ka med byung / /pha bsags pa can gyi bu rgyud la/ /nor rang bzhin che ba sngon gyi las/ /seng dkar mo khyung chen phru gu rnams/ /rtsal rang bzhin rdzogs pa rigs kyi mthu/ /bka' grub thob brgyud pa'i rjes 'jug la/ /sgom rang bzhin skye ba byin rlabs stobs/ /lo grangs mang po'i sdug yus dang / /sos dal du bsdad pa'i nga rgyal dang / /sdug u tshugs byas pa'i ham pa dang / /gzhan khyad gsod byed pa'i pho tshod dang / /rang so skye rnam rtog grangs 'debs la/ /sa lam gyi mngon rtogs brtsi ba sogs/ /snyigs dus kyi blun sgom khyad chos rnams/ /mi ldan grub thob kyi ming med kyang / /dpe

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 119brgyud pa bzang po'i gdams ngag gis/ /don phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mthong / /gzhi phyag chen lta ba'i gnas lugs go /lam phyag chen sgom pa nyams su myong / /'bras phyag chen sangs rgyas sems su rtogs/ /mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang / /dus snyigs mar skyes kyang skal pa che/ /snying rus chung yang gdams ngag zab/ /gzhi phyag rgyachen po zer tsa na/ /gnas lugs dang 'khrul lugs gnyis su gda'/ /'khor 'das kyi ris su ma chad cing / /sgro skur spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /rgyu yis ma bskyed rkyen ma bsgyur/ / 'khrul pas ngan du ma song zhing / /rtogs pas bzang du ma song ba/ /'khrul ma myong la grol ma myong / /ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pas/ /rnam pa gang med cir yang 'char/ /'khor 'das kun khyab nam mkha' bzhin/ /'khrul dang grol ba kun gyi gzhi/ /rang gsal shes pa 'char rung can/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes dang bcas/ /lung ma bstan de'i rig pa'i cha/ /ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal/ /dbyer med rig pa'i snying po can/ /ngos bzung mang ba bar snang khams/ /dri med rin chen dwangs pa'i shel/ /rang rig rang gsal mar me'i mdangs/ /brjod du med pa lkugs pa'i nyams/ /ma bsgribs ye shes zang thal ba 'od gsal chos sku bde gshegs snying / /gdod nas rnam dag lhun gyis grub/ /dpe sus kyang mtshon par mi nus shing / /tshig gang yang brjod par mi nus la/ /blos dpyad par mi bzod chos kyi dbyings/ /'di thog ma nyid du gtan la dbab/ /sgro 'dogs thams cad bcad kyang 'tshal/ /lta thog nas sgom pa skyong ba de/ /mkha' lding gnam 'phang gcod pa 'dra/ /gang la'ang nyam nga bag tsha med/ /lta ba med pa'i sgom pa de/ /dmus long thang du 'khyams pa 'dra/ /lam nges pa yin min gtad so med/ /sgom par mi nus lta ba yang / /phyug pos ser snas bcings pa 'dra/ /rang

120 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gzhan la dgos pa'i 'bras mi 'byin/ /zung 'brel du skyong ba dam pa'i lugs/ /lung ma bstan pa'i gti mug cha/ /rgyu mtshan lngas rang ngo ma shes pas/ /lhan skyes ma rig rgya mtsho las/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rba rlabs g.yos/ /rig pa bdag dang rang snang yul/ /gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags 'thas pa las/ /las bsags shing de las rnam smin byung / /lubor ba zo chun khyud mo gabor/ /'bor bzhin du ngo bo dri ma med/ /snang dus nyid nas bden pas stong / /snang tsam yang sku gsum bkra lam me/ /skyes pa'i rang bzhin ma skyes pa/ /ma skyes pa de 'gag pa med/ /gnyis med bar na gnas pa bral/ /brjod par dka' ba'i sems nyid las/ /'khor 'das kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs shar/ /rang grol du shes pa lta ba'i mchog /rtogs na thams cad de bzhin nyid/ /dgag sgrub med na gnyug ma'i gshis/ /blo las 'das na mthar thug lags/ /lam phyag rgya chen po zer tsa na/ /sems nyid dang snang srid phyag rgya che/ /sems lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ /snang ba lhan skyes chos sku'i 'od/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /rang gi las 'phro 'dzom pa na/ /sngar 'dris kyi mi bzhin rang ngo 'phrod/ /bshad bshad mang po'i kha na med/ /las dang po pa la gang yang dgos/ /'das ma 'ongs rtog pa'i skyel bsu spang / /da ltar gyi shes pa skad cig mar/ /bzo ma byas gnyug ma gshis kyi ngang / /blos ched du bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med/ /yengs 'khrul pa skad cig ma rbestor bar ma yengs mi sgom bzo med gnad/ /so ma lhug par rang dwangs ngang / /rnam thar sgo gsum gyi nam mkha' la/ /dran shes bzhin bya ra legs bkod nas/ /sems sgrim klod ran pos rtag bskyangs pas/ /phra rag sbom gsum gyi rtog tshogs zhi/ /sems ma bcos rang bab ngang la gnas/ /nyams rim pa bzhi po rim gyis skye/ /'od gsal gyi nyi

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 121ma khor yug 'char/ /sgom phyag rgya chen po'i rtsa ba tshugs/ /'di med pa'i rtogs pa mgro'o skad/ /rmang med pa'i mkhar gyi rnam bzhag 'dra/ /'dir ha cang zhen pa'ang bdud kyi las/ /thos chung snying rus can phal cher/ /ltar snang yon tan gyis blo brid nas/ /rang gzhan ngan 'gro'i lam sna byed/ /nyams bzang po bde gsal mi rtog kyang / /'dzin pa yod na 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /mos gus kyi snying la gzer btab nas/ /rig thog tu rdo rus 'phrod pa na/ /byin rlabs kyi don rgyud 'phos pa las/ /rbesgor sa bzhi ru ma 3(ra zhing / /gol sa gsum du ma lhung ba/ /dga' bzhi las 'das rkyen gsum bral/ /skye lugs gsum gyis mtshams sbyar bas/ /chen po gsum gyi blos ma reg /nyams myong bas ma sbags rang byung gshis/ /sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rang rig rang gsal smrar mi btub/ /dpe bral mi rtog ye shes te/ /tha mal shes pa rjen pa nyid/ /go yul dang pho tshod du ma lus par/ /chos kyi sku ru lhag gis mthong / /tshogs drug gi yul snang chu zla bzhin/ /ye shes kyi ngang du ya la la/ /gang shar bzo med gnyug ma'i ngang / /cir snang phyag rgya chen po'i gshis/ /snang srid chos sku bde ba che/ /sgom rang bab 'jog pa'i zhi gnas dang / /don mthong med mthong ba'i lhag mthong gnyis/ /gnas 'gyu rig go cog kun la/ /ya bral ma yin zung du 'jug /rnam rtog 'khrul pa spang du med/ /gnyen po'i dge sbyor bsgrub tu med/ /rang sar sleb pa'i dus shig mchi'o/ /rtog pa'i rang so zin pa la/ /sgom min pa ci yang yod min zhing / /bral thob med pa'i sa mtshams na/ /sgom pa nyid kyang med mod kyi/ /blo yi spu ris ma yal ba'i las dang po pa la sgom pa gces/ /sgom pa'i thog nas myong ba 'byung / /myong ba rig pa'i rgyan du shar/ /lam khyad par dbye na rnal 'byor bzhi/ /sems rang ngo shes pa rtse

122 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gcig yin/ /de chung 'bring chen po'i rim pa las/ /bde gsal gyi ngo bo res 'jog dang / /mnyam bzhag gi ting 'dzin rang dbang thob/ /nyams 'od gsal snang ba khor mo yug /sems rtsa bral du rtogs pa spros bral yin/ /de chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba las/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum stong par rtogs/ /snang 'dzin stong 'dzin gyi gzhi rtsa bral/ /chos kun la spros pa'i sgro 'dogs chod/ /snang sems 'dres pa ro gcig yin/ /de chung 'bring chen po'i rim pa las/ /gnyis dus kyi chos rnams rim par 'dres/ /snang sems chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ /ro gcig las ye shes du ma 'char/ /blo gtan zad du song ba sgom med yin/ /de chung 'bring chen po'i rim pa las/ /bsgom bya sgom byed kun dang bral/ /shes sgrib kyi bag chags rim gyis byang / /'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa las/ /chos dbyings ye shes klong du 'byams/ /mdor na mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /sems ci 'dod du gnas pa rtse gcig ste/ /tha mal gyi shes pa'i rang ngo mthong / /gzhi med du rtogs pa spros bral yin/ /chos gnyis su 'dzin pa ji snyed kun/ /rig thog tu grol ba ro gcig ste/ /sgom mi sgom gyi tha snyad kun las 'das/ /bag chags zad pa sgom med ces/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i sa/ /nā ro mi tris dbu bzung nas/ /rje bla ma padma dbang chen bar/ /bka' brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba rnams/ /sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sar gshegs/ /sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa dbyings su sangs/ /mkhyen pa gnyis kyi rtsal chen rgyas/ /gzhan don mkha' khyab kyi gter kha bye/ /blo the tshom med pa'i skyabs su bzhugs/ /bka' brgyud gcig la gcig brten ces/ /tshig tsam ma yin don la grags/ /mi rmu rgod so skye bdag 'dra yang / /rje khyed kyi brgyud pa'i rtags 'dzin pas/ /sgom med kyi rgyal sar myur du drongs/ /blo gtan zad du mdzod

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 123cig thugs rje can/ /'bras phyag rgya chen po skad pa de/ /gzhi gakhug ma'i sku gsum rang ngo 'phrod/ /lam lta sgom gnad du bsnun pa las/ /'bras dri bral sku gsum mngon du gyur/ /gshis stong nyid spros bral chos kyi sku/ /mdangs rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med sprul pa'i sku/ /dngos po kun gyi khyab bdag ste/ /zung 'jug rang bzhin phyag rgya che/ /spang thob med pa chos kyi dbyings/ /zag med bde ba'i lang tsho can/ /ye shes kyi longs spyod rgya che ba/ /thugs rje'i rang gzugs bsam las 'das/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas par/ /rtsol med kyi phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /gzhi lam gyi 'od gsal ma bu 'dres/ /gzhi 'bras gnyis po lto ba 'byor/ /sangs rgyas rang gi sems las rnyed/ /dgos 'dod kyi gter kha nang nas brdol/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba la/ /'di yin gyi dpyad ra mi 'jug pas/ /yid byed kyi shes pa rgyang du bskyur/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sgom pa la/ /'di snyam gyi 'dzin stangs ma mchis pas/ /bcos ma'i mnyam bzhag bor la thong / /phyag rgya chen po'i spyod pa la/ /'di byed kyi gtad so mi bdog pas/ /bya dang mi bya'i rtog pa bral/ /phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu la/ /'di bsgrub kyi gsar thob ma mchis pas/ /re dogs kyi 'dod blo ring du btang / /'di bka' brgyud yongs kyi dgongs pa'i mthil/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam/ /srid pa'i zhabrul 'khor zlog pa'i thabs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i chos/ /bka' mdo rgyud yongs kyi nying khu ste/ /mi bdag dang mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun/ /chams gcig tu rtogs grol dus mnyam nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i mchog grub 3(ga /'di'ang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid rnam pa rdo rje

124 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'dzin pa'i zol du snang ba'i gsung rnam pa thams cad pa'i rgya las mi 'da' ba'i slad du/padma'i 'bangs yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ de bī ko ṭi gsum pa tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi g.yon mgul kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du smras pa'o// //7/ zab lam nā ro chos drug gi gsang don nges pas drangs pa'i glu zab don rgyan gyi me tog ces bya ba/rje padma'i mtshan can rdo rje 'chang / /khyed thugs rje can gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus su kho thag chod/ /gsol 'debs kyi 'o dod lhang lhang bos/ /bcos min gdung shugs 'bral ba med/ /snang ba yang bkrag med bun lang song / /shugs 'byung gi sgom pa nyams su myong / /spros bral gyi lta ba'i gnas lugs shes/ /spyod pa yang bcos med rang bab ngang / /res 'ga' shes pa rgya yan gyi nyams/ /dag snang can la sngon sbyangs bzhin/ /res 'ga' 'thibs shing rmugs pa'i nyams/ /kun snang du blun po kha lkugs po/ /res 'ga' gnas lugs g.yo med nyams/ /nyams can ngor dran rdzi skyong ba 'dra/ /res 'ga' dug lnga rang grol nyams/ /log rtog can la col chung 'dra/ /res 'ga' gtad med zang thal nyams/ /gzhan gyis bltas na sems rlung 'dra/ /phal cher 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang can/ /rang nyid yi mug khong nas skye/ /skabs su go rtogs sprin bar nyi/ /shes pa 'ur la sems dpangs mtho/ /khyi khog nas gser chu skyug snying 'dod/ /skabs de dag tu yang thugs rje can/ /rje padma ma gtogs bsam rgyu med/ /don zab mo 'ga' re khong nas brdol/ /tshig ya ma zung 'ga' kha nas shor/ /sher

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 125 brtson che ba ma lags te/ /las 'phro'i gser thag ma chad snyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon du ma yi/ /zhabs padmor reg nas smin grol mnos/ /skye tshe rabs las kyi 'phro bzang byas/ /khyad par drin ldan zhal gnyis dang / /yang lhag par pha gcig padma des/ /sku byin rlabs gzi brjed lham mer bstan/ /gsung zab gsang chos sgra lhang ltang bsgrags/ /thugs ting 'dzin sgo brgyar 'jug cing lhang / /zhal dgyes pa'i mdangs kyis dbugs phyung nas/ /spyir bla med kyi smin byed du ma yis/ /rgyud sku bzhi'i sa bon gsos su btab/ /thun mong dang thun min gyi khrid rim gyis/ /mchog thun 'grub par byin gyis brlabs/ /zab chos sku bzhi ngo sprod kyis/ /rtogs pa don brgyud kyi dngos grub bstsal/ /sgos rgyud sde bzhi yi gsang ba'i bcud/ /lo tsā chen po'i khyad par chos/ /zab lam nā ro chos drug ces/ /bod gangs can tsam na snyan par grags/ /mkhas grub yongs kyi spyi nor de/ /snying gi bdud rtsi lhug par bstsal/ /bsre dang 'pho ba'i don rnams go /rlung sems gnyis med gnad kyang rig /dwags brgyud kyi rnam thar la nges shes skyes/ /nyon mongs la gtum pa'i ye shes bde/ /'khor 'das kun sgyu ma'i lus su snang / /'khrul snang chos kun rmi lam bzhin/ /chos kun gyi gnas lugs 'od du gsal/ /gnyis snang gi 'brul rtog bar do'i ngang / /ma 'khrul pa'i chos kyis gong 'pho thob/ /tshig don gyi chos drug thos pas go /mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs gnyis su bzhugs/ /tsaṇḍi dam tshig phyag rgyas bcings/ /yul snang lha skur sgyu mar blta/ /rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad kyis bzung / /ril 'dzin rjes gzhig 'od gsal sbyang / /bar do rang ngo shes pas bcad/ /'da' ka'i ye shes gong du 'pho/ /spyi don gyi chos drug bsam pas myong / /thun mong dang khyad par gyi gdams pa snang / /bde drod mi rtog rtsal

126 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/chen rdzogs/ /rlung sems lha yi sku ru shar/ /stong pa bzhi las lha skur ldang / /dpe don 'od gsal rang ngo 'phrod/ /snang stong zung 'dug 'ja' tshon sku/ /'od kyi gong bu sgra yis 'pho/ /sbas don gyi chos drug sgom pas rtogs/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbye bsal yod/ /tshig de yi rjes su ma zlos na/ /don de la sgom yor zhad cig phog /go myong rtogs la gdeng med kyang / /gnas lugs kyi ngang nas yin lugs byung / /yin lugs myong ba'i steng du 'phrod/ /car phog gi glu de rang byung 'dra/ /thun min nges pa bshad tsa na/ /zhu bde'i rang bzhin snang stong lus/ /rnam grol rang rtsal gnyug ma'i ngang / /rang grol rlung sems mkha' la spyod/ /thun min gyi chos drug ngo bo yin/ /bde drod ngang nas mi rtog 'char/ /snang yang bden 'dzin gyi shes pas stong / /nying 'khrul kha lo 'dod thog bsgyur/ /gsal stong shes pa mtha' dbus med/ /'dzin med sgyu ma longs spyod rdzogs/ /rlung sems mda' gzhu gyen du 'phen/ /thun min gyi chos drug mtshan nyid yin/ /snyoms 'jug dga' bzhi'i rol mor spyod/ /sad pa'i zhabrul rtog lha ru sgyur/ /rmi lam drwa ba btsan thabs gcod/ /gnyid mthug mun pa'i sgrib g.yogs phral/ /bar do'i 'jigs pa'i rdzun phug gtibs/ /'chi rtog sku gsum btsan sar skyel/ /thun min gyi chos drug byed las yin/ /'gyur med kyi bde stong zung du 'jug /chags sdang rang grol bde ba che/ /sprul sgyur sems kyi rtsal chen rdzogs/ /gnyug ma rgya 'byams chos sku'i klong / /sred len mtshams sbyor longs skur thim/ /sdig po che yang thar lam rnyed/ /thun min gyi chos drug dgos pa sogs/ /phyi snang stong yi dam lha yi sku/ /nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo 'khor phran bcas/ /bar a haṃ dpyid thig kha sbyor ni/ /rlung bum can 'phrul gyis 'bar 'dzag dang / /steng 'og rang gzhan lus la brten/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 127sems bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyis brgyan/ /rtsa ba gtum mo'i bsgom byar grags/ /thabs lam gyi rnal 'byor ngo re mtshar/ /phyi snang ba thams cad bden pas stong / /nang sgo gsum sgyu ma'i dpe dang mtshungs/ /bar lha sku snang stong zung 'jug ngang / /rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dben gsum la/ /sems zin pas snang gsum lugs 'byung las/ /lugs ldog sgyu ma mtshan dpe'i sku/ /dag ma dag thun min sgom pa can / /sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor ya mtshan che/ /nyin bar 'dun pa rgyun chags dang / /mtshan mo gdams ngag btsan thabs kyis/ /rmi lam du ngo shes spel cing sgyur/ /sgyu mas sgyu ma'i rnam thar sbyong / /de kho na nyid kyi mkha' dbyings su/ /rmi lam rdzun gyi ri mo yal/ /nying 'khrul dri ma zhabrud pa'i chu/ /rtsal rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor yid re dga'/ /lus gnad lta stangs phyi yi gnad/ /snying ga sna rtse nang gi gnad/ /yig 'bru thig le 'dun pa'i gnad/ /dus grogs dam tshig mthun pa'i gnad/ /gnad de dang 'brel ba'i gdams ngag gis/ /rlung zla nyi sgra gcan snying gar zin/ /nyin snang ba mi rtog lhums su gzhug /mtshan gti mug 'od gsal sbubs su bstim/ /gnyid srab mthug blo 'das chos sku'i ngang / /shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyang / /ril 'dzin dang rjes su gzhig pa las/ /don dam rdo rje gsum gyi klong / /'od gsal gyi nyams len ma zhabrul ba/ /gdeng thob kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde/ /snang mched thob gsum tha ma ndasga /'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa las/ /mi rtog chos sku'i rang zhal lta/ /snang gsum lugs ldog tu 'char ba na/ /sgyu lus yi dam lha yi sku/ /mi slob zung 'jug gi ngo bor ldangs/ /ngos ma zin bar do gsum pa shar/ /mngal gdam zhing skye ba dag pa yi/ /gnad da lta sbyor ba'i las 'phro can/ /blo chod kyi rnal 'byor gdeng re zab/ /rab 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur

128 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'pho/ /'bring bar do sgyu lus longs skur 'pho/ /tha ma skye ba sprul skur 'pho/ /sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung dgag /sgo gcig thar pa'i gsang lam dbye/ /rtsa dbu ma'i lam las sems kyi mda'/ /rlung sgra yi gzhu mos steng du 'phen/ /ye shes gong 'pho'i gseb lam can/ /mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor rlabs re che/ /thun min chos drugagi sgom rim yin/ /gegs sel dang bogs 'don 'phrul 'khor sogs/ /thabs kyi yan lag mtha' yas kyang / /gegs sel gyi bsdus don gzer lnga yin/ /bogs 'don gyi rgyal po dad brtson yin/ /'phrul 'khor gyi mdo rtsa lus gnad yin/ /don de dang mi 'bral pha yi bu/ /bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i gces phrug rnams/ /rlung bcu po dbu ma'i nang du 'gags/ /rtags du ba la sogs bcu po 'char/ /las bzhi grub brgyad thun mong dang / /thun min gyi sa lam yon tan thob/ /bde stong zung 'jug 'gyur ba med/ /'ja' lus sgrib bral sgyu ma'i tshul/ /snang stong rang shar so sor rtog /chos sku klong 'byams ye shes ngang / /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /gang du'ang 'pho med mkha' spyod che/ /mthar thug gi chos drug mngon du 'gyur/ /bde chen gyi btsan sa zin pa'i mi/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /grub thob kun gyi lam po che/ /dus kyi dbang gis 'gags la nye/ /da dung pha rjes zin pa'i bu/ /las kyi 'phro ldan rgyun mi chad/ /ri kha ba can ljongs khengs par byon/ /lam 'di las grub pa mthar thug thob/ /chos 'di yis sa steng khyab pa yis/ /sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rab 'bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lam las mthar thug gi gsang ba grub pa chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' yi gnang ba las/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ thol byung mgrin pa'i pi waṃ de bī ko ṭī tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben ljongs su brdungs pa'o// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 1297/ zab lam ni gu chos drug gi rdo rje'i gnas nges pa'i mgrin glu ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa rin po che rnam bdun/ /mi min mi yi tshul bzung rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyi gser phreng / /sangs rgyas rjen par stsol ba'i dpal ldan rtsa ba yi bla ma/ /zhabs kyi padmor 'dud do nyams rtogs gong 'phel du mdzod cig /e ma snying po'i lam 'dir kho bo'i skal ba ni bzang ldan/ /rdo rje 'chang gi zhal lung ye shes ḍā ki yi gsang tshig /grub thob brgyud pa'i nyams myong rtsa ba'i bla ma yi pha phog /snying gi nor bu bcangs pas blo yi gtad so 'dra bdog go /gangs can bod kyi ljongs 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa gyi drin las/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rin chen kun la thang ma ru brdal yang / /grub thob bar ma chad cing myong rtags mngon sum du thon pa/ /mkhas grub khyung po'i gser chos yid bzhin nor bu las lhag go /mthar thug rnam lnga ston mdzad su kha sirnyi dang ni gu /gsang ba'i lam mchog snang byed ye shes dkyil 'khor ni lnga ldan/ /bshad sgrub bka' srol 'dzin pa sar gnas byang sems kyi gdung brgyud/ /ma bsgrubs byin rlabs sgo 'char bsgrubs na grub pa lta ci smos/ /mkha' lding khyung chen zhes pa'i ming gi mngon brjod tsam kho nas/ /bya phran gzhan gyi gnas lugs ji mi snyam pa yi sems thob/ /khyung po'i gser chos zhes pa'i mtshan gyi gzi brjed kyi zil gyis/ /rang rtogs yi ge ris la gus pa lhod po ru byed do/ /kha nag yig nag sprad pa'i bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod ni bye bas/ /chos 'di yud tsam bsgoms pa'i nyams myong rtags

130 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/tshad la mi nye/ /rtog ge'i rig pa'i 'bor lo lo dang zla ba ru bskor yang / /don 'di nyams su blangs pa'i shes rab cha shas su mi phyin/ /deng sang dus kyi dbang gis rtse gcig sgom nus mkhan dkon kyang / /yid gnyis the tshom med pa'i chos la nges shes ni chen pos/ /spang blang res 'jog med par rgyun gyi nyams len tsam 'bad na/ /ring min mchog dngos 'grub pa ye shes mkha' 'gro yi tha tshig /sgrub la snying rus chung bas nyams rtogs rtsal kha ni ma rdzogs/ /col chung rnam par g.yeng bas drod tshad mngon sum 'dra dben kyang / /dkar po'i las kyi 'phro yis chos 'dir yid ches ni gdeng khel/ /snying dang srog ltar gces pa'i mos pa lhan skyes su 'dug go /gser chos rin chen mdzod las rgyud chen sde lnga yi yang bcud/ /mtshan gyi grags pa gsal ldan rtsa ba ni gu yi chos drug /stan thog gcig gi steng du nyams rtogs myu gu ni 'khrungs la/ /tshe lus gcig gi khongs su mchog gi 'bras ster 'di rmad do/ /gdod nas skye med yig 'bru 'khor 'das chos kun gyi sgo mo/ /bde chen 'bor lor shar ba'i dag byed bdud rtsi yi khrus kyis/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon bkrus las stong gsal rjen pa yi nyams ldan/ /dag byed stong ra'i thabs 'di gnad du phyin pa yi sngon 'gro/ /che gcig sangs rgyas sgrub na bde stong zung 'jug las gzhan pa'i/ /thabs lam yod pa ma yin de rgyu rang lus ni thabs ldan/ /rtsa rgod rlung rgod 'dul la gtum mo me rgod nyid myur bas/ /bdun phrag gsum gyi zhag nas ras dkar bla gos kyis 'khyongs so/ /rten gzhi rdo rje'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i stong rar/ /sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i bum can tshad ldan du khegs pas/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag 'phrul las skad cig dga' ba bzhis brgyan pa/ /thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar 'phags bod grub thob kyi snying

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 131nor/ /gtum mo zas su zos pas bde stong gzhon sha ni chags la/ /gtum mo gos su gyon pas bde drod bzod med du 'bar ba/ /gdan bting rta ru zhon pas brtan cing gang 'dod du phyin pa/ /thun mong tsam dang mi mnyam bla med rgyud rgyal gyi dgongs pa/ /mos gus bla ma'i lam las cir snang bden med du shar zhing / /snang stong lha sku rang shar cir snang sgyu ma ru mthong ba/ /sgyu lus snying po yin kyang nyams 'og chud pa ni dkon 'dug /bla ma grub pa'i dbang pos thugs dam mthil phyin tu myong song / /sad pa'i rkyen bzhi bral bas 'gro drug sgyu ma ru 'char byed/ /'dun pa brgyad gsum sprugs shing nad gdon sgyu ma ltar shes pas/ /yon tan tshogs drug 'char zhing a 'thas sbrul mdud nyid dkrol ba/ /dang po'i las can rnams la snying gi bdud rtsi ru 'dug go /nying 'brul snang ba rang zin dbang bzhi thig le yi gdams ngag /ma zin 'chug med gnad dgus 'khrul pa thug phrad du bzung nas/ /sbyong spel sgyur ba'i gnad kyis rang rtsal phyogs med du sbyangs pas/ /yul snang gtan la phebs shing rmi lam rnam thar yang 'byongs te/ /rtsol med lha sku rang shar mthar thug 'od gsal du bstim pas/ /nying 'khrul btsan thabs gcod pa gdams ngag zab dgu yi yang rtse/ /blun po ba lang rdzi yang sangs rgyas nyin rgyugs su btang 'dir/ /bla ma sangs rgyas drin las 'brel ba g.yar khral tsam bzhag go /mi rtag skyo shas spyod lam dam rdzas thabs lam dang gsol 'debs/ /rtsa ba yal ga lo ma me tog 'khri shing ni rgyas las/ /srab mthug 'od gsal 'bras bu bzung zhing sku gsum du khyer te/ /gsal stong mnyam bzhag rjes thob nyin mtshan bde stong dag bsres pas/ /gti mug gnyid kyi mun khang 'od gsal sgron me yis bcom te/ /rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel khyad par bla ma

132 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/yi byin gyis/ /bde gsal stong pa dbyer med zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od gsal/ /khor mo yug gi sbubs su gnyis snang bar lag 'dra gyes so/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid de longs sku zung 'jug gi yi dam/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i stobs dang 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi gong 'phos/ /dbang po'i rim dang mthun par 'da' ka'i mtshams sbyor 'dra bgyid pa/ /da lta'i sngags spyod kun gyi bskyed rdzogs grub mtha' ni 'di'o/ /'od gsal chos kyi sku dang rgyal ba longs spyod ni rdzogs pa/ /sprul sku 'gag med rang shar spyi gnad 'chug med dang bcas pas bar do gsum la grol byed dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par/ /dal dus grabs su btsud pas brel dus sleb par ni 'gyur ro/ /sngon 'gro rang bab gsum gyis zhi lhag ting 'dzin ni bskyed nas/ /dngos gzhi ngo sprod zab mos skyon bzhi rang grol du btang ste/ /rjes shes gsal stong zung 'jug sku gsum rang shar du shes pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lam 'di chos kyi sdong po nyid yin no/ /ye shes ḍā ki rnam gnyis mi tri gupta yi zhal lung / /bzo med rang bab ngo bo glang chen lta stangs dang 'grogs pas/ /ngos bzung kun dang bral ba'i tha mal shes pa ni so ma/ /sku gsum rjen par 'char bas sangs rgyas sbar bcang du rnyed do/ /cir snang bla mar shes pa'i mos gus phyogs med ni dang po/ /snang grags lha sngags rang bzhine dag snang phyogs med ni gnyis pa/ /snang sems sgyu ma rmi lam bden med lam khyer ni gsum pa/ /yal ga'i mtshan du gsol yang mdo sngags chos kun gyi snying po/ /zla ba li khri'i mdangs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ting 'dzin/ /khyad 'phags gsol 'debs shugs kyis snying rje'i chu rgyun ni bskul zhing / /'khor lo bzhi yi mar mes chags grol bde stong la bslabs pas/ /mkha' spyod me tog tshal du lhan skyes mdzes ma

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 133yis bsu'o/ /rang sems skye ba med pas 'gag cing 'chi ba yang med la/ /lus nyid bem po'i rang bzhin 'chi ba'i gdags gzhi tsam ma grub/ /rlung sems dbyings su bsdams shing 'phrul 'khor kha lo 'dra bsgyur bas/ /'dzag med dga' bzhi'i yo lang 'bras bu thang brdal du spyad chog /bla ma mgon po dbyer med sku lnga'i 'phrul chen ni bsgyur bas/ /las bzhi mchog gi dngos grub lo zla'i shas tsam gyis ster ba/ /lhag par bar do'i 'jigs skyob myur mdzad spyan ras ni gzigs dbang / /mos gus snying rje'i phyag rgyas gtan gyi snying nor du bcangs yod/ /sangs rgyas thub pa'i bstan pa drang nges rang thad du bden cing / /grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag che bshad rang sa na yod kyang / /gzhan la mtshan tsam dkon pa mkhas grub khyung po yi gser chos/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud la 'thung tshe chang la 'gram chu 'dra mi ldang / /byed lugs zom zom ngang la bsam lugs don thog tu bcang ba/ /snang lugs klad med 'dra la yin lugs gcig thog tu grim pa/ /zer lugs bcos ma nyid la byung lugs rang bzhin gyi bab gshis/ /btang snyoms sdod par ma nus sprang po blo gros kyi sug rjes/ /skye dang tshe rabs kun tu gser chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /snying gi dpal ber bcangs te zung 'jug rdo rje yi rgyal sar/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol ba'i skyob pa gnyis med ni gzigs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rjes myur du 'grub pa ru mdzod cig /ces pa'ang kun mkhyen mahā gu ru'i don chen rdo rje'i ljags brkyangs pas mos pa'i myu gu bsros pa las smra ba'i padmo dbang med du bye ste/ dben pa'i skyed tshal de bī ko ṭī tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi g.yon mgul du/ padma'i 'bangs spong ba pa'i gzugs brnyan yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes zab don bung ba'i mgrin glu cung zad cig blangs pa dge /maṅga le// //

134 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/7/ bla na med pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi gnas la dad pa'i padmo mchog tu rgyas pa'i dbyangs tshig rig ldan dgyes glu zhes bya ba/oṃ/ rang byung mchog tu mi 'gyur mtshan dpe'i sku/ /āḥ seng ge nā da'i sgra dbyangs mtha' yas tshig /hūm̐/ rnam pa kun ldan brjod med yang dag mtha'/ /hoḥ brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag ye shes rdo rje 'chang / /haṃ/ 'pho ba'i 'jigs bcom bcu drug lang tsho gang / /kṣa/ nyi rdul rab brtan gnas med dkyil 'khor mgon/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /srid pa las 'das srid gsum rnam pa can/ /skye ba'i phreng bar snying gi chu skyes la/ /chags pa'i col chung mgrin pa bye ba'i glu/ /bung ba'i rol mo yid 'gyur sbrang rtsis bskul/ /sos kas myos pa'i gzur gnas rna ba blogs/ /a ho/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig lam la mi tshe 'dis/ /bgrod par 'dod pa'i skal bzang blo chen po/ /u dum wa ra snyigs ma'i nags tshal du/ /zhabrungs pa yod na 'dir byon yid gtod dang / /rgyal ba'i gsang tshig mkhas grub snying gi bcud/ /bdag gi sems kyi rin chen yid gnyis dang / /the tshom dri mas ma gos nor bu'i sgrom/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i drin gyis dbye bzod pas/ /grogs dag gtan gyi dbul ba mi 'phrog gam/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas rgyud rgyal du ma sa /sbas rnams mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas su/ /gsal bar gsungs pa zung 'jug bzhi pa'i lam/ /sku yi rdo rje'i rnam cha mthong ba dang / /gsung gi rdo rje nyams su myong bar byed/ /bdag nyid thugs dang ye shes rdo rje la/ /zhugs pa'i sgo nas gdod

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 135ma'i rdo rje bzhi/ /mngon sum lam du byed kyi mos pas min/ /ye shes rjes su dpag cing sna 'dren pa/ /mngon sum 'bebs pa'i lam 'dir snying rje'i yul/ /khyab bya khams lnga'i gong bu stobs ldan pa/ /khyab byed ye shes mar khu de 'dra bas/ /klu dbang gtsug gi rgyan gyis cha tsam yang / /mi bsgrun lus dang chos 'di mtshungs par byung / /rgyal bas rgyud gzhan las kyang gsal bar gsungs/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas rnal 'byor tshad du phyin/ /nyin zhag gcig tu rdo rje'i ye shes cha/ /'bebs pas rmi lam du yang yid ches gsum/ /ma bral rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgo mthong ba /chos gzhan rtogs las 'di don che ba'i phyir/ /e ma skal bzang bzhin gyi chu skyes 'dzum/ /bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin 'od gsal khams/ /gsang gsum ye shes thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /kun rdzob las 'das don dam snang ba can/ /khams lnga'i dwangs ma stong chen yi ge lnga/ /phung po'i chos nyid stong pa 'gyur med drug /zung 'jug rang bzhin kun 'gro kun khyab pa/ /snying nang gzhom med 'bar yang glo 'bur sbubs/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi bag chags kyis g.yogs te/ /yon tan brgyad dang de las gzhan 'byung bas/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo rtag tu 'du byed pa/ /rtsa ba 'gyur med 'pho ba'i bag chags bcas/ /rags pa la brten phra ba'i dbu mar yang / /mod la reg byed rnam par mi rtog sems/ /rdo rje lus la bsnun pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rgyun mtha'i stobs dang ldan pas cis mi bcom/ /ltos med bzhi yis rdzogs pa'i lha sku bsnyen/ /sor bsam srog 'dzin dngos gzhir nyer sgrub cing / /'dod chags rjes su dran pas chags chen sgrub/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis ye shes mchog gi sku/ /sgrub pa chen po bgrod gcig lam mchog las/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang po'i rgyal sar 'gro/ /rtog ge'i mig gis ma mthong snying re rje/ /

136 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rnal 'byor phal gcig ma bgrod de bas kyang / /grub pa 'di nyid ma grub mtshang re che/ /thun min gzhan grogs sos ka'i sman ljongs su/ /lus ngag sems dang 'pho ba'i longs spyod la/ /mi ltos dbang po bcing zhing phung po bkag /rtog med dbu ma'i myu gu kha phye bar/ /snying po nam mkha'i me tog bzhad pa'i rdul/ /dang po'i blo yi bung bas bzhibs so kye/ /mkha' la 'khor lo can gyi khro bo yi/ /lta stangs byed pa bcing pa'i brtul zhugs 'dis/ /yul dang yul can 'brel ba so sor bcad/ / rnam shes spre 'u'i gar mkhan nang du sdud/ /gzhan gyi yul lngar ye shes dbang po spyod/ /g.yas g.yon thabs shes dkyil 'khor 'gags pa las/ /du ba smig rgyu mkha' snang mar me'i phreng / /'bar ba zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dang / /mchog cha thig le srid gsum stong pa'i gzugs/ /ma bris rang byung re khā'i ltad mo mthong / /ngo mtshar che'o lus sems thabs shes chos/ /'ching byed nyin mtshan rnal 'byor nyin zhag gcig /brtson pa'i skal ldan de la rgyal ba dgyes/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan las snang bcas pa yang / /phyi ru ma grub nang dang gzhan gyi mdangs/ /gzugs sems ngo bo mnyam pa'i rang bzhin la/ /g.yo med mnyam par 'jog pa'i bsam gtan yang / /shes rab rtog dpyod dga' dang g.yo med bde/ /yan lag rdzogs las nges pa gsum ldan gyi/ /longs spyod sku bzhugs thig le'i phreng ba yis/ /rab brgyan chos lnga ldan pa'i snang brnyan dang / /gdams ngag bsres pas 'od gsal khang bzang du/ /las snang zhi ba'i stong pa'i longs spyod dang / /gzhan la lkog tu gyur pa'ang longs spyod pas/ /sdug bsngal bral ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde/ /bdud rtsi'i lta ba rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim/ /dbug dgangs rengs sogs rtsa yi lam 'byangs nas/ /dgang zhing gtong pa 'jam po'i rlung sbyor

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 137gyis/ /srog dang rtsol ba dhā ti'i khyim du gzhug /'chi ba med pa'i sbrang rtsi de yang btung / /lhag mar rgyu ba tshum can lcags kyis sgrog /ma chings nyi zla'i 'gro lam btsan thabs dgag /'og sgo 'gags pa steng gi sbyor bas dgrol/ /steng 'og gong bur 'dres pa rdzogs pa'i sngags/ /stong gzugs 'jug gnas ldang dang dbyer mi phyed/ /yon po 'gags pas srog gzugs grub pa la/ /sras bcas rgyal bas byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ /ragasapa dkyil 'khor bcu po thabs kyis bcing / /phra ba rnam rtog bzhon pa rtog med brtan/ /shin tu phra ba dwangs ma 'od gsal ba/ /stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mos gcer phud do/ /rab brtan bum pa can dang lce gsum po/ /skyod pas nang gi bdud rtsi myong la sogs/ /btsan thabs sbyor bas gong bur 'dres pa'i rlung / /'khor lo drug dang mthar thug dag gi dbus/ /mi shigs thig ler thim pa lnga phrag lngas/ /gzhom med sgra dang 'bar ba'i snang ba yi/ /lha sku'i dkyil 'khor brtan las bde ba yi/ /ye shes dpyid kyi myu gu kha 'bus pas/ / bdud dang nyon mongs gdung ba nyams pa dang / /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che ba'i mchog /sgo gsum stobs kyis rgyas so a la la/ /dbang brtul thig le sla bas las kyi rgya/ /dbang 'bring cung zad ska la ye rgya ste/ /dbang rnon byang sems shin tu bska ba na/ /phyag rgya chen mos bde dang stong pa'i gzugs/ /rjes su dran las de dag yon tan gyi/ /khyad par chos bcas bye ba snyed 'phel bas/ /rtswa yi drwa ba gyur med thig les gang / /'od kyi dkyil 'bor thug pa med par snang / /dag pa'i gzugs brnyan nyid la brtan thob pas/ /ma dag srid pa gsum gyi spyod tshul dang / /rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin gzigs/ /rten 'brel phyogs med bsgrigs pas 'gro ba'i don/ /rgya cher mdzad pa sngon byon grub pa'i gtam/ /

138 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/snyigs ma'i skye bo'i skal par ma shong bas/ /ring por mi thogs lam 'dir ji bzhin par/ /'jug nus smon lam tsam la yi dam bgyid/ /stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'i dbang gyur lus/ /yid rig mdzes mar sbyor ba'i byang chub sems/ /gzung zlog 'grems bsre ye shes chen por bskyam/ /skad cig bzhi yi dga' ba'i lang tsho gang / /mtshan nyid kha dog drug ldan dus kyi mes/ /'khor lo lnga dbus dbyangs yig phug cing bsregs/ /zla ba zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /gsos shing ye shes rdo rjer khrus gsol bas/ /ba spu'i mthar thug bde ba'i rol mos khyab/ /dga' ba bcu drug stong pa'i gzugs spel ba/ /rjes mthun rnal du 'byor 'di'ang byang chub lam/ /phyag chen rtags bcus lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi /zhu bde rdzogs par drangs pa nor bu'i rtser/ /stong pa'i gzugs kyis bcings pas khu rdul rlung / /rab 'gags 'gyur ba med pa'i skad cig ma/ /dang po nas brtsams bcu gnyis sa yi bar/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dbugs 'gags shing / /'gyur med dga' ba de snyed 'phel ba yi/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid ting nge 'dzin/ /gzung 'dzin dang bral dmigs bcas dmigs pa med/ /ro mnyam gnas 'gyur thig les 'khor 'das kun/ /dbyings su zos pa'i mi 'gyur bde ba dang / /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa'i phyag rgya che/ /gnyis med zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i sku/ /thob pa'i lam 'dir nan tan snying por bya/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid la gzhung bzung nas/ /spros bcas spros med spyod pas mtshams sbyor te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa sgrub pa'i yan lag tu/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog blangs te/ /gnyid dang 'da' ka 'od gsal bar do dang / /mnyam rjes bsre ba'i man ngag zab dgu yis/ /blo yi bum pa gang ba'i blo gros spro/ /thog mar dge

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 139ba sor bsam sku rdo rjes/ /zhi gnas gzhi bca' lhag mthong sgron me sbar/ /bar du dge ba srog rtsol gsung rdo rjes/ /rlung dang sems bsre 'khor lo'i sgo mo dbye/ /tha ma dge ba dran ting thugs rdo rjes/ /'gyur med bde ba ye shes sku ru bsgrub/ /rgyu 'bras tshul gnas rnal 'byor yan lag kun/ /byed bcings phyag rgya gsum gyis sgrub pa po/ /lus ngag yid la rdo rje'i ye shes phebs/ /rtsa rlung zug slong 'phar g.yo'i 'phrul 'khor sogs/ /sna tshogs nyams kyis sgo gsum mdud pa bkrol/ /'khor lo drug dag rgyal ba rigs drug 'grub/ /sgom skyon ma yin dbu ma bye ba'i ltas/ /gegs min 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po dang / /bla ma rigs ldan rnams kyi byin rlabs nyid/ /byung rgyal bskyangs pas pha yi bu tsho 'tshengs/ /zhi gcod rim lnga lam 'bras chos drug sogs/ /rdzogs rim kun gyi skyel so theg pa'i rtse/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i zhe phugs 'dir/ /'jug cing spyod pa rmi lam rgyal srid nyid/ /lam 'di'i rtogs pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang / /rgyud 'di'i don la mi 'jigs sbobs pa brnyes/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod la dbang thob nas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la 'gyur med bde ster shog /ces pa'ang kun mkhyen bla ma dus kyi 'khor los gnang ba bstsal ba'i rkyen las/ dang po'i sangs rgyas padma'i mtshan can gyi 'bangs tha karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos/ de bī ko ṭi gsum pa tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi g.yon mgul kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du smras pa dge legs 'phel// //

140 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'chi med tshe'i ke'u tshang la spro ba'i thol glu/7/ a ho/ bsil ldan 'dzin ma'i ljongs la snyan par yongs su grags pa/ /'chi med tshe yi ke'u tshang mā ra ti ka gnyis pa/ /zag med rdo rje'i sku can o rgyan bla ma'i pho brang / /chu bur mig gis mjal 'di e ma ngo mtshar che'o/ /phyi ltar sa yi dpyad legs rin chen brag gi ba gam/ /nang ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'chi med tshe yi sgrub khang / /gsang ba sgyu 'phrul rdo rje padma drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ /rang dbang bzhin du spyod 'di e ma ngo mtshar che'o/ /bzang zhing dri yi ngad pas khams dang dbang po dwangs shing / /sprul pa'i bya rigs skad snyan rna bar sim pa skyed byed/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ring 'tsho'i bcud len sbyin pa/ /bsod nams dpal du grub 'di spyad nus skal ldan mchis sam/ /rdo rje sku can mang po ye shes rol pas bzhugs shing / /'chi med drang srong tshogs rnams zag med ting 'dzin sgom la/ /lha klu gnod sbyin khye'u mchod pa'i gar gyis rtse ba/ /thar pa don gnyer mchis na rdo rje'i gnas 'dir shog cig /rgyal tshab lo tsā chen po rnam par snang mdzad zhabs sogs/ /rje 'bangs grub thob rgya mtshos mchog gi go 'phang bsgrubs pa'i/ /rang byung rdo yi phug pa byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba/ /'di dag bdag gir bzung nas bdud rtsi nam zhig 'thung 'gyur/ /legs pa'i rten 'brel mang po gnas 'dir rang bzhin 'grigs shing / /sngon nas yun ring bsdad 'dra'i bag phebs dga' spro'i nyams ldan/ /dbus 'gyur tshal du phyin 'di da res don chen gyur song / /dge ba'i mthun rkyen gnang tsho e ma bka' drin che'o/ /sgyu 'phrul tshe

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 141mtha' yas pa'i bsnyen sgrub chu bo'i rgyun chen/ /ris med bstan 'dzin yongs kyi sku tshe'i bcud len nyid du/ /gangs ljongs 'dzin ma'i bdag po gong sa mchog nas btsugs pa'i/ /thog ma'i rten 'byung sna khrid kho bo rang nas grub song / /dag snang ris med sbyangs pa'i thugs rje bslu med nyid dang / /o rgyan gu ru'i thugs rje smon lam las 'phro 'dzoms pas/ /bcos min lung gis bstan pa'i don chen grub nas song ngo / /bzang po spyod pa'i grogs tsho bsam bzhin bka' drin che'o/ /rigs 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rigs rnams kun gyi spro gzhi/ /'chi med rdo rje'i 'khor lor ngo mtshar chen por snang ba/ /dri med rdo rje'i gsung de gnas mchog 'di ru sgrog na/ /bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan pa'i rten 'brel rang bzhin 'grigs 'dra/ /dgung sngon dbyings nas shar ba'i snang byed nyi zla'i khyelā /gling bzhi'i mun pa sel na 'od ldan dgos pa grub bo/ /lho sprin nang nas bab pa'i dus kyi sbrang char sil ma/ /'bru bcud lo tog smin na dus char dgos pa grub bo/ /'jog po'i gtsug nas 'ongs pa'i nor bu dbang gi rgyal po/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong na 'dod 'byung dgos pa grub bo/ /lhag bsam klong nas 'khrungs pa'i dge blo 'bral med skyes bu/ /gzhan la phan pa 'grub na las smon dgos pa grub bo/ /a la la ho/ sgrub gnas chen po brag dmar g.ya' ma lung 'chi med tshe'i ke'u tshang du/ rgyal khams pa blo gros mtha' yas sems rtsa spro snang 'char ba'i nyin mor smras pa'o// //mgrin pa'i pi waṃ dad nyams kyis brdungs pa'i sgra dbyangs/7/ e ma la a ho/ mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang 'bral med snying dbus su mchod do/ /

142 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gangs ljongs padma 'od mchims phu mjal ba 'di skyid do/ /klong dgu'i pho brang dngos ke'u tshang brten pa 'di dga' yo/ /rdo rje'i tshogs khang du 'du ba thob pa 'di spro'o/ /gu ru'i sku tshab las byin rlabs zhu ba 'di brod do/ /rtsa ba gsum po yi byin rlabs sprin phung ni 'khrigs gda'/ /yid la ci 'dod kyi dngos grub sbrang char ni 'bebs gda'/ /skal ldan snying rus can zhing sa yod na ni tshims gda'/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ni thibs thib/ /dpal chen he ru ka'i gar dgu'i gzi brjed ni lams lam/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'du ba ni spungs spungs/ /gnas gter srung ma yi mthu stobs drag rtsal ni khyugs khyug /rnal 'byor rig pa la 'dzin med chos sku ni lhag lhag /phyi yi snang ba kun ma skyes chos nyid kyi rang rtsal/ /nang gi shes pa kun rang grol chos sku yi rang bzhin / /snang shes bar lag na 'dzin rtog gzhi thog tu grol ba/ /blo zad chos zad la bral thob med pa tsho skyid do/ /mtha' 'khob srin po'i gling dam chos 'byung gnas su bsgyur ba'i/ /thar pa'i mig gcig po padma rgyal po yi drin 'di/ /gangs can 'gro ba yis 'khor thabs rtsa ba nas mi snang / /shes med nga rgyal can rang sgo'i pho bzo re phyar nas/ /drin gsob med pa'i khar drin lan log 'jal mkhan snang ngo / /kye ma thugs rje can rmongs pa 'di tsho la gzigs shig /bdag gi bla ma mchog 'chi med padma yi zhal nas/ /ro ldan bdud rtsi yi skyugs pa shar shar du phab pa/ /las 'phro'i mgrin pa ru 'thung ba'i dga' ba 'dra myangs byung / /brgya lam nam mkha' ru gser gyi me tog ni 'khrungs pa/ /yid ches lag pa yis gang 'dod rang dbang du thob pas/ /khams dbus skal ldan gyi gtsug rgyan brtan po ru 'jog yod/ /chos kyi 'byor pa can mchims phu'i tshogs khang du sdod 'di/ /nor bu'i shing rta can ded

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 143dpon khyim sleb dang 'dra'o/ /padma drwa ba'i zhing bsam yas mchims phu ru snang ngo / /zla gam dbang gi dal brag dmar ke'u tshang rang gda' 'o/ /gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin mngon sum bzhugs pa dag ci smos/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa yi tshogs mchod brgya lhag 'grub song / /bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi pū dza'i dam tshig kyang de mtshungs/ /yi dam dgongs 'dus kyi tan gan de tsam la longs spyod/ /gter gsar thugs sgrub ni lang ling zhar byung du brdal la/ /dgongs 'dus lhag ma gnyis ring min rten 'brel la 'jog go /rten 'byung sna khrid ni gu ru padma rang mkhyen no/ /sha thang chad chad du gsol ba gdab pa la dgongs shig /tshig lam byang byang du smon lam gsol ba 'di 'grub mdzod/ /sngon gyi las 'phro 'di shin tu btsan pa zhig 'dug go /lhag bsam mos pa 'di nam phugs 'grub nges su gda' 'o/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog 'di slu ba med nges su 'dug go /gu ru padma 'dis thugs rjes gzigs nges su snang ngo / /dad gus ma chung na gsol ba thebs nges su gda' 'o/ /a ho rmad du byung e ma ngo mtshar gyi dpal 'bar/ /bsam yas mchims phu dang yid kyi me tog ni mnyam bzhad/ /padma'i ze'u 'bru la dgongs 'dus sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'thung ba'i/ /thabs shes 'phur lding can bung ba'i rgyal po ru gyur nas/ /phyogs med yo lang gi brtul zhugs bdud rtsir ni gyur te/ /bstan 'gro yi srog rtsa bde ba'i rdo rje ru bsgrubs pas/ /gu ru'i rjes 'jug rnams bsam don kun 'grub tu 31ga cig /bod yul sgrub gnas thams cad kyi rgyal po bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du spro zhing dad pa'i nyams zil gyis mi non pa'i thol byung mgrin pa'i pi waṃ padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis brdungs pa'o// //

144 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rig 'dzin dgyes skyed kyi dga' glu thol byung /7/ gnas mchog khyad 'phags yar lung gi shel brag /he ru ka yi 'du khang ni gnyis pa/ /dpa' bo ḍā ki sprin phung ltar 'du zhing / /gnas kyis gang zag byin rlob de dga' yo/ /sbyin bdag khyad 'phags karma pa chen po/ /gnas sa'i dbang phyug dga' ldan gyi pho brang / /thugs bskyed dag pa'i mthun rkyen gyi drin las/ /bsam dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa 'di dga' yo/ /bsgrub bya khyad 'phags rtsa brgyad la stong sbyar/ / bsre bslad med pa'i gter byon gyi dam rdzas/ /sne grangs byas na brgya rtsa las brgal ba/ /'bad med lag tu 'tshogs pa 'di dga' yo/ /sgrub thabs khyad 'phags rdor sems ni sgyu drwa/ /o rgyan rje dang bdag cag gi bar du/ /grub thob gcig chog ḍā ki yi zhal rlangs/ /tho ler 'thul ba'i gsang 'dzin 'di dga' yo/ /yo byad khyad 'phags bram ze ni nyi snying / /bande bzang mo o rgyan gyi phyag thod/ /sku gsung thugs rten sgrol phur gyi bar du/ /gter byon sha stag 'tshogs pa 'di dga' yo/ /rten mchog khyad 'phags shel phug gi sku tshab/ /gu ru'i sku chos thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ/ /zhabs 'chag la sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi 'bar/ /rtag tu bzhugs sar 'dzoms pa 'di dga' yo/ /dus tshod khyad 'phags rgyud lung nas bsngags pa'i/ /rtsi bcud thog mar rgyas pa yi sos ka/ /mkhas grub skyes mchog du ma yi dus chen/ /ma bsgrigs lhun gyis grub pa 'di dga' yo/ /sgrub po khyad 'phags zol med kyi lung zin/ /gu ru'i byin rlabs 'jug pa yi snod rung / /bka' gter gdams ngag rgya mtsho yi skal ldan/ /'gyur med rig 'dzin

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 145rtsal 'chang 'di dga' yo/ /'dus pa khyad 'phags sar gnas kyi skyes bu/ /bsam bzhin srid pa'i snang brnyan can rnams dang / /dam tshig rtsa brtan las mthun gyi spun grogs/ /ji ltar bsgos bzhin mdzad pa 'di dga' yo/ /phyag bzhes khyad 'phags bka' gter gyi 'byung khungs/ /o rgyan smin grol gling pa yi ring lugs/ /zab mo'i man ngag legs dgu yis brgyan pa'i/ /gser sdong g.yu khras btab pa 'di dga' yo/ /'gro don khyad 'phags gangs can gyi mgon po/ /yas phyin zung gi phrin las kyis gar khyab/ /sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman gyis khyab pa'i/ /rgya che rgyun mi chad pa de dga' yo/ /bya ba khyad 'phags gangs can gyi bde thabs/ /zab gter gsar byon 'gro don gyi sna khrid / /dus gsum mkhyen pas rjes su ni bstan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i lung don 'grub pa 'di dga' yo/ /rten 'brel khyad 'phags gnas dus dang gang zag /zab chos dam rdzas yo byad dang sbyin bdag /ched du btsal yang rnyed pa rang dka' ba/ /ma bsgrigs lhun grub rang bab 'di dga' yo/ /ngo mtshar byas na khyad 'phags kyi dpal brtsegs/ /grangs su btab na bcu gsum gyi rtse mo/ /byung khungs bsam na gter chen gyi bla ma'i/ /sku drin gzhal na 'khor thabs dang bral lo/ /de dag kun kyang o rgyan gyi gu rur/ /chung nas ldog med dad pa ni brtan pa'i/ /thugs rje'i 'jug pa shas tsam du shes nas/ /slar yang o rgyan padma rang dran no/ /so skye'i ngag la skyag gtad ni med kyang / /de ring skabs su thol byung du blangs pa'i/ /dga' spro'i glu 'di gnas lus su 'gyur bas/ /rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dgyes skyed du shog cig /yul la snga ba yar mo lung / gnas kyi rgyal po shel brag padma brtsegs par 'dus pa sum cu brgal bas bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub chen bgyis nas grub pa'i tshe/ padma dgyes pa'i

146 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'bangs padma gar gyi dbang phyug blo gros mthas yas pa'i sdes smras pa'o// //skal mtshungs dgyes skyed kyi mgrin glu shugs byung /7/ khyab bdag mtsho skyes rdo rje/ /dbyer med padma dbang chen/ /zhal ras dgyes pa'i nyin byed/ /snying dbus pad mtshor gsal lo/ /bod yul dbus su bgrod nas/ /yul gyi bdud rtsi bsten pas/ /bsam don sna tshogs grub bo/ /dad pas byang khog brgyangs nas/ /ngal ba khyad du bsad pa'i/ /dgos pa phran bu grub bo/ /bsam shes dbang po ldan pas/ /don chen ltad mo mthong ngo / /ltad mo mig gi bdud rtsi/ /'khrul snang gzugs brnyan ma bltas/ /rdo rje'i gnas la bltas pas/ /ma tshang med par mthong byung / /khyad par lho brag mkhar chu/ /rta gdong dkar mo sku gnas/ /mthong ba tsam du ma zad/ /rdo rje'i 'brel zab bzhag yod/ /ri bo g.yas la bzhugs pa/ /mkho mthing rnam snang rgyab brten/ /rtse mo shel gyi mchod rten/ /gangs ri 'od zer lhag lhag /rked par chos kyi khri 'phang / /mchod rdzas sna tshogs lhun grub/ /rtsa bar yig drug rang byon/ /'gro drug 'dren pa chad med/ /ri bo g.yon la bzhugs pa/ /mkha' spyod tsā ri gnyis pa/ /nye ba'i 'thung spyod chen po/ /dpal gyi de bī ko ṭa/ /rigs lnga'i rgyal ba sogs dang / /bde mchog 'khor lo yab yum/ /rin chen brag gi rnam pa/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs/ /nags la bya tshogs brgyan pa/ /rin chen dbus na bzhugs pa/ /he ru ka yi tshogs khang / /yang dag thugs kyi gnas mchog /phu na 'od gsal chos rdzong / /mda' na mnyam med seng rdzong / /bar na khyung gshog mkha' rdzong / /rdzong chen

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 147gsum gyi 'dzom na/ /bod du grags pa che ba/ /mkhar chu gnam skas can gyi/ /g.yas na dpal gyi phug ring / /g.yon na lcags phur can dang / /ko ti gsang ba'i brag phug /byin rlabs gzi byin lam lam/ /bka' srung drag rtsal khyugs khyug /dpa' bo ḍā ki thibs thibs/ /ri rtse kha ba'i rdul brtsegs/ /gangs ri 'od mdangs lam lam/ /de la g.yu yi na bun/ /de las sbrang char sil sil/ /dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs chad med/ /rked par shel gyi brag ri/ /rtsa gsum sku yi dbyibs can/ /nang na zab gter bang mdzod/ /phyi rol bka' rtags sna tshogs/ /grub gnyis 'dod rgu 'jo ba/ /kun tu sna tshogs ljon shing / /nags tshal gzhon nu lhun 'thug /rtse mor skad snyan bya tshogs/ /rtsa bar gcan gzan gtum po/ /ḍā ki chos srung rnam rol/ /bar du gting zab mtsho chen/ /dge bsnyen dgyes pa'i khang bzang / /myang grol klu bdud rdo rje'i/ /zil pa chad med 'byung ba/ /skal ldan 'od lus sgrub byed/ /bzang dgu'i yon tan tshang zhing / /legs dgu'i ya mtshan ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i pho brang chen por/ /rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang ba'i/ /rten 'brel gnad 'dra bsgrigs yod/ /khyad par mchog sgrub zab pa/ /yang dag thugs kyi thig le'i/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhir bzhugs nas/ /gzugs snang he ru ka dpal/ /grags stong ru lu'i rang sgra/ /'gyu dran 'od gsal phyag rgya/ /ting 'dzin sgo mos bcings pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po'i nye rgyu/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin gseb lam/ /mthar son skal pas dben kyang / /rten 'byung sne zin tsam zhig /rtse gcig dad pas 'bad yod/ /a ho/ ber ka 'dom 'jal gyi shugs med kyang / /khral rta rgyugs lam du ma bsad pa 'di dga' yo/ /nyo bca' rgyab khur gyi stobs med kyang / /bong rgan sdug

148 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gri ru ma btang ba 'di dga' yo/ /stong mchod khri mchod kyi rdzas med kyang / /lha khang nas rkun po ma brgyabs pa 'di dga' yo/ /dbus rdzas khams 'gel gyi zong med kyang / /lha rten stong mjal du ma byas pa 'di dga' yo/ /sa stong kun skor gyi nus med kyang / /brag phug stong skor du ma log pa 'di dga' yo/ /dad pa byas na sems kyi dkyil na gzhag /mgo thug lag thug mang po ma byas bskyur/ /gsol 'debs byas na rtag tu shubs shub gdab/ /'ar 'ur ka ku mang po de yang bskyur/ /snying rje byas na kun snyoms mibral bskyed/ /sha tsha sdug ge tshig tsam ma byas bskyur/ /las 'bras byas na rtag tu bslu med dran/ /rang mgo skor ba'i g.yo zol ma byas bskyur/ /tshul khrims byas na bag yod rgyun du bsten/ /rgyus med yul du bag med ma byas pas/ /mdo med 'dra yang mdo don chod tshul la/ /shes med mtha' yas blo de lhag pa snyam/ /de skad lho brag nags ma'i tshal gyi ldongs/ /sgrub gnas rgyal po mkhar chu lcags phur can/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga dgyes pa na/ /ru lu 'bru brgyad dgongs par mnyam bzhag tshe/ /padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas sde/ /spro ba'i blos btegs shugs 'byung mgrin lam nas/ /thon 'dis skal pa mtshungs rnams dgyes skyed shog/ //sngon dran da mthong gi skyo glu ring mo/༈ chu babs pa kha babs rnam bzhi'i rgyun/ /phug gtugs na ma dros mtsho chen skad/ /bka' brgyud pa che bzhi chung brgyad srol/ /mthar gtugs na mar pa'i rjes zhugs rkyang / /don de phyir dgyes mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 149de ring dran/ /rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig rin po che/ /rje mar pa lo tsār mtshan grags pa/ /bod gangs can tsam na khyad 'phags shig /lho gro bo lung du byon no skad/ /byin rlabs kyi gzi brjed chen po yis/ /mi tha mal snang ba bsgyur ro skad/ /bla ma de 'dra mjal na dga' ba la / /de 'dra mjal na skyid pa la/ /byon pa'i shul rjes 'di mthong bas yi re skyo/ /dgyes gsang dang sgyu thod gdan bzhi sogs/ /bla med kyi rgyud sde mthas yas pa/ /smin grol bshad pa'i rgyun chen btsugs/ /chos dbang po dang 'tshams par bstan to skad/ /chos de 'dra zhig thos na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig thos na skyid pa la/ /chos khri stong pa 'di mthong bas yi re skyo/ /khong ka chen bzhi pos dbu mdzad pa'i/ /skal ldan gyi bu slob kun nas 'dus/ /mchog thun gyi dngos grub legs thob pa'i/ /sngags pa'i lha gral ring ngo skad/ /grogs de 'dra zhig 'tshogs na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig 'tshogs na skyid pa la/ /ser nyog sdug ge 'di mthong bas yi re skyo/ /rnam shes grong 'jug rol rtsed kyis/ /sha ba bla g.ye'i mthong du rgyug /lu gu shi ba gar thabs 'khrab/ /phug ron ma bu dga' bas rtse/ /rdzu 'phrul de 'dra zhig mthong na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig mthong na skyid pa la/ /mdzad pa'i rnam thar 'di thos pa yi re skyo/ /dpal bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rnams/ /lo zla ba sbrel nas smin khrid mdzad/ /khrid tshar nas grub thob 'byung ngo skad/ /dge sbyor ma skyes pa ni mi 'byung skad/ /khrid de 'dra thob na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra thob na skyid pa la/ /khrid lung rkyang du song bas yi re skyo/ /rje mi la zhes bya'i bu chen de'i/ /rgyud gnas ngan len gyi sgrib sbyong dang / /phyi rabs la dpe ru bstan pa'i phyir/ /spyo ba chen po brgyad btang skad/ /spyo chung gnyis dang bcu btang skad/ /log lta spu tsam ma skyes par/ /slar mos gus

150 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gong du 'phel lo skad/ /dad mos de 'dra zhig yod na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig yod na skyid pa la/ /rgyud mi srun par gyur pa 'dis yi re skyo/ /mkhar zhi drag dbang gsum brtsigs pa bshigs/ /rdo mthe bong tsam zhig skyel rogs med/ /shing lcags yu tsam zhig 'thu rogs med/ /sku sgal par phol mig gsum tsam brdol/ /mkhar bzo ba'i lag cha ma 'byor ba/ /rdo sta ma stephyi phyag rjes can/ /dus da lta mig gis mjal du yod/ /dka' spyad de 'dra zhig nus na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig nus na skyid pa la/ /skyid 'dod sdug mi khyog 'dis yi re skyo/ /thugs gting nas mnyes pas rjes su bzung / /chos gdams ngag bum pa gang byor gnang / /mtshan mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan gsol/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs so skad/ /tshe gcig la sangs rgyas grub po skad/ /thugs rjes de 'dra zhig gzigs na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig gzigs na skyid pa la/ /rgyab 'gal bla ma la byed pa 'dis yi re skyo/ /rngog chos rdor zhes bya'i mkha' spyod par/ /spang dag gi 'bul chen lan gsum phul/ /lan gsum phul ba'i phyi ma la/ /ra ma rkang chag ma yang len du phyin/ /len du phyin nas sku rgyab bsnams/ /rje mnga' bdag gting nas mnyes so skad/ /sku ma spangs mkha' spyod chen por phebs/ /rngog bdun brgyud nyid dang mnyam mo skad/ /mnyes pa de 'dra zhig 'grub na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig 'grub na skyid pa la/ /chos phyogs su ser snas bcings pa 'dis yi re skyo/ /rje lo tsā chen po'i bka' brgyud kyis/ /rgya bod kyi sa steng ma lus khengs/ /rgyal khams kyi mi phyed rnal 'byor gyur/ /rnal 'byor gyi phyed kas grub pa brnyes/ /chos bshad sgrub kyis sa steng khyab bo skad/ /bstan pa de 'dra zhig dar na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig dar na skyid pa la/ /gnas dgon stong shul rnams mthong bas yi re skyo/ /dpal mar

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 151pa'i bka' brgyud skad pa de/ /tshe 'di la phyi mig ma bltas par/ /chos brgyad po rmi lam du yang spang / /tshe 'di ltos thams cad lings kyis bor/ /dka' spyad brtson 'grus thang lhod med/ /lus rtsa rlung bde drod me ltar 'bar/ /ngag rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs chu ltar brdol/ /sems rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin mkha' dang mnyam/ /skye 'chi dang 'byung bzhi rang dbang bsgyur/ /ma 'gro ba rigs drug bde la bkod/ /ya mtshan po sha stag byon no skad/ /rjes de 'dra zhig zin na dga' ba la/ /de 'dra zhig zin na skyid pa la/ /mi tshe dkor rjes su zad pa 'dis yi re skyo/ /rje mar pa'i bka' brgyud grub thob khungs/ /nam tho rangs skar ma bkrag mi bkrag /khyed rjes 'jug rnam pa'i byed pas shes/ /chos tshul bzhin byed na rgyal ba dgyes/ /rgyud dam tshig gtsang na mkha' 'gro 'du/ /don rtse gcig bsgom na rtogs pa 'char /tshogs rgya chen bsags na bsod nams 'byung / /byams snying rje ldan na 'gro don che/ /bstan skyong na chos skyong shugs kyis 'khor/ /rgyal shāka thub bstan pa nam gnas par/ /rje mar pa'i sgrub brgyud mi chad pa/ /gsung bden pa'i tshig gis lung bstan kyang / /dus snyigs ma lnga po je cher bdo/ /mi mchog dman sems rgyud phyi phyir gyong / /nang nyon mongs dug lnga phyi phyir rgyas/ /phyi ser gos gyon pa brgya stong nang / /sems rang rgyud 'dul mkhan gcig tsam dkon/ /phar bltas na sha za'i tshang brdol 'dra/ /tshur bltas na mun pa 'khrigs pa 'dra/ /gnyis bar nas don brgyud stong gis dogs/ /sems ma dga' bla ma rje la bos/ /blo ma bde gsol ba lha la btab/ /rje mnga' bdag lo tsā sprul pa'i sku/ /dus deng sang tā yi si tur grags/ /dpal padma nyin byed thugs rje can/ /bdag dred po chos rdugs la gzigs sam kye/ /rgyud chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje mar mi'i

152 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bstan pas 'dzam gling gi /khyon mtha' dag nyi ma'i gdugs ltar khebs/ /de gzugs brnyan tsam du ma song bar/ /lung rtogs pa'i gzi 'od rgyas par shog /bka' brgyud kyi rtags tsam 'chang ba'i tha shal pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bod yul lho rgyud kyi gnas chen po rnams la tshogs gnyis kyi 'brel 'jog bgyid pa na/ lho gro bo lung gi gdan sa dang / sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang mjal/ sngon gyi rnam thar rgya mtsho'ang dran/ da lta'i gnas tshul mtha' dag mthong bas skyo glu ring mo thol byung du smras pa'o// //rje btsun la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i gdung dbyangs/7/ bod kha ba can gyi nags tshal du/ /dpe 'gran medaldini dum wa ra 'khrungs/ /de srid pa gsum gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /chos sgrub po yongs kyi dper 'os pa mtshan brjod na mi la ras pa zhes/ /mtshan tsam yang 'jig rten gsum na dkon/ /ras rkyang pa zla ba'i 'od mdangs can/ /nang mchog gi gtum mo 'bar ba'i rtags/ /yid rtse gcig ngang nas ras chen dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug gos kyi zhen pa grol/ /mchog tsaṇḍi 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sdig mi zas spangs nas zwa tshod gsol/ /ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i dam rdzas brten/ /nang ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho ba'i rtags/ /yid rtse gcig ngang nas mi la dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug zas kyi 'khri ba chod/ /zas ting 'dzin za nus byin gyis rlobs/ /ri gangs dkar ltongs na seng ltar 'gying / /tshe 'di snang thams cad lings kyis bor/ /dgra nyon mongs 'khrul rtog zil gyis mnan/ /'khor ba dang rgyab gyes mdzad pa'i rtags/ /yid rtse gcig dad pas rje btsun dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug 'jig rten bya ba thongs/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 153gnas ri khrod 'grim nus byin gyis rlobs/ /brag spo thon dkyil na rgod po ltar/ /chos nyid kyi gnam 'phang mthon po gcod/ /chos can gyi g.yang sar nyam nga med/ /'khor 'das kun chos skur shar ba'i rtags/ /blo rtse gcig thos pa dga' ba dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug rtogs pa mkha' dang mnyam/ /gnas brag phug bzung nus byin gyis rlobs/ /grong 'du 'dzi'i gseb tu dngul chu ltar/ /rdul tsam gyi snang chas ma 'dres par/ /don g.yo med ngang nas 'gro ba 'dren/ /chos brgyad la thog brdzis mdzad pa'i rtag/sa/ /blo rtse gcig rje btsun mi la dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug chos brgyad sgrog las grol/ /chos dgos dus sleb par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa thams cad phra rab dhū tir thim/ /sprul sgyur gyi cho 'phrul du ma ston/ /skye 'chi dang 'byung bzhi rang dbang sgyur/ /sku rdo rjer rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rtags/ /yid rtse gcig rdo rje rgyal mtshan dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug dngos 'dzin bag chags bcom/ /lus sprul skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung thams cad ye shes rlung du dag /gsung do ha'i chos dbyangs mtsho ltar brdol/ /bka' ci bstsal bden tshig bslu med 'grub/ /gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /yid rtse gcig bzhad pa rdo rje dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug sgrar 'dzin bag chags bcom/ /ngag longs skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thig le kun 'od gsal chen por zhugs/ /rdul med pa'i spyan dang mngon shes mnga'/ /tshad med pa'i ting 'dzin rtsal chen rdzogs/ /thugs rdo rjer mngon byang chub pa'i rtags/ /yid rtse gcig grub thob rgyal po dran/ /bdag rjes 'jug 'khrul rtog bag chags bcom/ /yid chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje gcig la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba/ /bod kha ba can gyi rna ba'i rgyan/ /dpal bzhad pa rdo rje rin po che/ /rje mi la ras pa

154 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/mkha' spyod dbang / /bdag rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /bu dred po'i blo sna chos la sgyur/ /nyams bzang po dbyar gyi chu ltar brdol/ /don rtogs pa'i ye shes mkha' dang mnyam/ /tshe gcig la sku gsum rgyal sa zin/ /ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don byed par/ /rje khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde sngon gyi rnam dkar gyi 'bras bus gangs ri'i khrod kyi sgrub gnas byin rlabs can gtso che ba phal mo cher phyin cing tshogs gnyis kyi 'brel 'jog ji ltar 'dod pa grub pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun mi la'i sgrub gnas thams cad kyi thog ma stag nya lung bstan phug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing tshogs kyi 'du ba la spyod pa'i rjes thog tu gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'o// //phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar rjes dran gyi gsol 'debs/7/ rje ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'gro mgon rin po che la 'dud/ /sku zla zhal mdo khams phyogs su gsal/ /bod yongs grags kyi mkhas grub ma lus bsten/ /dpal dwags po lha rje'i thugs sras su gyur/ /sbyangs rtogs kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /cho 'phrul gyis 'dzam gling mtha' dbus bkang / /gangs can na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston/ /bka' brgyud pa gser ri'i phreng ba la/ /dbus lhun po bzhin du brjed pa de/ /dpal phag mo gru pa ma lags sam/ /gnas kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod na/ /phyi snang tshad stug po bkod pa'i rgyan/ /nang skyes tshad sar gnas rgyal ba'i sras/ /sgra grags tshad theg chen chos kyi dbyangs/ /yid chos

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 155nyid gnyug mar byin brlabs pa/ /grub thob kyi rgyal po snying nas dran/ /rkyen lan cig ma yin lhan skyes su/ /zhal ras de snying gi thig le ndan /gsal lhag ge sngar 'dris bzhin du gda'/ /skabs de 'dra tsa na thugs yid bsres/ /tha mal gyi shes pa phag tu sad/ /blo bral gyi chos sku lkog langs brgyab/ /'di yin dang 'di min ma rnyed par/ /bzang ngan kun 'byams yug ngang du lus/ /lar go ba 'dra ba'i rtogs pa shar/ /rje byin rlabs can gyi thugs rjer shes/ /thub chen 'dzam gling grags pa la/ /rgyal bas lung bstan dag pa'i 'khor/ /lnga brgya'i nang nas 'gro don gyi/ /bka' babs 'gro mgon rin po che/ /thim phug tu ḍā ki'i lung bstan thob/ /mtha' rtsa ru mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /slar gdan sa yi mthil du dgongs gtad pa/ /rang byung la brag gi ba gam steng / /byang chub kyi rtswa yi spyil bu'i nang / /sku g.yo med bzhugs stangs drang po'i ngang / /thugs mi g.yo mngon par byang chub nas/ /gsung chos kyi 'bor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /zhi ba'i bdud rtsi gsol nas kyang / /mchog gi go 'phang la myur gshegs pa/ /grub thob kyi 'byung gnas gling rje ras/ /ngo mtshar la rmad byung khro phu pa/ /rten 'brel gyi bka' bab 'bri gung pa/ /mos gus la mthar phyin stag lung pa/ /skal ldan gyi rgyal po za ra ba/ /rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag gyer sgom che/ /rtsod med kyi grub thob smar ba rje/ /sangs rgyas kyi gar mkhan yel ba'i zhabs/ /zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi chu mgo byung / /sa steng du grub thob kyi tshang chen brdol/ /brtul zhugs kyi rgyal po nyag ras dang / /phyag rgya'i bka' bab zhig chen rje/ /chos nyid mngon gyur chos sku ba/ /ming can la gdugs thogs lnga brgyar grags/ /ming med kyi skyes bu bsam yas byon/ /'khor ba dong nas lan gcig sprugs/ /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i gdan sa na/ /dpal

156 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i chos 'byung khang / /shar mgon po 'bri gung pa yis brtsigs/ /lho 'gran med g.ya' bzang pa yis brtsigs/ /nub khro phu rgyal tshab khu dbon brtsigs/ /byang nye gnas stag lung thang pas brtsigs/ /dbus 'jag spyil du ka chen 'dom bcu bslangs/ /ngo mtshar gyi phyag rjes rdo la bzhag /brag sra mkhregs gzhal yas khang du bcos/ /rgyal tshab tu nyid las mi zhan pa/ /khong spyan snga bka' brgyu da bco lnga phebs/ /chos bshad sgrub gnyis kyis sa steng khyab/ /khri gdugs kyi 'og na phyag rjes che/ /sku stong phrag mang po'i gzhal med khang / /bkra shis pa'i sgo mang mchod rten brgyad/ /lha mi yi rin chen las grub pa/ /dpal mthong grol rgyal ba mched brgyad sogs/ /bod gangs can tsam na 'gran med pa/ /phrin las kyi 'bor lo'i shul mo che/ /dus da lta yang mig gi bdud rtsir bzhugs/ /a la la bka' brgyud kyi phyag rjes la/ /a la la sgrub brgyud kyi ngo mtshar la rje dran no de phag mo gru pa dran/ /rje dran no de bde gshegs khams pa dran/ /rje khyed 'dra'i rnam thar dran pa'i tshe/ /yid mi bzod mos gus gting nas g.yo/ /spong klog gi 'du 'dzis g.yeng ba gzhan/ /rje khyed 'dra'i thad nas gzugs brnyan tsam/ /dus snyigs ma'i bsod nams ma chun pas/ /khyed bstan dngos phal cher yol zin kyang / /chos brgyud pa 'dzin pa thor tsam dang / /phrin las kyi lhag ma cung zad 'dis/ /sa bon du byas nas bka' brgyud dang / /phrin las kyis 'dzam gling kun tu khyab/ /de mi nub byams mgon phebs kyi bar/ /khyed bstan gyi nyin byed brdal ba zhig /rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin/ /gzhan don la nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /tshe 'di yis mchog dngos 'grub pa zhig /rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin gyis rlobs/ /smras tshad chos su 'gro

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 157ba dang / /byas tshad dge bar 'gyur ba dang / /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa zhig /rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin gyis rlobs/ /rang byung gi chos sku kha yan po/ /bzang 'dzin gyi gnyer kha las grol nas/ /ci snang kun gnyug mar thim pa zhig /rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin gyis rlobs/ /spyir sems can sgos su bod yul gyi/ /dus ngan gyi rgud pa kun zhi zhing / /bde skyid la rtag tu longs spyod par/ /rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin gyis rlobs/ /'di'ang skal pa bzang pos khyad par du byas pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i ming can bod yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du phyin pa'i tshe/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du slebs/ 'jag spyil gyi sku 'dra rin po che mjal / phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs bsags kyang ji ltar 'dod pa grub/ dge sbyor kyang legs par bskyang du byung /ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa'ang mthong bas dad pa dang spro ba'i shugs chen pos thol byung du brjod pa'o// // snang ba brda'i bla mar rtogs pa'i rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs/pho/ skyabs rgyal ba kun dngos gtsug gi rgyan/ /dpal padma nyin byed rtse gcig dran/ /dus gnas skabs kun tu thugs rjes gzigs/ /rgyud rtogs grol dus mnyam chen po ru/ /rje khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /mtho dgung sngon 'di la yar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnams kyi lta ba dran/ /dpe kun khyab rtsa bral phyogs lhung med/ /don spros pa dang bral ba 'di ngo mtshar che/ /dma' rgya mtsho 'di la mar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnams kyi sgom pa dran/ /dpe rnyogs med gting bral g.yo ba med/ /don rtog pa'i rba rlabs rang grol 'di ngo mtshar che bar ri bo
