158 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'di la phar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnams kyi sgrub tshugs dran/ /dpe cis kyang mi g.yo rang so zin/ /don na thub 'chi thub 'di ngo mtshar che/ /rtse gangs ri 'di la yar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnam kyi rnam thar dran/ /dpe dkar ba la dus kyi khyad par med/ /don sdom gsum yar ldan 'di ngo mtshar che/ /'og nags tshal 'di la mar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnams kyi yon tan dran/ /dpe lhun 'thug ro ldan 'bras bu smin/ /don gsung rab dang mthun pa 'di ngo mtshar che/ /bar rlung po 'di la phar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnams kyi spyod pa dran/ /dpe chags thogs med par kun la 'gro/ /don spang blang dang bral ba 'di ngo mtshar che/ /mda' chu rgyun 'di la mar bltas pas/ /rje bka' brgyud rnams kyi phrin las dran/ /dpe rgyun mi 'chad par kun la phan/ /don ris su ma chad pa 'di ngo mtshar che/ /mthar rnal 'byor rang la tshur bltas pas/ /phyi snyigs ma'i btsun gzugs gya ma do/ /nang gtad so med pa'i zob stong po/ /bar nyon mongs kha rgyas 'khrul pa'i gsob/ /rkyen gnad thog mi khyog gze re che/ /gzhan zur khyad gsod pa'i lte bde po/ /rang pher sha sgrog 'dod ngo mthu po/ /don gdeng tshad mi ldan tha mal pa/ /yid gting nas chad do bla ma rje/ /zhen pa gting nas log go thugs rje can/ /tshe 'di 'dra'i ngang la mi yol bar/ /gnas brag phug nang nas mgur glu 'then/ /tshe sgrub pa mnyam zhing grub pa thob/ /bdud bzhi yi dgra la thog brdzis btang / /chos brgyad kyi 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las grol/ /ma 'gro ba mthong thos dran reg grol/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub gnyis thob nas/ /phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba zhig /spyir bka' brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /sgos padma'i rgyal tshab thugs rjes zungs/ /blo lings kyis bkal lo khyed rang mkhyen/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 159bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par shog /sku lha mkha' ri'i ngogs/ sgrub mtsho padma gling gi 'gram/ dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po dang / bka' brgyud grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen por karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos thol byung du smras pa dge/ //7/ gnyug ma'i de nyid gsal bar ston pa thol byung do ha'i glu phreng rdo rje pha lam gyi phreng ba'am/'chi med grub pa'i rgyal ba bka' drin can rnam gnyis la thugs rje bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs dpyid kyi dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba/a ho/ dgung sngon yangs pa'i klong na gsal byed kyi nyi zla/ /gdos bcas dbang po'i dwangs ma mthong byed kyi mig zung / /mtshungs med thub pa'i bstan la zhal tshab ni rnam gnyis/ /deng 'dir dad ldan mos pa'i bu la yang dgongs dang / /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos padma yi saṃ bha/ /'pho chen 'ja' skur bzhugs pa dri med kyi bshes gnyen/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ston pa zung dran no/ /snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba re 'debs so/ /dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen o rgyan gyi slob dpon/ /paṇa chen lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan bi ma la mi tra/ /bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i paṇa chen zung dran no/ /gsol ba snying nas 'debs so mkhyen brtse yis gzigs shig /skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba mtsho skyes kyi rdo rje/ /gdos bcas 'od du dengs pa phyag rgya yi rgya chen/ /'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i grub chen zung dran no/ /bcos min gdung shugs drag pos thugs rje re bskul lo/ /kha sbyor gnyug

160 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ma'i lha sku bde ba ni chen po/ /snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol ba kha che yi slob dpon/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur bzhugs bla ma zung dran no/ /dad mos snying nas shor ro byin rlabs 'dra gnang shog /gdug pa'i lha srin kun 'joms rdo rje yi thod phreng / /'od gsal rgyal brgyud spel mdzad bi ma la mi tra/ /bka' drin 'gran zla bral ba'i skyabs mgon zung dran no/ /bsam rgyu khyed las med do thugs rje yis gzigs shig /gangs can skye dgu'i skyabs gcig o rgyan gyi gu sa /skal ldan 'gro ba'i mig gcig kha che yi paṇa chen/ /rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa'i slob dpon zung dran no/ /re sa khyed las med do skyabs 'og tu tshud cig /'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i rgyal ba yi rjes 'jug /tshe thung nad gdon mang ba'i bar chad kyis gtser na/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun lhug lhug tu 'jo bas/ /tshe dbang mtha' ru phyin pa'i dngos grub re stsol cig /mkhas pa'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur paṇa chen gyi rjes 'jug /spang dang blang bya mi shes mun nag tu 'khyams na/ /shes bya mtha' dag rtogs pa'i blo gros kyi snang bas/ /rnam dpyod sbobs pa'i gter kha 'dzad med du phyes shig /gsang chen lam mthar son pa'i grub chen gyi rjes 'jug /ma grub grub par brdzu bas rang sma 'dra 'bebs na/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung lang ling du g.yo bas/ /brtul zhugs dbyar gyi rnga sgra sgrog nus su mdzod cig /bdud 'dul rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dpa' bo yi rjes 'jug /bdud bzhi'i skung 'phrang dam pos thar med du bkag na/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i gnam lcags thal byung du 'bebs pas/ /lhan skyes srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor thal ba ru rlogs shig /gdod ma'i rgyal thabs brnyes pa'i chos sku yi rjes 'jug /'gyur med rig pa'i khye'u chung bag chags la 'thas na/ /srid zhi ro mnyam chen po'i stong mdangs 'dra phyes la/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 161blo 'das ka dag gnyug ma'i rang zhal dang sprod cig /'ja' lus 'od skur bzhugs pa'i 'pho chen gyi rjes 'jug /gdos bcas phung po'i gdos su khor yug tu thogs na/ /'da' ka 'od kyi gong bu lhun grub tu spor te/ /dus bzhi'i mnyam nyid grub mtha' zad sa ru skyol cig /ma bcos cog bzhag chog pa kun bzang gi dgongs pa/ /rtogs grol zang thal rig pa bzang mo yi snying khrag /ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i rang rig gis ma tshims/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du 'tshol ba'i rtsol sgrub des 'brul lo/ /bcos ma'i 'ching grol a 'thas yid byed kyi lam nas/ /dgag sgrub spros pa bral ba'i gshis lugs ni ma mjal/ /rang grol chu yi gnyer ma grangs 'debs la zhen pas/ /chos sku lhun la 'byams pa'i go skabs ni mi 'dug /bu chung yul la bltas pas rang ngo ni ma mthong / /rma bya mdongs la yengs pas rang rtsal du ma rtogs/ /sgeg mo byad la chags pas rang snang nyid ma shes/ /rtog pa phyir gsal mched pas 'khrul snang du 'byams so/ /da ni skyabs gcig sangs rgyas rnam gnyis kyi thugs rjes/ /bdag la dbang bzhi'i ye shes tshang sprugs su skyed cing / /don brgyud rdo rje'i byin rlabs rtsal sprugs su gnang nas/ /gzhi thog rig pa skad cig rang grol du mdzod cig /ma skyes rig pa zang thal rang lugs su bzhag pas/ /'gyu stong chu yi ri mo rang yal du song nas/ /dgag sgrub mtshan ma'i gos bral gcer bu ru lding ba'i/ /g.yo med gnyug ma'i rtogs pa rang gsal du mdzod cig /yid dpyod grub mtha' las 'das gnyug ma yi gsang lam/ /sgron drug snang bzhi'i lam nas chos zad du 'khyol te/ /bde chen snying rje'i rang mdangs 'pho chen gyi 'ja' skus/ /'khor ba ji srid 'gro ba'i ded dpon du shog cig /dngos med rtog pa'i 'phro 'du gzhi thog tu yal zhing / /las snang

162 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/zhabrul pa'i bag chags 'ja' 'od du zad de/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka mtha' grol du thim nas/ /gting gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal sa ru skyol cig /grangs med rtsa yi drwa ba 'od sbubs su yal te/ /'pho bcas rlung gi rgyu ba ye shes su grol zhing / /sna tshogs thig le'i 'phro 'du dwangs sku ru smin nas/ /phung khams 'ja' lus chos skur dengs pa ru mdzod cig /sangs rgyas rnam gnyis byang chub go 'phang ni brnyes kyang / /rjes 'jug bdag cag 'khor bar gtan 'khyams su gyur pas/ /phyin bcu'i mtha' ru phyin pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bus/ /srid mtsho las bsgral byang chub nor gling dang sprod cig /mgon po rnam gnyis gdod ma'i grol gzhi la bzhugs kyang / /rjes 'jug bdag cag 'khrul rtog bar lag tu chud pas/ /grol ba bzhi ldan bya bral rtsol med kyi bden pas/ /skad cig gcig la rtogs grol dus mnyam du mdzod cig /gu dra rnam gnyis byin rlabs gzi brjed dang ldan yang / /rjes 'jug bdag cag nyam chung srin bu las dman pas/ /thugs rje'i stobs dang gsol 'debs mos gus kyi mthu las/ /mchog thun dngos grub pha phog lhug pa ru stsol cig /slob dpon rnam gnyis chags med spyan snga dang ldan yang / /rjes 'jug bdag cag ma mthong rdzun gsob tu zhugs pas/ /'gro 'dul thabs mkhas sgo mo ci 'dod du dbye na/ /mngon par shes pas gzhan rgyud 'dul nus su mdzod cig /grub chen rnam gnyis brtul zhugs phyogs med du grub kyang / /rjes 'jug bdag cag rang snang dgra ru ni ldangs pas/ /snang sems dbang du mdzad pa'i bsngags pa 'di bden na/ /thogs med rdzu 'phrul rkang pas bgrod nus su mdzod cig /rig 'dzin rnam gnyis 'chi med tshe dbang ni brnyes kyang / /rjes 'jug bdag cag skye 'chi lug rgyud du bstar bas/ /mos ldan re ba

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 163skong ba'i thugs dam la gnas na/ /rtag brtan tshe mchog grub pa'i bcud len ni stsol cig /lhun grub sbubs su brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du/ /'gran gyi do med rdo rje'i slob dpon ni rnam gnyis/ /spyi bo'i rgyan dang snying gi thig le ru bzhugs nas/ /'bral med thugs rje'i byin rlabs khor yug tu phob cig /skye dang tshe rabs phreng bar thugs rje yis bzung nas/ /bar chad bdud kyi g.yul ngo rtag pa ru zlog cig /don gnyi sa lhun grub 'dod pa 'bad med du 'jo bas/ /bsam don yongs grub bkra shis dpal 'bar du 3(ga cig /ces 'chi med grub pa'i rgyal ba bka' drin can rnam pa gnyis kyi thugs rje bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs dpyid kyi dbyangs snyan 'di'ang a ti yo ga la mos pa lam du byed pa'i padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis dben pa'i ri ngogs su smras pa dge/ //7/ grub thob rgya mtsho'i chu 'go bka' brgyud kyi ston pa bka' drin can rnams kyi thugs rje mngon par bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba/dgyes mdzad he ru ka dpal/ /mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ /gangs can grub pa'i gtsug rgyan/ /dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje/ /nges don bstan pa'i bdag po/ /chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nu/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i phrin las/ /dpal ldan karma bka' brgyud/ /kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang chen/ /padma nyin byed dbang po/ /snying nas gsol 'debs bu la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs dang / /nga yi gtan gyi re sa/ /grub chen mar mi dwags gsum/ /'gro 'dul thabs la mkhas pa/ /tshad med

164 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/thugs rje'i bdag nyid/ /'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pa/ /rdo rje'i ye shes 'bar bas/ /byin rlabs 'pho ba bstsal ba/ /nyams rtogs rgyun chad med pas/ /rgyal kun phrin las mdzad pa/ /rtogs ldan kun gyi rgyal po/ /bstan 'dzin kun gyi khyu mchog /grub thob kun gyi gtsug rgyan/ /shing rta kun gyi 'dren pa/ /chos mdzad kun gyi gtso bo/ /bya btang kun gyi yang rtse/ /skyes chen kun gyi rtsod med/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig /dad ldan mos pa'i bu la/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs dang / /tshogs drug yul sems 'phrad tshe/ /'khrul pa rgya 'byams song dus/ /chags sdang sbrul mdud zhig pa/ /mar pa lo tsā dran no/ /snying khong gting nas dran no/ /'khrul snang 'jig rten g.yeng bas/ /col chung rang sems bslus tshe/ /chos brgyad rtswa ltar dor ba/ /rje btsun mi la dran no/ /snying khong gting nas dran no/ /bzang 'dod rtog pa'i bun long / /gnyug ma'i rang zhal bsgribs tshe/ /snang srid chos skur shar ba/ /dwags po lha rje dran no/ /snying khong gting nas dran no/ /rkyen ngan thog brdzis ma nus/ /rang snang dgra ru langs dus/ /brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa/ /karma pakṣi dran no/ /snying khong gting nas dran no/ /gang shar bzo med ma 'khyongs/ /zhe 'dod lam du 'khyogs tshe/ /zhen med rnal 'byor dbang phyug /tā yi si tu dran no/ /snying khong gting nas dran no/ /sa steng 'gran zla bral ba/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag /gangs ri'i khrod kyi rgyal ba/ /bka' brgyud yongs kyi chu 'go /snyigs ma'i gdul bya 'dul la/ /ye shes 'dod dgu sgyur ba/ /bka' bab byin rlabs chu rgyun/ /gcig tu 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ /rje btsun mar mi dwags gsum/ /rjes 'jug blun dad can tsho/ /lam sna thar pa drongs dang / /chos sku gdod nas brnyes kyang / /g.ya' gangs

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 165dben pa'i khrod du/ /lus srog ltos med bor te/ /khams gsum srid pa'i bde la/ /rmi lam du yang ma chags/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pas/ /ye shes snying la shar nas/ /'brul pa'i rdzun phug rdib ste/ /dngos grub lag rtser son pa/ /grol ba phyi dus mi re/ /bde chen dang po'i rgyal ba/ /tshe lus gcig la brnyes pa/ /sangs rgyas mar mi dwags gsum/ /bu slob sdug zhen can tsho/ /blo sna chos la sgyur dang / /sngon dus ri sul 'di kun/ /bka' brgyud grub pa'i dbang phyug //pha rjes bus bsnyegs mang pos/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrubs kyang / /deng sang snyigs ma'i yang mthar/ /bka' brgyud rnam thar 'dzin pa/ /ri bong rwa ltar dkon la/ /bstan pa zad pa'i gzhug gu /dbugs rnga ma chad tsam la/ /spyod kyang rnyed bkur chos brgyad/ /zang zing lang long mang pos/ /rang mgo rang gis bskor nas/ /nyin mtshan chags sdang 'khor lo/ /lto gos gtam gyi khol po/ /rnam g.yeng rlung khyer smyon pa/ /rang rgyud shing ltar rengs shing / /tshe 'di blo yis ma thongs/ /dben ri mig gis ma mthong / /zhen 'o1ga yid la ma 'gyus/ /mos gus yud tsam ma shar/ /dag snang til tsam ma 'byongs/ /rgyu 'bras rdul tsam ma go /myong ba sne gcig ma skyes/ /gnyug mar 'phrigs tsam ma tshud/ /snying nas chos ma nus pa'i/ /dkor nag hab thob mkhan po/ /khyed kyi rjes 'jug bdag dang / /bdag 'dra tsho la gzigs dang / /ye shes mkha' khyab brnyes pa/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad pa/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba/ /thogs med mngon shes ldan pa/ /byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa/ /dkon mchog mar mi dwags gsum/ /grub chen karma pakṣi/ /drin chen padma nyin byed/ /gsol ba snying nas 'debs so/ /mgo bregs gos dmar gyon la/ /bka' brgyud grangs su rlom pa'i/ /chos min chos ltar bcos

166 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pa/ /bdag 'dra thugs rjes zungs dang / /tshad med snying rje chen pos/ /'khor ba'i g.yang las skyobs dang / /dpag med thugs rje'i 'od kyis/ /sdig lhung mun pa sol dang / /le lo btang snyoms med par/ /byin rlabs snying la phob dang / /'du 'dzi'i g.yeng bas mi 'ching / /skyid 'dod 'gong po ma zhugs/ /gal chung chos la ma shor/ /snying rul zhe bcad drag pos/ /mos gus tshad du longs te/ /nyams rtogs rtsol med 'char nas/ /rje btsun khyed kyi go 'phang / ciX/myur du 'grub par lhasag cig /sku gsum gshis la tshang ba'i/ /tha mal shes pa bzang thal/ /ya ki rdo rje 'chang nas/ /ma ki srin bu yan gyi/ /gzhug ma lhan cig skyes pa/ /kun gyi snying la sad nas/ /spang blang bsal bzhag med par/ /rang ngo rang gis shes te/ /khyed kyi gsang ba gsum dang / /sgo gsum dbyer med gyur nas/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i/ /phrin las bdag nyid kho nas/ /myur du 'grub par rbestog cig /ces pa'ang 'og min sa spyod kame'i ri sul du ras dkar gyi khyim la brten pa'i tshe yon tan rgya mtshos gang dran thol byung du gsol ba btab pa maṅga le// //7/ gtan skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam thar mngon par dran pa'i mos gus kyi dbyangs lhar bcas rna ba'i bcud len zhes bya ba/gnas 'og min yid dga' chos 'dzin na/ /rje padmas lung bstan rgyal ba bzhugs/ /mtshan thos pa don ldan sprul pa'i sku/ /dpalapadma nyin byed dbang po zhes/ /spyir bstan 'gro yongs kyi mgon gcig pu/ /sgos sgrubabargyud bstan pa'i

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 167nyin byed de/ /dus deng sang mdo khams ljongs su shar/ /sku mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid lham mer 'bar/ /gsung nges don chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog /thugs g.yo med ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed/ /mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sprin/ /gang 'dul sprul pa yi sgyu 'phrul shar/ /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /sems brjod med gnyug ma mkha' khyab na/ /rje bla ma rig stong chos skur bzhugs/ /rang byung gi ye shes rgyun chad med/ /mtshan brjod na dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam gyi byin rlabs bstsal/ /gzhi rdo rje'i lus sems 'od gsal sbubs/ /rje bla ma gsal stong 'o1ngas skur bzhugs/ /sku zhing khams rgya mtsho rgyun chad med/ /mtshan brjod na drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /rang snang ngo sprod kyi zab don bstsal/ /yul snang rang shar rang grol na/ /rje bla ma snang stong sprul skur bzhugs/ /thabs mkhas kyi 'dul thabs rgyun chad med/ /mtshan brjod na shāka thubadang ma pham pa/ /dpe don zung 'brel gyi gdams ngag bstsal/ /dha tis zos pa'i srid gsum dbus/ /rje bla ma a haṃ mnyam sbyor bzhugs/ /'pho rmebud kyi bde chen rgyun chad med/ /mtshan he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma/ /lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i ye shes bstsal/ /gnas rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi rir/ /rje bla ma 'pho chen 'ja' skur bzhugs/ /'gro 'dul gyi phrin las rgyun chad med/ /mtshan brjod na sangs rgyas thod pa rtsal/ / mngon sum lag gtod kyi grub pa bstsal/ /skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs dbus su/ /rje bla mas bka' brgyud kyi chu 'go btsugs/ /grub thob kyi gser phreng rgyun chad med/ /mtshan brjod na mar pa lo tsā zhes/ /snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i pha phog gnang / /khong gdul bya kor tshe'i snang ngo mā /rje bla mas sgrub bstan la phyag rjes bzhag /'chad rtsom gyi rnam dpyod rgyun chad med/ /mtshan brjod na bstan pa'i nyin

168 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas byed ces/ /rjes 'jug la shes bya'i sgo 'phar phyes/ /bdag so skye blun po'i khyu nang du/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos sprul pa'i sku/ /'brel tshad don ldan rin po che/ /zab don bstsal mdzad bka' drin can/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag de/ /skal mnyam mi yi zol du bzhugs/ /don dam du sku gsung thugs ye shes/ /rdo rje bzhi yi rnam par thar/ /mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul nyid/ /kun rdzob tu rigs mthun bstan na yang / /'dam las skyes pa'i padmo bzhin/ /srid pa'i dri mas ma gos par/ /bdag chos dred can gyi dkor zan la/ /gdams ngag rnam thar sgo nas ston/ /sdom dam tshig spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar/ /gces spras su mdzad pa mthong tsa na/ /bdag zog por rang mgo skor ba rnams/ /ngan song gi gtan yul la blo thag chod/ /mtshan snyan gyi sgrib shing la brten nas/ /log 'tsho lnga sdud pa'i 'gro don de/ /ring du dor ba mthong tsa na/ /bdag bzang brdzu can gyi 'dres khyer rnams/ /gzhan mgo bskor ba 'khrul tshabs che/ /thob go sa'i bse 'bag mi gyon par/ /chos bzhin gyi mdzad spyod mthong tsa na/ /bdag sprang po lto rgyab gnyis don tsam/ /chos 'gal ba byed nus snying re rul/ /skyes thob zab mo'i shes rab kyis/ /chos kyi gnad tig dkrol tsa na/ /bdag go ba'i 'ud gog 'thags pa rnams/ /mkhas 'dod kyi khur po rang bcings rgyu/ /'phral mi chos zhib zhib 'dra ba la/ /phugs rang grol chen po mthong tsa na/ /bdag kha don mi mtshungs pa'i grol brdzu can/ /chu skyar gyi brtul zhugs 'dis bslu bslu 'dra/ /gting dpag dka' ba rdo rje'i gsung / /tshig re res don chen mdzad tsa na/ /gzhan rgyud mi grol 'chad nyan zol/ /nee tso'i kha sbyang 'di don go chung / /g.yo zol ngo lkog med pa yis/ /bstan 'gro phan kho na mdzad lugs kyis/ /bdag lho rgyab gnyis las mi dran pa/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 169byang chub lam dang rgyang thag ring / /chos brgyad kyi 'khrul pa gtan nas zhig /tshe 'dir snang gi ngo srung mi mdzad par/ /blo chos mthun la dgyes pa de dran tsa na/ /bdag zob rgyal chos brgyad kyi grub thob rnams/ /rmi lam la 'khrul tshod de gas chog /snang grags sgyu ma'i yo lang la/ /gtad sa med pa'i rtogs pa can/ /snang ba gdong 'ded kyi zhabrul zhig la/ /blo khyad kyi mthong tshul ci yang snang / /lan re zhib tig can ltar ston/ /rtsing spyod phaṭa ral gyis sems rtsa gcun/ /lan re ci la'ang mi rtog pas/ /a 'thas can gyi 'jur mdud dkrol/ /lan re thos bsam mkhan la bsngags/ /blun sgom rnams kyi mchog 'dzin brtol/ /lan re sgom gyi bsngags pa mdzad/ /mkhas rlom rnams kyi dregs pa bsnyil/ /rtsod med dus gsum sangs rgyas khyed/ /tha mal pa ltar brdzu ba des/ /mngon shes nyi tshe 'chad pa sogs/ /bdud kyis bslus rnams zil gyis mnan/ /nges par dgos pa'i dbang gzigs na/ /dus gsum sgrib pa med pa'i spyan/ /bden gsung seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /log lta can rnams spa bkongs shing / /dad pa can rnams yid ches skyed/ /dad can dang dad med kyi kha gsag dang / /sdom ldan dang sdomu med kyi tshul 'chos dang / /chos mthun dang chos ltar bcos pa sogs/ /gzhan rgyud sa ler mkhyen pa yis/ /chos bzhin gyi rjes 'dzin ma gtogs par/ /mtho dman dang nye ring su la yang / /mi chos kyi rtsis gdab mi mnga' bas/ /khong la las sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /khong la las ma bcos lhug par mthong / /khong la las rang che nga rgyal mthong / /khong la las gti mug glen par mthong / /kha cig bsngags brjod gsol 'debs 'ur/ /kha cig log lta lkog lab byed/ /'brel tshad kun thar pa'i lam du sbyor/ /lung rtogs rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus/ /mgon shākya'i bstan pa'i snyigs

170 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ma la/ /log sgrub bzod pa'i go cha dang / /chos phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub can/ /nges pa don gyi bla ma de/ /rje padma nyin byed ma lags sam/ /brgyud pa yi chu mgo gangs la thug /rdo rje 'chang gsang sngags 'byung khungs bzang / /sprul pas sprul pa'i brgyud 'dzin phyir/ /bar chad dang dam sel gyi rnyogs ma med/ /kha nang ltas nyams rtogs kyi srol tshugs pas/ /byin rlabs kyi chu bo phyi phyir rgyas/ /rtogs pa don gyi bstan pa yis/ /thub bstan nyi ltar gsal ba la/ /dpal 'dzam gling grags pa lung du bstan/ /mgon de yi phrin las dbang sgyur mchog /khong thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa/byu/dbyings ro mnyam gang 'dul sprul pa'i gar/ /zhing kun tu tā yi si tur grags/ /dbang rab kyi skal bzang rnams kyi ngor/ /rje mnga' bdag chen po'i mdzad pa de/ /dus deng sang blun po skal med ngor/ /'bad pa med par ston par nus/ /bdag 'dra'i ro langs kyang ngo mtshar skyes/ /yi ga de dwags brgyud pa la shor/ /blo snying de bla ma rje la gtad/ /bsam blo de bstan pa'i phyogs su btang / /rnam thar de gong ma'i rjes su smon/ /sa steng gi sems can gdeng tshad can/ /bsam blo chags sdang phyogs su khrid/ /rang 'dod kha 'khyal smra ba la/ /pho rgod du rlom pa'i mgo stong de/ /mthong tsa bdag kyang 'dun ma legs/ /grags skam dang stobs 'byor gyi mig brid la/ /sangs rgyas dang byang sems su brjod na yang / /chos brgyad la nang nor byas byas nas/ /rang snying rul ba ma tshor bar kha bshad chu yi lha ba dkrug /spros bcas 'ja' tshon ri mo bri/ /ltar snang gi mngon shes grub rtags sogs/ /lha bu'i bdud kyi pha phog can/ /dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyi brgyud 'dzin la/ /ming snyan dgus 'bod pa'i zob stong de/ /mi tshogs ma bsags rnams sangs rgyas su mthong / /yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyi zang zing phul/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 171phyogs ris chags sdang gi spyan ltos log /bsod nams dang snyan grags nus mthu sogs/ /thar pa'i bar chad kyi byin rlabs thob/ /las dkar 'bras bu gnag pa de/ /mi bya'i dbang med bsags rgyab zhan/ /de steng snyigs ma'i gegs dbang btsan/ /bdag skal ldan rang zhig ma lags kyang / /de 'dra'i gral du ma 'khyogs pa/ /rje padma rdzogs sangs rgyas de'i mthu/ /yul sems kyi zang zing sna tshogs pa/ /'al 'o la sgyu ma tsam du snang / /sgyu mar 'dzin pa'ang stong par rtogs/ /rjes shes kyi lhan pa ma gdab pa'i/ /dang po'i shes pa skad cig ma/ /rtsol dran ma dgos rjen la bud/ /gshis lugs kyi rig stong la nges shes zhig skyes/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /gser bum dang rdza bum gyi nam mkha' bzhin/ /gsal rig stong gsum klong du gcig /bsre bsnan gyi dgag sgrub ma dgos par/ /dran stong las logs su med par rtogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub byas kyang chog /dmyal bar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /da dung yang byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyabs khyed las re sa gzhan med pas/ /thugs rjes zungs dang rin po che/ /byin gyis rlobs dang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar chad sol dang rdo rje 'chang / /lam sna drongs dang sprul pa'i sku/ /khyad par chos min gyi lam gegs sol/ /rtogs pa don brgyud kyi ye shes stsol/ /rtsa dag pa sku yi rdo rje nas/ /cha med kun 'gro'i zhu bde yis/ /lus sprul pa'i sku ru smin par mdzod/ /rlung dag pa gsung gi rdo rje nas/ /dus sbyor rdo rje'i bzlas par dgag /ngag kha sbyor longs spyod rdzogs par mdzod/ /thig le dag pa thugs rdo rjes/ /dpyid theg mchog tu mi 'gyur bar/ /yid chos sku'i bde ba grub par mdzod/ /ye shes rdo rje rdul spangs pa/ /rnam kun mchog ldan lhan cig skyes/ /ngo bo nyid sku'i rtsal rdzogs nas/ /mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba bsgral nus pa/ /

172 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rje rdo rje 'chang chen padma yi/ /gsang gsum gyi rnam thar myur rdzogs shog /ces pa'ang gdan sa chen po dpal spungs kyi yang khrod nas rnam thar glu ru blangs pas tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //nyams len gyi rmang rdo tshugs par smon pa/༈ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen sprul pa'i sku/ /rje padma'i mtshan can thugs rje can/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /blo chos la 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lus dal 'byor yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /dus da res lo brgya thog gcig yin/ /chud zos su btang ba a tsa ma/ /thob dka' de stong log byed re skan/ /lus sgyu lus bsgoms nas sprul skur bsgrub/ /ngag srog rtsol lam gyis longs skur bsgrub/ /yid tsaṇḍi bde stong chos skur bsgrub/ /'grub nus pa bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /dgra 'chi bdag nam mkha'i thog rgod de/ /'gog bsam yang khegs mi med pa yin/ /nam 'ong mi shes a tsa ma/ /da 'chi bdag nam 'ong mi bsgug re/ /lus mi yengs lha sku zhu bde sbyang / /ngag mi yengs rdo rje'i bzlas pa sbyang / /sems mi yengs phyag rgya chen po sbyang / /'byongs nus pa bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /las rgyu 'bras dpyid btab sa bon de/ /dkar nag ma 'dres so sor smin/ /las rgyu 'bras mi shes a tsa ma/ /dkar nag tu shan mi dbye re/ /lus rang gzhan kun gyi g.yog tu bkol/ /ngag thams cad dam pa'i chos su smra/ /sems ris med byang chub sems blo sa /sbyang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 173nus pa bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /srid gsum gyi bde 'byor ha la'i dug /'brel phyin nas srog rtsa gcad nges yin/ /zhim du tshor ba a tsa ma/ /blo ltar snang bde las mi ldog re/ /lus bas mtha'i skyibs su dka' thub dang / /ngag long gtam spang ba'i smra bcad dang / /yid 'khor ba'i breng thag chad pa sa /'bad nus pa bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag dang pha ma 'gro drug rnams/ /'khrul rgya 'byams kyi dbang du mi shor bar/ /dkar po dge ba'i las sad nas/ /long med kyi blo sna thung bar shog /dang po zhen pa log pa dang / /bar du nges par 'byung ba dang / /tha ma dad pa'i rmang rdo tshugs/ /las rgyu 'bras la yid ches skye bar shog /spyir mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud dang / /sgos sgrub brgyud kame rka tshang gi/ /bstan rnam dag sgo ru zhugs nas kyang / /bstan pa la byi dor byed par shog /rje rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa/ /skyabs bslu med tā yi si tu sogs/ /rgyal yab sras mnyes pa bsgrubs pa yis/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par 31ga/ //skyabs sems kyi nyams mgur/‘/ skyabs dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /dpal padma nyin byed zhabs la 'dud/ /mkha' mnyam pha ma sdug gu rnams/ /skyabs 'og tu tshud par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyir du mkha' mnyam sems can skyabs/ /sgos su drin chen pha ma skyabs/ /yang sgos sdang ba'i dgra bo skyabs/ /nying sgosaganod byed bgegs rigs skyabs/ /dgra gnyen med pa'i sems can skyabs/ /phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro ba skyabs/ /mtho dman med pa'i lus can skyabs/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel phyir skyabs/ /

174 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gtan bde'i go 'phang thob phyir skyabs/ /log lta'i g.yang las srung phyir skyabs/ /spyod ngan spu gri'i so las skyabs/ /'dod pa me yi 'obs las skyabs/ /chos brgyad sgrog gis 'ching las skyabs/ /chags sdang btson dong tshud las skyabs/ /ma rig mun pa'i 'phrang las skyabs/ /spyir bla med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs/ /sgos drin ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar skyabs/ /yang sgos sems nyid klong du skyabs/ /don skyabs yul bskyab bya skyabs 'gro yang / /ming tsam brda tsam rtog pa tsam/ /rang sems ma bcos gnyug ma nyid/ /rje skyabs yul kun 'dus ngo bo ste/ /gud du med pa kho thag chod/ /thun mong dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir/ /phyi mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum la skyabs/ /mchog gi dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir/ /rje gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang la skyabs/ /sangs rgyas lag bcang zhu ba'i phyir/ /nang rang sems yid bzhin nor bur skyabs/ /shes pa yul phyir 'brang ba la/ /yul 'dzin med chos sku'i nang du skyabs/ /'khrul rtog sgom du sems pa la/ /sems rang grol phyag rgya chen por skyabs/ /stong nyid yid la byed pa la/ /yid gnyug ma gza' gtad bral bar skyabs/ /phyi snang ba brda yi skyabs gnas la/ /mtshon byed tshig gis skyabs 'gro byas/ /nang rang rig sku gsum 'dus pa la/ /mtshon byed dran pas gsal 'debs byas/ /phyi ru nyams kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ /nang du rtogs pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ /phyin log bdud kyis khyer snyam med/ /khams gsum pha ma sems can kun/ /skyabs na de 'drar bskyab par shog /skyob pa de 'dras bskyab par shog /skyabs phyin ci log las 'da' bar shog /yang dag pa'i lam du tshud par shog /dkon mchog bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par shog /bka' mdo rgyud rgya che grangs mang yang / /don skyabs 'gro'i nyams len kho na yin/ /'bad na 'di 'drar 'bad

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 175par 'tshal/ /'bad pa mtha' ru dbyung ba 'tshal/ /bla ma dkon mchog skyabs 'og tu/ /ma 'gro ba rigs drug tshud nas kyang / /gtan bde ba'i ngal gso thob gyur cig /bkra shis// //7/ rje dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje can/ /padma nyin byed dbang por 'dud/ /mkha' mnyam pha ma 'gro drug rnams/ /rgyud byang chub sems mchog 'dredang ba dang / /byang chub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi stong pa nyid kyi sems bskyed 'di/ /ma rig sel ba'i nyi ma yin/ /lam mtshan ma med pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /gnyis 'dzin gcod pa'i sta re yin/ /'bras smon pa med pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /re dogs bkru ba'i chu rgyun yin/ /spang blang med pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /'ching ba brdal ba'i ral gri yin/ /phyogs ris med pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /ngo lkogabral ba'i dam tshig yin/ /dgra gnyen med pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /chos brgyad bshig pa'i rig sngags yin/ /snyems thag chod pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /gnyan thog gcod pa'i brtul zhugs yin/ /rang don spangs pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman mchog yin/ /bza' gtad bral ba'i sems bskyed 'di/ /sdig sgrib 'ded pa'i phyags shing yin/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi sems bskyed 'di/ /'brel pa thogs chog nor bu yin/ /dmigs pa med pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ /gzhan don 'byung ba'i gter sgo yin/ /lar thams cad thams cad sems bskyed yin/ /sems bskyed kyi snying po stong nyid yin/ /thams cad thams cad stong nyid yin/ /stong nyid kyi snying po snying rje yin/ /pha bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /lha rab 'byams zhi khre'i rnam 'gyur dang / /ma khams gsum sems can thams

176 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/cad kyang / /byang chub sems kyi rang rtsal yin/ /de yang bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ /de yang gnyug ma 'i rang mdangs yin/ /chos kun gyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems kyis dbang byas na/ /mi dge phal cher dge bar 'gyur/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /sprin yod kyang gsal la med kyang gsal/ /byang chub sems dang mi ldan pa'i/ /dge ba yin kyang mi dge 'gyur/ /rtsa ba rul ba'i ljon shing bzhin/ /bcad kyang 'gyel la slong yang 'gyel/ /byang chub sems dang ldan gyur na/ /las ci byas stong nyid snying rje'i ngang / /'bor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'dra/ /ci mdzad kyang phun tshogs ngang gis 'du/ /las rgyu 'bras la yid ches mi skye zhing / /byang chub kyi sems blo ma sbyang ba'i/ /stong pa nyid la blo phyogs kyang / /sgrib gsum drung 'byin mi nus te/ /thib 'og chud pa'i sems can 'dra/ /rang thog gi sa phung ma bsal na/ /phyi'i nam mkha' dran dang ma dran med/ /lar chos mdzad mang ste byang sems dkon/ /sems bskyed pa mang ste spyod pa dkon/ /spyod pa mang ste gnad thebs dkon/ /tshe thog ma med nas bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags mod kyang / /gnad byang chub sems kyis ma zin zhing / /rjes dmigs med bsngo bas ma thebs pas/ /lha tshangs dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal sogs/ /tshur mthong gi bde 'byor bag tsam las/ /gtan bde'i go 'phang ma thob bo/ /yin min mdo rgyud kun la dris/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa yang / /tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin mod kyi/ /smyug sprul lta bu'i gnas skabs 'di/ /'dun ma la blo nyes byung bas lan/ /yin min 'phags pa rnams la ltos/ /bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /dang po chos dang 'phrad par shog /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal bar shog /thugs rjes rjes su 'dzin par shog /de nas mi

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 177dngangs mi skrag par/ /thabs shes rab gnyis la rtog pa chug /stong nyid snying rje 'byong bar shog /byang sems kyi rtsa ba zug par shog /phar phyin gyi sdong po brtan par shog /bsdu bzhi yi yal 'dab rgyas par shog /bde legs kyi me tog zhabrungs par shog /sku gsum gyi 'bras bu smin par shog /dus 'di nas snying po byang chub bar/ /blo brjed ngas la sogs bar chad kyis/ /byang chub sems nyams par ma gyur cig /gzhi byang sems bde gshegs snying po la/ /lam snying rje byang chub sems 'byong nas/ /'bras byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs smin/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig /rje thugs rje'i rang gzugs padma'i mtshan/ /smon lam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces dpal spungs sgrub khang bsam gtan gling du rang lo nyer bzhi par phyag chen sngon 'gro 'bum ther bsags skabs skyabs sems la nges pa cung zad skyes pa'i khul du zhun mar ngogs su bris pa dge/ // karma bde legs bzang po'i gsung lan byung rgyal ma /7/ drin ldan karma bde legs ye shes bzang po nas/ ma gza' dam gsum gtor chog nyung bsdus bskul ma dang / lar nyams len skyong na phyi rol gtor ma'i go chod min gsung lan byung rgyal du phul ba ni/ rje padma'i mtshan gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /drin 'khor mtha' bral ba'i bla rgan lags/ /rang sems rang tsho ma zin pas/ /'khor 'das kyi snang cha shar ba las/ /spang dang blang bya gnyis su med/ /sems sna tshogs su 'char bas sna tshogs srid/ /rang tsho ma thub zhe sdang gi /rang mdangs chos skyong du gdags pa la/ /rang ngo shes pas mi mchod par/ /phyi rol du

178 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/su la gang gis mchod/ /'du 'bral med pa'i rang rig nyid/ /ngo shes dus med pa'i sgrib pa yi/ /rang sems kyi gsal cha shar ba la/ /phyi rol gyi yul du bzung bzung nas/ /lha dang 'dre zhes tha snyad byas/ /rang gis rang nyid ma rtogs par/ /min la yin par sgro btags te/ /yin la min par skur ba btab/ /mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu'i rang bzhin can/ /sangs dus med pa'i rnam rtog kho/ /chos sku zang mar ma shes nas/ /sangs rgyas phyis shig bsgrub bo lo/ /gnyis med kyi shes pa ye grol de/ /gnyis 'dzin blos bsgom du nan gyis gcun/ /rnam rtog gis rnam rtog ded ded nas/ /mtha' bral gyi gnas lugs bsgom mo skad/ /e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am/ /blta rgyu yod na blos byas dang / /bsgom rgyu yod na 'khrul pa dang / /nges shes skyes na bdag 'dzin te/ /phung krol rtsa ba de ka lags/ /ci yang ma yin pa'i gnas lugs la/ /ma mthong ba mthong ba ma lags sam/ /yengs na tha mal pa yin la/ /sgom na sgom chen ma yin no/ /ma bcos pa yi rang sems de/ /ye gdod nas spros pa kun bral phyir/ /ngo shes pa tsam gyis grol bar gda'/ /sna tshogs su shar yang ngo bos dben/ /sems stong nyid yin pa'i gnad du gda'/ /med bzhin 'gag med ci yang 'char/ /stong nyid rten 'brel yin pa'i gnad du gda'/ /skye ba med pa'i 'khrul tshul la/ /sems can zhes su brjod par gda'/ /'gag pa med pa'i grol tshul la/ /sangs rgyas zhes su brjod par gda'/ /gnyis med lam du khyer ba la/ /rnal 'byor zhes su brjod par gda'/ /a cang de tsam ku re yin/ /ku re'i gseb nas ngag 'khyal yin/ /ngag 'khyal gyi gseb nas don dam yin/ /bdag gis 'di dag shes min te/ /bla ma'i drin gyis cung zad shar/ /phyogs 'go tsam zhig go 'am snyam/ /thugs dgyes pa skyed pa'i rol mor shog/ //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 179chos tshul/ yin min gyi shan 'byed tshangs thig 'dun ma'i yang rtse/༈ chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs pa yis/ /chos brgyad kyi 'khrul pa gtan nas zhig /rje padma nyin byed byin rlabs can/ /sems chos brgyad rlabs 'di zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag 'dzin gyi/ 'dre rgod ma thul bas/ /rang 'dod de phugs su bcug nas kyang / /mkhas shing grub 'dod kyi rnam dpyod dang / /bzang gos mang po'i 'phyor chas dang / /tsher ma dar btums kyi zhi dul sogs/ /ming bstan dang 'gro don btags nas su/ /log 'tsho sdud pa'i kha thabs de/ /bdag sprang pos thon pa'i mkhos kyang med/ /ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan thogs nas su/ /bstan bshig gi gtso bo mi byed pa/ /smon lam de kha zhe med par 'debs/ /thar lam rang gis mi gcod par/ /blo chos mthun tsam zhig byung gyur na/ /sdug ltogs grir shi yang bsam don 'grub/ /khong sprul pa'i skyes chen ma gtogs pa/ /mi phal pa'i 'gro don gnyis phung rgyu/ /rang ma smin pa'i gzhan don de/ /nam gzhug zad ka'i char pa 'dra/ /'phral du mdzes kyang phugs su med/ /nang na med pa'i chos bshad de/ /ne tso'i kha yi yig drug 'dra/ /gzhan la bshad kyang rang la med/ /yon tan med pa'i 'phyor chas de/ /nyi char 'dres pa'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /mig sngar mdzes kyang snying po med/ /nyams myong med pa'i kha ta de/ /nad pas sman yig klog pa 'dra/ /thos dus tshims la dgos dus med/ /bla chen zang zing gi 'du long can/ /chos brgyad kyi sgrub chen shugs la tshugs/ /dgos nges kyi nyams rtogs 'ja' ltar yal/ /kha cig bya btang spros med tshul/ /mi tshe zob stong la rgas rgas nas/ /sgrub

180 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pa'i nyams len rlung la bskur/ /khong mkhas pa la la dgag sgrub mang / /don med du chags sdang sa bon btab/ /phyogs lhung can ngan 'gro'i g.yang la 'phangs kha cig brgal brtag gi khur po bor/ /don bzang ngan mi 'byed blun po'i khyu/ /chos rnam dbye med par rtswa ltar len/ /khong chen po la la phyogs ris che/ /rjes 'jug la chos spangs kyi pha phog gnang / /mthong thos kyi snang ba dgra ru bslangs/ /kha cig phyogs ris med do skad/ /khyi phag pa min pa skyabs su bsten/ /bar chad dang dam sel gyi dngos grub thob/ /khong la la thos bsam la mi tshe rgas/ /gzhan khyad gsod dang nga rgyal gyi 'chad rtsom mdzad/ /'brel tshad gnyis phung gi lam du bkod/ /kha cig gnas lugs sgom mo skad/ /bka' mdo rgyud rnams dang rgyab 'gal mdzad/ /bzang 'dzin la rtogs pa'i mchog tu rlom/ /mi la la bdud kyis shes pa bsgyur/ /ma grub grub brdzu'i spyod pa yis/ /mgon shākya'i bstan pa thabs kyis bsnubs/ /kha cig tshul khrims mchog 'dzin che/ /gsang sngags lta spyod dug ltar spangs/ /skal dman la log lta'i lam srol phye/ /phyi sgrob sgrob gcig che gnyis che la/ /nang nyams rtogs ni ri bong ra las dkon/ /phyi chos kyi char pa gzhan la phab/ /nang rang rgyud la chos kyi brlan tsam med/ /grags 'dod can chos brgyad kyi spyo chu 'thung / /des mi chog log 'tsho'i btsan dug 'gam/ /phyug 'dod can dbang chos kyi tshong khe byed/ /des mi chog dam sdom lhan cig 'dor/ /mkhas 'dod can rtsom pod kyi grangs ka 'dren/ /des mi chog skal med mgo bo bskor/ /grub brdzu rnams nyams myong 'o dod 'bod/ /des mi chog mi chos rdzun phug bzhugs/ /phyi 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrugs la phar bltas tsa/ /snyigs dus kyi tha ma mngon du gyur/ /bde skyid mi 'byung kho thag chod/ /nang skya ser byed spyod la

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 181bltas tsa na/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i yang mthar bslebs/ /tshul ldan mi 'byung kho thag chod/ /bar rang gi sems la bltas tsa na/ /gang shar kun 'khrul pa'i yo lang nyid/ /snying po med par kho thag chod/ /phyi snang ba'i yul la mi chags shing / /nang mkhas 'dod grub 'dod kyi bdud ma zhugs/ /bar nyams rtogs mchog 'dzin gyis ma bcings par/ /tha mal shes pa skyong bzhin du/ /gnyer kha med pa'i ri dwags bzhin/ /gtad med lung stong du 'chi nus na/ /bya btang gi 'dun ma'i yang rtse lags/ /ces pa'ang rang la snying brtse ba mang pos khyod mkhos kha thabs zhan 'dug sogs zer ba'i tshe rang gis rang la dpa' bkong ba'o// //stong nyid snying rje'i blo sbyong kun tu dgos pa'i nyams dbyangs rang shar/7/ rje bla ma sangs rgyas snying nas dran/ /rgyud byin gyis rlobs dang rin po che/ /bdag grub mtha'i tha snyad legs shes kyang / /lus la na tshas mnar ba'i tshe/ /grub mtha'i chos skad kyis phan ma thogs/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /rig gnas kyi bshad pa mkhas lags kyang / /sems la nyon mongs byung ba'i dus/ /bshad pa'i chos kyis mgo ma gnon/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /snyan ngag gi rtsom pa'i nyams shes kyang / /sang 'chi gnangs 'chi'i skabs thug tshe/ /'chi bdag la rtsom pas shags ma thebs/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /lus bde sems bde 'dug pa'i dus/ /rang gis rang la sems mgu yang / /rkyen ngan sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i

182 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/tshe/ /mkhas 'dod grub 'dod kyis go ma chod/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /bza' btung zas gos 'dzom pa'i dus/ /bdag 'dzin med med 'dra na yang / /gnad thog me btsas gdung ba'i tshe/ /tha mal pa dang khyad mi gda'/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /dben par 'dod yon 'bol ba'i dus/ /chos brgyad mgo bo bsnyams 'dra yang / /rkyen dang 'phrad na rang rtags ston/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /rkyen ngan sna res yid phyung tshe/ /bya ba snying nas thongs 'dra yang / /lus sems bde na dug ro langs/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /bsgom bzlas kyi nga rgyal che na yang / /gdon chen drag por 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /rtogs ldan dang nus ldan gyi mtshang chen brtol/ /der yang blo sbyong dgos par byung / /der yang stong nyid dgos par byung / /mo dang rmi lam rno mthong gis/ /gzhan la kha tshon bcad na yang / /rang la mi 'dod glo bur ba/ /rdzun mtshang ston pa'i me long de/ /rang gis brdungs nas gzhan la ngoms/ /dus ngan chos gzugs bdag 'dra ba/ /mkhas 'dod kyi bslab sbyang byas na yang / /legs bshad spro ba'i rnam dpyod med/ /grub 'dod kyi sgom pa byed lo yang / /nyams myong rtogs pa'i drod rtags med/ /mi tshe yang yengs ngang du zad/ /lto rgyab gnyis kyang gzhan la re/ /ci byas chos la brten pa'i sdig /gang zos dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor/ /bskyed rim 'a le 'o le la/ /brtan pa mi thob zhe sun po/ /sems ngo dran tsam rig tsam la/ /bogs skyed mi thon yi mug po/ /chos spyod za re zi re yis/ /nam zla phud pa'i mdo med po/ /blo sbyong rdo rus ma 'phrod pa'i/ /rkyen thog mi khel don med po/ /byed rgyu

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 183dran rgyu mang po yis/ /mdo rtsa shor ba'i klad med po/ /rdzun ma'i bu khyod bsam blo khug /rkyag gtad med pa'i bkra shis shog /ces me rta lor sngon las kyi lhong dang mtshams sgrub la bar gseng 3(ra bas rkyen byas nad chen sum btud kyis mnar nas slar khams cung zad dwangs pa'i skabs su sdug bsngal dang gdong 'phrad byung dus stong nyid snying rje'i bsre ba las gzhan cis kyang phan thogs med pa gting nas go ste thol byung du smras pa'o/ //las go gcig/ chod kyi ngang tshul rang gi sems gsos su smra ba/༈ pha bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /yul snang sgyu ma'i 'gyur ldog gis/ /blo sna bstung ba bka' drin che/ /mi rtag dran pa bla ma'i drin/ /nye 'brel lan chags bda' 'ded 'di/ /ma bkug kyang sngon gyi las kyis 'khor/ /khor yug zag pa'i gzhi ma 'di/ /ma bos kyang sngon gyi las kyis 'dus/ /na tsha sdug gi khur po 'di/ /ma btsal kyang sngon gyi las kyis bkal/ /bslab shes rang brdungs/ tho ba 'di/ /ma 'bad kyang sngon gyi las kyis 'phrad/ /rkyen ngan bar chad sna tshogs pa/ /ma bsam yang sngon gyi las kyis byung / /sdig sdug gtam ngan gzhi ma 'di/ /mi 'dod kyang sngon gyi las kyis 'grub/ /rgyal bas lhas byin rab tu phyung / /legs pa'i skar ma nye gnas bzhag /o rgyan padma'i dbang gral du/ /bdud blon sku la bdo rnams 'tshogs/ /brtags ma mkhas pa zhig ma lags te/ /sngon gyi las la bcos su med/ /sngon gyi las la bcos yod na/ /las kyi rnam smin ma gtogs zhes/ /khong thams cad mkhyen pas ci ste gsungs/ /'dun gros dpon po chags chen dang / /

184 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/btsan phyugs dar gsum 'dzoms rnams dang / /pho grung mo grung mang pos kyang / /bsam tshad thog tu ma khel bas/ /'dod pa rnams dang ring du bral/ /mi 'dod pa dang tug gi 'phrad/ /yid khong du chud pa'i ngo nag gis/ /gyod kha le lan bda' ba de/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi rang gzugs yin/ /mi rtag ces pa'i go don yin/ /lan chags zug po'i ngo sprod yin/ /bu lon snyeg pa'i 'ded pa yin/ /byed dran mang na yang snying po med/ /don gyi mdo rtsa rlung gis khyer/ /ha cang brling na yang snying po med/ /glen pas rang rtug gser du sgom/ /brtag dpyad mkhas kyang snying po med/ /'bor ba na skyon med kyi dngos mi srid/ /ma brtag pa'i ci dran yang snying po med/ /rang chu la mchongs na spyon pa yin/ /lar legs par brtags shing dpyad pa na/ /'bor 'das kyi chos la bden pa med/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'bor la/ /bden zhen byas na rang nyid bslu/ /gang byung sngon las su ma shes na/ /ci byas sdug gi snon ma yin/ /rang nyams kyis dogs pa'i khong skran gyis/ /brtag dpyad zhib kyang 'khrul rtog yin/ /chos pa zhabrul rtog gi rjes 'brang na/ /chos dang rang sems ji ltar bsre/ /gzhan gyi bstod smad brag cha'i sgra/ /brag chas bslus na ri dwags dngos/ /'gyur med rig pa'i rang mdangs la/ /snying rje'i brlan dang ma bral bar/ /chos min gyi spyod pa shes tshad spongs/ /las stabs kun ci red gang red la thongs/ /nga sprang yon gyi las go de kas chod/ /ces nye gnas pas go ma chod byung dus gzhan rnams kyis khyod rang ci byung gang byung byas pas dus rgyun ma lo ma nyen yang red gsungs skabs de bden yang rang la sems gso'i tshul du smras pa'o// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 185tshe 'dir snang gis bslus par zhe khrel ba'i mgur dbyangs shar ma/7/ dpal rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas karma pa/ /pha de dang dbyer med rin po che/ /rje padma nyin byed sprul pa'i sku/ /nga tsho 'khrul snang gi g.yang sa las ldog re ran/ /mi 'di tshos gzhan la btsog lta byed/ /glen pa nga rang la btsog snang shar/ /lus sha khrag snabs lud khu ba sogs/ /mi gtsang rdzas sna du mas gang / /gcin rtug gi bum pa rum na btsud/ /dkor sdig la yog zas yog 'thu byed/ /rang 'dod g.yo sgyu phugs na btsang / /khrel ngo tsha'i spyod pa gting nas dor/ /mi rung sna dgu'i ngan spyod kyi/ /rang btsog 'dis rang la brdzad nges gda'/ /gzhan btsog gos kyang a'u tsi/ /mi gzhan tsho'i dgra bo phyi nas langs/ /mkhos chung nga'i dgra bo nang na gda'/ /bdag 'dzin gyi gdon rgod snying la zhugs/ /rig pa'i skyes bu'i dgra ru langs/ /'chor med 'dod chags zhags pas btab/ /zhe sdang spu gri rnon pos 'dra/ /gti mug mun pa'i dong du bcug /lhan skyes ye shes rgyang du dor/ /las bde sdug sna tshogs dang du blang / /'dre rgyang du yod pa rtsa ru bos/ /sdug yan gar yod pa rang thog spungs/ /dgra nyon mongs 'di yi mgo non na/ /khams gsum g.yos kyang bzod pa'i grogs/ /mi 'di tshos gzhan la 'phya khrel byed/ /tha shal nga rang spyod la gting nas khrel/ /rang don sgrub dus snying rus med/ /gzhan don byed dus phan sems med/ /ser gos gyon la bsrung bya med/ /sdom pa bsrung na ngo lkog mang / /dam tshig blangs na g.yo zol byed/ /yon tan med la nga rgyal che/ /chos

186 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/brgyad phyir shi yang bzod pa la/ /chos phyir du lto yang gcog mi nus/ /zang zing phyir klad pa sla ba la/ /dag snang gi mgo bo rdo las sra/ /rang khrel gyis rang la gos pa 'di/ /mthong na gzhan skyon shugs la 'dag /nor yod tsho'i jag rkun phyi nas 'ong / /nga sprang po'i rkun jag nang nas langs/ /dran shes kyi so pas ma tshor bar/ /dug lnga'i jag pa glo bur rgyugs/ /bslab pa gsum gyi nor bu de/ /yang yang bsrungs kyang yang yang 'phrog /rtsal rang bzhin gnyis po gdong 'thab shor/ /ma rig pa'i skung 'phrang btsan dang gcig /bag chags kyi dgra rkun mang dang gnyis/ /gegs bar chad kyi nang bying rgod dang gsum/ /dge ba'i nor la rngams drags te/ /dus 'bral ba med par do bsdo bas/ /rang grol gyi btsan sa ma zin par/ /bsrungs pas 'khyongs pa gda' lags sam/ /rnam rtog gi rkun bu 'di zin pa na/ /phyi yi rkun ma gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /grung po tshos gzhan la rdzun ma zer/ /shes med ngas rdzun rgan rang du mthong / /kha yengs sems yengs kyi ltogs sgur la/ /mtshams sgrub tu btags nas lo zla bgrang / /dkor log 'tshos rang lto 'tshol ba la/ /'gro don du btags nas mi tshe zad/ /chos min byung rgyal du spyod pa la/ /bstan 'dzin du rlom nas gnyis phung sgrub/ /sems ci byung gi tshor shes tsam la/ /rtogs ldan du rlom nas sgrog gis bcings/ /gzhung 'grel kha shas thos pa la/ /mkhas pa ru bsgrags nas gzhan sun 'byin/ /chos brgyad kyi che thabs 'gran pa la/ /tshogs gsog tu rlom nas ngo so phyar/ /rdzun po che 'di rtsad chod na/ /ngag brag cha'i rjes su ci la 'brang / /mi spyi pa'i dus ngan phyi ru shar/ /nga chos med kyi dus ngan nang nas shar/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa'i lo tog de/ /nyon mongs sad ser gyis rtag tu bcom/ /dug lnga'i 'du ba gting nas

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 187zhabrugs/ /rang snang zhabrul pa dgra ru langs/ /chos rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom grir 'chi/ /dge bcu'i mthun rkyen gser las dkon/ /'gal rkyen mi dge'i rlung dmar 'tshubs/ /rtsod med dam chos kyi pha zhing shor/ /bla ma dang chos kyi mu ge phog /bsam spyod phyin log gi rim yams 'gos/ /nyams rtogs kyi longs spyod 'dzom dus med/ /'phags nor gyi khang bzang hrul por gyur/ /spyod ngan gyi dus 'di bcos nus na/ /bde skyid kyi dus bzang shugs la 'byung / /'khrul snang gi gzugs brnyan sems las byung / /rang sems la gnyer kha ma thub na/ /rmi lam dang chu gnyer zad mtha' med/ /'gyu ba gshis thog tu phab tsa na/ /mo gsham gyi bu la chags sdang bral/ /thag khra la sbrul du 'dzin pa zhig /ri bong rwa rno rtul su zhig rtsod/ /rig pa yul phyir mi 'brang bar/ /zhen pa la gnyen po med par grol/ /lhun 'byams klong du bzhugs par 'tshal/ /lan gcig yul snang sgyu mas mig brid/ rnam par g.yeng ba'i ltad mo la 'byams tsa na/ kha cig btsog lta byed/ phal mo ches dgra rkun la zon byed/ 'ga' zhig dus ngan gyi gleng slong gis dus 'da' ba'i tshe de dag la gting nas zhe khrel ba zhig gis rkyen byas shar mar bris pa'o// //'phral snang gdong 'ded kyi gsal 'debs/༈ nga sprang po za nyal byed pa la/ /las stabs legs kyang dgos rgyu chung / /stabs ka nyes kyang 'gyod pa med/ /snyan grags kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /blo nang du khug dang 'dod pa can/ /nga dam chos snying nas bsgrub pa la/ /blo she/sa sgo yangs kyang dgos rgyu chung / /mkhos kha thabs zhan yang 'gyod pa med/ /mi chos

188 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /'dang rang la rgyob dang mgo ril po/ /nga bka' brgyud gong ma'i rjes 'jug la/ /rgyu zas nor 'dzom yang dgos rgyu chung / /khyi ltar shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /mig 'khrul kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /blo chog shes gyis dang dkor zan po/ /nga sangs rgyas dwags po'i bu rgyud la/ /sgom zhi gnas brtan kyang dgos rgyu chung / /sems rnam rtog 'tshub kyang 'gyod pa med/ /dug lnga kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /sems rang grol thongs dang gu yangs so/ /nga klong chen rab 'byams rgyal rgyud la/ /nyams kra kri shar yang dgos rgyu chung / /sgom had por song yang 'gyod pa med/ /yengs zhabrul kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /blo rtsis med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa/ /nga ka dag lhongs su gyur pa la/ /tha snyad kyi mdzub tshugs dgos rgyu chung / /blo la ma shongs kyang 'gyod pa med/ /grub mtha' kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /chos zad sar skyol dang skal pa can/ /nga rig pa zang thal skyong ba la/ /yod med kyi sgro 'dogs dgos rgyu chung / /lam rtags med kyang 'gyod pa med/ /spang thob kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /blo tha mal du sgyur dang snyom las pa/ /nga dran pa'i rtsa ba stor ba la/ /blos byas kyi gnyug ma dgos rgyu chung / /nyams mtho dman byung yang 'gyod pa med/ /'char sgo kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /gzhi rtsa chod dang sgyu ma'i bu/ /nga gtad so med pa'i bya btang la/ /kad kad krig krig gis dgos rgyu chung / /mi rjes ma sleb kyang 'gyod pa med/ /snang shas kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /bcos min du spyod dang mdo med po/ /nga kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i mtshang rig pas/ /bslab shes mang yang dgos rgyu chung / /mi mkhas zer yang 'gyod pa med/ /gzhung 'grel kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /sems gtan la phob dang re dogs

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 189can/ /nga chos kyi gnad tig go ba la/ /mang thos kyi chos bshad dgos rgyu chung / /chos dred zer yang 'gyod pa med/ /ston pa kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /chos rgyud la sbyor dang pha yi bu/ /nga thag sgo gcig thog gcod pa la/ /blo tshab tshub mang pos dgos rgyu chung / /gti mug zer yang 'gyod pa med/ /'phar yang kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /rang dbang du tshugs dang dgos pa 'grub/ /gzhan zer gyi kha la nyan pa yi/ /blo sna kha mang pos sgom chen bslu/ /da dung brtan pa ma thob par/ /sgrub pa la bar chad med/ par phre ga /yang re zhig chos bshad mkhan dag gi bshad pa kha cig kyang thos/ sems brtse ba rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi gros 'debs pa yang byung / 'on kyang rang nyid lugs zung gnyis char rang thag sngar nas chod zin pas 'phral snang ci 'dra yang gting nas blo 'gyur ldog cher med pas gsal 'debs su smras pa'o// //lta sgom spyod pa'i 'phrang grol gyi gsol 'debs/lje/ pha dran mchog gi rgyal po padma'i mtshan/ /sems rig stong gi ngang du lhal / ger shar/ /mtha' bral tsam gyi go ba dang / /blo 'das kyi yid dpyod ma zhig par/ /rtogs so snyam pa'i khog 'tshangs kyis brgyangs/ /lta ba blos byas kyi shan zhig de na gda'/ /dwangs pa'i shel la 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /snang sems kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyang / /rig stong la 'pho 'gyur rdul tsam med/ /cog bzhag gi lta ba mi zer ram/ /gnas 'gyu la a 'thas 'gyu dran gyis bzung / /ye grol la yongs grol gyi 'dzin rtog bsgrubs/ /rang byung la bzo bcos kyi lhan pa gdab/ /sgom pa mtshan 'dzin gyi shan zhig de na gda'/ /sems gsal rig stong gsum zung 'jug

190 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/nyid/ /gang shar gyi rang 'gros skyong ba yi/ /bzo med kyi rig pa zang thal la /rang bab kyi sgom pa mi zer ram/ /btsun tshugs bzung dang brtul zhugs spyod/ /smyo spyod tho co la sogs pa/ /zhabrul snang a 'thas kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /spyod pa tshul 'chos kyi shan zhig de na gda'/ /bden zhen dang yengs zhabrul ma zhugs na/ /spyod lam kun chos nyid kyi rol pa la/ /dgag sgrub byed blos mi bcings pa/ /shugs 'byung gi spyod pa mi zer ram/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum rang sems kyi 'khrul/ /mtshan rtog la gnyer kha mi byed par/ /rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba rang 'gros su/ /rang rig rang gsal gyi dran par dag /rang grol gyi ngang du rgyun chad med/ /'bras bu lhun rdzogs kyi byin rlabs dus 'dir stsol/ /dpal spungs dben rir bdag gu ṇa snang ba dwangs skabs smras pa dge/ //rig 'dzin bkra shis kyi gsung lan 'brel tshad don ldan/7/ skyabs dus gsum kun mkhyen pad 'byung dang / /dbyings gcig 'gyur padma nyin byed dbang / /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin rlabs stsol/ /gson dang rig 'dzin bgres po lags/ /chos ma shes nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa min/ /lag tu ma blangs pas rang re bslus/ /mtho mtho zab zab cig 'dod 'dod nas/ /thos tshad la ched gnyer med pa de/ /rgyud tha mal du lus pa'i snga ltas su gda'/ /bka' mdo brgyud rnams su ma 'thus pa'i/ /gdams ngag tu rlom pa'i tshigs bcad sogs/ /chos gsar pa'i khong na ci yang med/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang grub thob gsung / /byin rlabs can gyi tshig gcig des/ /the tshom mdud pa mang dkrol

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 191bas/ /so skyes mdzes mdzes bsgrigs pa yi/ /pusti mang pos do zla min/ /bka' dang mthun na chos pa yin/ /lung dang mthun na nyams myong yin/ /the tshom chod na rtogs ldan yin/ /rlom sems spangs na btsun po yin/ /rgyun chad med na rnal 'byor yin/ /chos kha bshad shes pa mang lags kyang / /sems chos dang 'dres pa nyin mo'i skar/ /blo rgyud gnya' rengs su btang bas lan/ /de 'chi ba rgyud la ma dran pas lan/ /nam 'chi cha med 'di ma go ba'i/ /ming chos par btags nas chos brgyad dang / /skad cig kyang 'bral bar mi phod pa/ /bdag lta bu'i ser gzugs grog tshang ltar / /brdol nas bstan la rma 'byin par/ /yi lan brgyar chad kyang las kyi mthus/ /rang dbang rang gis ma 'dus par/ /nyin mtshan chos min gyi 'khor lo bskor/ /las rgyu 'bras kyi rang gzugs bslu med de/ /rang thog tu myong 'gyur dran tsa na/ /snying tshal bar mi 'thor 'di ci zhig /dpal 'byor rtswa rtser chags pa yi// /zil pa phra rab tsam zhig la/ /blo 'bral bar ma bzod dal 'byor lus/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa/ /chos min gyi bsam sbyor shes tshad kyis/ /chud zos su gtong ba bdag 'dra bas/ /deng sang rgyal khams kun gang ba/ /'di mthong che mtho ris thar pa'i lam/ /ming tsam du gyur snyam rab tu skyo/ /khyed rnal 'byor dbang po ji ltar dgongs/ /'on kyang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /thabs mkhas 'gro phan mdzad pa la/ /tshul ston du sna tshogs gzugs 'chang dang / /nang gi rnal 'byor la gnas pa sogs/ /khong ye shes kyi spyan ldan ma gtogs pa/ /so skye'i brtags dpyad ji tsam du/ /legs kyang rgyud tshod mi zin pas/ /dag snang 'di chos kyi snying po yin/ /grub mtha'i rang tshugs shor dogs pas/ /so so'i sa na che bshad kyis/ /gzhan gyi skyon 'don mang lags kyang / /

192 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rang re la tshugs ka'i gnyer med pas/ /shes bzhin du thar lam mi sgrib par/ /dag snang gi blo rgya bskyed par 'tshal/ /dag snang phyogs med mkhan go ba'i slad/ /chos thos tshad nyan la lag len med/ /dbang skur tshad zhu yang nyams len med/ /bla ma mthong tshad bsten la dam tshig med/ /snyigs dus mi blo bdud kyis bsgyur/ /bstan bzhig zog po 'grim sgo che/ /gser ra gan nor nyen 'dug pas na/ /dag snang phal cher phung ba'i rgyu/ /de 'dra 'chal pa yin pas spang / /kun rdzob 'khrul sems kyis 'dus pa'i chos/ /rmi lam rmis pa'i myong tshor ltar/ /don dam gyi bsnyonas su ma grub kyang / /ji srid 'khrul snang ma dag pa/ /de srid las 'bras phra mo yang / /bslu ba med la nges rnyed na/ /ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs mtho ris kyi/ /sgo chen phyed 'gyur 'jigarten pa'i/ /yang dag lta ba de tsam zhig /mi ldan stong pa'i rbad kham can/ /'brel tshad log pa'i 'dren ston yin/ /snang tsam 'di bkag kyang mi khegs kyi/ /'dzin zhen gyi bslad kyis ma bslad na/ /snang shes gnyis stong pa nyid du mnyam/ /gnas lugs spros dang bral bas na/ /bcos ma'i dgag sgrub rang bcing rgyu/ /mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pas stong pa de/ /rgyal bas stong pa mthong zhes gsungs/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab yin/ /blo yis dpyad pa'i spros bral de/ /yul du byas pa'i stong nyams te/ /med dgag gi zhen la 'then 'then nas/ /lta bar nyes na phung khrol che/ /rnam rtog gi bun long stong par mthong / /mthong ba po gtad med kyi ngang du grol/ /'dzin med kyi rig pa zang thal de/ /yid dpyod kyi mun pas ma bsgribs na/ /'od gsal gyi nyi ma khor yug shar/ /rtsol med kyi rang sa ma zin na/ /rtsol bcas kyi bsam gtan 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /bya ba snying nas ma thong na/ /btang ba'i rtsol bas tshur la 'khor/ /rtogs ma

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 193rtogs kyi re dogs sangs pa na/ /rtogs pa kun gyi mchog tu gyur/ /deng sang lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo/ /chos bshad skye bo pho mo mkhas/ /sgom kha la babs pas sa steng gang / /rgyud nyon mongs 'dul ba ri bong rwa/ /mi tshe zog zob kyi ngang du zad/ /'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom na yang / /lam sna phyogs tsam ma zin pa/ /skal dman rnams de 'dra la ngo mtshar byed/ /dam pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa'i/ /ser gzugs de gnyis phung gi tho ba yin/ /de la ngo mtshar ci zhig yod/ /chos dang sne gcig mthun gyur na/ /rtogs pa dman yang ngo mtshar che/ /chos min gyi rang rgyud bsregs bsregs nas/ /mi rjes ma sleb pa'i sdug gtam lags/ /khyed bden pa gzigs la zhu ba min/ /bstan par khag bsnyad kyi 'khrugs rtsod dang / /kha mchu bun skyed tshong khe sogs/ /gzhan gnod kyis phug tu 'tshang bzhin du/ /'dul 'dzin du rlom pa smyon pa dngos/ /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spangs pa de/ /khyim na gnas kyang tshangs spyod kyi mchog / log 'tsho sdud thabs kyi 'phyor gos de med kyang bzod/ /byang chub don du gnyer ba'i blo/ /'bral ba med der sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos kun 'du bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos thams cad 'dun pa'i rtsa bar gnas/ /'dun pa ma zhum pa zhig 'tshal/ /skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad/ /mi 'bral gzhan phan gzhir bcas spyod/ /theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba de/ /sangs rgyas sgrub la med ka med/ /rang 'dod can gyi snying rje dang / /bdag gces 'dzin can gyi 'gro phan bde/ /byang chub kyi spyod dang 'gal na yang / /chos pa bzang brdzus bslus pa mang / /gsang sngags kyi sgo ru zhugs phyin chad/ /dam tshig med na khong stong yin/ /dam tshig gi snying po mos gus yin/ /bcos min gyi mos gus skyes pa la/ /mchog gi ye shes 'bab cing 'khor/ /bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba la/ /rgyal bsras

194 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bcas kyi byin rlabs 'jug /zang zing gi gnang sbyin ngo bstod sogs/ /mthun 'jug 'dod thog byung tsa na/ /sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug pa skad/ /chos brgyad dang g.yo sgyu mi ldan na/ /mi chos ma mkhas pas phung ba skad/ /rang 'dod kyis bla ma bzang ngan bcos/ /ci mdzad legs par ma mthong ba'i bcos ma'i mos gus de yi chad rgyu/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro ba bsod nams chung / /zog po rnams ni sangs rgyas su mthong / /dam pa rnams ni khyi ltar lod/ /dge sdig kyang de ltar go ldog spyod/ /rgyu des bskyed mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung / /so skye'i rang 'dod la gtad so ci/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la dpang po 'tshal/ /deng sang dus kyi dbang gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas byon nas chos gsungs kyang / /mgo ril ril byed pa ma gtogs pa/ /yid ches thob pa 'byung dka' bas/ /grong tshig gi phreng bas ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang dam pa'i gsung gi lan/ /mdor bsdus byung rgyal du smras te phul/ /'brel thogs rgyud la phan par shog /ces rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor maṅga la'i mtshan can gyi bzhed ngor yon tan rgya mtshos smras pa dge/ //nyams len gyi dogs sel grub thob rgya mtsho'i gshegs shul/༈ chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nu padma yi nyin byed/ /bdag dang dad ldan blo sna chos la rang sgyur mdzod/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi lus ni rin chen/ /rmi lam rgyal srid bzhin du yud tsam la thob pa/ /mi rtag rtswakha'i zil dang rlung nang gi mar me/ /skad cig rang dbang yod dus lha chos la brtson nas/ /rang mgo rang gis 'don 'tshal shes ldan gyi grogs po/ /bslab shes rnam grangs mang drags mtha'

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 195rgya ni mi chod/ /shes kyang rgyud la khel ba'i mkhas pa yang dkon pas/ /byas byas shes shes mang po'i rnam dpyod ni che yang / /gnyid dang rnam g.yeng mi tshe stong zad la song ba/ /rmongs pa bdag 'dra rang gis rang bslus la 'gyod do/ /pha ma nye mdza' shag rogs thar lam gyi phung krol/ /sha chang gzugs mdzes bslu brid ngan song gi gting rdo/ /chos min chos ltar brdzu ba rang rdung gi tho ba/ /tha snyad snying por bzung ba zab chos kyi skal chad/ /ma grub grub brdzu'i 'chol spyod rgyal bstan gyi rkang 'dren/ /gsang chos khrom du bsgrags pa gsang sngags kyi dam sri/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa che shos de 'dra las grol nas/ /ma nor zab lam snying po'i lam bzang nas byon mdzod/ /a ho/ lta sgom gnad don nyid kyis yi ge ru bris pa/ /nor 'khrul mi 'dug de lhag brjod rgyu yang mi 'dug /'on kyang gnyug ma'i rang 'gros tha mal gyi shes pa/ /sgom 'dod bzo bcos med pa'i rang bab la bskyur nas/ /dran rig rang tshugs ma tre(ra tha mal du bsdad pas/ /dgag sgrub mtshan 'dzin mkhan po chos nyid du yal nas/ /ye grol chos sku'i gshis la nges shes shig skyes tshe/ /lta sgom yod na yod chug med na yang med chug /rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa'i mgo bo ni tshugs pas/ /nang rtags phyi la shar ba'i mthun snang gi mngon rtags/ /gzung 'dzin 'brel thag chad pa'i rang bzhin gyi rang mdangs/ /'dir snang chos min lta ci dam pa yi chos kyang / /zhe 'dod rlom pas mi sgrub 'khri ba kun zad pa/ /bya btang rnal 'byor chen po sangs rgyas kyi gsang lam/ /skal ldan dam pa'i snying la myur ba ru 'phos nas/ /bka' brgyud grub thob rgya tsho'i rjes bsnyeg tu shog cig /ces pa'ang dad dam 'gyur med tshe dbang nas nyams len dri ba'i dogs sel du dpal spungs dben khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling nas phul ba dge/ //

196 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/phyag chen lnga ldan du nyams su len tshul/rmā/ rje padma'i mtshan can rdo rje 'chang / /bu rjes 'jug blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /bdag rgyud chos dang ma 'dres pas/ /chos gzhan la bshad pa nee tso'i glu/ /mdo don nyams su ma myong na/ /tshig bshad yams mang po nam mkha'i 'ja'/ /spyir snyigs dus dam chos rnal ma med/ /sgos chos gzugs rnams chos dang rgyab 'gal byed/ /nyams len rdo rus ma 'phrod pa'i/ /chos byas lo mang pos rang mgo g.yogs/ /'chi ka gtad so med nyen gda'/ /dus da lta mi 'chi'i gdeng med cing / /'chi na gar 'gro'i gtad so med/ /lus longs spyod 'khor g.yog mdza' bshes bcas/ /shing kha'i bya bzhin myur du gyes/ /mi rtag pa kam kem dran par mdzod/ /'chi ba snying nas ma dran na/ /blo chos brgyad dang bral dus mi gda' bas/ /gang byas tshe 'di'i lag cha ste/ /chos dang 'jig rten zung 'jug gi /kha mkhos legs legs bzang bzang po/ /rang gzhan gnyis phung rgyu yin pas/ /de 'dra'i gral du ma re bar/ /bka' brgyud rnam thar dran par mdzod/ /thun mgor skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /sems bskyed rnam dag byang chub sems/ /dar drag snang ba 'gyur nges bya/ /dngos gzhi rang lus yi dam gyi/ /lha sku khyad par bzhi ldan bsgom/ /cha shas nas bzung rdzogs pa'i bar/ /re re bzhin du sems bzung bas/ /thun mong zhi gnas zhar la 'grub/ /khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mos gus kho nar mthil phur bca'/ /sems bzo med gnyug ma'i rang 'gros skyong / /rjes 'khor gsum yongs dag bsngo smon spel/ /phyag chen lnga ldan zhes bya

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 197ba/ /bka' mdo rgyud yongs kyi snying po ste/ /pha bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs pa'i shul/ /mi rang rang dad brtson ma zhan na/ /tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang dngos 'khru1ba/ /khyad par phyag chen mnyam bzhag la/ /rnam rtog snga ma 'gags nas su/ /phyi ma ma skyes da ltar gyi/ /shes pa bzo med had po nyid/ /rang bab bzhag la rang gros skyongs/ /mi gnas rnam rtog gang 'phro yang / /byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsa ba ni/ /lan cig min par yang yang bcad/ /go yul tsam du ma lus pa'i / /rig thog myong ba thon byas na/ /kho thag chod cing nges shes skyes/ /gnas 'gyu rig gsum dbyer med rtogs/ /de tshe bla ma'i mos gus dang / /rtag tu dran shes bsten nus na/ /'gyur med rtogs pa thob par 'gyur/ /'on kyang dben par dka' spyad kyis/ /nges 'byung snying rje dag snang gis/ /rgyud sbyong tshogs bsag sgrib sbyong sogs/ /sgom mgo rkang cung zad ma tshang bar/ /'phags pa'i ye shes gting zab pa/ /rang nam 'dod dus su mi mthong bas/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad par mdzod/ /sgom la tshogs bsag mi dgos dang / /bskyed rdzogs re res chog ces dang / /zhi gnas med par lhag mthong sprad/ /ma bcos zhog dang rang ngo ltos/ /ci yang yid la ma byed sogs/ /dbang po rab kyi spyod yul de/ /so skye blun po'i rna ba sa /bsgrags rnams bdud kyi gsang tshig yin/ /gol sa shor sar 'gro nyen mchi/ /bdag gong smos mdo rgyud dpang yod pas/ /blo chos mthun zhig mdzad na de ltar mdzod/ /swā la'i nags khrod grub pa'i gnas/ /kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling / /gnas de na bsti ba'i chos gzugs ni/ /ming yon tan rgya mtshor 'bod des bris/ /mthong thos kyi 'gro rnams smin grol shog /ces dge slong kame dbang ldan ngor yon tan rgya mtshos so/ /maṅga lo// / /

198 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/lta sgom spyod gsum dran shes gcig bsdus kyi man ngag7/ sangs rgyas kun dngos padma'i mtshan/ /bdagasnying padma'i ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ /gatshog ma'i rang zhal zer ba de/ /ma bltas bzhag pas mjal ba yin/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs zer ba de/ /ma btsal klong na thob pa yin/ /chos sku phyag rgya chen po de/ /rang gi sems la zer ba yin/ /lta spyod sgom pa rnam mang yang / /dran shes gcig pur 'du ba yin/ /dran pas rang nyid bcings pa mang / /lhod kyis klod na dran pa yin/ /rang sems rang gis ma bcings par/ /gu yangs ngang du rang 'gros sbyong / /rnam rtog sems kyi rang rtsal yin/ /'gyu ba mi 'gag rang grol mthong / /sprin char thog glog ci byung yang / /nam mkha' stong par phan gnod med/ /sems la rtog pa ci shar yang / /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig mnyam/ /bsgom mo snyam pa'i shes pa de/ /rtog pas rang ngo bsgrib pa yin/ /yid byed thams cad blo yin pas/ /yid la mi byed phyag rgya che/ /bzo bcos dgag sgrub spang blang dang / /re dogs byas pas mthong ba min/ /tha mal shes pa rjen pa dang / /rang byung rig pa 'du 'bral med/ /bzo med ngang du tshogs drug kun/ /snang la ma zhen bskyang bar 'tshal/ /gnas lugs rtogs par the tshom med/ /'bras bu thob par som nyi ci/ /gtso bor bla ma'i mos gus dang / /'gro la byams dang snying rje bsgom/ /dam tshig sdom pa rnam dag mdzod/ /dge ba'i bsags rgyab bsgrub pa na/ /rang byung ye shes shugs la 'char/ /gzhan phan smon lam stobs kyis 'byung / /de skad dge blos rgyud phyug pa/ /pradzñā'i mtshan can bzhed pa'i ngor/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 199yon tan rgya mtshos gang dran bris/ /'brel tshad phyag rgya che thob rbestog/ //lta sgom spyod pa'i gces gnad 'brel thogs smin byed mgur chung dang po/7/ pad 'byung bla ma dbyer med pa/ /snying dbus dwangs ma'i thig ler mchod/ /gnas lugs lta ba skyong 'dod na/ /spros bral gtan la 'beb dgos pas/ /thos bsam shes rab bskyed par gces/ /rang bab bsgom la brtson 'dod na/ /mos gus stobs kyis 'char dgos pas/ /dran shes mos gus 'bral med gces/ /bcos min spyod la gnas 'dod na/ /dgag sgrub blo dang 'bral dgos pas/ /re dogs thad kar gcod par gces/ /rnal 'byor gral du bsnyegs 'dod na/ /sgrub brgyud rnam thar bskyang dgos pas/ /lang shor dbang du mi gtang 'tshal/ /gdams pa'i gnad 'gag 'di la tshang / /mang du smos kyang tshig tu zad/ /dge bas khyed la sogs pa yi/ /'brel thogs 'gro kun smin grol shog/ //lta spyod don gnyis lhun grub mgur chung gnyis pa/༈ na mo gu sa bka' brgyud grub pa'i tshogs dang bla ma rjes/ /'gro kun rtogs grol dus mnyam dngos grub stsol/ /phyag rgya chen po dkar po gcig thub tu/ /grags kyang gnad kyi man ngag mi ldan par/ /gnas 'gyu gang shar rang ngo shes tsam gyis/ /sa lam bgrod min zhabrul rtog kha snon nyid/ /des na thog mar srid gsum bde 'byor la/ /nges 'byung drag pos dgos med skye bar mdzod/ /nam 'chi

200 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/cha med snying la gzer ba yis/ /chos brgyad rnam rtog yan pa nang du khug /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed theg chen chos kyi rmang / /gal chung mi bya nyams len snying por brtson/ /sgrib pa byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa na/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes rang bzhin 'char bar gsungs/ /sgrib sbyong mthar thug rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang / /tshogs bsag snying po maṇḍal nyid la 'bungs/ /dbul po'i lag tu rin chen mi thob ltar/ /mos gus nor gyis phongs pa'i gang zag gis/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rin chen mi thob pas/ /bka' brgyud grub brnyes gshegs pa'i lam po che/ /mos gus gsol 'debs gdung shugs khor yug bskyed/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i snying po bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /dbang bskur thob nas dam tshig ma nyams pas/ /snang grags lha dang sngags kyi 'khor lor blta/ /yid ni stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug ngang / /sgyu ma tsam du dge sgrub sdig sbong sogs/ /chos bzhin 'bad pas mchog thun dngos grub gnyis/ /skye ba 'di dang phyi mar nges thob pa/ /bslu med tshad ma rgyal ba'i bka' yin pas/ /thugs la bzhag nas tshul ldan lta spyod 'dis/ /don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis dpal bar shog/ //sems ngo lta ba'i man ngag mgur chung gsum pa/7/ rje drin ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /khyed rig thog tu nyams len brtson 'dod na/ /kha phyir bltas kyi shes pas mi grol bas/ /nang rig mkhan gyi rang zhal mjal bar zhu/ /dran shes bzhin mi ldan nyams len mkhan/ /gnad shes kyang rgyal po dmangs 'khyams 'dra/ /ngo 'chug med legs par 'phrod phyin nas/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 201dus rtag tu skyong ba gdams ngag zab/ /spros bcas dang spros med la sogs pa/ /kun dril nas nyams su len pa las/ /gzhan khyad du gsod pa mi rung bas/ /blos gang lcogs lag tu len par 'tshal/ /sgom phyag chen zer ba'i g.yer po che/ /tha mal gyi shes pa las gzhan med kyang / /zab drags pas rang ngo ma shes pas/ /nyes drags pas rang yid ma ches skyon/ /gnad khel gyi rtogs pa'i gdeng ldan dkon/ /kha stong lta mkhan gyis phyogs kun khyab/ /rgyud mi grol chos kyi rkang 'dren pa/ /blo chos brgyad dbang du shor bas lan/ /sgom mthon po la hab sha ma che bar/ /sems mi rtag dran pas zhun thar gcad/ /chos che chung med par rang rgyud la/ /sbyor mdzod dang mchog dngos 'bras thob 'gyur/ /maṅga lo// //bka' brgyud rgyal sa 'dzin thabs 'dra chos bcu gcig mgur chung bzhi pa/༈ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kho bo thos dang sgom pa yi/ /sbyangs pa chung bas zab mo'i don/ /rgya cher smra bar mi sbobs kyang / /khyed kyi bzhed pa skong ba'i slad/ /zab mo'i gnad 'gag nyung ngu gsol/ /'bor ba'i bde 'byor 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /snying po med pa mkhyen par mdzod/ /dal 'byor mi rtag chu bur 'dra/ /myur du yal ba mkhyen par mdzod/ /las 'bras dpyid btab sa bon 'dra/ /bslu med smin nges mkhyen par mdzod/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen long khrid 'dra/ /med thabs med pa mkhyen par mdzod/ /kha chos phyi nas byugs pa 'dra/ /dgos dus phan med mkhyen par mdzod/ /byang chub sems gnyis gser dang 'dra/ /cis kyang 'gyur med mkhyen par mdzod/ /rang sems col chung byis pa 'dra/ /rnam kun 'tsho dgos

202 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/mkhyen par mdzod/ /chos sku sa 'og gter dang 'dra/ /rang la yod pa mkhyen par mdzod/ /rnam rtog nyon mongs sbrul mdud 'dra/ /glod na grol ba mkhyen par mdzod/ /rang rig shel gong dwangs pa 'dra/ /snang la ma 'dres mkhyen par mdzod/ /lta spyod 'dzoms pa mkha' lding 'dra/ /gang la'ang thogs med mkhyen par mdzod/ /mkhyen pa tsam du mi 'jog par/ /rang rgyud chos dang 'dres gyur nas/ /bka' brgyud rgyal sa zin pa yi/ /dge legs bkra shis dpal 'bar shog /gdams pa'i mgur chung le tshan bzhi po phyogs tha dad nas bskul ba po so so'i bzhed ngor gang dran 'phral du bris pa'o// // lha dbang bkra shis la gnang ba'i zhal gdams/7/ gu ru padmar bdag skyabs mchi/ /bka' rgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /dad ldan blo sna chos la sgyur/ /mi ldog thar pa'i lam zin shog /gangs can mgon po a ti shas/ /mang po'i nang du ngag la brtag /gcig pur 'dug na sems la brtag /ces pa mdor bsdus gnyis su gsungs/ /yid ni nyes pa'i rtsa ba ste/ /kha ni nyes pa 'byung ba'i sgo/ /de phyir 'di gnyis rtag tu bsrung / /'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems/ /gzhan nas rdul tsam byung ba med/ /bde sdug bzang ngan mchog dman sogs/ /thams cad sems kyi rtog pa yin/ /rang sems dag na sangs rgyas te/ /gang du sdod kyang dag pa'i zhing / /ji ltar byas kyang chos nyid ngang / /gang snang ye shes rol pa'i rgyan/ /rang gi sems nyid ma dag na/ /sangs rgyas yin kyang skyon du mthong / /pha ma la yang khong khro skye/ /snang ba phal cher dgra ru

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 203lang / /re dogs chags sdang rgyun mi chad/ /mi lo mi nyan mi tshe zad/ /su dang 'grogs kyang mi mthun la/ /gang du bsdad kyang bde ba med/ /ci tsam yod kyang chog mi shes/ /re re 'dzom yang re re dgos/ /tshe 'di'i snang bas g.yeng g.yeng nas/ /chos bya snyam yid la dran na yang / /da byed ngang du mi tshe zad/ /nges 'byung so ma skye ba'i skabs/ /yod tshad ling bor thub thub 'dra/ /'khreb nas khab la'ang ser sna skye/ /mos gus gsar pa skye ba'i tshe/ /bla ma de las gzhan mi dran/ /yun ring song nas log lta skye/ /dad pa gsar pa'i skabs su ni/ /dge sbyor gcig thog gnyis pa bsnan/ /rgas nas thams cad dbyings su yal/ /mthun grogs gsar pa rnyed pa'i dus/ /rang las de yi lus srog gces/ /a gsar yal nas dgra ru ldang / /de dag thams cad rtsa ba ni/ /rang sems tshod ma zin pas lan/ /rang sems bkol du btub pa na/ /dben gnas gzhan du 'tshol mi dgos/ /rnam rtog med na dben pa yin/ /bla ma phyi ru 'tshol mi dgos/ /sems nyid bla ma sangs rgyas yin/ /dge sbyor thon los dogs mi dgos/ /yengs medadage sbyor snying po yin/ /g.yeng ba ched du spang mi dgos/ /dran shes brtan na rang grol yin/ /nyon mongs skye dogs skrag mi dgos/ /rang ngo zin na ye shes yin/ /rang sems skad cig ma 'di las/ /'khor 'das gzhan du ma grub pas/ /rtag tu sems la bya ra 'tshal/ /rang sems nang du ma thul na/ /phyi rol dgra la zad pa med/ /nang du khong khro thul ba na/ /sa steng dgra bo thams cad zhi/ /sems la chog shes ma skye na/ /'dod rgu 'dzom yang sprang po 'dra/ /zhen log chog shes can kyi mi/ /zang zing med kyang rtag tu phyug /'jig rten bya ba legs pa dang / /chos dang dge ba sgrub pa'i tshe/ /sems la dga' ba skye ba yi/ /bag chags de yis mtho ris

204 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/skye/ /de yang mi rtag 'bor ba yin/ /dga' ba'i ngo bor bltas pa na/ /stong par mthong de thar lam rgyu/ /chos dang 'jigarten bya ba rnams/ /ma legs sdug bsngal byung ba dang / /khong khro zhe sdang 'dod chags sogs/ /nyon mongs rtog pa'i rje sa 'brang na/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba'i rgyu/ /der skyes sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gang skyes kyang / /rang ngor bltas pas stong par yal/ /de las ye shes log na med/ /rang sems 'di dang mi 'bral bas/ /rtag tu rang sems bsrung ba gces/ /sems srung ba la chos kun 'dus/ /srung tshul rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ /sems srung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /thams cad 'bad pas srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /ces gsungs bzhin du nyams len gces/ /de phyir tshogs drug yul snang kun/ /sems nyid gcig pu'i cho 'phrul te/ /spang blang byed na byed mkhan zhabrul/ /ro snyoms lam khyer mchog yin kyang / /las dang po yi gang zag gi /lta ba mtho la spyod pa zhib/ /mi lus dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhes/ /'chi ba mi rtag yang yang bsam/ /las 'bras bslu med nges shes bskyed/ /gzhan dag shi ba mthong thos tshe/ /rang la brda' ston shes par mdzod/ /dbyar dgun 'gyur ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /thams cad mi rtag dran par mdzod/ /sbrang dang sbrang rtsi mthong ba'i tshe/ /nor rdzas dgos med shes par mdzod/ /khang zhig grong stong mthong ba'i tshe/ /sdod gnas khang khyim shes par mdzod/ /gzhan dag mdza' ba bral mthong tshe/ /rang gi nye mdza' dran par mdzod/ /gzhan la mi 'dod glo bur tshe/ /rang la'ang 'byung ba dran par mdzod/ /rang gzhan thams cad rmi lam ltar/ /bden par grub pa rdul tsam med/ /rang sems bzo bcos ma bslad par/ /gnyug ma'i rang ngo bskyang ba'i

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 205tshe/ /phyi nang chos kun stong pa nyid/ /gsal stong zung 'jug mkha' ltar rtogs// /de ni don dam byang sems yin/ /de ltar ma shes 'gro ba rnams/ /gzung 'dzin dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal myong la tshad med pa'i/ /snying rje bcos min shugs la skye/ /de ni kun rdzob byang sems yin/ /snying rje 'dzin med stong par rtogs/ /stong pa'i rang rtsal snying rje shar/ /zung 'jug mdo sngags chos kyi snying / /nyams len phug po 'di la mdzod/ /de dag rgyud la skye ba'i thabs/ /tshogs bsags lag tu gang thebs bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gatre(la ba gdab/ /bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun/ /rang gzhan sdig las ldog pa dang / /ci nus dge ba'i las la bskul/ /theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang / /rnam dag bsngo ba 'bral mi bya/ /dge blo yar zla'i dpal yon can/ /de bend+ra yi gsal 'debs su/ /dge sbyong blo gros mtha' yas zhes/ /rgan po 'du gsum pa yis bris/ /tshe dang chos sgrub mthar phyin cing / /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /sarba sirnyi rastu maṅga lo// //dam pa'i rnam thar tha mal dbang pos spyod pa la ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/7/ a ho/ sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i ya mtshan gyi ltad mo/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur pa'i ngo mtshar gyi chos sgra/ /yid la sngon ma myong ba'i snying dbus kyi bdud rtsi/ /gnas mchog gu ru gtso 'khor gyi pho brang du tshogs so/ /phyi nang snod bcud khyad 'phags gter lung gi yul ljongs/ /dus tshod khyad par 'phags pa rab byung gi thog mar/ /gu ru padma'i rgyal tshab rig 'dzin gyi khyu mchog /rdo rje sems dpa'

206 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dngos snang nyi zla ni zung 'brel/ /zhal ras lhan cig rgyas pa'i dga' ston la spyod tshe/ /'og min padma drwa ba'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs khang / /thag ring gzhan na mi 'dug chu bur gyi ltad mo/ /sgyu ma'i phung khams ma dor tshe 'dir rang mthong song / /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lo ru gzigs tshe/ /ma dag 'khrul snang la zhen bar chad kyi bgegs tshogs/ /thugs rje rdo char shugs kyis rgyang ring du bskrad tshe/ /skal pa ldan pa rnams kyi thar lam la gegs byed/ /mo gto tshab tshub ma gos byin rlabs skad cig mas dengs song / /mi shigs rdo rje nā da'i glu dbyangs ni zab mos/ /nang dang gsang ba'i rnam thar rdo rje yi rol mo/ /'byung 'gyur lung du bstan pa thun mong dang thun min/ /skal ldan spang blang 'byed pa'i sgron me ni spar song / /ngo mtshar gter rgya bkrol ba mthong ba yi sems ldan/ /re dogs mdud pas bcings pa'i skya ser kyi khrom tshogs/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshogs rnams kha mig ni gdengs nas/ /nyin zhag gsum du brag rtsar dka' ba 'dra spyad kyang / /nyin byed 'char ba'i tshe na 'byung bya yi mig bzhin/ /mngon sum spyod yul nyid kyang dbang po'i lkog na mor gyur song / /khrag 'thung mngon par rol pa'i tshogs khang ni chen mor/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag o rgyan sangs rgyas ni gnyis pa/ /dpal chen dkyil 'khor dgu yi tshom bu mngon pa ru snang bas/ /smin grol gdams zab nyin zhag phrug gcig la bstsal tshe/ /skal med kho bo cag ni gti mug smag rum du chud song / /ngo mtshar byung ba rgya mtsho'i lo rgyus rna ba ru thos tshe/ /mngon sum bltas kyang ma mthong 'ostong ba yi mthar thug /rgyu mtshan yid la ma go glen pa rgya phrag gi gral mtha'/ /bdag 'dra'i gzugs brnyan rnams la yi mug khong nas rang skyes so/ /bde chen mkha' 'gros bskul ba'i gter ston grub thob kyi rgyal po/ /rdo

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 207rje thod phreng bzhugs pa'i 'od gsal shel phug gi gsang sgo/ /snang gsal zhun mar ngogs su dka' ba med pa ru phyes nas/ /skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshom bus ga na tsakra la spyod tshe/ /khyab bdag grub mchog rnam gnyis ye shes dgongs pa yi byin gyis/ /'bad rtsol dka' tshegs med par mig 'phrul sgyu ma dang mtshungs par/ /rang 'byung rdo yi sgrom bu lag pa'i padmo ru son tshe/ /tshong pa nor rnyed lta bu'i blo bde rang mal du chud song / /phyogs 'dir sngon chad med pa'i ya mtshan mngon dga' yi bkod pa/ /dag snang mig ldan yod na mos gus bzhin ras kyis ltos dang / /gsang bdag dpa' bo'i cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa ru mthong 'dug /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa'i btsas gsum gyi ngo mtshar/ /klong chen rab tu 'byams pa'i dngos grub zho sha las byon nas/ /yongs rdzogs dpyid du babs pa'i skal bzang snod ldan 'dra srid kyis/ /'byung 'gyur rjes slob byung na yid ches rtse gcig tu mdzod cig /rje btsun bla ma rnam gnyis thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis khyab pas/ /sngon med zab mo'i chos dang myong grol bdud rtsi yi thig le/ /thar pa'i gsos su myangs ba'i skal bzang 'di 'dra la bsam na/ /yid la spro ba'i ngo mtshar bla na med pa yi dpal gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan du snying gi dpyid bcud ni rgyas so/ /de tshe khong na med kyang kha skad stong pa yi 'ur sgra/ /mkhas grub phul byung tshogs rnams yang yang bzhad gad kyi 'bab stegs/ /skyid sdug ngo tsha med pa'i col chung thol glu ni tshig bzhi/ /rnam snang rnam par 'phrul ba'i mgrin pa dog mo las thon song / /rang byung ye shes spros bral nam mkha' yi dbyings su/ /bde chen 'gyur med 'od gsal nyi zla yi snang bas/ /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams sku dang zhing khams kyi thig ler/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba gdod nas rang sangs su dengs
