208 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/song / /ma bcos tha mal shes pa blo 'das chos sku yi dbyings su/ /gnyis snang rtog pa mtha' dag bya lam rjes med du song bas/ /dga' sdug re dogs mtha' dag mkha' la sprin bzhin du dengs tshe/ /grub thob mtshan snyan med kyang 'di kas chog pa yi pho tshod/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i drin gyis bcos min rang byung du shar ro / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i mdun sar dam tshig rnam dag gi tshogs pa/ /lung thob dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gsang ba'i brtul zhugs la rol tshe/ /dpal ri padma 'od kyi ye shes gzhal med du slebs 'dra'i/ /ye shes gzi byin chen po rnal 'byor sgo gsum la phebs pas/ /bya bral gnyug ma'i ngang du 'khor 'das gnyis chos kun nub nas/ /mnyam gzhag 'dzin med ngang las rjes thob bcos min gyi mos gus/ /bla ma rang rig dbyer med lhan skyes ye shes su shar bas/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i sems dang chu la chu bzhag bzhin 'dres pa/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su 'khor ba dong nas rang sprugs pa'i/ /smon lam bkra shis bzang pos dge legs mtha' rgyas su byas 'di/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid bka' yi gnang ba ni lci bas/ /mi nub bzhin du mkhas 'dod snyoms las kyi mkhan po/ /rong nag yul du skyes pas ma go ma rig ni med pa/ /gti mug dngos grub thob pas lta spyod tshom 'jog gi bdag po/ /bde ba'i rdo rje zhes pas kha gla gos zad du rgyu skabs/ /g.yar khral ngag 'khyal du bris pa kun la bzod par gsol lo/ /zhes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang gi lto nub sgrub phug rgyal po gnas mchog padma shel ri'i gnas gter gyi sgo khyab bdag grub pa'i dbang po rnam gnyis zhal rgyas pa gsar 'byed skabs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar tha mal dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur pa las brtsams padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyi mgrin lam sbug 'thom las g.yar khral du thon tsam byung ba'o/ /dge'o// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 209rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' lan lta sgom spyod 'bras/༈ bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /thugs bskyed byin rlabs mthu yis smin krol stsol/ /kho bo shin tu dman pa'i sbrang bu la/ /rgyal mchog brtse chen gzigs pa'i bka' yi mchid/ /sos ka'i rtsi bcud lta bu bstsal ba yis/ /dad gus mos spro'i lus stobs cher rgyas nas/ /zang zing snyan pa'i dbyangs chung cung zad 'bul/ /mgon khyod gdod nas mngon sangs rgyas gyur kyang / /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can don/ /slar yang byang chub spyod pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /gdul bya'i bskal pa dang 'tshams sprul bsgyur mdzad/ /thams cad sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i rol mo la/ /so skye'i blo yis rjes su dpog mi nus/ /rim bgrod lam gyi ngal bar ma ltos kyang / /gdul bya 'dul slad thub dbang rnam thar bzhin/ /gdams ngag rnam par thar pa'i sgo nas ston/ /dal 'byor nyin mo'i skar ltar rnyed dka' zhing / /'dus byas chos rnams skad cig tsam mi rtag /las 'bras bslu med rnam smin rjes su 'brang / /sdug bsngal rang bzhin srid las nges 'byung rnams/ /kha bshad tsam las rang rgyud 'byor ba dkon/ /gang gi thugs la ji bzhin nges pa ni/ /dngos gzhi las kyang sngon 'grozab gsungs phyir/ /thun mong gdul bya 'dul ba'i ston par grub/ /drang don chos 'bor bskor bar gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i lus can rnams/ /mtshan thos tsam yang srid pa mtha' can phyir/ /gsum la skyabs 'gros ngan song g.yang las ldog /sems mchog bskyed pas sangs rgyas sa bon thebs/ /byang chub spyod pas

210 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi phrinatsholas lags/ /byang sems mdzad pas ma bsgral sgrol bar gsol/ /deng sang skal dman rnams kyi skal pa dang / /'tshams pa'i brdol chos gsar byung ma yin pa'i/ /khungs dang 'brel zhing yid ches brgyud ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba thun mong dang / /khyad par lam gyis blo chen skal bzang rnams/ /smin cing grol 'dis sangs rgyas gzhan dag gi /bstan la ma byon thub pa'i thugs bskyed dang / /rlabs chen phrin las khyad chos nyid kyi phyir/ /dad gus dam tshig ldan pa'i skye bo kun/ /myur lam zab mos sangs rgyas sar 'god gsol/ /thun mong rig gnas khyad par mdo rgyud gzhung / /gang la'ang phyogs ris med pa'i thos pa btsal/ /gsan pa tsam gyis chog shes mi mdzad par/ /bsam pas nges shes rnyed pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /de don rang rgyud la sbyor sgom pa yang / /nam zhig tsa na bya snyam ma yin par/ /rtag tu dran shes bsten pa'i mnyam bzhag dang / /sngon sbyangs can gyi dam pa'i rnam par thar/ /lhun gyis grub pa de las ma g.yos 'tshal/ /sgrib bral so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /ji lta'i gnas lugs gdod nas gzigs pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa grub pa'i nyams myong dang / /ji bzhin mtshungs pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gsang nyid/ /thos pa'i skal bzang thob snyam dad spro 'phel/ /spyir ni tshogs lam gnas pas go ba tsam/ /sbyor lam nyams myong mthong lam rtogs pa'i sne/ /gsungs kyang dbang po rab la cig car 'grub/ /gzhi yi gnas lugs rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /dpyad sgom pa rnams thos pas gtan la dbab/ /de yi grogs su lung dang rigs pa dgos/ /kha phyir bltas na gzung 'dzin sgrog gis 'ching / /'jog sgom pa rnams sgom pas nyams su myong / /de don rtogs labla ma'i man ngag

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 211gces/ /rtsad brdar ma chod lung ma bstan tu 'byams/ /gang la'ang bdag med rtogs pa'i gdeng thob dgos/ /de yi bogs 'don ro snyoms gcod yul zab/ /lta ba'i mthar thug gang yang ma grub la/ /cir yang mi 'dzin bsam brjod blo las 'das/ /khas len bral yang rang thag chod pa lags/ /de don lam du byed nas sgom pa'i tshe/ /rtsol med rang babs gnas pa'i bsam gtan ni/ /med du mi rung zhi gnas ting 'dzin gzhi/ / rang ngo hrig ger rig pa lhag mthong ste/ /'gyu ba rang sar yal ba gnyug ma'i gshis/ /dang po'i las can sgom la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /thog mar 'du byed dran pa rgyun chags brten/ /skad cig mi yengs khab mig skud 'dzud bzhin/ /rtog pa rang gi ngo bor glod la 'jog /goms nas rnam rtog kho rang sgom du shar/ /dran rig rang tshugs ma shor rgyun skyong na/ /snang srid chos sku phyag rgya chen por 'char/ /'di don ngo sprod gnad kyi mthar thug pa/ /dpal ldan karma pa yi khyad chos ni/ /chos sku gnas lugs gdod nas spros bral dang / /rang sems dbyer med ngo bo chos kyi sku/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags pa/ /'dzin bral lham mer snang ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /rang rtsal cir yang ma yin cir yang snang / /zung 'jug thugs rje sprul pa'i skur shes na// /'khor 'das dbyer med sku gsum gshis la rdzogs/ /spyod pa mang yang snyigs dus mchog dman kun/ /khe che nyen chung kun bzang brtul zhugs zab/ /srid la nges 'byung 'gro la snying rje skyed/ /bcos min mos gus ris med dag snang sbyong / /rang don don gnyer chos brgyad rtswa ltar 'dor/ /don dam stong nyid mkha' 'dra rtogs gyur kyang / /kun rdzob bden pa phra mo'ang khyad mi gsod/ /'gro rnams tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong lam la gzud/ /bcos min shugs 'byung spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /

212 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'brel tshad don ldan phrin las sgrub gsol 'debs/ /gnad kyi snying po rang sems gnyug ma'i gshis/ /shes pa phyi mas lhan pa mi gdab par/ /bzo med lhug par 'jog pa'i rgyun skyong ste/ /mos gus stobs kyis bla ma'i byin zhugs na/ /tha snyad las 'das don dam bden pa mthong / /tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad/ /dngos kun khyab bdag dngos med nam mkha'i lus/ thob med 'bras bu'i phyag chen thob par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku mchog nyid lta bur/ /so skye'i tshig gis gsal 'debs mi 'tshal yang / /thugs brtse'i dgongs pa thun min gtad nas kyang / /rtogs brjod lhug par bstsal ba'i bka' lan du/ /mdor bsdus gus pa chen pos phul ba la/ /nongs pa gang mchis ye shes klong du bshags/ /dgongs pa dgyes pa'i dge bas skye kun tu/ /sangs rgyas karma pa yis rjes bzung ste/ /gsang gsum yon tan phrin las bcas pa dang / /dbyer med mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i 'dren par shog /ces de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben khrod nas bka' 'bangs rgan bu blo gros mtha' yas kyis dad cing gus pa'i yid kyis phul ba sarba maṅga le// //rtogs pa'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba'i myur lam phyag chen/7/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rjes/ /bdag sogs byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dal 'byor lan gcig thob 'di la/ /phyi mar phan pa'i chos bsgrub 'tshal/ /mi tshe sprin bar nyi ma 'dra/ /ci byas med par yud tsam 'dzad/ /'chi khar 'gyod kyang bya thabs bral/ /de phyir myur du brtson 'grus brtsam/ /chos la rgya che

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 213grangs mang yang / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i chos/ /mthar thug phyag rdzogs gnyis po yin/ /thabs lam bde stong phyag chen ni/ /sngags kyi nyams len dngos yin kyang / /lag tu lon pa re re tsam/ /grol lam lhan skyes phyag rgya che/ /khe che nyen chung nyams len bde/ /dbang po mchog dman kun la phan/ /'di la thugs dam snying por mdzod/ /mi rtag 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas/ /cis kyang dgos med blo sna bstung / /khams gsum 'khor ba mtha' dag la/ /zhen log nge sa 'byung snying nas bskyed/ /thog mar sngon 'gros rgyud dag bya/ /dngos gzhi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ /mos gus gong nas gong 'phel bya/ /lus gnad bcas la rang gi sems/ /gnas sam 'gyu ba'i ngo bor blta/ /gnas kyang rung la 'gyus kyang rung / /rang sems nyid las gzhan med pas/ /ngo bo'i ngang du ma bcos ba zhag /rtag tu dran shes 'bral med gces/ /sems gnas brtan po byung ba na/ /de la ched 'dzin mi bya bar/ /tshogs drug rtog pa sna tshogs dang / /bsres la rnam rtog lam du bslang / /da lta'i rnam rtog skad cig ma'i/ /rang ngo hrig gis mthong ba'i tshe/ /rang grol chos skur 'char ba las/ /sems ngo bya ba gzhan med pas/ / shes pa phyi mas bzo mi bcos/ /rtog pa'i lhan po mi gdab par/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma'i rang bab tu/ /ma yengs mi sgom glod shes na/ /myur du rtogs pa'i dbang phyug 'gyur/ /de skad yongs 'dzin bla ma mchog /dharma tā ra'i gsung bskul ngor/ /blo gros mtha' yas ku swā lis/ /mdor bsdus tsam du phul ba dge / //

214 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/sems khrid chos nyid bden mthong /༈ na mo gu ru be/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes/ /mdo sngags rtogs pa bsres pa'i khrid/ /nyams med dwags po'i bka' srol 'dir/ /mos gus nyid la gzhi bzung ste/ /zhi gnas rtsa ba tshugs pa dang / /lhag mthong rtogs pa thob nges dgos/ /goms nas zhi lhag zung 'jug gi /nyams len gnad dang ma bral bar/ /bdag po chos nyid dran pa bcas/ /sgom yun shi dang mnyam nus na/ /spros bral rtogs pa tsam ni mang / /nyid kyi zhi lhag 'jog tshul rnams/ /dpe bltas go ba tsam min pa/ /sems thog brdar sha chod pa'i gsung / /phyin ci ma log go ba ste/ /'dris shing goms na nyams myong skye/ /tshogs bsags mos gus stobs sogs kyis/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes lhag ger mthong / /tha mal shes pa snying dbus sad/ /rnam rtog chos kyi sku ru shar/ /snang srid phyag rgya chen por grol/ /de la gegs byed rnam rtog go /dgag sgrub the tshom rtag tu spang / /cir snang thad kar lam du khyer/ /rang bab gnyug ma bskyang pa la/ /gnyen po'i bzo bcos yal ba na/ /gnas lugs lhums su tshud par 'gyur/ /don dam chos nyid bden mthong na/ /don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis shog /ces sgrub brgyud mkhan po bde ldan gyis bzhed ngor blo gros mtha' yas sdis spel// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 215las dang po pas sems ngo bskyang tshul/7/ na mo gu mā las dang po pa'i ngo bo bskyang tshul la/ /'dzin pas gtan nas ma bslad mi 'byung zhing / /dran pa kho na gnad du zab pas na/ /dang po mi yengs snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang / /yengs na de dbang mi btang dam bca' bzung / /dran pa shugs 'byung byung na de rgyun bskyang / /rang bab gsal stong ngang du gnas pa'i tshe/ /rang ngo shes pas bcos med sa ler bzhag /'phro na rtog pa tshur la mi 'gugs par/ /ma yengs bltas pas gnyug ma'i ngang du grol/ /tshogs drug rtog pa ji ltar mang na yang / /spang blang dgag sgrub med par lam du khyer/ /dran shes yod na cis kyang 'ching mi 'gyur/ /dran rdzi med na yengs 'khrul dbang du 'gro/ /yengs dang ma yengs tsam gyi khyad par las/ /bsgom rgyu'i sems ngo zer ba ci yang med/ /rtogs pa'i rkyen ni sems bskyed mos gus dang / /tshogs gsog gang 'grub brtson 'grus bskyed pa dang / /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rjes 'jug pa/ /skal ldan dkon mchog bstan skyong thugs bzhed ngor/ /sgrub rgyud rtags 'dzin gu ṇa'i ming gis bris/ /nyams len mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog/ //sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i gshis lugs ngo sprod/༈ na mo gu ru be/ /so sor sdud pa'i stong gzugs de/ /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya che/ /sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i gshis/ /rang byung rang shar rang grol

216 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/yin/ /brtan cing bsam gtan skyes pa na/ /zhi gnas lhag mtherdzong mthar thug 'grub/ /phyag rdzogs sgom pa'i gnad dang gcig /blos dpyad mi dgos lta ba rtogs/ /de nas srog rtsol rnal 'byor gyis/ /las rlung dbu ma'i dbyings su sdud/ /rjes su dran pas rtsa mdud grol/ /ting 'dzin 'pho ba rab bkag nas/ /dwangs ma mi shigs rdo rje'i sku/ /khyab bdag 'gyur med bde la sbyor/ /de bas 'di 'dra'i gnad zab mo/ /rgyud sde gzhan du gsungs pa med/ /lam mchog 'di dang 'phrad pa'i bu/ /skal pa bzang ba shes par 'tshal/ /ces dzee thang dge slong dam chos nas bskul ngor blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdo tsam smras pa dge legs 'phel// //sku gsum sgrub tshul gyi man ngag gces gnad lnga pa/7/ rigs drug khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems kyi ngo bo rtogs 'dod skal pa bzang / /'bad pas thos bsam lo brgyar byas pa las/ /rang ngo yud tsam skyong ba sa chod che/ /ngo bo dang ni gnas lugs don gcig yin/ /gnas lugs zhes pa gshis kyi bzhugs tshul lags/ /gshis lugs ma bcos rang bab skyong nus na/ /dgag sgrub spros pa ci yang mi dgos kyang / /thog med 'khrul pa 'di dang 'grogs yun ring / /ma rig bag chags 'thug po tshan che bas/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul 'khor btsan thabs bzlog par dka'/ /des na thabs mkhas rgyal bas gsung pa'i lam/ /thog mar 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin la/ /bsam pa thag pas nges 'byung drag po bskyed/ /srid pa'i bde la zhen pa gting nas ldog /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ma zad par/ /de srid las dang rgyu 'bras mi bslu phyir/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 217rnam pa kun tu las la yid ches pas/ /sgrib sbyong tshogs gsog spang blang ma 'chol bya/ /lha dang bla ma dbyer med nges shes kyi/ /mos gus drag pos rtag tu gsol ba gdab/ /dge sbyor dngos gzhi bla ma'i rnal 'byor brtson/ /thugs yid bsres la bzo med ngang du bzhag /las dang po la lus gnad sems gnad gces/ /goms nas bzo med gnyug mar 'jog pa gces/ /ngo bo mthong nas yid dpyod blo bral gces/ /rtogs pa thob nas tshogs drug lam khyer gces/ /kun la yengs med sgom med dran shes gces/ /de 'bras ring por mi thogs sku gsum po/ /rang gi sems las gzhan du btsal med par/ /thag chod brtan thob yon tan gong 'phel 'gyur/ /gnas sgo drung pa sprul skus bzhed bskul ngor/ /blo gros mtha' yas zhes bya bhu su kus/ /gnas chen de bī ko ṭi'i snying por bris/ /'brel tshad rang ngo mthong nas byang chub phregag /dge legs 'phel// //mos ldan 'ga'i gsal 'debs 'chi khar gtad thub kyi gdams ngag༈ na mo gu sa bsgom pas gnas lugs rtogs 'dod na/ /thog mar zhi gnas rtsa bar brtan/ /bar du lhag mthong rang ngo 'phrod/ /tha ma zung 'jug mthar phyin dgos/ /nyams len snying nas byed pa'i mis/ /zhar byung sgom par don mi 'grub/ /skyo shas nges 'byung gting nas bskyed/ /mi rtag 'chi ba snying la gzer/ /lus ngag yid gsum dben par bsten/ /lus gnad gcun pas sems gnas 'char/ /yugs sas dā phrug skyong ba bzhin/ /skyo ngal med pa'i dran shes brten/ /gnas 'gyu gdam ga mi bya bar/ /gang shar ngo bo ma bcos skyong / /byung gnas 'gro

218 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/gsum rtsad chod nas/ /gzhi med rtsa bral mthong ba'i tshe/ /re dogs dgag sgrub med pa yis/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la bzhag /stong pa gshis kyi rang bab ste/ /gsal ba gnyug ma'i rtsal du grub/ /dbyer med gnas lugs de bzhin nyid/ /ngo shes tsam gyis chog pa min/ /rtag tu goms shing 'dris pa yis/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas/ /rkyen dang 'phrad tshe brtan thob pas/ /'chi khar gtad so yod pa dgos/ /mos ldan 'ga' yi gsal 'debs su/ /blo gros mtha' yas ku swā lis/ /rdzong sar bkra shis lha rtser smras/ /maṅga lam̐// //phyag chen sbyor dngos rjes gsum/༈ na mo gu sa chos sngon 'gro mang du gsungs pa yi/ /don bsdus zhen log nges 'byung yin/ /khyad par bla ma'i mos gus gces/ /sa lam lo zlas bgrod pa yin/ /dngos gzhi'i gnad mang bshad na yang / /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can / /de las zab pa'i chos gzhan med/ /rang sems stong gsal ma 'gags pa/ /sku gsum rang bzhin tshang ba nyid/ /ngo shes dran rdzi brten pa las/ /stong nyid logs su 'tshol mi dgos/ /gnas lugs ma rtogs 'khrul pa yi/ /ma rgan 'gro la snying rje bsgom/ /rjes kyi bya ba mang bshad kyang / /sdig pa byas na 'phral du bshags/ /dge ba gang 'grub sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo bar bya/ /theg pa chen po'i smon lam gdab/ /de skad ri nang mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /bzhed ngor blo gros mtha' yas pas/ /shar mar smras 'dis gzhan phan 3|ga /maṅga le// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 219phyag chen lta sgom spyod 'bras mthar 'khyol gyi man ngagadza/ na mo gu ru be/ lung dang rigs pas 'khor 'das chos kun gyi/ /spros gcod gnas lugs gzhal ba mkhas pa'i lugs/ /shes rab che zhing gnad du rbe1nga ba na/ /lta ba'i rlabs kyis sgom pa'i lam chod kyang / /shes rab dman pas go ba'i gting ma phyin/ /'dzin stangs log pas bdag 'dzin kha snon btab/ /sman nyid dug tu song ba'i skabs kyang mang / /blo dman spros pa sems thog gcod pa nyid/ /bshad nyan dus su rnam dpyod mi che yang / /nyams len sgom pa'i gnad la 'di ka zab/ /go ba chung yang gnas lugs rang zhal mjal/ /shes rab dman kyang spros pa nang nas chod/ /'on kyang nyams len gnad du ma khel na/ /bya sla 'dod chen tsam gyis don mi 'grub/ /de bas srid bder zhen pa gting nas log /'khor ba'i gnas las nges 'byung shugs drag pos/ /nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i skyo shas brtson 'grus kyis/ /mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnad du bsnun/ /dag snang sems bskyed snying rje lam du khyer/ /dran dang shes bzhin gnyis kyi so pa btsugs/ /chos kun rang gi sems su thag chod nas/ /sems kyang gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang las/ /dam pa'i don du gdod nas yod ma myong / /gnas lugs dbyings kyi rang bzhin mkha' lta bu/ /rang byung rig pa gdod nas 'khrul ma myong / /gshis thog bcos med rjen par 'jog pa las/ /sgom pas bcos pa gnas lugs don las gol/ /gshis la bsal bzhag med pa lta ba'i mchog /rig stong rang so zin pa sgom pa'i gnad/ /shar grol dus mnyam ma bcos spyod pa'i rtse/ /dran rtog chos

220 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/skur thim pa 'bras bu dngos/ /nyams len mkhan po stan la 'phongs zug cing / /dbyings rig 'bral med klong du bsran thub pa/ /myur du gdod ma'i grol sar snyog par 'gyur/ /bslab gsum dbang phyug dha dza'i mtshan can gyis/ /bzhed ngor blo gros mtha' yas sprang 'chal pos/ /rdzong sar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwar //shā5// //sems ngo skyong ba'i gces gnad thog mtha' bar gsum/7/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kun snying po sgom la brtson 'dod na/ /thog mar gnas nyams gtan la dbab la gces/ /bar du sems kyi rtsad brdar chod pa gces/ /tha ma lhag mthong rang ngo rig pa gces/ /don la da lta'i rnam rtog skad cig ma/ /'di las gzhan pa'i chos sku ma mchis kyang / /rang ngo ma shes mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rang ngo shes na skad cig gcig la grol/ /rang sems 'dod nas spros bral chos kyi sku/ /mkha' ltar kun khyab mtshan mas gos ma myong / /rtog pa'i sprin ris bzang ngan ci shar yang / /chos dbyings de bzhin nyid las mi 'da' bas/ /sgom 'dod blo yi lhan pa mi gdab par/ /ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa gnas lugs gnyis/ /gol shor bral ba'i nyams len bsran tshugs na/ /goms 'dris brtan pa thob tshe rtsol med du/ /nang gi sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /gcig chod gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par nges /zhes pa'ang sgrub bla ma dge legs rab rgyas kyi nyams bzhes gsal 'debs su blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes dpal spungs yang khrod nas spel ba dge/ //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 221sems nyid mdo rgyud chos kun gyi rtsa bar ngo sprod pa/7/ rje bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /khyed sngon bsags las kyi 'phro ldan pa/ /bka' brgyud pa rin chen chos sgor zhugs/ /chos snying po sgrub la blo kha phyogs/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rnams dang mjal/ /don brgyud pa ma chad byin rlabs thob/ /yid bsam tshad lag thog khel ba de/ /dpe long bas nor bu rnyed pa 'dra/ /da chud zos btang na rang nyid zhan/ /lar dang po'i dad pa na bun 'dra/ /rkyen bser bu langs na yal nyen yod/ /lo nyung ngu'i brtson 'grus shing skam me/ /de snon kha ma btab rgyun mi rtag /las dang po'i lta sgom sos ka'i nyi/ /res 'char bas sems rtsa skyid na yang / /rtag mi thub sgom pa bor snying 'dod/ /de kun la mi rtag lcag 'debs zab/ /'chi nges dang nam 'chi cha med la/ /yid gting nas ches pa'i blo skyes na/ /chos byed pa'i skul ma gzhan mi dgos/ /mdo rgyud kyi chos zab grangs mang yang / /de kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems yin/ /sems 'dul la sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dus/ /de 'dul thabs lugs srol grangs mang yang / /kha nang log ngo bo skyong ba 'di/ /bka' phyag rgya chen po'i myur lam ste/ /dpal grub thob rgya mtsho'i gshegs shul lags/ /sems da lta'i rnam rtog skad cig ma/ /stong bzhin du snang ba sna tshogs shar/ /snang bzhin du ngo bo ma grub stong / /de rang gis rang la rtsad bcad na/ /gzugs gang yang ma grub cir yang snang / /stong phya le gsal la 'dzin rtog med/ /brjod mi shes rang gi myong ba can/ /'di kho na nyid las gzhan du med/ /sems thog ma gnas dgos snyam pa'i tshe/ /skad cig kyang mitshosdod rnam

222 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rtog 'tshubs/ /de sems la bya ra byas pa'i rtags/ /sems re 'ga' dal la re 'ga' brel/ /de gnas nyams cung zad skyes pa'i rtags/ /sems nam bzhag dus su kyi ler gnas/ /de zhi gnas rtsa ba tshugs pa'i rtags/ /de ma byung bar du gnas pa 'tshol/ /yengs ma yengs byar rtse gcig bsgrim/ /las dang po pa la gnas nyams gces/ /sems mi gnas ngo blta bsdam pa na/ /rtogs pa la bogs bskyed thon dus med/ /rgyu zhi gnas med pa'i lhag mthong 'bras/ /rlung drag po'i gseb kyi mar me 'dra/ /nyams brtan nas gnas rgyu'i ngo bor blta/ /cang med pa'i stong par mthong ba de/ /rkyang 'ded kyi ngo lta shes pa'i rtags/ /blta bya la tsir zin mi byed par/ /lta mkhan nyid rang la rang gis ltos/ /de gzhi med rtsa bral ngo bos stong / /gnas 'gyu gnyis dbyer med gcig tu shes/ /lta mkhan gyi rang ngor lhag ger gnas/ /de lhag mthong gi mgo bo zin pa'i rtags/ /de tsam nas dran pa'i bya ra las/ /gnas rgyu yi rjes 'ded byed pa dang / /lta mkhan dang lta yul gnyis 'dzin sogs/ /re dogs kyi 'phrang la mi gshar bar/ /nam dran dran ma bcos lhug par bzhag /don rang bab gnyug ma ma gtogs pa/ /bzo bcos dang dgag sgrub mi dgos na/ /phyag chen gyi sgom lugs shes pa'i rtags/ /sgom de rgyun yun ring bskyang ba na/ /rtogs pa dang 'dra ba'i go ba shar/ /de rjes su 'brangs na sgom chen ldog /bar myong ba skyes nas nyams rtags mang / /der 'dzin zhen che na bdud kyis bslu/ /mthar 'gyur med rtogs pa brtan po thob/ /don rtags med rtags kyi rgyal po 'grub/ /sgom chen la rtag tu gces pa ni/ /mos gus la thang lhod med pa dang / /byams snying rje'i sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /dag snang gi blo rgya yangs por bskyed/ /tshogs bsags kyi rim pa rgyun du brtson/ /rang che yi nga

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 223rgyal rmang nas bshig /gtso mnyam par bzhag dang mi 'bral bar/ /sgom pa'i yun shi dang mnyam nus pa'i/ /tshe sgrub pa mthar phyin gyur pa na/ /yid the tshom mi dgos sa lam chod/ /don rtogs pa'i ye shes rang zhal mjal/ /gzhan 'dri bshad mi dgos rang yid ches/ /blo the tshom mdud pa rang sar zhig /thag chod kyi nges shes nang nas shar/ /sgom chen gyi rgyal sa zin pa lags/ /tshig de skad skyabs che'i sgrub pa po/ /rnal 'byor la gzhol ba tshe yi ming / /yid rtse gcig mos pa'i g.yar ngo ru/ /dpal bka' brgyud rgyal ba yab sras las/ /don brgyud kyi byin rlabs legs thob pa/ /tshul 'du shes gsum 'chang sbong ba pa/ /ming blo gros mtha' yas grags pa des/ /gnas tsā 'dra rin chen brag khrod du/ /smras pa 'dis khyod la sman gyur cig /maṅga le// //rnal 'byor bzhi yi 'char rim gegs sel bogs 'don gyi man ngag༈ na mo gu sa chos kun rtsa ba sems yin pas/ /rang sems ngo bo skyong nus na/ /bslab gnyer gang yang bya mi dgos/ /blo gsal spros pa phyi ru bcad/ /mi tsher bslab sbyangs byas na yang / /kun shes gcig rdugs gyur pa mang / /sgom chen spros pa nang nas bcad/ /nam zhig gnas lugs rtogs pa'i tshe/ /gcig shes kun grol nyid du 'gyur/ /ngo bo yod pa ma yin te/ /rgyal bas kyang ni ma gzigs gsungs/ /yod do snyam na rtag pa'i mtha'/ /rang bzhin med pa ma yin te/ /gsal cha 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ /med do snyam na chad pa'i mtha' mthar 'dzin mu stegs lta dang mtshungs/ /ngo bo shes mkhan dran rig yin/ /de nyid las

224 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dang po la gces/ /dran pa rang yal song ba'i tshe/ /goms 'dris brtan pa thob pa'i tshe/ /chos nyid ngang du 'byams pa la/ /dran pa logs su 'tshol mi dgos/ /bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /ye nas yengs ma myong ba ni/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob 'dres ma yin/ /de la nges shes thag chod dgos/ /sems la gnyis snang med na yang / /yul snang dbyings dang ma khrol na/ /da rung spros bral kha 'byams rtags/ /snang ba'i steng du 'phrig tshud nas/ /snang sems gcig tu 'dres pa'i tshe/ /ro gcig mngon du gyur ba'i rtags/ /snang sems chos nyid dbyings su stong / /bya rgyu med kyang byas go chod/ /bsgom rgyu med kyang the tshom zad/ /bya dang mi bya'i dgag sgrub med/ /bsgom med rgyal sa zin nye'i rtags/ /blun sgom u tshugs can 'ga' re/ /mi tshe zhi gnas tsam po dang / /lhag mthong rtog med ngang la 'byams/ /gnas lugs mngon du gyur dus med/ /skal ldan 'ga' zhig lo zlas kyang / /nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /chos nyid bden pa mngon du gzigs/ /sngon gyi bsags rgyab che chung dang / /mos gus snying rje'i khyad par gda'/ /khyed ni skal ldan brtson 'grus che/ /tshe gcig nyams len byas pa'i 'bras/ /rtogs pa klong du 'gyur nges pas/ /nga rgyal med pa'i nges shes dang / /mos gus snying rjes bogs bton nas/ /sa lam mtha' ru dbyung bar mdzod/ /de skad phyogs med sgrub pa po/ /rtogs ldan chos grags gsung lan du/ /blo gros mtha' yas ku swā lis/ /tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi mdun/ /dben khrod kun bde gling nas phul// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 225dge sbyor khor yug skyong ba'i gnad bar do 'phrang grol/7/ na mo gu sa sems kyis sems la bltas pa'i tshe/ /ngo bo stong pa mkha' 'dra yang / /bem stong cang med ma yin par/ /rang bzhin gsal cha lhag ge ba/ /stong gsal rtsal las bzang ngan gyi/ /rnam rtog snang tshul ci yang 'char/ /shar yang dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /de yi ngo bo rig tsam las/ /bcos med rang sor bzhag pa'i tshe/ /rnam rtog mi 'phro rang bzhin gnas/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams 'char ba/ /zhi gnas zhes bya sgom gyi rkang / /dran shes brtan pas gnas sam 'gyu/ /rang ngo rig thog dbyings su grol/ /lhag mthong zhes bya sgom gyi mig /gnas 'gyu 'dor len mi dgos par/ /gang shar de kas chog pa ni/ /zhi lhag dbyer med bsgom gyi mthil/ /de tsam shes shing skyong ba yi/ /rtogs ldan ming thogs mang na yang / /mi rtag rgyud la ma skyes shing / /tshe 'di'i snang bas blo 'phrog pas/ /brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag dkon/ /long med rgyud la skyes pa'i mi/ /blo sna chos su shugs kyis 'gro/ /nyin mo g.yeng bas bar mi chod/ /rgyu des mtshan snang rtsol med grol/ /nyin mtshan 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor de/ /'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang la de mi bgrod/ /chos sku'i rtsal las gzugs skur shar/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa lhun grub 'gyur/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams ni/ /rig dang ma rig kho na yin/ /rig bya chos dbyings de bzhin nyid/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /sems la mthong bya'i yul dang ni/ /mthong byed yul can med mod kyang / /sems kyi rang rtsal 'gags med du/ /'phro 'du'i rnam

226 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rtog lta ba yin/ /'bor 'das snang ba ji snyed kun/ /rnam rtog skad cig ma yi gzugs/ /rtog pa'i rjes su 'brang ba na/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud/ /thog ma med nas rgyun ma chad/ /da rung de la mtha' yod min/ /rtog pa'i rang ngor bltas pa'i tshe/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang du grol/ /'khrul snang thams cad dbyings su 'gag /de nyid zhi ba mya ngan 'das/ /bden pa mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /rig dang ma rig khyad med kyang / /las dang po yi gang zag rnams/ /nyams len yod med 'dir thug pas/ /dus rgyun rang ngo rig par gyis/ /de la dran shes gnad du zab/ /mkhar mdo dge slong dge sbyong mchog /byams pa ting 'dzin thugs bzhed ltar/ /blo gros mtha' yas blor shar ba/ /gru gu gter rdzong gnas su bris/ /nyid dang gzhan la'ang phan thogs nas/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid ngang grol 3(ga /dge stusprogarba/ khurdophe95// //spang blang mnyam nyid du spyod tshul tshogs drug rang grol/7/ a ho/ gtad med rnal 'byor nga ni gang shar thug 'phrad du spyod pa/ /btsun gzugs smyon pa nga ni ngo tsha 'dzem bag dang bral ba/ /rig 'dzin sngags 'chang nga ni rtog med zang thal du 'byams klas/ /kun bzang rgyal brgyud nga ni 'khor 'das bar lag ni 'gyel 'dra/ /rgod tshang grub thob min kyang tshogs drug ye shes kyi dbyings grol/ /'brug gtsang rnam gnyis min yang thabs lam bde chen gyis rtag myos/ /khams dgus smyon pa min yang snyems byed ngar 'dzin ni thog brdzis/ /gling pa rnam lnga min yang zab gter bang mdzod la longs spyod/ /rang rig mngon du

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 227gyur tshe cir snang ye shes kyi 'bor lo/ /'brul pa'i rtsa ba zhig tshe rtogs pa'i rtse mo ni rno ngar/ /re dogs 'ching ba grol tshe rang snang dgung ltar du mtho ba/ /sgyu ma'i yul snang 'grib tshe kun la gza' gtad dang bral song / /dgag sgrub mtha' dang bral ba'i rig pa dri med kyi nam mkha'/ /gos bral gcer bu bzhin du mtshan nyid mngon sum du mthong bas/ /'khrul snang sems kyi sprin tshogs 'du 'god sna tshogs su snang yang / /phan gnod ci yang med pa'i yid ches gdeng chen 'dra thob bo/ /rang rig 'od gsal klong du yul snang rtog med kyi gzugs brnyan/ /gang shar bde ba chen po'i yo lang rgyun chad ni med pas/ /rtsol sgrub ngal bar ma ltos chos nyid bden pa'i don mthong ba/ /gu ru sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i byin rlabs gzi brjid kyis reg snyam/ /ye nas bsal bzhag med pa chos kun gdod ma yi gshis lugs/ /sangs rgyas sgam pos ma bcos sems can sgrin po yis ma bslad/ /rang snang ris med chen po ka dag zang thal gyi ngang nas/ /rnal 'byor nga yi lta ba dri med nam mkha' dang mtshungs so/ /'khrul rtog sems su shar yang gdod nas gshis lugs la ma gos/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum thal ba'i rig pa rang so ru bzhag pas/ /shar grol gnyis su med pa'i ye grol cog bzhag gi dgongs pa/ /rnal 'byor nga yi sgom pa 'od gsal nyi zla dang mtshungs so/ /nyon mongs bud shing med na ye shes me dpung yang mnal nas/ /dug lnga'i dmag dpung nang du gnyen po gdung khyer du zhugs pas/ /tshogs drug yul snang kun la spang blang mnyam nyid du gdal ba/ /rnal 'byor nga yi spyod pa bar snang rlung chen dang mtshungs so// //

228 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/zab lam phyag rgya chen po'i sgom rim gnad bsdus/7/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/de'i ched du zab lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya snyam pa'i sgo nas/ thog mar rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos gus kha zhe med par byas nas spyi bor bsgom/ bdag gi phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba btab la/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang dang gnyis su med par thim par mos nas mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da ltar skad cig ma la gang shar ba de la re dogs spang blang dgag sgrub the tshom spu tsam mi bya bar/ lhod de/ shig ge me re/ had de/ chem mer ma yengs par bzhag ma 'khrul bar bzhag de tshe 'gyu ba phra rags bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ci byung yang dga' sdug spang blang med par 'dzin med du bzhag shar grol du btang / yang gnas tshe de'i ngo bo yengs med du skyong / yang 'phro na 'phro mkhan gyi rnam rtog gcig 'byams gnyis 'byams su mi mthud par de'i ngo bor blta zhing yengs su mi 'jug ste/ ma yengs tsam du ngo bo skyong / de ltar gnas 'gyu gnyis/gnas pa dang 'gyu ba rig mkhan gyi rig pa gsum so so ma yin tha mi dad kyang dper na me long du shar ba'i gzugs brnyan/ rang gi gzugs rig mkhan gyi mig gi rnam par shes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar gnas 'gyu res mos la dus rgyun du/ za 'gro/ nyal 'dug dal brel/ shi gson/ dgra gyod/ 'khyag ltog bde sdug gang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 229byung de'i dbang du mi gtang bar de rnams 'gro 'ong gnas gsum 'dug gam mi 'dug brtag pas skad cig ma'i shes pa ma bcos pa de'i ngo bor grol ba las med gsungs/ de ltar shes pa ngal dub khams gsal rnyogs dang bstun nas bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi ltar yang yang gsal gdab par bya/ rnam dkar dam pa'i lha chos che phra gang byed kyang sems bskyed rgya chen dang smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs la mkha' khyab ma rgan la bsngo/ dus rgyun thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du yengs med 'khrul med che 'di'i bya bzhag bzang ngan thams cad mdang zhag gi rmi lamadang khyad par med par blta zhing bden 'dzin a 'thas mi bya/ snang srid thams cad la bden 'dzin zhig pa zhig nges par dgos gsungs pas/ de bzhin 'da' kha 'chi brod mdzad 'tshal// // thar pa'i rgyal sar 'jug pa'i nyams len gnad bsdus/7/ na mo gu sa mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag thams cad nas/ /rang gi sems nyid sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ /de nyid rtogs na chos kun 'dus par gsungs/ /yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rang sems gdod ma nas/ /rig stong 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /de yi rang rtsal 'khor 'das chos rnams shar/ /rtogs na sangs rgyas ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /de phyir sems kyi rtsa ba gcig chod na/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnad 'gag khrol ba yin/ /'di don dang por thos shing bar du bsam/ /mtha' mar bsgom pas gtan la 'bebs dgos kyang / /sgrub brgyud ku swā li pa phal cher gyis/ /spros pa rang gi sems thog bcad pa las/ /phyi yi spros

230 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pa rang chod phyag len mdzad/ /de la thog mar gnas nyams brtan pos bsgrub/ /'gyu dran byung gnas 'gro sogs rtsad brdar bcad/ /gnas 'gyu dbyer med brjod bral blo 'das kyi/ /gnas lugs phyogs tsam go bas lam du khyer/ /bar du bzo bcos med par gnyug ma'i ngang / /rang bab dran dang shes bzhin mi 'bral bar/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs pas nyams myong skye/ /tha mar bla ma'i byin rlabs lam du bslang/ /dge sbyor snying po mos gus snying rje'i mthus/ /tha mal shes pa chos kyi sku ru shar/ /rang rig dri med snying gi dbus su sad/ /dgag sgrub the tshom spros pa nang nas chod/ /blo 'das phyag rgya chen po mngon du rtogs/ /rang sems rang la yod pas gzhan dag nas/ /'tshol du med phyir shes par sla mod kyang / /shes tsam gyis ni nyams len go mi chod/ /rtag tu dran shes 'bral med skyong nus dgos/ /dran rdzi med na rgyal bu gsang 'khyams 'dra/ /yengs med dran pa'i rtsa ba brtson 'grus yin/ /chos kyi phyogs su brtson 'grus byed pa la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong ba'i zhen log dang / /srid der nges 'byung drag po med thabs med/ /de phyir bsgom gyi rtsa ba de nyid gtso/ /chos brgyad snying la zhen pa'i rtogs ldan dang / /zhen log nges 'byung bral ba'i sgom chen dang / /dag snang chung zhing las 'bras mi brtsi ba'i/ /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams kyis rang gzhan bslu/ /bslu med rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang por/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i phyag bzhes ma 'khrul bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu slob pa'i smon 'dun dang / /mi 'bral thar pa'i rgyal sar 'jug par mdzod/ /ces nyams len gnad bsdus nyung ngu 'di'ang 'gro 'dren gnas mdo gcod bla sprul pa'i sku karma thub bstan rab 'phel dpon slob kyi bzhed ngor/ blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes sde dge lhun sdo/ba steng nas phul ba dge legs 'phel// //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 231thos grol nyams snang dga' glu/7/ rje 'chi med padma'i mdzad pa dran/ /skyabs o rgyan gu ru'i bka' drin dran/ /spyir grub thob rnams kyi rnam thar dran/ /sgos sgrub brgyud gong ma'i ngo mtshar dran/ /bdag snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon thugs rje ma chung byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas g.ya' gangs brag ri nags khrod 'grim/ /zas chags med zhen med tshogs su rol/ /gos dro 'khyags bzod tsam gang byung gyon/ /grogs dam tshig gtsang ba su rnyed 'grogs/ /las blang dor med par thad kar spyod/ /tshul 'di 'dra byed pa'i mi re skyid/ /don 'di mtha' 'byol na dga' ba la/ /pha gu ru'i bka' lung ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan tshul 'chos bya bzhag blo yis btang / /dus de 'dra'i skabs su sleb tsa na/ /tshig tha snyad rjes su ma 'brang yang / /don kun bzang dgongs pa snying la shar/ /blo re dogs mdud pa khong nas grol/ /sems gang shar chos sku'i dbyings su gnas/ /gdeng rang byung rig pa'i ngang du 'cha'/ /'brul rtog tshogs nyon mongs sprin gtibs kyang / /dbyings ka dag mkha' las g.yos pa med/ /phan ma btags gnod pa ma bskyal zhing / /kun ma spangs ye shes rol pa'i rgyan/ /phar dgag bya'i dgos pa gting nas sangs/ /tshur bsgrub bya'i re ba rtsad nas zad/ /shar grol la ye shes re ba dang / /'gyu stong la chos skur gdags pa dang / /'dzin stangs la rtogs par rlom pa sogs/ /'phrang che chung la rtsal mchongs byas nas su/ /tshig 'di thos med par don rtsa go /ngo sus sprad med par rang zhal mjal/ /lam 'dir bgrod med par dgos sar bslebs/ /bdag rang

232 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rgyus med pa dgod bag bro/ /mkha' sprin bral lta bu'i ka dag dbyings/ /zang thal gyi rig pa 'od gsal ba/ /ye gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i gshis/ /'khrul pa dang grol ba ming du zad/ /'khor ba dang myang 'das btags pa tsam/ /gnyis 'dzin du snang ba zhabrul pa'i sems/ /sems gdod ma'i gshis su grub ma myong / /ma grub pa'i dbyings su la zlo ba/ /nga sprang 'chal rnal 'byor khyad chos te/ /gzhan phal pa'i blo la ma shong yang / /rje padma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs kyi rig 'dzin yin pa'i rtags/ /dpal o rgyan yab yum byin brlabs pa/ /gnas ngo mtshar dkar mo stag tshang du/ /nyams snang ba dga' ba'i glu ru blangs/ /tshig 'di yang thos grol dus mnyam shog/ //phyag rjerdogs tshe gcig thar lam/༈ na mo gu ru be/ dal 'byor lan gcig thob 'dir dud 'gro ltar/ /yengs ma lam du chud zos mi btang bar/ /phyi ma'i don bsgrub de la grangs mang yang / /stong nyid snying rje zung lacag kho nar dril/ /de yi srog rtsa dran dang shes bzhin bsten/ /de don mthar thug phyag chen rdzogs chen lags/ /blo sna mi mang brtson 'grus mthar phyin na/ /tshe gcig thar pa'i lam bzang bgrod par 'gyur/ /ces 'bras ldongs bla ma o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi thugs bzhed ltar blo gros mtha' yas kyis phul ba dge/ //

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 233gdams ngag nyams len gnad bsdus/7/ 'dir snang sgyu ma'i chos la blo gtad spangs/ /gnyis 'dzin zhabrul pa'i rtsa ba meng nas bshigs/ /nyams la ma zhen rtogs pa'i gdeng chen tshogs/ /sgom med rtogs kyang yengs med dran pa bsten/ /mos gus snying rje thang lhod ma shor 'tshal/ /gdams ngag nyams len gnad bsdus de la mjordod// //rang mtshang phud pa'i do ha gzhi thog rtsal rdzogs/7/ na mo gu ru bhya: gangs can bla ma'i skal pa padma 'byung / /khyad par nga yi skyabs gcig mtsho skyes rje/ /dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma rin po cher/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rjes 'jug rnal 'byor phyi zhig nang stong ngas/ /mgon khyod skyabs su bsnyen pa'i bka' drin las/ /skad snyan med kyang glu zhig len snying 'dod/ /spobs pa dman yang 'phyor cig sgrog snying 'dod/ /rnal 'byor nga la nga gcig mi zer te/ /col chung nga ni mtshan ldan bla ma'i bu/ /gcig shes kun la 11la bas nam mkha' 'dra/ /yang dag gtugs na khab mig bzhin du dog /rig 'dzin nga la nga gcig mi zer te/ /sngags 'chang nga ni o rgyan padma'i rigs/ /yin rtags shugs 'byung bstan dus grub thob 'dra/ /yang dag gtugs na nus med tha mal pa/ /'khrul zhig nga la nga gcig mi zer te/ /col chung nga ni sgrub brgyud brgyad srol skyong / /gang yang bza' gtad med pas smyon pa 'dra/ /yang

234 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dag gtugs na pha waṃ las kyang ljid/ /rtogs ldan nga la nga gcig mi zer te/ /blun sgom nga ni dwags shangs bka' brgyud pa/ /bzo med gnyug ma skyong bas glen pa 'dra/ /yang dag gtugs na sgom pa dbyings su stor/ /bla ma nga la nga gcig mi zer te/ /ser gzugs nga ni mkhas grub mang po'i sras/ /mang thos lag len btab pas tshong dpon 'dra/ /yang dag gtugs na byar med nam mkha'i klong / /de ring khog tu ma bskyil kha la gyer/ /kha la gyer yang gting la ci yang med/ /med pa'i dbyings su chos kun 'ub kyis rdzogs/ /'od gsal thig le chen por phyam brdal lo/ /chos kun gdod nas ma skyes stong pa nyid/ /gar yang mi 'gag cir yang gnas pa med/ /snang tsam ma 'gags rten cing 'brel 'byung tshul/ /rnal 'byor nga yi lta ba rang stong yin/ /brjod du med kyang brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /'od gsal rang bzhin 'khor 'das kun la khyab/ /brtag pas mi mtshon dpyad pa'i blos mi reg /rnal 'byor nga yi sgom pa gzhan stong yin/ /rtog pa glo rdeg gang dran thad kar spyod/ /'dod yon lam khyer re dogs mtha' gnyis bcad/ /gzung 'dzin mdud pas dbu ma'i dbyings su gzhil/ /rnal 'byor nga yi spyod pa zhi gcod yin/ /ma bcos tha mal shes pa skad cig ma/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam gang shar chos kyi sku/ /yengs med sgom med rang bab gnyug ma'i 'gros/ /rnal 'byor nga yi nyams len phyag chen yin/ /ye nas 'khrul ma myong bas grol rgyu med/ /stong gsal zung 'jug sku gsum gshis la rdzogs/ /sems kyi gos bral rig stong rjen pa'i ngang / /rnal 'byor nga yi snying thig rdzogs chen yin/ /ka dag dbyings kyi rang bzhin yangs pa che/ /klong yangs nam mkha' gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ /phyogs su ma lhung gar yang rgya ma chad/ /rnal 'byor nga ni rang snang ris med dang / /rang byung

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 235rig pa'i rgyal po bdal sa che/ /thig le bdal bas mtha' dbus med par khyab/ /dgag tu med cing bsgrub byar cang ma mchis/ /rnal 'byor nga yi rig pa rang sar grol/ /gnas lugs gang yang dbyings las gaskusnas pa med/ /snang lugs thams cad rig pa'i rtsal du shar/ /yin lugs shes na kun kyang de bzhin nyid/ /rnal 'byor rtogs tshogs dbyings kyi rgyan du rdzogs/ /'khor 'das snang ba ma skyes gnyug ma'i ngang / /zang thal rig pa 'gag med 'od du gsal/ /zung 'jug gang yang yin la cir yang min/ /rnal 'byor gnas lugs cog bzhag klong du bde/ /rang rig ye shes kun khyab 'od du gsal/ /legs par smin pas rang snang lha skur shar/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su 'khrul pa btsan thabs sangs/ /rnal 'byor gcer mthong klong du gtad med grol/ /sus kyang ma bcings cis kyang bkrol ba med/ /sor bzhag rgyal po ye babs lhun 'byams ngang / /gtad med ngang du byar med gnyid log pas/ /rnal 'byor dran pa'i brtod phur dbyings su stor/ /'jur bu'i mdud pa rang bab ngang du grol/ /dran pa'i dmigs gtad chos nyid dbyings su zhig /klong yangs chen por ye shes phyam brdal bas/ /rnal 'byor sems la rtsis gdab gang yang med/ /yul snang 'dod yon lnga yi dga' ma la/ /rang grol rig pa'i skyes bus rtag tu 'khyud/ /blang dor gnyis med bde ba chen por 'byams/ /rnal 'byor thabs kyi lam las rnam par grol/ /lta bas ma bslad sgom pa'i 'ching ba bral/ /spyod pas ma bcos gnas lugs gdod ma'i gshis/ /naskamakha'i klong du rtogapa'i sprin ris yal/ /rnal 'byor gnyer kha med pas ci byas bde/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i mtshan 'dzin ri bong rwa/ /chos dang chos can rnam 'byed mo gsham bu/ /'khrul grol spang gnyen nam mkha'i padmo bzhin/ /rnal 'byor lta ba med pa'i

236 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/dbyings su rdzogs/ /rig pa'i ye shes rgyar chad phyogs lhung bral/ /brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kun la mkha' ltar khyab/ /lhun 'byams bdal sa chos nyid yangs pa che/ /rnal 'byor sgom pa phyal ba'i dbyings su rdzogs/ /dgag sgrub rtog pa ka dag chen po'i ngang / /bya rtsol mtshan ma smra bsam brjod bral klong / /'od gsal thig le nyag gcig 'ub chub pas/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa gcig pu'i dbyings su rdzogs/ /'khor ba ma spangs cir snang rgyal ba'i zhing / /myang 'das ma btsal thams cad gzhi la rdzogs/ /rtse mo byung rgyal grol sar ngang gis bsnyegs/ /rnal 'byor 'bras bu lhun grub dbyings su rdzogs/ /dang po 'du byed rtog pas lha sku bcos/ /bar du rang gsal ma 'gags lhag ger shar/ /tha ma cir snang rang byung lha ru shes/ /rnal 'byor spros bcas bskyed pa'i rim pa yin/ /dang po go ba'i stong nyid blo phugs gtad/ /bar du byin rlabs las 'phros rang zhal mthong / /tha ma dbyings las rig pa'i ye shes sad/ /rnal 'byor spros med rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin/ /snang ba'i ngo bo gshis lugs babs kyis stong / /stong pa'i rang mdangs ma 'gags cir yang snang / /rgyas gdab mi dgos gdod nas lhun gyis grub/ /rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams len yin/ /so thar spyod dus mngon lkog khyad par che/ /byang sems bslab dus rang nyid nyams kyis dogs/ /sngags dus phyi nang dkyil 'khor gsum dang bral/ /rnal 'byor sdom gsum ldan pa'i rnam thar yin/ /rang don zhe la bzhag nas chos gzugs byas/ /gzhan don mi 'grub bzhin du dkor nag zos/ /nam phugs snying po med kyang bya byed mang / /rnal 'byor rang mgo rang gaskurdzogs gya ma do/ /bslab shes mang yang mkhas pa'i lag rjes chung / /mtshams sgrub byas kyang grub pa'i rtsal ma rdzogs/ /'chad nyan mang yang brgyud 'dzin slob

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 237ma dkon/ /rnal 'byor ci byas cang med yug sa rkyang / /rtogs pa'i gdeng gis rkyen ngan stobs mi chom/ /rig pa'i rtsal gyis brtul zhugs spyod mi nus/ /dgongs pa'i stobs kyis 'khrul snang zil mi non/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po lta ba kha khye ra lags/ /mkhas pa'i khog pa tha snyad tshwa chus sbos/ /grub pa'i spyod pa khyi phag rjes su 'brang / /btsun pa tshul khrims mchog 'dzin lam du khyer/ /snyigs dus bdag 'dra'i ngang tshul bshad ci 'tshal/ /bshad lugs bltas na su yang sangs rgyas dngos/ /byed lugasartsobaltas na thams cad sems can nyid/ /nga dang nga 'dra rnams la ci zhig smos/ /brjod med dbyings su grol ba'i bkra shis shog /ming ma yin don gyi kun spong pa/ /dad dam ldan 'jam dbyangs dge legs gang / /'phral 'khor ba spangs nas chos sgor zhugs/ /tshig tha snyad ma sbyangs sgrub la brtson/ /sems blun sgom ma byas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /rgyu bsags sbyangs rim pa mtha' ru phyin/ /rkyen bla ma yi dam byin rlabs kyis/ /don rtogs pa'i rang zhal mjal ba yi/ /mgron dga' ston zang zing mi 'dug kyang / /thugs bzhed bzhin padma gar dbang pas/ /gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rdzong shod du/ /tshig nges med do has rang mtshang phud/ /glu 'brel med rang byung smras pa yis/ /deng phyin chad rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ /dpal yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong du 'phel/ /gzhi thog tu dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs shog/ //kun 'dus gzhi med klong grol/7/ gzhi med klong grol bla ma kun tu bzang / /rang rig ngo bor 'bral med gsol

238 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/ba 'debs/ /bdag dang rigs drug 'khesar ba'i sems can rnams/ /gzhi med klong du grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das lam gsum kun tu brtags pa'i chos/ /stong pa'i dbyings las gsal ba'i rig rtsal du/ /shar yang mkha' la 'byung bzhi'i 'du 'god ltar/ /gdod ma nyid nas gzhi med klong grol lo/ /phung po lngas bsdus 'khor ba'i chos rnams dang / /sku dang zhing khams myang 'das 'dzin pa yang / /rtog 'khrul sngags kyis bslad pa'i gnyis snang ste/ /sgyu ma lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /ye gzhi'i gshis la cir yang grub pa med/ /bdag tu rtog las rang mdangs gzhan du snang / /snang yang bden par ma grub dri za yi/ /grong khyer lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /dbyings las rig rtsal g.yos pa'i skad cig mar/ /gnyis 'dzin sems kyi rten 'brel lu gu brgyud/ /'byung ldog spel ma 'di yang 'ja' tshon ni/ /chu zla lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /skye bzhi lam rgyud lngas bsdus 'khor ba pa/ /don gyi dbyings la gsal 'grib med bzhin du/ /bdag 'dzin nad kyis bsgribs pas log par mthong / /mig g.yor lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gzugs phung rnams/ /thogs med bag chags ring du goms pa'i mthu/ /don du med pa gsal ba'i me long gi /gzugs brnyan lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /sgra skad snyan dang mi snyan 'dzin pa yi/ /blang dor 'dis kyang col chung byis pa slu/ /gcig la gcig brten rang bzhin med pa'i ngag /brag cha lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /wal po rjes med rnam rtog chu gnyer la/ /zad du med pas brtsi bgrang byed pa 'brul/ /dgon pa'i ri dwags smig rgyu'i mtshang rig ltar/ /rang mtshang rtogs na gzhi med klong grol lo/ /dga' bas sems dang sdug bsngal yid gdung ba/ /bar ma btang snyoms

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 239gyur pa'i tshor ba kun/ /yod pa ltar snang mi brtan 'pho zhing 'gyur/ /zil pa lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /mtshan med dbyings kyi rgya mtsho gting zab las/ /mtshan 'dzin blo yi chu bur rkyen gyis brdol/ /'du shes yangs dog sdug bsngal nyer len kyang / /rang sar bzhag na gzhi med klong grol lo/ /chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i nam mkha' las/ /gzung 'dzin dbang gis 'du byed sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ /gcig las mang 'phel las nyon char pa babs/ /rtsa ba chod na gzhi med klong grol lo/ /chags sdang rmongs sogs glo bur nyon mongs sems/ /rjes su 'brang dang spang sgyur thabs kyang 'khrul/ /skad cig rkyen byung glog gi gar mkhan 'dra/ /rang ngo shes na gzhi med klong grol lo/ /gang nas ma 'phos cir yang mi dmigs kyang / /rtog 'khrul dbang gis bde sdug sna tshogs spyod/ /las dang las kyi 'bras bu bcas pa yang / /rmi lam lta bur gzhi med klong grol lo/ /rtog pas bris pa'i bzang ngan ri mo kun/ /bden par bzung na thog mtha' med par 'khor/ /rtsa ba chod na mkhan po mi rnyed pas/ /gnyis snang thams cad gzhi med klong grol lo/ /rnam rtog ji ltar shar yang 'khrul pa'i sems/ /de la bltas pas chos nyid don mi mthong / /gshis lugs ngang du tsam gyis bzhag pa na/ /rang rig rgyal po gzhi med klong grol lo/ /'od gsal gshis kyi gnas lugs 'gyur ba med/ /ye shes yangs pa'i spyod yul bsam mi khyab/ /ltar med sgom med bya rtsol las 'das pa'i/ /cog bzhag chen por gzhi med klong grol lo/ /rang grol nyid ma bskyar grol ma dgos pas/ /lhug par gnas pas rang rig gzhi la rdzogs/ /ma btsal lhun grub 'bras bu rang las rnyed/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su gzhi med klong grol lo/ /gnas mchog bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rdzong shod du/ /lugs gnyis bya

240 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bzhag gzhi med 〈snang grol ba/ /blo ༷thos mtha' yas sems la shar nas smras/ /khams gsum 'khor ba gzhi med klong grol the(ga /sarba maṅga lo// //rtse mo byung rgyal gyi lta sgom spyod 'bras/༈ rtse mo byung rgyal 'di rdzogs chen gyi lta ba/ /lta ba'i rtse mo ni chos nyid la thug pas/ /blos byas lta ba yis cha tsam yang mi phyin/ /ka dag byung rgyal gyis 'khor 'das kun zang thal/ /klong yangs phyam brdal gyi gshis lugs 'di bde'o/ /rtse mo byung rgyal 'di rdzogs chen gyi sgom pa/ /sgom pa'i rtse mo ni dbyings rig la thug pas/ /yid dpyod sgom pa yis cha tsam yang mi phyin/ /lhun grub byung rgyal gyis cir snang kun 'od gsal/ /rang snang ris med kyi ltad mo 'di mtshar ro/ /rtse mo byung rgyal 'di rdzogs chen gyi spyod pa/ /spyod pa'i rtse mo ni rang bab la thug pas/ /mtshan 'dzin spyod pa yis cha tsam yang mi phyin/ /ma bcos byung rgyal gyis blang dor kun mnyam nyid/ /rang shar rang grol gyi blo bde 'di skyid do/ /rtse mo byung rgyal 'di rdzogs chen gyi 'bras bu/ /'bras bu'i rtse mo ni ye gzhi la thug pas/ /'chi grol rtsol sgrub kyis cha tsam yang mi phyin/ /btsal med byung rgyal gyis 'khor 'das kun dbyer med/ /ye shes rang gsal gyi dgongs pa 'di mtho'o/ /rtse mo byung rgyal 'di rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor/ /rnal 'byor rtse mo ni blo bral la thug pas/ /yin snyam 〉tem chen gyis cha tsam yang mi phyin/ /rtsa med byung rgyal gyis snang sems kun la zla/ /gu yangs rgya yan gyi nyams len 'di zab bo/ /rdzogs pa chen po ni lta sgom gyi yang rtse/ /rnal 'byor nga rang ni tha mal gyi gral mtha'/ /skyid sdug med ngang la mi

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 241tshe 'khyams pas/ /rtsa rtse go log tu 'byung nyen 'dug go /rdzogs pa chen po la thams cad rdzogs kyang / /yid dpyod la sgom can rdzogs dus mi 'dug /da ni blos byas kyi khur po bor la/ /byar med klong yangs kyi mal du nyol cig /re med dogs med kyi sdod tshugs zin na/ /rtsa rtse gnyis po yang gzhi med rtsa bral/ /gang snang chos nyid kyi yo lang chen por/ /mnyam rdzogs phyal pa yi grub mthar snyeg go /ban rgan spyo tshab can padma gar dbang / /thol byung nya mas shar gyi srin bu'i sug rjes/ /rtog pa'i chu gnyer la zad mtha' med kyang / /zegs ma phra mo 'di 'thor nas thal lo/ /sarba maṅga lo// //gter chos dang 'brel ba'i dri lan/༈ rje btsun ma hā gu rur 'dud/ /deng sang snyigs dus mtha' la thug /bod khams bstan 'gror 'tshe ba mang / /de la skyob byed skyes bu yang / /gsar rnying kun la mang du byon/ /khyad par gter ston mang byung ba/ /dri med lhun po ratna gling / /gtso gyur tshad ma'i lung las gsal/ /de mtshungs lha min cho 'phrul yang / /byung dang 'byung 'gyur yongs su grags/ /gang zag rgyud tshod sangs rgyas las/ /gzhan gyis rtogs par mi 'gyur phyir/ /mtha' gcig kha tshon gcod dka' yang / /gter dag e 'ong gang zag la/ /rag las gu ru padmas gsungs/ /bstan 'gror phan nges dam pa yi/ /rnam thar gtsang na mir ma zad/ /mi min rnams kyang bkur bar 'gyur/ /de min rdzun gyi 'phrul 'khor dang / /phyogs ris khengs pas dregs la sogs/ /ltar snang yon tan ci bzang yang / /nam phugs bstan 'gro phung ba'i

242 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/'dre/ /de 'dra byung ba'ang grangs mang phyir/ /so skye mngon shes mi ldan pa/ /bdag 'dras gang zag ris med pa/ /kun la dag snang sbyong ba las/ /mchog dman dbye ba'i nus pas dben/ /'on kyang thos mang legs bshad ni/ /gter la re dogs dor nas su/ /rang rgyud las su rung bar 'tshal/ /re dogs bdud kyi g.yab mo yin/ /'bad med byung na dngos grub ste/ /de yang gzab nas 'tsho shes dgos/ /rang don ma grub gzhan don ni/ /ji ltar brtsams kyang 'bras bus dben/ /des na rang nyid brtan thob nas/ /'gro don shugs 'byung smon lam zhu/ /ces pa 'di phyis byon gter ston zhig gis khong la gter chos yod pa tshad ldan yin min dang da phyin 'dor len ci byed dri ba byung ba'i lan du brjod pa'o/ /maṅga lo// //bslab bya legs par ba 〉dud pa skabs bzhi pa/7/ legs bshad gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen las byung / /des gsungs rnam pa thams cad du/ /tshad ma nyid phyir dang bar byos/ /dal 'byor 'di ni thob par dka'/ /de bas chos dang mjal bar dka'/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan tsam yang / /thos pas 'khor ba mtha' can byed/ /gsum la rtag tu skyabs 'gro zhing / /snying nas yid ches ldan par 'tshal/ /'di ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags/ /skyabs 'a1sto phal cher tshig tsam ste/ /gsum la yid ches ldan pa'ang dkon/ /de ltas dge ba gang bsgrubs kyang / /mngon mtho'i bde 'bras tsam du zad/ /rang gi las ngan smin pa'i tshe/ /blo chung 'ga' zhig log par blta/ /thog med dge rtsa gcod byed pa'i/ /las de dug bzhin spang bar rigs/ /skyes tshad

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 243thams cad 'chi ba ste/ /rang nyid mi 'chi bsam mi 'tshal/ /de dbang bdag la yod ma yin/ /'chi yang skrag par mi 'gyur na/ /de blo phyugs dang mtshungs pa ste/ / de yi gdeng ni ci zhig yod/ /nam 'chi'i dus btab ma mchis shing / /'chi bdag nam 'ong cha med la/ /'chi dus chos kyis phan pas na/ /myur du chos la 'bad par 'tshal/ /dam chos rgyal bas gsungs de bsgrub/ /mdo rgyud dag dang mi mthun pa'i/ /byas chos mi tshe 'dzad pa'i rgyu/ /rjes kyi nang nas glang po dang / /me tog nang nas padma nga/kar/ /'du shes nang nas mi rtag pa/ /mchog ces rkang gnyis gtso bos gdams/ /snyigs dus mi tshe shin tu thung / /dgun gyi nyi bzhin yad yud 'dzad/ /bu nor khang khyim shul du lus/ /gcer bu lag pa stong pa ru/ /gcig pur 'jig rten pha rol 'gro/ /de dag don du sdig spyod pa'i/ /rnam par smin pas rang nyid brlag /mi rtag dran na dgos med dran/ /de yis tshe 'dir blo log pas/ /gang byas chos dang mthun par 'gyur/ /nad med chos dang 'byor pa sogs/ /bsgrub phyir ltar snang chos spyod pa/ /nor bu phye dang brjes pa bzhin/ /dge rtsa rnam smin chung ngur 'dzad/ /stobs 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags sogs/ /skye sngon rnam dkar bsags pa'i 'bras/ /bsod nams ldan na shugs kyis 'byung / /rtsol bas bsgrub kyang 'grub par dka'/ /dge ba'i 'phen shugs zad pa na/ /de dag rmi lam bzhin du yal/ /'jig rten pha rol lta ci smos/ /da lta nyid du'ang phan mi 'gyur/ /de bas phun sum tshogs 'dod na/ /nyo tog 'dod pas sa bon bzhin/ /sbyin sogs dge la brtson par 'tshal/ /dge bas pha rol lta ci smos/ /skye 'dir mngon suX phan gdags 'gyur/ /rang blo lkog tu ma gyur pas/ /rang gi rgyud tshod rang gis bzung / /bdag ni spyan lnga mi ldan pas/ /mi shes snyam du khengs bskyungs

244 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas la/ /gzhan gyi rgyud chosad bzung mi bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sna tshogs spyod pa'i tshul ston pa/ /so skye'i blo yis mi rtogs pas/ /cung zad khros sam brnyas pas kyang / /bskal par dmyal ba'i gnas su skye/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can/ /mthar ni 'tshang rgyar 'gyur ba nyid/ /kun la dga' zhing 'dun par bya/ /nga nyid bzang zhes gzhan brnyas pa/ /de yis rang nyid tshe 'dir brlag /phyi mar yi dwags 'gro bar skye/ /mir skyes na yang bran du 'gyur/ /gzhan skyon brtag la mkhas pa rnams/ /rang gi skyon ni yongs mi shes/ /gzhan skyon rtog pa'ang rang gi skyon/ /rang rgyud las su rung ba'i tshe/ /skyon yang yon tan nyid du 'char/ /gzhan skyon ji ltar che yang rung / /rang la gnod pa byed mi 'gyur/ /rang gi skyon gyis rang nyid brlag /de bas rnam kun rang skyon brtag /gzhan gyi skyon ni 'tshol mi bya/ /spyir yang skyon yon 'byed par dka'/ /skyon gyi phung po chen po la/ /rmongs pas ngo mtshar nyid du 'jin/ /skal ngan nga rgyal ldan pa dag /yon tan la yang skyon du mthong / /gang zag mchog la skyon brjod na/ /rang gi bsod nams phyags mas 'ded/ /dad pa sangs rgyas chos kyi ma/ /yon tan kun skyed sa gzhi yin/ /dad dang gus pa 'tshol bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes rabs dang / /gong ma'i rnam thar ris med mjal/ /de las dang ba'i dad pa skye/ /dge dang sdig pa'i las 'bras dang / /chos kyi phan yon rtag tu bsam/ /yid ches dad skye de dag las/ /byang chub 'dod pa 'i dad pa skye/ /dad las mos pa skye 'gyur zhing / /mos pas dam chos 'tshol bar byed/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la phyogs ris med/ /ris su gcod pa blun po'i lugs/ /bod kyi chos lugs thams cad kyang / /rgyud srol so so'i gang zag ste/ /'byung khungs thub pa'i bka' ru gcig /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 245byang chub lam ni kun la yod/ /bshad sgrub phyag rjes re yang mchis/ /gang la bzang dang ngan mthong ba/ /de blo phyogs su lhung ba'i rtags/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i blo ldan ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la snyoms/ /de bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol/ /sdig pa'i bshes grogs ring du spong / /dge ba'i lam ston de ni bshes/ /sdig la sbyor ba gang yin bdud/ /gang zhig ltar snang chos ston cing / /tshul 'chos tshe 'di'i che thabs bsgrubs/ /phyogs ris nga rgyal 'dod sred che/ /snying rje chung sogs mi dge'i bshes/ /deng sang dus kyi dbang gis mang / /de 'dra'i rjes su zhugs pa na/ /kha zas dug can zos pa ltar/ /'phral la bde ba ltar snang yang / /nam phugs gnod pa chen po skyed/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin phyin chad/ /gsung de chos dang mthun pa dgos/ /spyod lam tsam la snying po med/ /rtsod dang chags sdang lhur len pa'i/ /bshes gnyen de yang spang bar bya/ /chags dang sdang bas bslad pa yi/ /so skye'i yid la mi 'thad pa/ /de 'dra chos log yin nges med/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun pa/ /su la 'dug kyang log chos yin/ /mdo sngags lta spyod dang 'gal ba/ /spyod pa de dag log pa'i bshes/ /khal bkal dud 'gro gsod pa dang / /so nams khe spogs rngon la sogs/ /srid pa'i las yin 'di ni 'os/ /'di 'drar sdig pa med smra ba/ /de dag bdud kyi pho nya yin/ /sdig la sdig tu ma shes na/ /de yi sdig pa mu mtha' med/ /sdig tu shes nas gnong zhing 'gyod/ /'bras bu yang ba nyid du 'gyur/ /skra dkar gnyer ma lhags pa dang / /nad sogs lus kyi lang tsho nyams/ //gzhan dag shi ba mthong zhing thos/ /nam zla dus bzhi/'i 'gyur ldog ston/ /'di dag lha yi pho nyar gsungs/ /gal te mtho ris 'gro 'dod na/ /de rgyu myur du sgrubs shig ces/ /yang yang skul bar byed

246 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/pa bzhin/ /'di yang rgyal ba'i phrin las yin/ /chos la bskul ba'i gtam ste dang pho// //gal te 'chi la mi 'jigs kyang / /las kyi 'bras bur 'jigs par blta / /las 'bras mngon sum myong dus su/ /gzhan la bgo bsha' byar yod min/ /med dang brlag par byed mi nus/ /rang gis byas pa rang la smin/ /nam yang chud zos 'gyur ba min/ /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab tsam gyi phyir/ /ngal ba du ma khyad bsad na/ /'jig rten pha rol bde ba'i rgyu/ /mi sgrub gang de phyugs las blun/ /tshe 'dir mi bde chung ngu yang / /'bad pa du mas sbong byed na/ /skye pa gtan gyi sdug bsngal rgyu/ /shes ldan su zhig sgrub par phod/ /zang zing chu yi lbu ba 'dra/ /bsags pa thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu/ /gang la chog shes mnga' ba de/ /nor bu'i gter mdzod 'chang ba 'dra/ /phyug po phal cher ser snas bcings/ /dbul po las kyang sems khong dog /de lta'i bsags pa dgra bos spyod/ /brkam chags me ltar 'bar ba'i yid/ /mi bde'i zug rngu bcas te 'chi/ /pha yis sdig pas bsags pa'i nor/ /bu tsha sogs la phog snyam yang / /sems can rang rang las 'bras la /spyod pa nyid phyir phan pa dkon/ /rang la sbyin 'bras yod pa na/ /dbul po'i bu yang phyug por 'gro/ /rang la sbyin pa'i 'bras med na/ /rgyal rgyud sprang du 'khyams pa mang / /shin tu gces pa'i dngos po dang / /'bral mi phod pa'i grogs dag kyang / /nam zhig nges par bor dgos na/ /thams cad gtong ba mnyam po la/ /spyin pas bsod nams chen po bskyed/ /chags dang ser snas bsdoms pa yi /longs spyod rnams ni gsog cing 'dzad/ /chags med sbyin la dga' ba rnams/ /ji tsam gtong ba de tsam 'phel/ /rku 'phrog ser sna'i dbang gis ni/ /gsog pa po la

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 247sbyin pa nyung / /sbyin pa po la ster ba mang / /'byor pa sgrub la'ang 'gal rkyen mang / /des na 'phral dang yun dag tu/ /bsags pa zad 'gyur sbyin pa 'phel/ /legs spyod gzhan pa'ang de dang mtshungs/ /gzhan la phan dang phyi mar bde/ /las de dge ba kho na yin/ /gzhan la gnod cing pha rol tu/ /sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur mi dge ba/ /zhib par brtags nas blang dor bya/ /'phral snang tsam la yid mi rton / /zhing dang bsam pa rnam dag na/ /nas bre gang gi sbyin pas kyang / /mtho ris bde skyid tshad med myong / /bsnyen gnas nyin gcig bsrungs pas kyang / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal bar byed/ /de bzhin log lta yud cig gam/ /tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal lan cig gis/ /mnar med dmyal sogs ngan 'gror 'gro/ /srog gcig bcad pas srog gi lan/ /dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'khor/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod dka' myong / /dad pas rgyal la dmigs pa yi/ /me tog gcig tsam mkhar phul bas/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /las kyi tshul ni bsam mi khyab/ /rnam par smin pa'ang tshad bzung med/ /de bas las la yid ches byos/ /dmag gi g.yul ngo bsham pa dang / /bya dang ri dwags rngon pa dang / /rgya yis nya rnams bgor ba ste/ /gsum po mthu chen las su gsungs/ /tshe thung ba dang nad mang dang / /dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu chen po/ /rims sogs dus min 'chi ba dang / /mi bzadatshosdug bsngal sna tshogs skyed/ /srog gcod mang dang log g.yem dga'/ /sku gzugs glegs bam mchod rten bzhig /dge 'dun 'tsho ba 'phrog byed pa/ /'di bzhis 'phral du tshe thung zhing / /ngan song gnas su rtag par 'khor/ /nges par gsad bya gtong ba dang / /dbul po rnams la zas gos sbyin/ /dpya khral yang bar byed pa dang / /nya dang ri dwags 'tshe spangs pa/ /'di bzhis 'chi bdag 'phral du

248 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bzlog /'khor ba'i mthar thug bde ba 'thob/ /spong dang klog pa'i sde 'dzugs shing / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab glegs bam 'bri/ /sngon med gtsug lag khang byed pa/ /'di gsum 'dus byas dge ba ni/ /kun las 'phags pa'i bsod nams yin/ /bla ma dang ni rten gsum dang / /dge 'dun rnams la yon 'bul zhing / /phongs pa'i longs spyod gtong bar bya/ /dge 'dun la brten chos gnas pas/ /dge dang sdig pa gang bsags kyang / /sku gzugs mchod rten sogs las kyang / /rnam smin dge 'dun kho na che/ /gtong dang yongs su spyad pa yi/ /rnam smin gnyis 'thob gzhan dag la/ /gtong ba'i bsod nams 'ba' zhig go /rab byung khyim par bzlog pa dang / /ngur smrig rtags tsam 'dzin pa yang / /rdeg gsod 'ching sogs byed pa na/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /lha khang rten gsum chos smra dang / /dge 'dun rnams kyi longs spyod dag /ma byin par ni len byed na/ /las 'di shin tu sbyang bar dka'/ /srog chags bye ba gsod kyang sla'i/ /dkon mchog gsum la sdig bsags pa/ /de dag sbyang du med par gsungs/ /pha ma nad pa mang du thos/ /ting 'dzin sgom dang chos smra ba/ /ye shes ldan dang tshul khrims ldan/ /dbul po bla ma dam pa ste/ /'di dgu zhing gi dam pa yin/ /gzungs sngags bzla zhing swātstsha 'debs/ /mdo klog sku gzugs glegs bam byed/ /sems bskyed stong pa nyid bsgom pa/ /sdig pa sbyang la stobs che ba'i/ /gnyen po'i sgo ni de drug yin/ /skyabs su song zhing sems bskyed la/ /sngar byas sdig la gnong zhing 'gyod / /srog la babs kyang phyin chad bsdam/ /dge ba mang po'i grogs dang bcas/ /khyad par bzhi ldan bshags pa yis/ /sdig pa'i ri bo'ang 'joms par nus/ /zla rer bsnyen gnas len pa dang / /dus su 'tshe ba thams cad spang / /dad

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 249pas dkon mchog rnams la bkur/ /rtag tu bsam pa bzang po bsten/ /byas pa drin du gzo ba de/ /khyim pa'i legs spyod rnam lnga po/ /gang zhig bdag nyid spyod byed cing / /gzhan yang de la 'god pa na/ /tshe ring nad med grags pa thob 'chi ba na yang mya ngan chung / /shi nas mtho ris gnas su 'gro/ /chos kyis tshe 'dir phun tshogs 'thob/ /skye bo kun kyang de la 'dun/ /bde bar gnyid log bde bar sad/ /'chi khar 'gyod pa mi 'byung zhing / /'jig rten gzhan du bde rgyas 'gyur/ /sems ni ma rig sbubs su 'thums/ /chags sdang rnam par rtog pas bcings/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni/ /byas tshad 'khor ba ngan song rgyu/ /zag bcas dge bar rlom rnams kyang / /'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu byed na/ /las gzhan lta yang smos ci dgos/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /sems nyid dri ma med par 'tshal/ /dug gi rtsa ba ma btsugs na/ /sdong po rgyas par ga la 'gyur/ /rgyu 'bras blang dor ji bzhin nyid/ /'phags min so skye'i spyod yul min/ /rang 'dod g.yo zol ma 'dres pa'i/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis/ /ci byas mtho ris thar pa'i rgyu/ /dge ba de la mdo ru zungs/ /las 'bras blang dor gyi gtam ste gnyis pa'o //gang zhig khyim na gnas pa'am/ /rab tu byung ba yin kyang rung / /dam pa'i chos ni thos par bya/ /dam chos tshig gcig thos pas kyang / /thar pa'i sgo chen 'byed par byed/ /yid ni dge bas 'dun byed kyang / /chos mi shes pa dmus long 'dra/ /tshad med snying rje chen po dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /stong pa nyid la blo sbyong ba/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir 'dus so/ /gang blo 'du 'dzis rnam g.yengs pa/ /de blo pha rol phyin la sogs/ /dge chos mang po slob mi nus/ /

250 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/chos gcig la ni g.yar dam bya/ /de ni byang chub sems mchog go /sems bskyed rtsa ba snying rje ste/ /de yang byams pa'i rgyu las byung / /thog mar de nyid goms pa'i phyir/ /nye ring bar ma'i 'gro kun la/ /sdang dang khong khro bskyed mi bya/ /zhe sdang skad cig bskyed pas kyang / /bskal pa mang po'i dge rtsa gcod/ /srog chags grog sbur tshun chad rnams/ /pha ma yid 'ong 'ba' zhig bsgom/ /gnod byed la yang mi khro zhing / /gdon sogs la yang 'drer mi 'dzin/ /rtag tu byams sems kho na bskyed/ /de nas de dag sdug bsngal ba'i/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul bsams pas/ /bzod med snying rje shugs kyis 'byung / /sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod blo/ /bcos min skyes tshe byang chub kyi/ /sems mchog bla med bskyed par bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rgyal po la/ /gdams pa'i mdo las 'di skad gsungs/ /rgyal po khyod ni bya byed mang / /sbyin sogs re rer slob mi nus/ /'gro 'dug nyal dang 'greng yang rung / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub la/ /'dun dang dad pas don gnyer zhing / /gzhan gyi dge la yi rang nas/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /dge rtsa de yang 'gro kun dang / /thun mong nyid du byas nas ni/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams yongs su rdzogs 'gyur bar/ /de ltar byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de ltar byas na rgyal srid kyi/ /bya ba las kyang mi nyams la/ /byang chub tshogs kyang rdzogs zhes gdams/ /theg chen chos kyi snying po ste/ /'dun pas don gnyer yod phyin chad/ /de tsam nyams len dka' ba'ang min/ /byams dang snying rje med pa'i mis/ /chos byas par yang gol sar lhung / /de bas sangs rgyas 'dod phyin chad/ /snying rje chen po ma spongs shig /mi nus snyam dang mi khom snyam/ /gzhan dbang shor dang phyi bshol lus/ /sgyid lug pa dang rang

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 251mthong che/ /mi bden snyam dang long yod byed/ /brgyad po 'di ni chos kyi gegs/ /'phrad 'dir rang gzhan thams cad 'gag /'chi khar 'gyod mi dgos pa nyung / /bza' btung tsam gyi phyir yang ni/ /gzhan lus dum bur gtub phod cing / /srog gcod pa la mtshar du brtsi/ /sdig zas sha khrag rgyun mi chad/ /zug rngu til gyi shun pa tsam/ /rang gi lus sems thog mi bzod/ /byang sems 'di 'drar mchi ma dku/ /chos pa zer yang tshig tsam yin/ /rgyal bas yang nas yang bsngags pa'i/ /lag tu lon nges rgyu 'bras kyi/ /spang blang rtsa bzhin dor nas su/ /lag tu mi lon rtsa thig rlung / /bskyed rdzogs chos skad mthon po dang / /las dang dngos grub sgrub pa dang / /grub 'bras mngon shes ngu laphyul sogs/ /dran tshad smyon pa ltar spyod pa'i/ /snyigs ma'i chos par yid brtan med/ /phal cher de 'dras bslus pa mang / /'ong kyang log lta skur 'debs spang / /rjes su mi 'jug dag snang sbyong / /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di 'drar/ /las 'bras tshul bzhin brtsi ba dang / /rang 'dod g.yo zol/ med pa zhig /byung na kun las de ngo mtshar/ /snying rjes rang la byams pa dang / /spyin pas dbang du 'du ba dang / /bsgom bzlas dgra gdon thul ba sogs/ /blo chung phal cher chos byas pa'i/ /'bras bu tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod/ /rang 'dod thog tu ma khel na/ /dge rtsa bsgrub la yi chad bsgom/ /tshe 'di'i bde sdug sngon gyi las/ /da lta'i las rnams phyi mar smin/ /nam phugs dge 'bras mi bslu bas/ /phyi ma yod par yid ches 'tshal/ /da rung spyod mchog mdor bsdu na/ /zhe gnag g.yo sgyu spangs pa yi/ /rnam kun rang sems dri med pa/ /phan 'dod lhag bsam dang ldan pas/ /phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang ni/ /yan lag bdun pa ci nus bya/ /zab mo'i smon lam mang du gdab/ /blo yis ji ltar nus pa

252 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/bzhin/ /stong pa nyid dang snying rje bsgom/ /thar par bgrod pa'i nyams len tshang / /stong nyid sgom lugs mang yod kyang / /rang sems stong nyid legs rtogs na/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyi bar lag 'gyel/ /'khrul grol mdud pa rmang nas zhig /sems 'di gdod nas stong nyid yin/ /bcos nas gsar du bsgom pa min/ /'khor 'das snang cha ci shar yang / /thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul las/ /gud na gcig kyang yod pa min/ /dpyad nas stong nyid bsgom pa kun / /khang stong phyi nas bshigs pa 'dra/ /sems thog 'jog nas sgom byed pa/ /khang stong nang du phyin dang mtshungs/ /stong nyid rtogs la nye ba yin/ /bde sdug kun gyi byed pa po/ /da lta'i rnam par rtog 'di yin/ /spros bral chos sku zer ba yang / /rig stong zang thal las gzhan med/ /rnam rtog dang ni rang rig kyang / /bzang ngan ya bral tha dad min/ /rang ngo rig dang ma rig khyad/ /gal te bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs 'di/ /rtogs par bya zhes dam 'cha' na/ /nges 'byung blo dang snying rje che/ /mos gus byin rlabs 'gug nus shig /ma skyes bar du gnas lugs don/ /ji bzhin nyid du mi rtogs shing / /phyogs tsam mthong ba'ang yang dag min/ /'jog sgom pa la 'di gal che/ /'gyu byed yid kyi shes pa kun/ /phyi ma ma skyes snga ma 'gags/ /bar der ci yang mi mno yang / /gsal rig 'gag pa med pa'i sems/ /nyams su myong yang brjod pa bral/ /de la ngos bzung med par zhog /dgag sgrub bzo bcos bya mi 'tshal/ /de las rtog pa ci shar yang / /ngos bzung rang grol ngang du bzhag /'byongs na gnyen po med par grol/ /bde sdug chags sdang nyon mongs sogs/ /myong mkhan ngo bo rtsad bcad la/ /shes pas yul phyir mi 'brang bar/ /gshis lugs stong pa'i ngang du gzhil/ /

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 253goms nas skyon du mi blta bar/ /thad sor bzhag pas snang ba nyid/ /rang log ye shes chen por 'char/ /rnam rtog bskyar grol med pa'i tshe/ /las dang rnam smin dbyings su zhi/ /de bar stong nyid phyogs mthong yang / /las dang rnam smin dag la 'dzem/ /'gyur med rig pa so zin na/ /chos sku lhun grub chen por 'byams de bar sgom du med 'dra yang / /mos gus dran shes mi 'bral gces/ /rang lugs sgom du shar ba'i tshe/ /nyams len gzhan nas 'tshol mi dgos/ /'char sgo thams cad stong pa'i rtsal/ /shar dus nyid nas rang grol gyi/ /gnad mtshang ji bzhin rig pa'i tshe/ /rjes 'ded byis pa'i las su go /ngo shes tsam gyis chog go lo/ /rnam rtog kha yan spyon pa'i las/ /ma bcos so mar rlom na 'khrul/ /gang shar de kas chog pa ni/ /mi bsgom sgom pa'i mchog yin kyang / /rang rig ngo bo ma 'brul dgos/ /'khrul na don med lung ma bstan/ /'khrul yang chog pa'i thag chod can/ /sgom chen tshad du phyin pa yin/ /rang sems gnas sam 'gyu yang rung / /dran pa yengs med thabs kyi mchog /yengs kyang ma 'khrul gdeng rnyed na/ /gnas pa logs su 'tshol mi dgos/ /rnam rtog byed rtsol ci yang rung / /shar dang byed las thim pa kun/ /dbyings las rdul tsam ma g.yos par/ /rtogs nas bya rgyu zad pa na/ /bsgom bya sgom byed rang sar dag /ma bcos so ma'ang ming du zad/ /snang ba sgom du 'char zhes grags/ /'on kyang de ltar rtogs pa la/ /sgom gyi mgo rkang tshang ba yis/ /byed blo rang sar grol grol du/ /bsgom skyes bdag med ma song bar/ /yug sas dwa phrug 'tsho ba bzhin/ /skyong bran brtson mthar phyin pa dgos/ /sgra phyir 'brang pa'i go yul dang / /rtog dpyod blo yis don mi mthong rang sems skyong ma thag pa nas/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs min kyang / /thog mar don

254 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/spyi'i tshul du go /bar du phyogs tsam nyams su myong / /tha mar ji bzhin rtogs nas su/ /tshig dang dpe las 'das pa yi/ /stong nyid don gyi dam pa rtogs/ /re dogs 'phrang las thar bar 'gyur/ /bden zhen a 'thas phyir phyir dam/ /gal chen bya ba nyin bzhin 'phel/ /chos brgyad ngal stegs bcas bzhin du/ /gnas lugs rtogs par rlom rnams zhabrul/ /chos pa rab mtha' 'jal ba'i srang / /snang bar bden 'dzin che chung yin/ /snang ba sgyu mas bslus ltar song / /gang la'ang ched du mi 'dzin cing / /rlom sems nga rgyal dbyings su zad/ /sgom pa goms pa'i grub rtags so/ /nyams len snying po bsdus pa'i gtam ste gsum pa'o// //lugs kyi bstan bcos ngo mtshar ba/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /chos rgyal mes dbon la sogs pas/ /bka' yi khrims yig rim par mdzad/ /deng sang dus mtha' ches snyigs pas/ /lugs bzhin spyod pa ches dkon yang / /chen po lugs bzhin mi spyod na/ /phal pa rnams ni de bas thu/ /thams cad lugs las 'gong ba na/ /su la'ang bde skyid mi 'byung ngo / /snyigs dus ngan par spyod mang ba/ /spyi yi las yin ldog med kyang / /so sos legs par spyad pa na/ /so so'i thad du bde skyid 'byung / /sngon gyi srog chags bzhi po bzhin/ /de bas phyag tu blang 'os pa/ /lugs shes rnams kyi bstan bcos ni/ /'bral med bsten bya de dag kyang / /glegs bam klog pa tsam min par/ /che thang nyams su bzhes par rigs/ /blo chung nga rgyal can dag ni/ /phan dang drang por smra la khro/ /g.yon can ngo bstod byed la dga'/ /nam phugs rang gzhan gnyis ka brlag /blo ldan bdag la byams pa yi/ /tshig rnams khyad du gsod mi bya/ /rang la dpyod pa'i blo med cing / /phan par smras pa'ang mi nyan na/ /nam yang legs par mi 'byung zhing / /gnod pa'i

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 255rgyun dag 'bab par 'gyur/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong 'gyur na/ /rang gzhan phan pa kun gyi gter/ /chos mi ldan pa'i rgyal srid ni/ /'khor bcas dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i sngon gyi srol/ /phra mo tsam yang bsnub mi bya/ /'bras ldan ljon shing bcad dang mtshungs/ /mi 'os lugs srol gsar pa ni/ /do gal che yang bzhag mi bya/ /dug gi sa bon btab dang mtshungs/ /rang gi 'byor pas chog mi shes/ /gzhan gyi dpal la shin tu sdang / /'khor dang 'bangs la mi byams shing / /yon po'i khrims la dga' ba yi/ /rgyal srid ston ka'i sprin ltar g.yo/ /'bangs rnams nyam thag sdug bsngal na/ /rje bo la ni gus med 'gyur/ /mnga' 'bangs gus par mi byed na/ /gtso bo'i dpal yang rmi lam 'dra/ /dbul na gzhan gyi nor la brkam/ /'byor dang ldan na'ang dgra la dogs/ /ji ltar byas kyang zug rngu can/ /de blo nam yang bde mi 'byung / /bdag nyid nor la dga' ba bzhin/ /'gro ba rnams kyang de la dga'/ /nyes pa phra mor bsnyad 'dogs nas/ /gzhan nor 'phrog par mi bgyi'o/ /mnga' 'bangs shin tu phun tshogs na/ /rgyal po'i phun tshogs de nyid yin/ /'bangs 'khor thams cad dbul gyur na/ /rgyal srid mar ngo'i zla dang mtshungs/ /spyod ngan 'phel na kun la gnod/ /de yang srog la mi gnod par/ /phyi mtha' khegs pa'i tshar gcod bgyid/ /srog ni bdag la gces pa bzhin/ /gzhan yang shin tu gces pa lags/ /bya ba che phra gang yin kyang / /thams cad shin tu ma brtags par/ /mod la brtsam par mi byed cing / /brtsams nas de nyid mtha' ru dbyung / /de bzhin nye ring su yang rung / /legs nyes bar ma'i tshig smras pa/ /brtags nas nges shes 'drongs kyi bar/ /blang dang dor dang brnyas mi bgyi/ /mang thos blo gros stobs la sogasi/ /yon tan ldan na

256 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/kun gyis bkur/ /yon tan med na sus kyang brnyas/ /de bas rang rgyud yon tan spel/ /nor dang ldan la skye bo dga'/ /drin dang ldan la de ltar min/ /ya rabs blo dang ldan pa rnams/ /nor ldan spang nas drin ldan 'tshol/ /tha shal byas pa mi gzo bas/ /phan btags lan du gnod pa skyel/ /gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba ni/ /dam pa'i spyod bzang bla na med/ /rang gis bya ba nyes pa la/ /gzhan gyis gshe yang khro mi bgyid/ /de nyid gzhan gyi skyon ma yin/ /rang gi blo gros nyes pa'i skyon/ /de la brten nas bsam sbyor ni/ /phyin chad shin tu bag yod bya/ /tshig rtsub kyis ni kun dang 'gras/ /bden par smras pas skyon can 'khrugs/ /lkog lab mang na mi rtsis chung / /rdzun gyis rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu/ /smra mang rang gzhan rgyud dkrugs pas/ /mang po'i nang du ngag bsrung la/ /gcig pur sdod na spyod lam bsrung / /rnam pa kun tu rang gi sems/ /legs par bsrung ba nyid du bya/ /de yis rang nyid mi nyams la/ /mang pos bkur ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /g.yo sgyus thog mar gzhan bslu la/ /mthar ni rang nyid slu bar byed/ /g.yo med drang por spyod pa de/ /re zhig pham yang mtha' mar rgyal/ /de bas g.yo sgyu spangs nas ni/ /zhi des gsang po'i tshul du spyod/ /kun gyi blo gtad rung bar 'gyur/ /sngar 'dris spang zhing gsar pa 'tshol/ /ngo tsha med cing phyi thag thung / /brtsam pa gang yang mthar mi 'don/ /go sa mtho la shes sgo dma'/ /snyan grags che la yon tan chung / /zhe 'dod rang gi phug tu bcug /gyod kha don med gzhan la bkal/ /rang phyogs min la skur ba 'debs/ /legs par bshad rnams sun 'byin byed/ /phan par bslab na dgra ru 'dzin/ /blo gtad bcas pa'i snying rku zhing / /gsang gtam dgra yi gam du 'chad/ /ko long dam la zur mgo rags/ /gshis ngan sus kyang 'grogs par

zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi/ 257dka'/ /bcol na mi nyan bzhag na slong / /bsdus na 'bros la btang na 'du/ /byas na rung kun mi byed par/ /mi 'os bya ba ci yang byed/ /kye ma dus ngan shugs bdo bas/ /ma rabs rnams ni dbu 'phang mtho/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bde bar 'khrul/ /ngan par spyod rnams bzang por rlom/ /chos pa chos bzhin spyod pa dang / /skye bo lugs bzhin byed pa ni/ /nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du dkon/ /'on kyang chos mthun spyod byed na/ /dus kyi 'gyur bas go mi 'gag /sa chen dbang ba'i mi dpon dang / /srog chags grog sbur phra mo gnyis/ /phyi ma'i gdeng la khyad med cing / /snang ba 'di dag rmi lam 'dra/ /yad yud yin te rtag pa med/ /gang la'ang yid brtan mi thub pas/ /zhen med legs spyod lam du bya/ /lugs kyi blang dor las 'phros pa'i gtam ste bzhi pa'o// / /chos dang srid kyi ring lugs la/ /gzigs pa brgya yis spras pa'i spyan/ /nyi tshe'i tshig la ltos min yang / /'di tsam mdo ru bsdus pa'i tshig /gsung bzang mi ldog phyir du smras/ /kho bo dam pa ma yin zhing / /lugs shes mkhas par chud pa'ang min/ /'on kyang dri med gzhung lugs ni/ /mang thos dpang por bzhag ste bris/ /mdo smad sa yi thig le ni/ /sde bzhi dge bcus skyong mdzad pa'i/ /sa skyong rgyal po'i mdun na 'don/ /rgyal srid chos kyis skyong bzhin du/ /dge la rtag tu thugs gzhol pa/ /gnyer chen bsod nams gsung bskul ngor/ /mang du thos pa'i dge sbyong gzugs/ /ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bris/ /kun kyang legs spyod brtul zhugs kyis/ /thar par bgrod pa'i rkyen du shog /sarba maṅga le// //

dpe skrun smon tshigarig pa'i rdo rje gsung rab mdzod khang nas/ /blo gros mtha' yas mdzod kyi lde mig ces/ /deb phreng 'phrul gyi par du bskrun pa'i dges/ /kun gyi blo gros gter sgo rang dgar 'byed/ /rig pa'i nor bu rigs drug thang mar brdal/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i dbul ba ring du bcil/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i brjod don kha yi rlangs/ /mtha' yas skye 'gro'i blo yi mkha' la 'thul/ /rtogs pa'i chu ris snying rje'i sprin du 'khrigs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa 'i mdzad 'phrin char du bsnyil/ /las nyon mi gtsang dri ma dag par bkrus/ /mngon mtho'i ljang pa lang 'tsho rab tu smin/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi skya rengs ngang gis shar/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i go skabs dbyings su nub/ /kun mkhyen rta bdun dbang pos mdun bsus nas/ /chos kyi 'bor lo'i 'od zer 'bum du spros/ /ma lus sdug kun ljan ljin rab tu skem/ /

260'phags pa'i tshogs kyi pad tshal ci dgar bzhad/ /mchog gsum snang ba mi nub rtag tu brtan/ /rdzogs ldan dpal yon nam mkha'i spun zlar shar/ /snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs mtha' dag cig car zhi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gang / /chos kyi sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas/ /zab rgyas rgyu mthun chos sku yun du gnas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'bras bu chos sku'i go 'phang mngon byed shog /ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod ces pa'i deb phreng rim byon gyi dpe skrun smon tshig tu 'jam mgon bla brang gi mkhan po'i ming tsam 'dzin pa blo gros rnam rgyal ne gis/ phyi lo 2008 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin bris pa dge'o// //

na mogus lasadangapopa yingoboskyongatshul la/ /'dzin pas gtan nasam bsla'abyungazhing/ /dran pa khon gnadaduzab pasan/ /dngapomi yengasasnyam pa'i'aphebatang/ /yengasan de dbangami btangadam bca'abazung/ /dran pashugasa'abyungan dergyun bskyang/ /rangabab gsal stongangangaduganas pa'itshe/ /rangangoshes bcosamed salerabazhag /'phronartog patshural mi 'gugs par/ /ma yengaltas pas gnyug ma'i ngangadugrol/ /tshogs drug rtog pa ji ltar mang na yang /nga blangadagag sgrub med paralam dukhyer/ /dranashes yod na cis kyanga'aching gyur/ /dran rdzi medan yengasa'akhrul dbangadu'agro/ /yengs dngam yengasatsam da paralas/ /bsgomargyu'isemasangozerabaci yangamed/ /rtogs pa'irkyen ni semaskyedamos gus dang/ /tshogasagasog ganga'agrub brtson 'grus bskyed pa dang /jig rten gsum gyimagon porjesa'ajug pa/ /skal ldan dkon mchog bstan skyogs bzhedangor/ /sgrubargyudartaspus+ho'adzin guṇa'imingagis bris/ /nyams letha'aruphyin pa'ibakrashisasdog snga/trī— lpe wa~Xring di bhelkene tre7wa) hūṃ)rke dobyett+waṃng ༄ram̐~X (|(pe tsho snga༄ cidku wa — sprowa snyenghruhūṃsni༄༄nghruri7 (sde — ) snga༄rine)pophro— — rdo()mo/ (ṣe4khaṃXrdergutyā la ni rnge )༷hūṃho/rghaṃX/༷bye khu/———༷༷ ༷༷ nga — sgotrī —da zlo5dugasnye05skre lho
